nodes.summary: Defines the DOMException error type and DOMErrorName enum mapping WebIDL exception names to numeric codes, with serialization support for cross-process error propagation.

nodes.name: domimplementation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOMImplementation interface providing factory methods to create DocumentType nodes, XML/HTML documents, and query feature support per the DOM specification.

nodes.name: domparser.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOMParser interface for parsing XML and HTML markup strings into Document objects, supporting multiple MIME types including text/html, text/xml, and image/svg+xml.

nodes.name: domstringlist.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOMStringList interface providing an ordered, indexed collection of DOMString values with sorted and unsorted construction variants.

nodes.name: domstringmap.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOMStringMap interface for accessing HTML data-* attributes, with camelCase-to-hyphenated bidirectional name conversion per the HTML specification.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains non-trivial case conversion logic for data-* attribute name mapping between camelCase and hyphenated forms.

nodes.name: domtokenlist.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOMTokenList interface for managing space-separated token attributes like classList, with validation, update steps, and optional supported-tokens filtering.

nodes.name: elementinternals.rs

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the Encoding API subsystem, declaring sub-modules for TextDecoder, TextDecoderCommon, TextDecoderStream, TextEncoder, and TextEncoderStream.

nodes.name: textdecoder.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TextDecoder interface per the Encoding specification, decoding byte buffers into strings using configurable encodings with fatal-error and BOM-ignore options.

nodes.name: textdecodercommon.rs
nodes.summary: Shared decoding infrastructure used by both TextDecoder and TextDecoderStream, encapsulating the encoding_rs Decoder, I/O queue, and the core decode algorithm per the Encoding standard.
nodes.languageNotes: Shared component pattern: TextDecoderCommon is composed into both TextDecoder and TextDecoderStream structs.

nodes.name: textdecoderstream.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TextDecoderStream interface as a TransformStream that decodes byte chunks into string chunks, with standalone decode-and-enqueue and flush-and-enqueue algorithm functions.

nodes.name: textencoder.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TextEncoder interface for encoding strings into UTF-8 byte arrays, including the EncodeInto method that writes directly into a pre-allocated Uint8Array.

nodes.name: textencoderstream.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TextEncoderStream interface as a TransformStream that encodes string chunks into UTF-8 byte chunks, with JS value-to-primitive conversion and code-point-level encoding logic.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains JS-to-primitive conversion and code-point-type classification for handling non-BMP characters in encoding.

nodes.name: eventsource.rs

nodes.name: async_runtime.rs
nodes.summary: Manages the Tokio async runtime used by the networking component. Provides functions to initialize the runtime, spawn async and blocking tasks, and hold the runtime handle for coordinated shutdown.

nodes.name: connector.rs
nodes.summary: HTTP connector layer for Servo's networking stack. Defines TLS configuration, certificate error handling, proxy support, and instrumented connectors/streams. Bridges Hyper's HTTP client with Servo's TLS and devtools integration.

nodes.name: cookie.rs
nodes.summary: Implementation of cookie creation, parsing, and matching per RFC 6265. Defines the ServoCookie wrapper with domain matching, path matching, expiry handling, and secure-prefix validation (__Secure-, __Host-). Includes a nom-based cookie date parser.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses nom parser combinators for RFC 6265 cookie-date grammar parsing.

nodes.name: cookie_storage.rs
nodes.summary: Cookie jar storage implementing RFC 6265 storage model. Manages per-domain cookie vectors with eviction policies, secure cookie overlapping prevention, session clearing, and cookie retrieval sorted by path length for HTTP headers.

nodes.name: decoder.rs
nodes.summary: Non-blocking HTTP response body decoder supporting gzip, deflate, brotli, and zstd decompression. Wraps async byte streams and produces decompressed output via the async-compression crate.

nodes.name: devtools.rs
nodes.summary: Integration layer between Servo's networking and the DevTools protocol. Prepares and sends HTTP request/response events (including timing, headers, and body data) to the DevTools control channel for network panel inspection.

nodes.name: embedder.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the NetToEmbedderMsg enum for communication from network threads to the embedder. Includes messages for file picker dialogs, web resource request interception, authentication requests, and cookie operation responses.

nodes.name: filemanager_thread.rs
nodes.summary: File manager for blob URL storage and file I/O operations. Manages a store of in-memory blobs and on-disk file references with reference counting, origin tracking, token-based access, and chunked file reading for the Fetch API.

nodes.name: hosts.rs
nodes.summary: Hosts file parser and resolver. Reads the system hosts file (or a config-specified file) to build an IP address lookup table for hostname resolution, supporting host replacement in network requests.

nodes.name: hsts.rs
nodes.summary: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) implementation. Manages an HSTS list with preload support via finite-state transducers, dynamic entry updates from response headers, and automatic HTTP-to-HTTPS scheme upgrading per the Fetch specification.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the `fst` crate for efficient preload list storage via finite-state transducers.

nodes.name: http_cache.rs
nodes.summary: RFC 7234-compliant in-memory HTTP cache. Implements cache keying by URL, freshness lifetime calculation, conditional request validation, stale-while-revalidate support, and cache eviction with configurable size limits.

nodes.name: http_loader.rs
nodes.summary: Core HTTP fetch implementation following the Fetch specification. Handles request construction, CORS preflight, redirects, authentication, cookie management, HSTS enforcement, content decoding, caching, and response streaming. The primary HTTP loading engine of Servo.

nodes.name: AsyncRuntimeHolder
nodes.summary: Holds an optional Tokio Runtime for coordinated shutdown. Implements the AsyncRuntime trait.

nodes.name: init_async_runtime
nodes.summary: Initializes a Tokio multi-threaded runtime with configurable worker threads, IO, and timers. Stores the runtime handle globally and returns an AsyncRuntime for shutdown.

nodes.name: spawn_task
nodes.summary: Spawns a future onto the global Tokio runtime handle. Panics if the runtime is not initialized.

nodes.name: spawn_blocking_task
nodes.summary: Blocks on a future using the global Tokio runtime handle, returning its output. Used for synchronous bridge into async operations.

nodes.name: ServoHttpConnector
nodes.summary: Servo's HTTP connector wrapping a Hyper HTTP connector with timeout configuration.

nodes.name: TlsHandshakeInfo
nodes.summary: Captures details about a TLS handshake including protocol version, cipher suite, key exchange, and certificate chain.

nodes.name: CertificateErrorOverrideManager
nodes.summary: Manages user overrides for TLS certificate verification errors, allowing specific certificates to be trusted despite verification failures.

nodes.name: create_tls_config

nodes.name: ProxyConnector

nodes.name: create_http_client
nodes.summary: Creates a Hyper HTTP client with the given TLS configuration, including proxy connector and connection pooling.

nodes.name: ServoCookie
nodes.summary: RFC 6265 cookie wrapper with host-only flag, persistence, creation/access timestamps, and expiry. Provides domain matching, path matching, URL appropriateness checks, and cookie date parsing.

nodes.name: CookieStorage
nodes.summary: Per-domain cookie jar with configurable max-per-host limits. Implements cookie insertion, removal, eviction, session clearing, and retrieval sorted by path-specificity per RFC 6265.

nodes.name: Decoder

nodes.name: event_callback
nodes.summary: Central event dispatcher handling all XR session events: session end (resolves end promises, dispatches end event), input source events (selectstart/select/selectend/squeezestart/squeeze/squeezeend), visibility changes, and reference space reset events.
nodes.languageNotes: Monolithic event handler of ~145 lines processing 7+ event types. Dispatches XRSessionEvent, XRInputSourceEvent, and XRReferenceSpaceEvent. Manages end promise resolution, input source add/remove, and reference space reset broadcasting.

nodes.name: raf_callback
nodes.summary: Implements the requestAnimationFrame callback loop. Processes pending render state, updates projection matrix for inline sessions, handles frame events, begins/ends layer rendering, fires registered rAF callbacks, and re-requests the next frame.
nodes.languageNotes: Core rendering loop of ~88 lines driving the entire XR frame lifecycle. Manages render state transitions, layer begin/end frame calls, rAF callback execution with high-res timestamps, and recursive frame re-request.

nodes.name: update_inline_projection_matrix
nodes.summary: Updates the inline (non-immersive) projection matrix based on the active render state's base layer size, depth near/far, and inline vertical FOV using frustum-to-projection conversion.

nodes.name: layers_begin_frame
nodes.summary: Begins a frame for all active layers: calls begin_frame on the base layer and each additional layer with the provided frame data.

nodes.name: layers_end_frame
nodes.summary: Ends a frame for all active layers: calls end_frame on the base layer and each additional layer with the provided frame data.

nodes.name: handle_frame_event
nodes.summary: Processes per-frame events including hit test results: retrieves pending hit test promises, creates XRHitTestSource objects, resolves promises, and applies remaining events to the session backend.

nodes.name: apply_nominal_framerate
nodes.summary: Applies a new nominal framerate to the session. If the session has ended, ignores the update; otherwise sets the framerate and dispatches a frameratechange event.

nodes.name: UpdateRenderState
nodes.summary: WebIDL method to update the session's render state. Validates session state, layer ownership, duplicate layers, inline FOV restrictions, layers feature gate, then clones current state and applies pending changes.
nodes.languageNotes: Comprehensive validation of ~124 lines: checks session liveness, layer session membership, duplicate layer IDs, inline-only FOV restrictions, layers feature gating, and clip plane updates.

nodes.name: RequestAnimationFrame
nodes.summary: WebIDL method registering a callback for the next animation frame. Assigns a unique rAF ID and pushes the callback onto the pending callback list.

nodes.name: CancelAnimationFrame
nodes.summary: WebIDL method cancelling a previously requested animation frame by removing the callback with the given ID from both pending and current callback lists.

nodes.name: RequestReferenceSpace
nodes.summary: WebIDL method requesting a reference space of a given type. Validates feature requirements (viewer/local/local-floor/bounded-floor), creates the appropriate XRReferenceSpace or XRBoundedReferenceSpace, and resolves via Promise.
nodes.languageNotes: Validates that immersive sessions support the requested reference space type, checks granted feature flags, and restricts certain types (viewer, bounded-floor) to immersive-only sessions.

nodes.name: End
nodes.summary: WebIDL method to end the XR session. Creates a promise, marks the session as ended, resolves immediately if no pending end, calls the backend to end the session, and cleans up input sources.

nodes.name: RequestHitTestSource
nodes.summary: WebIDL method requesting a hit test source. Validates the hit-test feature grant, extracts the space and optional offset ray, queues a hit test request on the backend, and returns a Promise.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive validation of hit-test request parameters: checks feature grant, validates space and offset ray, resolves entity types filter, and manages hit test ID allocation.

nodes.name: GetSupportedFrameRates
nodes.summary: WebIDL method returning the session's supported frame rates as a Float32Array. Returns None if the backend does not support frame rate queries.

nodes.name: UpdateTargetFrameRate
nodes.summary: WebIDL method to update the target frame rate. Validates the rate is supported, replaces any pending update promise, creates an IPC callback to apply the framerate changes asynchronously, and returns a Promise.
nodes.languageNotes: Handles concurrent framerate update requests by replacing pending promises. Creates a ProfileGenericCallback to queue a DOM task that applies the new framerate via the IPC backend.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates the native XRSessionEvent instance by constructing the parent Event and storing the associated XRSession reference.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a fully reflected XRSessionEvent DOM object with event type, bubble/cancelable flags, and the associated XRSession.

nodes.name: new_with_proto
nodes.summary: Creates an XRSessionEvent with a specified prototype, handling DOM reflection, event initialization, and type atom binding for proper event dispatch.

nodes.name: Constructor
nodes.summary: WebIDL constructor extracting 'type' and 'session' from the init dictionary, then delegating to new_with_proto for event creation with proper atom conversion.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates the native XRSpace instance by constructing the parent EventTarget, storing the session reference, and initializing the input source as None.

nodes.name: new_inputspace_inner
nodes.summary: Creates the native XRSpace for input sources, constructing the parent EventTarget, storing session and input source references, and the grip space flag.

nodes.name: new_inputspace
nodes.summary: Creates a fully reflected XRSpace DOM object for input sources, handling DOM reflection and box allocation for the input space instance.

nodes.name: space
nodes.summary: Resolves the WebXR BaseSpace enumeration for this XRSpace by downcasting to specific types (XRReferenceSpace, XRJointSpace, or input source) and returning the appropriate base space.

nodes.name: get_pose
nodes.summary: Computes the pose of this XRSpace relative to a base pose by dispatching to the appropriate space type or input source, extracting grip origin or target ray origin transforms from frame input data.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates the native XRSystem instance, initializing the parent EventTarget, pending/active session tracking, gamepad list, test field, and pipeline ID reference.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a fully reflected XRSystem DOM object, initializing it with the window's pipeline ID for IPC communication with the XR backend.

nodes.name: end_session
nodes.summary: Ends an active XR session: clears the immersive session if matching, dirties layers, removes from inline sessions, and resets the active immersive session state.

nodes.name: IsSessionSupported
nodes.summary: WebIDL method checking if a given XR session mode is supported. Creates a Promise, sets up an IPC callback to the XR registry, and resolves with the support result from the backend.

nodes.name: RequestSession
nodes.summary: WebIDL method to request an XR session. Validates user interaction for immersive sessions, checks no pending/active session exists, processes required/optional features (adds viewer and local defaults), creates IPC channels, and queries the XR registry backend.
nodes.languageNotes: Comprehensive session request handling of ~108 lines: enforces user activation requirement for immersive sessions, manages pending session state, processes feature strings (required/optional), sets up bidirectional IPC channels (frame receiver and session response), and integrates with the WebXR registry.

nodes.name: session_obtained
nodes.summary: Callback invoked when a session is obtained from the backend. Creates the XRSession DOM object, adds it to inline sessions or sets it as the active immersive session, resolves the request promise, and triggers initial input setup.

nodes.name: dispatch_sessionavailable
nodes.summary: Dispatches a sessionavailable event by queuing a DOM task that fires the event on the XRSystem with the initial immersive session reference.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates the native XRTest instance with an initialized reflector and an empty device connection list.

nodes.name: device_obtained
nodes.summary: Callback when a simulated device is obtained from the backend. Creates a FakeXRDevice wrapper, adds it to the connected devices list, and resolves/rejects the promise accordingly.

nodes.name: SimulateDeviceConnection
nodes.summary: WebIDL method to simulate an XR device connection for testing. Validates input parameters (supportsSession, views, supportedFeatures, world), creates a Promise, sets up IPC profiling callbacks, and communicates with the WebXR registry backend.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive test simulation of ~110 lines. Validates device configuration parameters, deserializes view projections, resolves feature strings, and configures world sensing data. Creates a ProfileGenericCallback for IPC communication with the WebXR registry.

nodes.name: DisconnectAllDevices
nodes.summary: WebIDL method disconnecting all simulated XR devices. Resolves immediately if none connected; otherwise creates a Promise, disconnects each device via IPC, and resolves when all devices have disconnected.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a reference-counted approach to track disconnected devices: decrements a shared counter in each device disconnect callback and resolves the promise when all devices report disconnection.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates the native XRView instance, initializing the DOM reflector, storing the session, eye type, viewport index, perspective projection, view transform, and viewport scale cell.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a fully reflected XRView DOM object. Optionally transforms the view using a to-base rigid transform, creates an XRRigidTransform from the cast transform, and reflects into the DOM.

nodes.name: ProjectionMatrix
nodes.summary: WebIDL getter returning the view's projection matrix as a Float32Array. Lazily initializes and caches the matrix data from the perspective projection.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates the native XRViewerPose instance by constructing the parent XRPose with the given rigid transform and initializing an empty views heap.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a fully reflected XRViewerPose DOM object. Builds the views array for both inline (single view) and immersive (left/right eye per view) rendering, transforms with to-base matrix, reflects into DOM, and stores views as a JS array.
nodes.languageNotes: Large constructor of ~150 lines handling both inline and immersive view configurations. Generates XRView instances for each eye (None/Left/Right) from the viewer pose's view data, applies to-base transforms, and manages the auto-realm for cross-origin JS object creation.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates the native XRViewport instance with an initialized reflector and the device-pixel viewport rectangle.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a fully reflected XRViewport DOM object from a device-pixel viewport rectangle, allocating and reflecting the DOM object.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates the native XRWebGLBinding instance with an initialized reflector and stored references to the XR session and WebGL rendering context.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a fully reflected XRWebGLBinding DOM object with a specified prototype, storing the session and WebGL rendering context references.

nodes.name: Constructor
nodes.summary: WebIDL constructor for XRWebGLBinding. Validates the WebGL context base, checks session is not ended and context is not lost, and ensures the session is not immersive (inline-only restriction).

nodes.name: convert
nodes.summary: Converts WebIDL XRWebGLLayerInit options into the backend's SessionInit layer creation parameters (antialias, depth, stencil, alpha, ignoreDepthValues).

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates the native XRWebGLLayer instance by constructing the parent XRLayer, storing the session, initializing layer options (antialias, depth, stencil, alpha, ignore-depth-values) from init, and storing the optional framebuffer.

nodes.name: size
nodes.summary: Returns the layer's framebuffer size. Falls back to the framebuffer's actual size or the WebGL context drawing buffer size as a default.

nodes.name: begin_frame
nodes.summary: Begins rendering a frame by binding the XR swap-chain textures into the WebGL framebuffer. Handles color texture attachment (with saved framebuffer restore), optional depth/stencil attachment, and texture target configuration.
nodes.languageNotes: Critical rendering pipeline method of ~65 lines. Binds WebXR-provided textures into WebGL framebuffer at COLOR_ATTACHMENT0 and DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT, saves/restores previous framebuffer state, and sends WebGL commands for texture binding.

nodes.name: end_frame
nodes.summary: Ends rendering a frame by detaching XR textures from the WebGL framebuffer (setting attachments to None) and flushing the WebGL context to ensure commands are submitted.

nodes.name: Constructor
nodes.summary: WebIDL constructor for XRWebGLLayer. Validates session/context state, computes recommended framebuffer resolution for immersive sessions, creates a WebGL framebuffer, registers the layer with the backend, flushes the context, and returns the initialized layer.
nodes.languageNotes: Comprehensive constructor of ~58 lines. Validates session liveness, computes immersive framebuffer resolution from the backend, creates a WebGLFramebuffer via maybe_new_webxr, registers the layer via IPC, flushes WebGL, and handles optional framebuffer storage.

nodes.name: GetViewport
nodes.summary: WebIDL method returning the viewport for a given XRView. Validates view/session match, retrieves viewports from the session backend, and creates the appropriate XRViewport for the view's viewport index.

nodes.name: ColorTexture
nodes.summary: WebIDL getter returning the color texture as a DomRoot from the stored WebGL texture reference.

nodes.name: assert.rs
nodes.summary: Provides two lightweight assertion helpers (assert_in_layout, assert_in_script) to enforce thread-safety guarantees in the Servo script bindings layer.

nodes.name: assert_in_layout
nodes.summary: Asserts that the current thread is the layout thread, used to guard DOM access from layout.

nodes.name: assert_in_script
nodes.summary: Asserts that the current thread is the script thread, used to guard DOM access from script.

nodes.name: callback.rs
nodes.summary: Defines infrastructure for JavaScript callback invocation from Rust, including CallbackObject for rooting JS callbacks, ExceptionHandling strategies, and call-setup helpers with realm and incumbent tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses SpiderMonkey JSAPI directly for rooting, realm management, and exception handling.

nodes.name: CallbackObject
nodes.summary: Owns a rooted JS callback value with permanent rooting and incumbent global tracking for safe GC integration.

nodes.name: CallbackContainer
nodes.summary: Generic container trait for callback holders providing access to the underlying callback and incumbent scope.

nodes.name: CallbackFunction
nodes.summary: Wraps a single JS callback function object for IDL callback function types.

nodes.name: CallbackInterface
nodes.summary: Wraps a JS object implementing an IDL callback interface with support for get_callable_property.

nodes.name: call_setup
nodes.summary: Generic callback invocation setup: enters the correct realm, runs script policy checks, and invokes the callback with exception handling.

nodes.name: get_callable_property
nodes.summary: Retrieves a callable property from a callback interface object by name, with type checking.

nodes.name: cell.rs
nodes.summary: Provides DomRefCell and related borrow guards for interior mutability of DOM objects with script/layout thread safety assertions.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements custom RefCell-like borrowing with layout-thread-safe bypass methods and GC tracing support.

nodes.name: DomRefCell
nodes.summary: DOM-safe RefCell wrapper providing borrow/borrow_mut with script-thread assertions, layout-thread bypass methods, and GC trace support.

nodes.name: borrow_for_layout
nodes.summary: Borrows the cell for layout thread access, bypassing standard borrow guards with an unsafe unchecked borrow.

nodes.name: constant.rs
nodes.summary: Defines ConstantSpec and ConstantVal for representing IDL constant definitions and their JS value mapping, plus define_constants for installing them on JS objects.

nodes.name: ConstantSpec
nodes.summary: Specification for a single WebIDL constant with its name, value, and JS conversion.

nodes.name: ConstantVal
nodes.summary: Enum of supported IDL constant value types: Int, Uint, Double, Bool, and Null.

nodes.name: define_constants
nodes.summary: Installs a set of ConstantSpec values as properties on a JS object via the SpiderMonkey JSAPI.

nodes.name: constructor.rs
nodes.summary: Implements WebIDL constructor invocation, interface object creation (namespace, callback, non-callback), and post-GC barrier cache management.
nodes.languageNotes: Manages post-GC barrier caching for prototype/interface object arrays using raw pointer manipulation.

nodes.name: NamespaceInit
nodes.summary: Configuration for initializing a WebIDL namespace interface object with static methods, constants, and attributes.

nodes.name: InterfaceInit
nodes.summary: Configuration for initializing a standard WebIDL interface with prototype class, methods, constants, attributes, and unscopables.

nodes.name: create_interface
nodes.summary: Creates the full interface object hierarchy (prototype + constructor) for a WebIDL interface, handling multiple InitType variants.

nodes.name: create_namespace_interface_objects
nodes.summary: Creates the JS objects for a WebIDL namespace interface, including constructor and prototype.

nodes.name: conversions.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the WebIDL-to-JS and JS-to-WebIDL type conversion layer with traits for safe conversion, prototype checking, DOM class extraction, and array-like detection.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive use of Rust trait-based polymorphism for generic JS-to-DOM type conversions with prototype chain verification.

nodes.name: IDLInterface
nodes.summary: Trait for IDL interface types with a derives method returning prototype check depth for interface inheritance verification.

nodes.name: PrototypeCheck
nodes.summary: Enum controlling prototype chain verification strategy: Derive (automatic) or Depth (manual depth spec).

nodes.name: private_from_proto_check
nodes.summary: Extracts the private DOM pointer from a JS object after verifying it belongs to the expected DOM class via prototype check, with cross-compartment unwrapping.

nodes.name: get_dom_class
nodes.summary: Retrieves the DOMJSClass from a JS object, handling both regular DOM objects and DOM proxy wrappers.

nodes.name: is_array_like
nodes.summary: Determines if a JS value is array-like by checking against known DOM collection types (DOMTokenList, FileList, HTMLCollection, NodeList, etc.).

nodes.name: dom.rs
nodes.summary: Defines internal DOM pointer types MutDom, UnrootedDom, and MutNullableDom for safe, unrooted DOM references with thread safety assertions and upcast/downcast support.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of unsafe pointer manipulation for zero-cost DOM object references that bypass GC rooting.

nodes.name: MutDom
nodes.summary: Mutable DOM pointer backed by UnsafeCell for interior mutability with script-thread assertion guards.

nodes.name: UnrootedDom
nodes.summary: Unrooted DOM pointer supporting upcast (transmute to parent type) and downcast (type-checked transmute) operations.

nodes.name: MutNullableDom
nodes.summary: Nullable mutable DOM pointer with lazy initialization via or_init and script-thread safety assertions.

nodes.name: domstring.rs
nodes.summary: Core DOMString type implementing the WebIDL DOMString specification with multi-representation storage (Rust String, JSString reference, Latin-1 vector), encoding support, and extensive string manipulation methods.
nodes.languageNotes: Internal representation uses an enum with three variants: Rust (owned heap string), JSString (reference to GC-managed JS string), Latin1Vec (owned Latin-1 bytes). Lazy conversion between representations.

nodes.name: DOMString
nodes.summary: The main DOMString type implementing WebIDL DOMString with multi-backing storage and 40+ methods including whitespace handling, case conversion, parsing, and comparison.

nodes.name: DOMStringType
nodes.summary: Internal enum representing the three backing storage variants of a DOMString: Rust (owned String), JSString (GC-managed JS string), or Latin1Vec (owned Latin-1 byte vector).

nodes.name: from_js_string
nodes.summary: Creates a DOMString from a JS string, choosing Latin1 or Rust backing based on the string's encoding, with GC rooting.

nodes.name: strip_leading_and_trailing_ascii_whitespace
nodes.summary: Strips leading and trailing ASCII whitespace from the DOMString, mutating in place.

nodes.name: normalize_crlf
nodes.summary: Normalizes CRLF line endings to LF, handling the WebIDL text normalization algorithm.

nodes.name: error.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Error enum mapping all standard WebIDL/DOM exception names and provides throw_invalid_this / throw_constructor_without_new helper functions.

nodes.name: Error
nodes.summary: Comprehensive enum of all standard DOM exception types (IndexSize, NotFound, Syntax, Security, Network, Abort, Timeout, QuotaExceeded, Type, Range, JSFailed, and 20+ more).

nodes.name: throw_invalid_this
nodes.summary: Throws a TypeError when a method is called on an object that does not implement the expected interface.

nodes.name: finalize.rs
nodes.summary: Implements DOM object finalization hooks (finalize_common, finalize_global, finalize_weak_referenceable) that run during GC to drop Rust-side memory and clear proto/iface caches.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses raw pointer dereferencing and Box::from_raw to reclaim Rust heap memory during SpiderMonkey GC finalization callbacks.

nodes.name: finalize_common
nodes.summary: Common DOM object finalization: drops the Rust heap allocation and calls drop_memory on the reflector.

nodes.name: finalize_global
nodes.summary: Finalizes a DOM global scope object, clearing proto/iface caches before dropping the heap allocation.

nodes.name: guard.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Guard and Condition system for WebIDL [Exposed] and [Pref] extended attributes, conditionally exposing interface members based on global scope, preference flags, and secure context.

nodes.name: Guard
nodes.summary: A guarded value with a list of Conditions that must all be satisfied for the value to be accessible.

nodes.name: Condition
nodes.summary: Enum of exposure conditions: Func (custom function), Pref (preference flag), Exposed (global scope), SecureContext, or always Satisfied.

nodes.name: expose
nodes.summary: Evaluates all guard conditions and, if satisfied, returns the guarded value after checking [Exposed] global scope and calling the condition function.

nodes.name: import.rs
nodes.summary: Defines macros used by the code-generated script bindings for importing and re-exporting module items, bridging the auto-generated binding code with the script bindings infrastructure.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains macro_rules! definitions for use by auto-generated binding code; no regular functions or structs.

nodes.name: inheritance.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Castable trait for safe DOM object type casting using proto_id comparison, plus HasParent for accessing the parent type in the inheritance chain.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses mem::transmute for zero-cost upcast/downcast after proto_id type verification.

nodes.name: Castable
nodes.summary: Trait enabling safe DOM object type casting: is() checks proto_id, upcast() transmutes to parent, downcast() checks then transmutes to child.

nodes.name: HasParent
nodes.summary: Trait for DOM types that have a parent type in the inheritance chain, providing as_parent() for upcasting.

nodes.name: init.rs
nodes.summary: Provides InitClassOpsConfig and DomJSClassConfig for configuring SpiderMonkey JSClass initialization with DOM-specific hooks (enumerate, resolve, finalize, trace).

nodes.name: InitClassOpsConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for SpiderMonkey JSClassOps initialization with optional enumerate, resolve, may_resolve, finalize, and trace hooks.

nodes.name: DomJSClassConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration bundle for a DOM JSClass including name, flags, reserved slots, and class ops config.

nodes.name: interface.rs
nodes.summary: Core WebIDL interface object creation module: creates global objects, non-callback/callback interface objects, prototype objects, named constructors, unscopable objects, and guarded method/property/constant installation.
nodes.languageNotes: Direct SpiderMonkey JSAPI usage for global object creation with trusted principals, compartment selection, and property definition.

nodes.name: NonCallbackInterfaceObjectClass
nodes.summary: JSClass for non-callback WebIDL interface constructor objects with string representation and prototype depth metadata.

nodes.name: InterfaceConstructorBehavior
nodes.summary: Trait controlling constructor behavior: throw() for abstract interfaces, call() for delegating constructors.

nodes.name: create_global_object
nodes.summary: Creates a SpiderMonkey global object with the provided JSClass, sets up trusted principals, stores private DOM data, and fires the new-global hook.

nodes.name: create_interface_prototype_object
nodes.summary: Creates the prototype object for a WebIDL interface with regular methods, properties, constants, and unscopable names.

nodes.name: get_desired_proto
nodes.summary: Implements the WebIDL desired prototype algorithm: resolves the intended prototype for a constructor call from new.target, including cross-realm wrapping.

nodes.name: interfaces.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the central trait system for DOM interfaces: Interface (define/enable), DomHelpers (exception throwing, HTML construction, settings stack), GlobalScopeHelpers, and specialized helpers for documents, WebGL, windows, and servo internals.

nodes.name: Interface
nodes.summary: Base trait for all WebIDL interfaces providing define() and enabled() hooks for interface registration and conditional exposure.

nodes.name: DomHelpers
nodes.summary: Central DOM helper trait providing throw_dom_exception, call_html_constructor, settings_stack, principals_callbacks, interface_map, and reflect_dom_object_with_cx.

nodes.name: GlobalScopeHelpers
nodes.summary: Trait for global scope objects providing from_current_realm, from_object, origin(), incumbent(), perform_a_microtask_checkpoint, get_url(), and is_secure_context().

nodes.name: iterable.rs
nodes.summary: Implements WebIDL iterable declarations: Iterable trait, IterableIterator DOM object, IteratorType enum (Keys/Values/Entries), and the Next() method for the iteration protocol.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the ECMAScript iteration protocol with JS_NewObject-based result dictionaries for {value, done} and {key, value, done} returns.

nodes.name: Iterable
nodes.summary: Trait for iterable DOM collections providing get_iterable_length, get_value_at_index, and get_key_at_index.

nodes.name: IterableIterator
nodes.summary: DOM object representing an iterator over an iterable collection, holding a reflector, the iterable source, iterator type, current index, and a phantom marker.

nodes.name: Next
nodes.summary: Implements the ECMAScript iterator Next() method, dispatching by IteratorType to return Keys, Values, or Entries from the underlying iterable collection.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the script_bindings module: re-exports all submodules and declares the overall module structure for the Servo script-to-JS binding layer.

nodes.name: like.rs
nodes.summary: Implements WebIDL Setlike and Maplike declaration support via traits providing get_index, get, size, set/add, has, clear, delete operations backed by IndexMap/IndexSet.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses IndexMap/IndexSet for O(1) lookup with insertion-order iteration to satisfy WebIDL iteration semantics.

nodes.name: Setlike
nodes.summary: Trait for WebIDL setlike declarations providing get_index, size, add, has, clear, and delete backed by an IndexSet.

nodes.name: Maplike
nodes.summary: Trait for WebIDL maplike declarations providing get_index, get, size, set, has, clear, and delete backed by an IndexMap.

nodes.name: lock.rs
nodes.summary: Provides ThreadUnsafeOnceLock, a single-threaded one-time initialization lock for use in Servo's script thread where locking is unnecessary.

nodes.name: ThreadUnsafeOnceLock
nodes.summary: A single-threaded wrapper around OnceLock that provides safe initialization without synchronization overhead, since Servo's script thread runs single-threaded.

nodes.name: mem.rs
nodes.summary: Exports a helper to compute the malloc size of a raw DOM object pointer including its own allocation, used for SpiderMonkey memory accounting.

nodes.name: malloc_size_of_including_raw_self
nodes.summary: Computes the total malloc-allocated size of a DOM object by dereferencing a raw pointer and calling its size_of method, used as a SpiderMonkey DOM size callback.

nodes.name: namespace.rs
nodes.summary: Defines NamespaceObjectClass and create_namespace_object for creating WebIDL namespace objects on the JS global, mapping DOM interface constants and methods.

nodes.name: NamespaceObjectClass
nodes.summary: Represents the JSClass definition for a WebIDL namespace object, bundling its name, methods, attributes, and constants.

nodes.name: create_namespace_object
nodes.summary: Creates and defines a WebIDL namespace object on the JS global, installing its methods, attributes, and constants via SpiderMonkey APIs.

nodes.name: num.rs
nodes.summary: Defines Finite<T>, a newtype wrapper ensuring a numeric value is finite (not NaN or infinity) before use in WebIDL bindings.

nodes.name: Finite
nodes.summary: A newtype wrapper around a numeric type T that guarantees the inner value is finite, rejecting NaN and infinity at construction.

nodes.name: principals.rs
nodes.summary: Implements ServoJSPrincipals and ServoJSPrincipalsRef, JSPrincipals-based security wrappers that carry origin information for same-origin checks.

nodes.name: ServoJSPrincipals
nodes.summary: An owned wrapper around SpiderMonkey's JSPrincipals, holding an origin string and managing the C++ JSPrincipals lifecycle through Clone and Drop.

nodes.name: ServoJSPrincipalsRef
nodes.summary: A borrowed reference to JSPrincipals that can be dereferenced to ServoJSPrincipals, used for accessing origin data from JS engine callbacks.

nodes.name: proxyhandler.rs
nodes.summary: Implements SpiderMonkey's DOM proxy handler with full cross-origin security checks, expando object management, property key enumeration, and platform object same-origin verification.
nodes.languageNotes: Large file (1039 lines) implementing the complete SpiderMonkey DOM proxy handler interface with extensive cross-origin access control logic.

nodes.name: CrossOriginProperties
nodes.summary: Holds arrays of JSPropertySpec for attributes and methods that are accessible cross-origin on a DOM proxy object.

nodes.name: JSProxyHandlerOwnPropertyKeysConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration struct for JSProxyHandlerOwnPropertyKeys that holds indexed getter/length info, cross-origin properties, and supported named properties.

nodes.name: JSProxyHandlerOwnEnumerablePropertyKeysConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration struct for enumerable property key enumeration, mirroring OwnPropertyKeysConfig for the enumerable-only variant.

nodes.name: shadow_check_callback
nodes.summary: SpiderMonkey callback that checks if an expando object already has a property, preventing the proxy from shadowing it.

nodes.name: define_property
nodes.summary: Proxy handler trap that defines a property on the expando object after ensuring it exists, used by SpiderMonkey [[DefineOwnProperty]].

nodes.name: delete
nodes.summary: Proxy handler trap for [[Delete]] that removes a property from the expando object if one exists.

nodes.name: ensure_expando_object
nodes.summary: Ensures an expando object exists for a DOM proxy, creating a new JS object and storing it in the proxy private slot if needed.

nodes.name: maybe_cross_origin_set_prototype_rawcx
nodes.summary: Proxy trap that handles [[SetPrototypeOf]] with cross-origin checks; cross-origin objects use a null prototype while same-origin delegates normally.

nodes.name: cross_origin_has_own
nodes.summary: Checks whether a cross-origin proxy object has an own property by matching against the allowlisted cross-origin property set.

nodes.name: ensure_cross_origin_property_holder
nodes.summary: Creates (or retrieves a cached) holder object that stores the allowlisted cross-origin properties (attributes and methods) for a cross-origin proxy.

nodes.name: report_cross_origin_denial
nodes.summary: Throws a SecurityError DOMException when cross-origin access to a property is denied, converting the property id to a human-readable string for the error message.

nodes.name: maybe_cross_origin_set_rawcx
nodes.summary: Proxy [[Set]] trap with cross-origin awareness: delegates to cross_origin_set for cross-origin targets, or the underlying proxy handler for same-origin.

nodes.name: maybe_cross_origin_get_prototype
nodes.summary: Proxy [[GetPrototypeOf]] trap: same-origin objects delegate to a prototype-fetching closure; cross-origin objects return the relevant global prototype.

nodes.name: cross_origin_get
nodes.summary: Handles [[Get]] for cross-origin objects: retrieves the own property descriptor, invokes getters, and reports denials for disallowed properties.

nodes.name: cross_origin_property_fallback
nodes.summary: Fallback handler for cross-origin [[GetOwnProperty]]: returns an all-allowlisted descriptor for allowlisted properties, or reports denial for others.

nodes.name: JSProxyHandlerOwnPropertyKeys
nodes.summary: SpiderMonkey proxy trap for [[OwnPropertyKeys]]: handles cross-origin filtering, indexed properties from length getters, named properties, and expando merging.

nodes.name: JSProxyHandlerGetOwnEnumerablePropertyKeys
nodes.summary: Similar to OwnPropertyKeys but for enumerable-only keys; used when SpiderMonkey needs to enumerate without non-enumerable properties.

nodes.name: get_expando_object
nodes.summary: Retrieves the expando object stored in a DOM proxy private slot, returning null if none exists or the slot holds a non-object value.

nodes.name: cross_origin_own_property_keys
nodes.summary: Enumerates own property keys for cross-origin proxy objects by appending allowlisted attribute and method names plus well-known symbols.

nodes.name: cross_origin_get_own_property_helper
nodes.summary: Helper that ensures the cross-origin property holder exists and retrieves a property descriptor from it for the given property id.

nodes.name: is_cross_origin_object
nodes.summary: Determines if a JS object is a cross-origin wrapper by checking if it is a WindowProxy or a Location/DissimilarOriginLocation DOM object.

nodes.name: cross_origin_set
nodes.summary: Handles [[Set]] for cross-origin objects: retrieves the own property descriptor, invokes setters if present, or reports cross-origin denial for disallowed properties.

nodes.name: is_platform_object_same_origin
nodes.summary: Checks whether a platform object belongs to the same origin realm by comparing JSPrincipals from both the subject and object realms.

nodes.name: realms.rs
nodes.summary: Provides enter_auto_realm, a convenience function to enter a SpiderMonkey AutoRealm using a DOM object JS reflector to determine the target realm.

nodes.name: enter_auto_realm
nodes.summary: Enters a SpiderMonkey AutoRealm for a given DOM object by extracting its JS object via the reflector, ensuring correct JS realm context.

nodes.name: record.rs
nodes.summary: Implements Record<K,V>, the WebIDL record type binding, with RecordKey enum supporting DOMString, USVString, and ByteString keys and JS-to-Rust conversion.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Rust generics and the IndexMap type to map WebIDL record keys to values with safe JS-to-Rust conversion through the SafeFromJsval/ToJsval traits.

nodes.name: RecordKey
nodes.summary: Enum representing the three WebIDL string key types for records: DOMString, USVString, and ByteString, each implementing from_id and to_utf16_vec.

nodes.name: Record
nodes.summary: Generic WebIDL record type wrapping an IndexMap, supporting safe conversion from JS objects with typed keys and values.

nodes.name: safe_from_jsval
nodes.summary: Converts a JS object value to a typed Record<K,V> by iterating enumerable own properties, converting each key/value pair through the WebIDL conversion traits.

nodes.name: safe_to_jsval
nodes.summary: Converts a Record<K,V> back to a JS object by creating a new object and setting each key-value pair using JS_DefineProperty.

nodes.name: reflector.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the core Reflector type and DomObject traits that bridge Rust DOM objects to SpiderMonkey JS objects, plus reflect_dom_object family of functions for creating JS wrappers.
nodes.languageNotes: Centrally important file: every DOM object in Servo uses Reflector to connect a Rust heap object with a JS heap object. Includes associated memory tracking via SpiderMonkey AddAssociatedMemory/RemoveAssociatedMemory.

nodes.name: Reflector
nodes.summary: The core struct that pairs a Rust DOM object with its corresponding JS object on the SpiderMonkey heap, tracking memory size and prototype chain id.

nodes.name: DomObject
nodes.summary: Trait for DOM objects that have been reflected (paired with a JS object). Provides reflector() accessor.

nodes.name: MutDomObject
nodes.summary: Trait for DOM objects that can be mutable and initialized with a reflector, providing init_reflector to bind a newly created JS object.

nodes.name: DomObjectWrap
nodes.summary: Trait that binds a Rust DOM type to its WebIDL wrapper, specifying the JSClass and wrap function used to create the JS object.

nodes.name: WeakReferenceableDomObjectWrap
nodes.summary: Extension of DomObjectWrap for DOM objects that support weak references, providing additional JSClass configuration for weak reference support.

nodes.name: reflect_dom_object
nodes.summary: Creates a JS wrapper for a DOM object by calling the type WRAP function with the given JS context and global, the main entry point for DOM object reflection.

nodes.name: reflect_dom_object_with_proto
nodes.summary: Like reflect_dom_object but accepts a custom prototype chain, used for DOM objects with non-default prototype hierarchies.

nodes.name: reflect_dom_object_with_cx
nodes.summary: Variant of reflect_dom_object that takes an explicit JSContext reference instead of obtaining it from the global runtime.

nodes.name: reflect_weak_referenceable_dom_object
nodes.summary: Creates a JS wrapper for a weakly-referenceable DOM object, using WeakReferenceableDomObjectWrap WRAP instead of DomObjectWrap.

nodes.name: root.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOM rooting infrastructure: Dom<T> (reference to a GC-traced heap object), DomRoot<T> (stack root), RootCollection, MaybeUnreflectedDom, and DomSlice.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements Servo custom rooting system using SpiderMonkey trace hooks. Dom<T> is a NonNull pointer to a traced heap object; DomRoot<T> pins it on the stack to prevent GC collection.

nodes.name: Root
nodes.summary: A stack root entry that holds a value and a back-pointer to its RootCollection, ensuring the value is traced during GC.

nodes.name: StableTraceObject
nodes.summary: Trait for DOM objects that can provide a stable trace target, allowing DomRoot<T> to trace the underlying JS reflector.

nodes.name: Dom
nodes.summary: A typed pointer to a GC-traced DOM object on the SpiderMonkey heap, convertible to DomRoot<T> for safe stack access via the rooting API.

nodes.name: MaybeUnreflectedDom
nodes.summary: A Dom-like pointer for DOM objects that may not yet be reflected (have no JS object), supporting from_box and from_rc construction from owned values.

nodes.name: RootCollection
nodes.summary: A per-thread list of stack roots; trace_roots iterates all active roots and traces each one underlying JS object to prevent GC collection.

nodes.name: trace_roots
nodes.summary: Traces all active stack roots in the per-thread RootCollection, calling each root trace method to keep referenced JS objects alive during GC.

nodes.name: upcast
nodes.summary: Performs a safe upcast from DomRoot<T> to DomRoot<U> where T: DomObjectWrap and U is a supertype, using mem::transmute on the underlying pointer.

nodes.name: downcast
nodes.summary: Attempts a safe downcast from DomRoot<T> to DomRoot<U> by checking the type id first, returning Some if valid or None otherwise.

nodes.name: script_runtime.rs
nodes.summary: Provides thread-local runtime state tracking for the script thread: liveness checks, GC collection status, and a temporary JSContext accessor.

nodes.name: settings_stack.rs
nodes.summary: Manages the incumbent/entry settings stack for WebIDL spec compliance, providing run_a_script and run_a_callback to properly scope JavaScript execution contexts.

nodes.name: StackEntryKind
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing Incumbent (for callbacks) vs Entry (for scripts) settings stack entries.

nodes.name: StackEntry
nodes.summary: Represents an entry on the settings stack, pairing a global scope with the kind of execution context (incumbent callback or entry script).

nodes.name: run_a_script
nodes.summary: Pushes an Entry stack frame for script execution, runs the closure, pops the frame, and optionally performs a microtask checkpoint when the stack empties while not panicking.

nodes.name: run_a_callback
nodes.summary: Pushes an Incumbent stack frame for callback execution, hiding the scripted caller during execution and restoring it afterwards via SpiderMonkey AutoHideScriptedCaller.

nodes.name: str.rs
nodes.summary: Defines ByteString and USVString types for WebIDL string bindings, plus is_token validation and serialize_jsval_to_json_utf8 for JSON serialization.

nodes.name: ByteString
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapping Vec<u8> for WebIDL ByteString, providing safe construction, comparison, and conversion from JS strings.

nodes.name: USVString
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapping String for WebIDL USVString (Unicode scalar value string), providing display, equality, and conversion implementations.

nodes.name: is_token
nodes.summary: Validates whether a byte string slice is a valid HTTP token per RFC 2616, checking for non-empty and no separator/control characters.

nodes.name: serialize_jsval_to_json_utf8
nodes.summary: Serializes a JS value to a JSON UTF-8 string using SpiderMonkey JS::ToJSON, returning the result as an owned Vec<u8> or a TypeError error.

nodes.name: structuredclone.rs
nodes.summary: Defines marker traits MarkedAsSerializableInIdl and MarkedAsTransferableInIdl that assert a type supports structured clone serialization or transfer.
nodes.languageNotes: These are zero-sized marker traits used at compile time to assert WebIDL [Serializable] and [Transferable] extended attributes.

nodes.name: MarkedAsSerializableInIdl
nodes.summary: Marker trait for types declared [Serializable] in WebIDL; calling assert_serializable() would fail at compile time if not implemented.

nodes.name: MarkedAsTransferableInIdl
nodes.summary: Marker trait for types declared [Transferable] in WebIDL; calling assert_transferable() would fail at compile time if not implemented.

nodes.name: trace.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the GC tracing infrastructure: trace_reflector, trace_object, CustomTraceable trait, RootedTraceableBox, NoTrace wrapper, and blanket Trace implementations for standard types.
nodes.languageNotes: Blanket Trace implementations cover JSTraceable, Heap<T>, Vec, HashMap, IndexMap, Rc, Arc, Mutex, RefCell, and many more standard types, allowing the GC to recursively trace entire DOM object graphs.

nodes.name: trace_reflector
nodes.summary: Traces a DOM reflector JS object by calling trace_object on the rootable handle, the core GC trace entry point for all DOM objects.

nodes.name: trace_object
nodes.summary: Calls SpiderMonkey CallObjectTracer on a JSObject pointer with a type description, registering the JS object for GC tracing.

nodes.name: CustomTraceable
nodes.summary: Trait for types that need custom GC tracing logic beyond the standard blanket implementations, with a single trace method.

nodes.name: RootedTraceableBox
nodes.summary: A wrapper around js::gc::RootedTraceableBox that provides safe Rust access to a GC-rooted traceable value on the stack, with Deref/DerefMut.

nodes.name: NoTrace
nodes.summary: A newtype wrapper that implements Trace as a no-op, used for types that should be explicitly excluded from GC tracing.

nodes.name: utils.rs
nodes.summary: Provides core binding utilities: DOMClass/DOMJSClass definitions, generic_method/getter/setter dispatching, dictionary property helpers, global enumeration, and cross-origin security integration.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest file in the bindings crate (870 lines). Implements the generic_method family that bridges SpiderMonkey JSNative call signatures to typed Rust WebIDL operations, including this-value validation and cross-origin security checks.

nodes.name: DOMClass
nodes.summary: Rust-side representation of a DOM JSClass, storing the interface chain, prototype depth, type ID, malloc size callback, and global slot index.

nodes.name: DOMJSClass
nodes.summary: Pairs a SpiderMonkey JSClass with the Servo-specific DOMClass metadata, providing the complete class description for DOM object wrappers.

nodes.name: CallPolicy
nodes.summary: Enum that selects lenient-this behavior for overloaded operations: LenientThis allows non-matching this values without throwing.

nodes.name: CallPolicyInfo
nodes.summary: Configuration struct carrying lenient_this and needs_security_check_on_interface_match flags for the generic call dispatcher.

nodes.name: get_property_on_prototype
nodes.summary: Looks up a property on the prototype chain of a proxy object, used for prototype-based property resolution in the DOM binding layer.

nodes.name: get_array_index_from_id
nodes.summary: Parses a SpiderMonkey jsid to determine if it represents an array index, handling int ids, string-based numeric ids, and lowercased ASCII escaping.

nodes.name: get_dictionary_property
nodes.summary: Reads a named property from a JS dictionary object, returning the value through a MutableHandleValue or an error if the property is missing.

nodes.name: set_dictionary_property
nodes.summary: Writes a value to a named property on a JS dictionary object using JS_SetProperty.

nodes.name: define_dictionary_property
nodes.summary: Defines a new property on a JS dictionary object via JS_DefineProperty with JSPROP_ENUMERATE, used when constructing dictionary objects from Rust.

nodes.name: generic_method
nodes.summary: Extern C entry point dispatched by SpiderMonkey for regular DOM methods; wraps generic_call with the EXCEPTION_TO_REJECTION policy.

nodes.name: generic_getter
nodes.summary: Extern C entry point for DOM attribute getters; delegates to generic_call with promise-rejection exception handling.

nodes.name: generic_setter
nodes.summary: Extern C entry point for DOM attribute setters; delegates to generic_call without exception-to-rejection conversion (setters throw synchronously).

nodes.name: generic_static_promise_method
nodes.summary: Extern C entry point for static promise-returning methods; extracts the JIT info, calls the static function, and converts exceptions to rejected promises.

nodes.name: exception_to_promise
nodes.summary: Converts a pending JS exception into a rejected promise by calling CallOriginalPromiseReject, used by promise-returning DOM methods on failure.

nodes.name: trace_global
nodes.summary: Traces all prototype and interface objects stored on the global, ensuring they are kept alive during GC by calling trace_object on each.

nodes.name: enumerate_global
nodes.summary: Enumerates standard JS classes on the global object using SpiderMonkey JS_NewEnumerateStandardClasses for the basic JS environment.

nodes.name: enumerate_window
nodes.summary: Enumerates the Window global: delegates to enumerate_global, then appends all enabled WebIDL interface names from the interface map.

nodes.name: resolve_global
nodes.summary: Resolves standard JS classes on the global object (e.g., Array, Object) by delegating to SpiderMonkey JS_ResolveStandardClass.

nodes.name: resolve_window
nodes.summary: Resolves a property on the Window global: tries standard classes first, then looks up WebIDL interface names and calls their define function to install the interface.

nodes.name: weakref.rs
nodes.summary: Implements WeakRef<T> and the WeakReferenceable trait for DOM objects, providing weak reference semantics using Rc::Weak for GC-safe DOM object references.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses std::rc::Weak under the hood since Servo DOM is single-threaded, avoiding the need for atomic reference counting.

nodes.name: WeakRef
nodes.summary: A weak reference to a DOM object that does not prevent GC collection, providing upgrade to DomRoot<T> when the referent is still alive.

nodes.name: WeakReferenceable
nodes.summary: Trait implemented by DOM objects that support weak references, providing a downgrade method to create a WeakRef from a DomRoot.

nodes.name: wrap.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the main wrap function that creates SpiderMonkey JS wrappers for DOM objects, handling proxies, cross-origin objects, prototype chains, and unforgeable members.

nodes.name: WrapConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration struct for the wrap function specifying whether the object is a proxy, cross-origin, global, its prototype chain, JS class, and unforgeable member status.

nodes.name: wrap
nodes.summary: Creates a JS wrapper object for a DOM object: enters the correct realm, creates proxy or regular objects, sets prototype chains, links the reflector, and handles unforgeable members.

nodes.summary: Per-WebView renderer managing pipeline frame trees, scroll/zoom event batching, touch event dispatch with hit-testing, wheel event handling, viewport description processing, HiDPI/page/pinch zoom composition, and window size change notifications.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines multiple zoom sources (page zoom, HiDPI scale, pinch zoom) into a single device-pixels-per-page-pixel scale; batches scroll events to minimize redundant WebRender transactions.

nodes.name: InitialPaintState
nodes.summary: Configuration data struct passed to Paint::new() containing channels, proxy, profiler handles, shutdown state, event loop waker, and optional WebXR registry for initializing the rendering subsystem.

nodes.name: RenderNotifier
nodes.summary: Wraps a PainterId and PaintProxy to forward WebRender frame-ready notifications (new_frame_ready) into the Paint message system, enabling asynchronous frame completion handling.

nodes.name: LogTarget
nodes.summary: Trait providing a log_target method that returns a static string identifier for structured, per-event-type log filtering in the paint subsystem.

nodes.name: LargestContentfulPaintCalculator
nodes.summary: Aggregates LCP candidates per pipeline, tracks enabled/disabled state per WebView (per spec limitations), and calculates the final largest contentful paint when a frame composites.

nodes.name: PipelineDetails
nodes.summary: Per-pipeline state container holding the composition pipeline reference, parent/child hierarchy, animation and throttle flags, scroll tree, paint metric cells, viewport scale, exit source, display list epoch, and paint-side animations.

nodes.name: WebGLExternalImages
nodes.summary: WebGL external image handler that locks/unlocks GPU swap chain surfaces, creates/destroys textures via the rendering context, and tracks busy WebGL contexts for proper resource lifecycle management.

nodes.name: PinchZoom
nodes.summary: Tracks the pinch-zoom viewport with zoom factor, 2D transform, and unscaled viewport size; supports zooming around a center point, panning with scroll delta absorption, and computing the VisualViewport rect for script.

nodes.name: WebContentAnimator
nodes.summary: Drives paint-side animations (caret blinking) using a timer refresh driver; toggles caret visibility each tick and produces WebRender dynamic color property updates for all connected pipelines.

nodes.name: PipelineAnimations
nodes.summary: Per-pipeline animation tracker for paint-side animations; currently manages caret blinking with a timeout-based blink count, creating CaretAnimation instances on new display lists.

nodes.name: ScreenshotRequestPhase
nodes.summary: Three-phase enum for screenshot lifecycle: ConstellationRequest (waiting for page readiness), WaitingOnPipelineDisplayLists (waiting for display lists at target epochs), and WaitingOnFrame (waiting for WebRender frame completion).

nodes.name: ScreenshotTaker
nodes.summary: Manages a queue of pending screenshot requests; drives the three-phase state machine from request through readiness coordination to final image capture via the rendering context.

nodes.name: BaseRefreshDriver
nodes.summary: Abstract base for refresh driver implementations; manages a list of RefreshDriverObserver subscribers, coordinates frame-start callbacks, and uses the embedder's EventLoopWaker to trigger repaints when frames are ready.

nodes.name: RefreshDriverObserver
nodes.summary: Trait for internal subscribers to vsync/timer frame-start signals; observers return true to keep observing or false to be removed by the BaseRefreshDriver.

nodes.name: AnimationRefreshDriverObserver
nodes.summary: Default refresh driver observer that sends TickAnimation messages to the Constellation for animating WebViews on each frame start, driving CSS animations and requestAnimationFrame callbacks.

nodes.name: TimerRefreshDriver
nodes.summary: Timer-based refresh driver running a TimerScheduler on a dedicated background thread (PaintTimerThread); dispatches completed timers and supports queuing new timers with callback execution at deadlines.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements Default with thread spawning; gracefully shuts down via Drop by sending a Quit message and joining the timer thread.

nodes.name: WebRenderDebugOption
nodes.summary: Enum controlling which WebRender debug visualizations are active: Profiler (GPU timing), TextureCacheDebug, or RenderTargetDebug.

nodes.name: RepaintReason
nodes.summary: Bitflags struct tracking why a repaint is needed: ReadyForScreenshot, ChangedAnimationState, NewWebRenderFrame, Resize, StartedFlinging, or BlinkingCaret.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the bitflags! macro for ergonomic bitwise flag composition.

nodes.name: Paint
nodes.summary: Central rendering subsystem struct responsible for maintaining WebRender instances per rendering context, receiving and forwarding display lists, driving animations via refresh driver, eagerly handling touch/scroll events, and coordinating WebGL/WebGPU/WebXR integration across all WebViews.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Rc<RefCell<>> for shared mutable state; integrates with profiler channels, crossbeam for message passing, and feature-gated WebXR/WebGPU support.

nodes.name: FrameDelayer
nodes.summary: Delays WebRender frame generation until all asynchronous canvas image updates complete; tracks pending image epochs per ImageKey and notifies the Constellation when pipelines are no longer waiting.

nodes.name: PaintMetricState
nodes.summary: Enum tracking the lifecycle of a paint timing metric: Waiting (no display list yet), Seen (display list processed, waiting for composite at epoch), or Sent (metric dispatched to Constellation).

nodes.name: Painter
nodes.summary: Per-RenderingContext painter managing a WebRender document instance, all associated WebView renderers, display list construction and submission, scroll/zoom transaction batching, font and image resource uploads, paint metric emission (FirstPaint, FirstContentfulPaint, LCP), and screenshot coordination.
nodes.languageNotes: Initializes WebRender with configurable upload method (Immediate for ANGLE, PBO otherwise), worker thread pool, and namespace allocation; memory reportable via MallocSizeOf.

nodes.name: TouchHandler
nodes.summary: Per-WebView touch input state machine managing touch sequences (down/move/up/cancel), panning with velocity tracking, pinch-zoom gestures, fling physics with exponential decay, click emulation, and hit-test result caching for low-latency touch response.

nodes.name: TouchSequenceInfo
nodes.summary: Per-touch-sequence state tracking active touch points, current TouchSequenceState, move prevention flags, pending move actions for async script processing, and cached hit-test results.

nodes.name: TouchSequenceState
nodes.summary: Enum representing all states in the touch input state machine: Touching, Panning, Pinching, MultiTouch, PendingFling, Flinging, PendingClick, and Finished.

nodes.name: FlingRefreshDriverObserver
nodes.summary: RefreshDriverObserver that drives fling animation by calling update_touch_handling_at_new_frame_start on each frame tick; returns false when fling completes to stop observing.

nodes.name: WebViewRenderer
nodes.summary: Per-WebView renderer managing pipeline frame trees, scroll/zoom event batching and processing, touch event dispatch with hit-testing, wheel event forwarding, viewport description handling, composite zoom (page + HiDPI + pinch), window size notifications, and cursor refresh.

nodes.name: ScrollZoomEvent
nodes.summary: Enum representing either a PinchZoom event (magnification factor and center point) or a Scroll event for batching and deferred processing.

nodes.name: PinchZoomResult
nodes.summary: Enum indicating whether a pinch zoom operation actually changed the zoom state (DidPinchZoom vs DidNotPinchZoom), used for optimizing root pipeline display list rebuilds.

nodes.name: debuggeradddebuggeeevent.rs

nodes.name: new

nodes.name: debuggerblackboxevent.rs

nodes.name: DebuggerBlackboxEvent

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerBlackboxEvent, handling two code paths for full-source vs partial-source coverage blackbox events, initializing line/column ranges accordingly.

nodes.name: new

nodes.name: debuggerframeevent.rs

nodes.name: DebuggerFrameEvent

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerFrameEvent with type 'frames', storing pipeline ID, start index, and frame count for devtools frame listing requests.

nodes.name: debuggergetenvironmentevent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DebuggerGetEnvironmentEvent DOM struct for the 'getEnvironment' debugger event. Carries a frame actor ID to retrieve lexical environment details.

nodes.name: DebuggerGetEnvironmentEvent
nodes.summary: DOM struct for the 'getEnvironment' debugger event, holding a frame actor ID used to query lexical environment (scopes, bindings) from a stack frame.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerGetEnvironmentEvent with type 'getEnvironment', storing the frame actor ID for subsequent environment lookups.

nodes.name: debuggergetpossiblebreakpointsevent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DebuggerGetPossibleBreakpointsEvent DOM struct for the 'getPossibleBreakpoints' event. Identifies the Spidermonkey source to query for settable breakpoint locations.

nodes.name: DebuggerGetPossibleBreakpointsEvent
nodes.summary: DOM struct for the 'getPossibleBreakpoints' debugger event, carrying the Spidermonkey source ID to query all viable breakpoint locations in a script.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerGetPossibleBreakpointsEvent with type 'getPossibleBreakpoints', storing the Spidermonkey source ID for breakpoint location queries.

nodes.name: debuggerglobalscope.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DebuggerGlobalScope, the central controller for the Servo devtools debugger protocol. Manages the debugger lifecycle including source notification, breakpoints, eval, frame listing, environment inspection, pausing, and blackboxing via fire-and-forget events sent to the devtools channel.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements multiple devtools traits (NotifyNewSource, GetPossibleBreakpointsResult, EvalResult, etc.) and coordinates Spidermonkey JS engine debugging with the devtools protocol over channels.

nodes.name: DebuggerGlobalScope
nodes.summary: The central DOM struct for the debugger global scope, inheriting from GlobalScope. Holds devtools sender/receiver channels, result senders for async debugger queries, and pipeline/origin state.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs the DebuggerGlobalScope with devtools channel endpoints, resource/storage threads, and GPU ID hub. Initializes the internal about:internal/debugger URL origin and wraps the global for JS binding.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Executes the debugger JavaScript initializer by reading the bundled debugger JS resource and evaluating it on the global scope within an auto realm.

nodes.name: origin
nodes.summary: Returns a clone of the debugger global scope's immutable origin.

nodes.name: as_global_scope
nodes.summary: Casts the debugger global scope up to its parent GlobalScope type for DOM interoperability.

nodes.name: fire_add_debuggee
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerAddDebuggeeEvent on the debugger global scope. Notifies devtools that a new script worker has been attached, optionally including the worker ID.

nodes.name: fire_eval
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerEvalEvent carrying JavaScript code to evaluate in a specific debuggee context. Optionally includes worker ID and frame actor ID for targeting.

nodes.name: fire_get_possible_breakpoints
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerGetPossibleBreakpointsEvent to query all settable breakpoint locations for a given Spidermonkey source script.

nodes.name: fire_set_breakpoint
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerSetBreakpointEvent to set a breakpoint at a specific script ID and bytecode offset within a Spidermonkey source.

nodes.name: fire_interrupt
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerInterruptEvent to request an interrupt in script execution. A lightweight event used when the devtools server asks the JS engine to pause.

nodes.name: fire_list_frames
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerFrameEvent to request a paginated listing of call-stack frames from a specific pipeline, with start offset and frame count limits.

nodes.name: fire_get_environment
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerGetEnvironmentEvent to request the lexical environment (scopes and bindings) for a specific frame actor identified by its actor ID.

nodes.name: fire_resume
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerResumeEvent to resume script execution with an optional resume-limit type (e.g., step-over, step-into) and target frame actor ID.

nodes.name: fire_clear_breakpoint
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerClearBreakpointEvent to clear a breakpoint identified by Spidermonkey source ID, script ID, and bytecode offset.

nodes.name: fire_blackbox
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerBlackboxEvent to mark a source region as blackboxed (e.g., framework code to skip during stepping), with coverage information.

nodes.name: fire_unblackbox
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerUnblackboxEvent to remove the blackbox designation from a source region, with coverage information for the unblackboxed area.

nodes.name: pipeline_id
nodes.summary: Returns the debugger's associated pipeline ID.

nodes.name: NotifyNewSource
nodes.summary: Handles the DevtoolScriptControlMsg::NotifyNewSource message from Spidermonkey. Parses the source URL, determines introduction type (inline script, eval, event handler, etc.), resolves worker ID, and sends a CreateSourceActor message to devtools. The central hook for onNewScript in the debugger protocol.
nodes.languageNotes: Longest method in the debugger module (92 lines). Contains extensive URL parsing, introduction-type classification, and conditional logic for worker-aware source tracking.

nodes.name: GetPossibleBreakpointsResult
nodes.summary: Handles the result of a getPossibleBreakpoints query. Maps Spidermonkey breakpoint entries to devtools RecommendedBreakpointLocation structs and sends them via the stored oneshot sender.

nodes.name: EvalResult
nodes.summary: Processes the result of a JS eval request. Parses the serialized return value as a devtools DebuggerValue, handles both success and exception cases (including exception messages), and sends the result via the stored oneshot channel.

nodes.name: RegisterObjectActor
nodes.summary: Registers a devtools object actor for a serialized JS value. Creates a channel pair, sends a CreateObjectActor message to devtools, waits for the actor name response, and maps it to an Option<String>.

nodes.name: PauseAndRespond
nodes.summary: Called when the JS engine pauses (e.g., at a breakpoint or step). Sends a DebuggerPause message to devtools with frame actor ID and pause reason, then enters the debugger pause loop via the script thread.

nodes.name: RegisterFrameActor
nodes.summary: Registers a devtools frame actor for a script stack frame. Serializes the frame's 'this' value, resolves display name, type, and URL, then sends a CreateFrameActor message to devtools.

nodes.name: ListFramesResult
nodes.summary: Collects the list of frame actor IDs from a frames query and sends them through the stored oneshot sender to the awaiting devtools client.

nodes.name: RegisterEnvironmentActor
nodes.summary: Registers a devtools environment actor for a lexical scope. Extracts bindings as property descriptors, serializes the scope object, maps type and scope kind metadata, sends CreateEnvironmentActor to devtools, and returns the actor name.

nodes.name: GetEnvironmentResult
nodes.summary: Sends the single environment actor ID result back through the stored oneshot sender to the awaiting devtools client.

nodes.name: debuggerinterruptevent.rs

nodes.name: DebuggerInterruptEvent

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerInterruptEvent with type 'interrupt'. A compact constructor that initializes only the inherited Event base.

nodes.name: debuggerresumeevent.rs

nodes.name: DebuggerResumeEvent

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerResumeEvent with type 'resume', storing the optional resume limit type and frame actor ID as DOMString values.

nodes.name: debuggersetbreakpointevent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DebuggerSetBreakpointEvent DOM struct for the 'setBreakpoint' debugger event. Carries Spidermonkey source ID, script ID, and offset to set a breakpoint.

nodes.name: DebuggerSetBreakpointEvent
nodes.summary: DOM struct for the 'setBreakpoint' debugger event, carrying the Spidermonkey source ID, script ID, and bytecode offset to identify where a breakpoint should be set.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerSetBreakpointEvent with type 'setBreakpoint', storing Spidermonkey ID, script ID, and offset for breakpoint placement.

nodes.name: debuggerunblackboxevent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DebuggerUnblackboxEvent DOM struct for the 'unblackbox' debugger event. Carries source coverage info for reversing a previous blackbox operation including start/end line-column ranges.

nodes.name: DebuggerUnblackboxEvent
nodes.summary: DOM struct for the 'unblackbox' debugger event with info about the unblackboxed source region including Spidermonkey ID, coverage flag, and source range.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerUnblackboxEvent, handling two code paths for full-source vs partial-source coverage unblackbox events, initializing line/column ranges accordingly.

nodes.name: mod.rs

nodes.name: pipelineid.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the PipelineId DOM struct, a WebIDL binding wrapper around the pipeline ID concept for the debugger. Exposes NamespaceId and Index fields for devtools pipeline identification.

nodes.name: PipelineId
