nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a PipelineId DOM object, reflecting it via reflect_dom_object_with_cx and storing the pipeline identity with namespace and index components.

nodes.name: mediadeviceinfo.rs
nodes.summary: MediaDeviceInfo DOM struct representing an audio/video input/output device with device ID, kind, label, and group ID; implements the Media Capture API WebIDL binding plus servo-media device kind conversion.

nodes.name: MediaDeviceInfo
nodes.summary: DOM struct holding device information (device_id, kind, label, group_id) for media input/output devices, implementing the MediaDeviceInfo WebIDL interface with getter methods per the Media Capture API.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a new MediaDeviceInfo with all fields initialized from string device descriptors and a MediaDeviceKind. The standard DOM object construction helper that does not involve JS reflection.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public constructor that creates a MediaDeviceInfo and registers it with the JS reflector, linking the Rust DOM object to a JS wrapper via reflect_dom_object_with_cx.

nodes.name: mediadevices.rs
nodes.summary: MediaDevices DOM interface implementing getUserMedia() and enumerateDevices() from the Media Capture and Streams API, with constraint conversion helpers for bridging JS constraint objects to servo-media types.

nodes.name: MediaDevices
nodes.summary: DOM struct extending EventTarget to provide the MediaDevices API entry point; implements getUserMedia() for camera/microphone access and enumerateDevices() for listing available media devices.

nodes.name: GetUserMedia
nodes.summary: WebIDL method implementing getUserMedia(): converts JS constraints, interacts with ServoMedia backend to create audio/video input streams, assembles MediaStream with tracks, and resolves the returned promise.

nodes.name: EnumerateDevices
nodes.summary: WebIDL method implementing enumerateDevices(): queries the media device monitor for all audio/video devices, converts each to a MediaDeviceInfo DOM object, and resolves the returned promise with the list.

nodes.name: convert_constraints
nodes.summary: Converts a JS BooleanOrMediaTrackConstraints union into an optional servo-media MediaTrackConstraintSet, mapping height, width, aspect ratio, frame rate, and sample rate constraints for getUserMedia.

nodes.name: convert_culong
nodes.summary: Converts a JS ClampedUnsignedLongOrConstrainULongRange into an optional servo-media Constrain<u32>, handling exact value, range, and ideal constraint variants.

nodes.name: convert_cdouble
nodes.summary: Converts a JS DoubleOrConstrainDoubleRange into an optional servo-media Constrain<f64>, handling exact value, range with min/max/ideal, and exact-only constraint variants.

nodes.name: mediaerror.rs
nodes.summary: MediaError DOM struct for HTML media element error reporting, exposing an error code and an empty message string per the HTML spec.

nodes.name: MediaError
nodes.summary: DOM struct encapsulating a media error code (u16) per the HTML spec, with Code() and Message() accessor methods exposed via WebIDL.

nodes.name: mediafragmentparser.rs
nodes.summary: Media Fragment URI parser implementing the W3C Media Fragments spec for temporal (NPT, UTC timestamps) and spatial (pixel/percent) fragment extraction from media URLs, with ID and track fragment support.

nodes.name: SpatialRegion
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing pixel-based from percent-based spatial coordinates in a media fragment's xywh clipping region.

nodes.name: SpatialClipping
nodes.summary: Struct representing a rectangular spatial clipping region (x, y, width, height) extracted from a media fragment, with an optional region type (pixel or percent).

nodes.name: MediaFragmentParser
nodes.summary: Parser for W3C Media Fragment URIs extracting temporal (start/end NPT and UTC), spatial (xywh pixel/percent clipping), id, and track fragment dimensions from URL query and fragment components.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Entry point that splits a URL into query and fragment components, decodes percent-encoded octets, and dispatches recognized keys (t/track, id, xywh) to temporal and spatial sub-parsers.

nodes.name: parse_temporal
nodes.summary: Parses temporal media fragment values supporting NPT hh:mm:ss.f format, NPT seconds format, wall-clock UTC timestamps, and comma-separated start/end pairs.

nodes.name: parse_utc_timestamp
nodes.summary: Parses UTC wall-clock timestamps (ISO 8601 date-T-timeZ) from media fragments, converting them to HMS format. Handles single timestamps and comma-separated start-end timestamp pairs.

nodes.name: parse_spatial
nodes.summary: Parses spatial media fragment values in xywh=pixel:10,20,100,200 format, extracting pixel/percent region type and four coordinate values into a SpatialClipping struct.

nodes.name: split_url
nodes.summary: Splits a full or relative URL string into its query and fragment components by locating '?' and '#' delimiters, returning (&str, &str) for the query and fragment parts.

nodes.name: split_prefix
nodes.summary: Splits a media fragment string at the first colon delimiter into an optional prefix (e.g., 'pixel', 'percent') and the remainder value, used for spatial fragment parsing.

nodes.name: parse_npt_minute
nodes.summary: Parses a Normal Play Time minute component (at most 2 digits, 0-59) from a string slice, returning a u32 minute value or an error on overflow or invalid input.

nodes.name: parse_npt_seconds
nodes.summary: Parses Normal Play Time seconds including optional fractional part; validates at most 2 integer digits (0-59) and at most one decimal point, returning an f64 second value.

nodes.name: parse_hms
nodes.summary: Parses a colon-delimited HMS time string (seconds, minutes:seconds, or hours:minutes:seconds) into total seconds as f64; handles NPT and clock-time formats with validation.

nodes.name: mediametadata.rs

nodes.name: new_with_proto

nodes.name: Constructor
nodes.summary: WebIDL constructor entry point that creates a new MediaMetadata from a JS-provided MediaMetadataInit dictionary, returning the DOM object to script.

nodes.name: mediaquerylist.rs
nodes.summary: MediaQueryList DOM interface for CSSOM View that evaluates CSS media queries against document state, tracks match state changes, fires change events, and supports legacy addListener/removeListener.

nodes.name: MediaQueryListMatchState
nodes.summary: Enum tracking whether a media query's match state has changed since the last evaluation, with Same and Changed variants used to decide when to fire change events.

nodes.name: MediaQueryList
nodes.summary: DOM struct extending EventTarget for CSSOM View media query evaluation; tracks the owning Document, a Stylo MediaList, and last-match state to detect changes and fire change events.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a MediaQueryList associating it with a document and the style system's MediaQuery object, initializing the match state cell for change tracking.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public DOM constructor that creates a weakly-referenceable MediaQueryList and registers it with the document window for lifecycle management.

nodes.name: evaluate_changes
nodes.summary: Re-evaluates the media query against the current document environment, updates the stored match state, and returns whether the match state changed (Same or Changed).

nodes.name: AddListener
nodes.summary: Registers a 'change' event listener on the MediaQueryList for the legacy addListener() API, delegating to the EventTarget add_event_listener method.

nodes.name: mediaquerylistevent.rs
nodes.summary: MediaQueryListEvent DOM event for CSSOM View change notifications, carrying the media query string and a matches boolean; extends the Event base class with WebIDL constructor.

nodes.name: MediaQueryListEvent

nodes.name: new

nodes.name: new_with_proto

nodes.name: Constructor
nodes.summary: WebIDL constructor called from JavaScript to create a MediaQueryListEvent from a type string and an init dictionary with media and matches fields.

nodes.name: mediasession.rs
nodes.summary: MediaSession DOM interface for the Media Session API managing playback metadata, playback state, action handlers (play/pause/seek/stop/skip), position state, and bridging between DOM controls and the embedder via constellation messages.

nodes.name: MediaSession
nodes.summary: DOM struct implementing the Media Session API; manages embedder metadata, playback state, action handlers (play/pause/seek etc.), position state, and bridges media controls with the controlled HTMLMediaElement via weak reference.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a MediaSession with default empty metadata, None playback state, an empty action handler map, and an unset media instance weak reference.

nodes.name: handle_action
nodes.summary: Dispatches a platform media action (play/pause/next/previous/seek) to the registered action handler callback, falling back to direct play/pause on the associated HTMLMediaElement if no handler is set or if it fails.

nodes.name: send_event
nodes.summary: Routes a MediaSessionEvent to the constellation via the window's pipeline, notifying the embedder of metadata changes, position state updates, or playback state transitions.

nodes.name: update_title

nodes.name: GetMetadata

nodes.name: SetMetadata

nodes.name: convert

nodes.name: mediastream.rs
nodes.summary: MediaStream DOM interface for the Media Capture API managing a collection of MediaStreamTracks with constructors (empty, from stream, from tracks), add/remove/clone, and filtering by audio/video type.

nodes.name: MediaStream
nodes.summary: DOM struct extending EventTarget for the Media Capture API; manages a collection of MediaStreamTracks with constructors (empty, clone, from tracks), add/remove/clone operations, and audio/video track filtering.

nodes.name: new_single
nodes.summary: Creates a MediaStream initialized with a single MediaStreamTrack of a given type (audio/video) and device ID, used by getUserMedia to build streams from individual capture devices.

nodes.name: Constructor
nodes.summary: WebIDL zero-argument constructor creating an empty MediaStream with the default prototype.

nodes.name: Constructor_
nodes.summary: WebIDL copy constructor creating a new MediaStream by cloning an existing stream's tracks via clone_with_proto.

nodes.name: Constructor__
nodes.summary: WebIDL constructor taking a sequence of MediaStreamTrack objects, creating a new MediaStream and adding all provided tracks to it.

nodes.name: GetTracks
nodes.summary: WebIDL method returning all tracks in the stream as a vector of DomRoot references, iterating over the internal track collection.

nodes.name: GetAudioTracks
nodes.summary: WebIDL method filtering the stream's tracks to return only those of MediaStreamType::Audio.

nodes.name: GetVideoTracks
nodes.summary: WebIDL method filtering the stream's tracks to return only those of MediaStreamType::Video.

nodes.name: GetTrackById
nodes.summary: WebIDL method that finds a track by its string ID within the stream, returning the matching track or null if no track has the given ID.

nodes.name: AddTrack
nodes.summary: WebIDL method that adds a MediaStreamTrack to the stream, first checking for duplicates to avoid adding the same track twice.

nodes.name: clone_with_proto
nodes.summary: Creates a cloned MediaStream with a specified prototype, copying all tracks from the source stream into the new one and preserving the original global scope.

nodes.name: mediastreamtrack.rs
nodes.summary: MediaStreamTrack DOM interface representing a single media track identified by a servo-media MediaStreamId with an audio/video type; implements the WebIDL binding with id, kind, and clone accessors.

nodes.name: MediaStreamTrack
nodes.summary: DOM struct extending EventTarget to represent a single media track identified by a servo-media MediaStreamId with an audio or video type; exposes id, kind, and clone via the WebIDL binding.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public constructor that creates a MediaStreamTrack with the given device ID and type, registering it with the JS reflector for web content access.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Rust module barrel declaring all 13 media DOM sub-modules (mediadeviceinfo through videotracklist) as pub(crate), making them accessible within the script crate.

nodes.name: videotrack.rs
nodes.summary: VideoTrack DOM interface per HTML spec representing a video track with id, kind, label, language, and selected state; maintains a back-reference to the parent VideoTrackList for coordinated selection.

nodes.name: VideoTrack
nodes.summary: DOM struct representing a single video track per the HTML spec with id, kind, label, language, and selected state; holds a weak back-reference to the parent VideoTrackList for coordinated selection management.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a VideoTrack with all identifying fields (id, kind, label, language) and links it to its parent VideoTrackList, initializing selection state to false.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public DOM constructor that creates a VideoTrack, registers it with the JS reflector, and optionally associates it with a parent VideoTrackList for coordinated track management.

nodes.name: SetSelected
nodes.summary: WebIDL setter for the selected property: when set to true, deselects the currently selected track in the parent VideoTrackList before marking this track as selected.

nodes.name: videotracklist.rs
nodes.summary: VideoTrackList DOM interface managing an ordered collection of VideoTracks with indexed getter, selected index tracking, add/clear operations, and event handlers for change, addtrack, and removetrack per HTML spec.

nodes.name: VideoTrackList
nodes.summary: DOM struct extending EventTarget to manage an ordered collection of VideoTracks; supports indexed access, selected index tracking with exclusive selection enforcement, add/clear, and fires change/addtrack/removetrack events.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a VideoTrackList from a slice of VideoTrack references and an optional media element reference, converting track pointers to Dom-wrapped references for the internal collection.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public DOM constructor that creates a VideoTrackList, registers it with the JS reflector, and optionally associates it with a media element for change notifications.

nodes.name: set_selected
nodes.summary: Implements single-selection logic: when a track is selected, deselects the previously selected track, updates the media element's video track, and queues a trusted change event task to notify web content.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Adds a VideoTrack to the list, links the track back to this list via add_track_list, and auto-selects it if it is the only track in the list.

nodes.name: clear
nodes.summary: Removes all tracks from the list by calling remove_track_list on each track and then clearing the internal collection.

nodes.name: GetTrackById
nodes.summary: WebIDL method that finds a VideoTrack in the list by its string ID, returning the matching track as a DomRoot or null if not found.

nodes.name: SelectedIndex
nodes.summary: WebIDL getter returning the index of the currently selected track, or -1 if no track is selected. Used by web content to discover and control video track selection.

nodes.name: clipboard_delegate.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the ClipboardDelegate trait and StringRequest type for system clipboard access, with platform-specific clipboard implementations using arboard on desktop and a fallback in-process store.

nodes.name: gamepad_delegate.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the GamepadDelegate trait and GamepadHapticEffectRequest type for handling gamepad haptic feedback (vibration) requests from web content.

nodes.name: gstreamer_plugins.rs
nodes.summary: Provides the gstreamer_plugins() function that returns the list of GStreamer plugin filenames for the current platform (Windows/macOS), used to initialize the media backend.

nodes.name: javascript_evaluator.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the JavaScriptEvaluator that manages asynchronous JavaScript evaluation requests from embedders, dispatching them to the constellation and routing results back via callbacks.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the servo embedding crate. Declares all submodules and re-exports the full public API surface â€” including Servo, WebView, delegate traits, rendering contexts, and protocol handlers â€” for embedder applications.

nodes.name: network_manager.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the NetworkManager struct for managing network-layer state (HTTP cache) across public and private browsing contexts, separate from site data management.

nodes.name: proxies.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the ConstellationProxy type â€” a thread-safe, cloneable proxy for sending messages from the embedder to the constellation, with disconnection tracking and preferences observer integration.

nodes.name: responders.rs
nodes.summary: Provides the IpcResponder and ServoErrorChannel abstractions for sending typed responses over IPC channels with automatic default-response-on-drop behavior, plus the AbstractSender trait for channel abstraction.

nodes.name: servo.rs
nodes.summary: Core engine file implementing the Servo struct, ServoBuilder, and the main event loop (spin_event_loop). Orchestrates constellation creation, media backend initialization, logging setup, embedder message handling, webview lifecycle, and the content process sandbox.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses crossbeam_channel::Select for efficient multi-receiver event loop without rebuilding the selector each iteration. Platform-conditional media backend init (GStreamer, OHOS, dummy).

nodes.name: servo_delegate.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the ServoError enum and ServoDelegate trait for embedder notifications about engine-level errors, devtools server events, web resource loading, and console messages.

nodes.name: site_data_manager.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the SiteDataManager for inspecting and managing site-associated data (cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage) across public and private browsing contexts, with async cookie operation support.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bitflags! macro for StorageType to allow composable storage category queries. Cookie operations use callback-based async pattern with pending operation tracking via FxHashMap.

nodes.name: user_content_manager.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the UserContentManager for injecting user scripts and stylesheets into webviews, with automatic cleanup on drop via constellation messages.

nodes.name: webview.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the WebView handle and WebViewBuilder, the primary embedder-facing API for managing browser views. Provides methods for navigation, input events, zoom, rendering, accessibility, JavaScript evaluation, screenshots, and embedder control delegation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Rc<RefCell<WebViewInner>> for shared ownership with interior mutability, reference-counted handles that auto-close the webview when the last handle drops.

nodes.name: webview_delegate.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the WebViewDelegate trait and all request/response types for embedder interaction: navigation requests, permission requests, authentication, embedder controls (context menus, color pickers, file pickers, select elements, dialogs), web resource interception, and accessibility tree updates.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of the type-state pattern via Drop implementations that automatically send default/deny responses when request objects are dropped without explicit handling.

nodes.name: StringRequest
nodes.summary: Encapsulates a clipboard text request with success/failure callbacks. Automatically sends a failure response on drop if no explicit response was sent.

nodes.name: ClipboardDelegate
nodes.summary: Trait for embedders to implement system clipboard access (clear, get_text, set_text). Default implementations are no-ops.

nodes.name: GamepadHapticEffectRequestType
nodes.summary: Enum representing the type of gamepad haptic effect request: Play (with effect parameters) or Stop.

nodes.name: GamepadHapticEffectRequest
nodes.summary: Encapsulates a gamepad haptic effect request with gamepad index, request type, and a callback. Automatically calls the callback with false on drop if unhandled.

nodes.name: GamepadDelegate
nodes.summary: Trait for embedders to handle gamepad haptic effect (vibration) requests from web content.

nodes.name: JavaScriptEvaluator
nodes.summary: Manages asynchronous JavaScript evaluation by dispatching scripts to the constellation with unique IDs and routing results back to embedder callbacks via FxHashMap lookup.

nodes.name: CacheEntry
nodes.summary: Represents a single HTTP cache entry identified by a unique key (URL), used for listing cache contents.

nodes.name: NetworkManager
nodes.summary: Manages network-layer state including the in-memory HTTP cache for both public and private browsing contexts. Provides cache_entries() and clear_cache() APIs.

nodes.name: ConstellationProxy
nodes.summary: Thread-safe, cloneable proxy for sending EmbedderToConstellationMessage messages to the constellation. Tracks disconnection via AtomicBool and implements PreferencesObserver for preference change forwarding.

nodes.name: ServoErrorSender
nodes.summary: Sender for asynchronously raised errors from delegate request objects, wrapping a crossbeam channel sender.

nodes.name: ServoErrorChannel
nodes.summary: Bidirectional channel pair for asynchronous ServoError delivery from WebViewDelegate request objects, with non-blocking try_recv.

nodes.name: AbstractSender
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting over different sender types (GenericSender, GenericCallback, TokioSender, OneshotSender) for use in IpcResponder.

nodes.name: IpcResponder
nodes.summary: Sends a typed response over any AbstractSender channel. If dropped before an explicit send, automatically sends the provided default response, ensuring delegate requests always receive an answer.

nodes.name: Message
nodes.summary: Internal enum wrapping the three embedder message types (FromNet, FromConstellation, FromUnknown) for unified handling in the event loop.

nodes.name: Servo
nodes.summary: The primary embedder-facing handle to the Servo engine. Provides methods for event loop spinning, delegate configuration, webview access, network/site data management, rendering, preferences, and WebDriver command execution.

nodes.name: ServoBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder for constructing a Servo instance with configurable options, preferences, event loop waker, protocol registry, and WebXR registry.

nodes.name: ServoInner
nodes.summary: Internal state container for the Servo engine. Owns the constellation proxy, delegates, webview registry, network/site data managers, shutdown state, and implements the main event loop with embedder message dispatch.

nodes.name: run_content_process
nodes.summary: Entry point for Servo content processes. Initializes the sandbox, sets up the pipeline namespace, and starts the constellation in content process mode.

nodes.name: ServoError
nodes.summary: Enum representing unrecoverable Servo errors: lost backend connection, devtools startup failure, or failed delegate response delivery.

nodes.name: ServoDelegate
nodes.summary: Trait for embedders to receive engine-level notifications: errors, devtools server start, devtools connection requests, web resource loading, notifications, and console messages.

nodes.name: StorageType
nodes.summary: Bitflags enum identifying categories of site-associated data: Cookies, Local storage, and Session storage. Used for composable queries and clearing operations.

nodes.name: SiteData
nodes.summary: Data model representing a site (by name/eTLD+1) and the types of storage data associated with it.

nodes.name: SiteDataManager
nodes.summary: Central manager for site-associated data (cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage) across public and private contexts. Provides query, clear, and cookie CRUD operations with async callback support.

nodes.name: UserContentManager
nodes.summary: Cloneable manager for injecting user scripts and stylesheets into webviews. Sends constellation messages for add/remove operations and auto-destroys itself on drop.

nodes.name: WebView
nodes.summary: Reference-counted handle to a Servo webview. Provides the primary embedder API for navigation, input events, zoom, rendering, focus, accessibility, JavaScript evaluation, screenshots, and embedder control delegation.

nodes.name: WebViewInner
nodes.summary: Internal state for a WebView: holds delegates, rendering context, accessibility tree IDs, navigation state, load status, title, favicon, focus, cursor, and back/forward list.

nodes.name: WebViewBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder for constructing a WebView with configurable delegate, URL, hidpi scale factor, user content manager, clipboard delegate, and gamepad delegate.

nodes.name: NavigationRequest
nodes.summary: Represents a pending navigation request for a WebView. Embedders can allow() or deny() the navigation; defaults to allow on drop if unhandled.

nodes.name: PermissionRequest
nodes.summary: Wraps a permission feature request from web content, allowing embedders to grant or deny access to features like geolocation or notifications.

nodes.name: AllowOrDenyRequest
nodes.summary: Generic allow-or-deny responder used across multiple delegate request types. Wraps an IpcResponder<AllowOrDeny> with error reporting.

nodes.name: ProtocolHandlerRegistration
nodes.summary: Data struct carrying a protocol handler registration or unregistration request with scheme, URL, and register/unregister flag.

nodes.name: BluetoothDeviceSelectionRequest
nodes.summary: Encapsulates a Bluetooth device selection dialog request, providing the list of discovered devices and methods to pick a device or cancel.

nodes.name: AuthenticationRequest
nodes.summary: Represents an HTTP authentication challenge with URL and proxy flag, allowing embedders to provide credentials via authenticate() or let it fail on drop.

nodes.name: WebResourceLoad
nodes.summary: Represents an intercepted web resource load. Embedders can inspect the request and optionally intercept() to provide custom response data.

nodes.name: InterceptedWebResourceLoad
nodes.summary: Handle for sending intercepted web resource response data. Supports send_body_data(), finish(), and cancel() with automatic cancel on drop.

nodes.name: EmbedderControl
nodes.summary: Enum representing all types of embedder UI controls that Servo may request: SelectElement, ColorPicker, FilePicker, InputMethod, SimpleDialog, and ContextMenu.

nodes.name: ContextMenu
nodes.summary: Encapsulates a context menu request with position, element info, and menu items. Embedders select an action or dismiss the menu.

nodes.name: SelectElement
nodes.summary: Encapsulates a select dropdown request with options, multi-select support, and methods for selecting options and submitting or dismissing.

nodes.name: ColorPicker
nodes.summary: Encapsulates a color picker request with current color and position. Embedders select a color and submit or let it dismiss on drop.

nodes.name: FilePicker
nodes.summary: Encapsulates a file picker request with filter patterns and multi-select support. Embedders select file paths and submit or dismiss.

nodes.name: InputMethodControl
nodes.summary: Describes the current state of an input method editor (IME) for text input, including input type, text content, insertion point, position, multiline flag, and virtual keyboard preference.

nodes.name: SimpleDialog
nodes.summary: Enum representing the three JavaScript dialog types: Alert, Confirm, and Prompt. Each variant contains the dialog-specific data and response sender.

nodes.name: CreateNewWebViewRequest
nodes.summary: Request to create a new WebView, providing a builder() method that returns a pre-configured WebViewBuilder with the Servo instance and responder.

nodes.name: WebViewDelegate
nodes.summary: Primary embedder trait for handling per-WebView events: URL/title/status/focus/load/favicon/cursor changes, navigation requests, unload, resize/move, new window creation, permissions, authentication, Bluetooth dialogs, embedder controls, resource loading, notifications, console messages, and accessibility updates.

nodes.summary: Context manager that spins up a local ThreadingHTTPServer to serve test files from a directory, starting and stopping the server in a background thread.

nodes.name: ParserReflect

nodes.summary: Trait defining the Web Storage engine interface with load, clear, delete, set, and save operations for key-value origin data persistence.

nodes.name: SqliteEngine
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed WebStorageEngine holding a database connection and implementing key-value storage with WAL journal mode and in-memory fallback.

nodes.name: init_db
nodes.summary: Initializes a WebStorage SQLite database, creating the data table with key-value columns and setting WAL journal mode, or creates an in-memory database when no path is given.

nodes.name: set
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a key-value pair in the WebStorage database within a transaction, attempting an UPDATE first and INSERTing only if no row was updated.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Persists an entire OriginEntry by deleting all existing data and bulk-inserting key-value pairs within a transaction, logging errors on failure.

nodes.name: WebStorageThreadFactory
nodes.summary: Public trait for creating WebStorage thread instances, implemented by GenericSender to spawn a named WebStorageManager thread with memory reporting.

nodes.name: StorageOrigins
nodes.summary: Serializable collection of origin descriptors for tracking which origins have storage data, with JSON persistence to disk via localstorage.json.

nodes.name: OriginEntry
nodes.summary: In-memory representation of an origin's Web Storage data as an ordered BTreeMap of key-value pairs with size tracking for quota enforcement.

nodes.name: WebStorageEnvironment
nodes.summary: Pairs a WebStorageEngine with in-memory OriginEntry data, auto-saving on drop, and bridging between the engine's persistent storage and in-memory operations.

nodes.name: WebStorageManager
nodes.summary: Central manager for all Web Storage operations, owning session and local storage origin registries, per-webview session data, and per-origin SQLite environments.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Main event loop for the WebStorageManager, dispatching WebStorageThreadMsg variants: Length, Key, Keys, SetItem, GetItem, RemoveItem, Clear, Clone, ListOrigins, and ClearDataForSites.

nodes.name: set_item
nodes.summary: Implements Storage.setItem() with quota enforcement: computes the new size, rejects if over the 5MB limit, and delegates to the SQLite engine for local storage persistence.

nodes.name: clear_data_for_sites
nodes.summary: Removes all storage data for specified eTLD+1 sites, deleting origin directories from disk for local storage and filtering session data maps, then persisting the updated origin list.

nodes.name: gl_utils.rs
nodes.summary: Provides GlClearer, a utility struct for managing OpenGL framebuffers used to clear WebXR layer textures with proper winding-order handling.

nodes.name: GlClearer
nodes.summary: Manages OpenGL framebuffers (FBOs) keyed by layer and depth-stencil settings; handles framebuffer creation, clearing, and destruction for WebXR rendering.

nodes.name: fbo
nodes.summary: Creates or retrieves a framebuffer object for a given layer, attaching color and depth-stencil textures with configurable winding order.

nodes.name: clear
nodes.summary: Clears a layer's framebuffer by saving/restoring GL state, binding the FBO, clearing color/depth/stencil, and restoring original state.

nodes.name: destroy_layer
nodes.summary: Destroys all framebuffers associated with a given layer and context, cleaning up GL resources.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Implements a desktop window-based WebXR backend using surfman for OpenGL context management, supporting multiple render targets (blit, stereo, cubemap, spherical) and window event handling.

nodes.name: GlWindow
nodes.summary: Trait representing a window that can provide render targets, rotation, translation, display handle, and rendering mode for the GL window WebXR backend.

nodes.name: GlWindowMode
nodes.summary: Enum defining rendering modes: Blit (texture copy), StereoLeftRight, StereoRedCyan, Cubemap, and Spherical for the GL window WebXR backend.

nodes.name: GlWindowRenderTarget
nodes.summary: Enum specifying whether rendering targets a native widget surface or a swap chain in the GL window backend.

nodes.name: GlWindowDiscovery
nodes.summary: Discovery struct that scans for available window-based WebXR devices; creates and manages the connection, adapter, and window handles.

nodes.name: GlWindowDevice
nodes.summary: Main device struct for the GL window WebXR backend; manages the surfman device, GL context, layer manager, swap chains, viewports, shaders, and event dispatch.

nodes.name: GlWindowShader
nodes.summary: Compiles and manages GLSL shaders (vertex + fragment) for texture rendering in various window modes (blit, stereo, cubemap, spherical).

nodes.name: GlWindowDiscovery::new
nodes.summary: Constructor for GlWindowDiscovery; creates a surfman connection, adapter, and queries the GL API version from the provided window handle.

nodes.name: GlWindowDiscovery::request_session
nodes.summary: Requests a new WebXR session by validating the mode and initialization, then spawning a GlWindowDevice on the main thread.

nodes.name: GlWindowDevice::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a GlWindowDevice by creating surfman device/context, loading GL functions, setting up surfaces, swap chains, and a GlWindowShader for rendering.

nodes.name: GlWindowDevice::end_animation_frame
nodes.summary: Completes an animation frame by acquiring swap chain surfaces, rendering via the shader or blit, presenting surfaces, and managing framebuffers.

nodes.name: GlWindowDevice::viewport_size
nodes.summary: Calculates viewport dimensions based on window size and rendering mode, supporting various stereo and cubemap layouts.

nodes.name: GlWindowDevice::view
nodes.summary: Computes a view transform (position + rotation) for a given eye in various window modes including stereo, cubemap faces, and spherical projections.

nodes.name: GlWindowShader::new
nodes.summary: Compiles vertex and fragment shaders for the GL window backend, including a fixed vertex buffer, VAO setup, and shader program linking with compile-status checks.

nodes.name: GlWindowShader::draw_texture
nodes.summary: Draws a texture to the screen using the compiled shader program, setting uniforms for scaling and applying the viewport/GL draw call.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Implements a headless (mock) WebXR backend for testing and development, supporting simulated devices, input events, hit testing against 3D geometry, and frame management.

nodes.name: HeadlessMockDiscovery
nodes.summary: Discovery struct for mock WebXR devices; allows enabling/disabling and simulating device connections for testing.

nodes.name: HeadlessDiscovery
nodes.summary: Discovery struct for programmatic headless WebXR sessions; holds shared device data and tracks support for VR, inline, and AR modes.

nodes.name: HeadlessDevice
nodes.summary: Device struct for headless WebXR sessions; manages per-session state, layer manager, hit tests, and input event dispatch via shared data lock.

nodes.name: HeadlessDeviceData
nodes.summary: Shared data container for the headless backend; holds floor transform, world geometry, inputs, views, sessions, and hit-test state protected by a Mutex.

nodes.name: HeadlessMockDiscovery::simulate_device_connection
nodes.summary: Simulates a WebXR device connection by spawning a background thread to run the event loop with shared device data if the mock is enabled.

nodes.name: HeadlessDiscovery::request_session
nodes.summary: Requests a headless WebXR session by validating mode support, creating per-session state, and spawning a HeadlessDevice with shared data.

nodes.name: HeadlessDevice::begin_animation_frame
nodes.summary: Begins an animation frame in headless mode; acquires layer frames, processes hit tests against world geometry, and emits frame update events.

nodes.name: HeadlessDeviceData::get_frame
nodes.summary: Builds a Frame from current shared state: clones views, computes viewer origin transform, and collects active input sources with their rays and grips.

nodes.name: HeadlessDeviceData::handle_msg
nodes.summary: Processes incoming messages for the headless backend: updates floor origin, manages input sources (add/remove), handles button/select events, and quits sessions.

nodes.name: HeadlessDeviceData::native_ray
nodes.summary: Converts a WebXR hit-test ray into native-space coordinates using floor transform, viewer origin, input pointer, and space offset transforms.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the WebXR component; declares submodules (gl_utils, glwindow, headless, openxr, surfman_layer_manager) and defines the WebXrRegistry registration trait.

nodes.name: WebXrRegistry
nodes.summary: Trait for registering WebXR backend implementations; provides a single `register` method that takes a WebXrRegistrar to connect backends.

nodes.name: graphics.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the GraphicsProvider and GraphicsProviderMethods traits for abstracting graphics API-specific OpenXR session creation, format picking, and surface texture conversion.

nodes.name: GraphicsProvider
nodes.summary: Marker trait for graphics backend types that implement GraphicsProviderMethods.

nodes.name: GraphicsProviderMethods
nodes.summary: Trait defining the graphics provider interface: enable extensions, pick swapchain format, create OpenXR session, and convert swapchain textures to surface textures.

nodes.name: graphics_d3d11.rs
nodes.summary: Direct3D 11 implementation of the GraphicsProvider traits for OpenXR, including DXGI adapter matching, session creation via D3D11, and surface texture conversion.

nodes.name: pick_format
nodes.summary: Selects the optimal D3D11 swapchain format from a list preferring SRGB8_ALPHA8, then UNORM8_ALPHA8, falling back to the first available format.

nodes.name: create_session
nodes.summary: Creates an OpenXR session with D3D11 graphics binding; builds a surfman adapter from the OpenXR system and passes the native D3D11 device to the session.

nodes.name: get_matching_adapter
nodes.summary: Enumerates DXGI adapters to find one matching the given LUID requirements (vendor ID, device ID) for OpenXR-D3D11 interoperability.

nodes.name: input.rs
nodes.summary: Implements OpenXR input handling: click/squeeze state machines, action binding setup per interaction profile, per-frame input polling (pose, buttons, axes), and hand joint tracking via XR_EXT_hand_tracking.

nodes.name: ClickState
nodes.summary: Enum tracking click state machine: Clicking (active press) or Done (released). Used for select and squeeze button processing.

nodes.name: OpenXRInput
nodes.summary: Per-hand input state struct holding OpenXR action handles for aim pose, grip pose, click, squeeze, buttons, axes, and optional hand tracker; manages input lifecycle.

nodes.name: OpenXRInput::new
nodes.summary: Creates per-hand OpenXR action handles (aim pose, grip pose, click, squeeze, buttons, axes) from an action set, with optional hand tracker and interaction-profile-specific button setup.

nodes.name: setup_inputs
nodes.summary: Creates action sets for left and right hands, builds action-to-path bindings per supported interaction profile, and attaches action sets to the session.

nodes.name: OpenXRInput::frame
nodes.summary: Polls all per-frame input: locates aim/grip poses, computes target ray from gaze and grip, reads button/axis states, updates click/squeeze state machines, and locates hand joints.

nodes.name: locate_hand
nodes.summary: Locates hand joint positions via XR_EXT_hand_tracking or XR_FB_hand_tracking_aim extensions, transforming joint locations into WebXR hand data structures.

nodes.name: interaction_profiles.rs
nodes.summary: Defines all supported OpenXR interaction profiles (KHR Simple, HTC Vive, Oculus Touch, Valve Index, Microsoft MR, etc.) with their paths, extensions, button/axis layouts, and profile resolution helpers.

nodes.name: InteractionProfileType
nodes.summary: Enum listing all supported OpenXR controller/hand interaction profile types across major vendors (KHR, HTC, Oculus, Meta, Valve, Microsoft, Samsung, etc.).

nodes.name: InteractionProfile
nodes.summary: Struct describing a single interaction profile: profile type, OpenXR path string, required extension, standard button/axis mappings, and left/right-specific buttons.

nodes.name: get_profiles_from_path
nodes.summary: Looks up interaction profiles matching a given OpenXR path string from the static profile table.

nodes.name: get_supported_interaction_profiles
nodes.summary: Filters the static interaction profile table to those supported by given OpenXR extensions, collecting profile references based on extension availability.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Core OpenXR backend implementation: device discovery, instance creation, session management, layer/swapchain management (via surfman), animation frame loop with view/projection, input integration, passthrough support, context menu handling, and frame rate control.

nodes.name: ContextMenuProvider
nodes.summary: Trait for providing context menu functionality in OpenXR sessions; supports opening a context menu and cloning the provider object.

nodes.name: AppInfo
nodes.summary: Struct holding application metadata (name, version) and engine metadata (name, version) for OpenXR instance creation.

nodes.name: ViewInfo
nodes.summary: Per-eye view information: the view pose, recommended render extent, and a cached projection matrix (recomputed when clip planes change).

nodes.name: OpenXrDiscovery
nodes.summary: Discovery struct for the OpenXR backend; creates instances on demand and supports session requests with the given context menu provider and app info.

nodes.name: CreatedInstance
nodes.summary: Result of instance creation: holds the OpenXR instance, system ID, and capability flags (hand tracking, secondary views, mutable FOV, passthrough, framerate control).

nodes.name: OpenXrDevice
nodes.summary: Main device struct for the OpenXR backend: owns the session, frame waiter, layer manager, viewer space, shared data, action set, hand input objects, and context menu state.

nodes.name: SharedData
nodes.summary: Thread-safe shared data container (Arc<Mutex<>>) for the OpenXR device: left/right/secondary view info, blend modes, frame state, reference space, and swapchain sample count.

nodes.name: OpenXrLayerManager
nodes.summary: Manages OpenXR swapchain layers: creating/destroying layers with depth-stencil textures, beginning/ending frames with projection layer submission, and clearing framebuffers.

nodes.name: OpenXrLayer
nodes.summary: Represents a single OpenXR swapchain layer with its images, surface textures, depth-stencil texture, and acquire/release tracking for frame management.

nodes.name: create_instance
nodes.summary: Creates an OpenXR instance: loads the entry point, enumerates extensions, enables graphics and interaction-profile extensions, queries system capabilities (hand tracking, mutable FOV, secondary views), and returns a CreatedInstance.

nodes.name: OpenXrDiscovery::request_session
nodes.summary: Requests an OpenXR session by validating mode/features, creating an instance, checking feature support, validating init, and spawning the OpenXrDevice on the XR thread.

nodes.name: OpenXrLayerManager::create_layer
nodes.summary: Creates an OpenXR layer: picks swapchain format, creates swapchain, allocates GL depth-stencil texture, and wraps in an OpenXrLayer for per-frame surface texture acquisition.

nodes.name: OpenXrLayerManager::end_frame
nodes.summary: Ends an OpenXR frame: releases swapchain images, builds projection layer views (primary and optional secondary), submits composition layers via the frame stream, and handles passthrough.

nodes.name: OpenXrLayerManager::begin_frame
nodes.summary: Begins an OpenXR frame: calls frame_stream.begin(), acquires and waits on swapchain images, converts to surface textures via GraphicsProvider, and clears framebuffers.

nodes.name: OpenXrDevice::new
nodes.summary: Constructs an OpenXrDevice: creates session via GraphicsProvider, sets up frame streams (primary/secondary), creates reference spaces, enumerates view configs/blend modes, and initializes input handling.

nodes.name: OpenXrDevice::begin_animation_frame
nodes.summary: Orchestrates an animation frame: processes OpenXR events, waits for frame timing, begins the layer frame, locates views, syncs action inputs, polls hand/controller input, handles context menu, and emits input events.

nodes.name: OpenXrDevice::handle_openxr_events
nodes.summary: Polls and dispatches OpenXR events: session state changes (ready, stopping, loss, exiting), visibility changes, interaction profile changes (updates input source profiles), and reference space changes.

nodes.name: OpenXrDevice::quit
nodes.summary: Gracefully shuts down the OpenXR session: requests exit, polls remaining events until session ends, and notifies listeners with a SessionEnd event.

nodes.name: transform
nodes.summary: Converts an OpenXR Posef (quaternion orientation + vector3 position) into a WebXR RigidTransform3D with rotation and translation.

nodes.name: fov_to_projection_matrix
nodes.summary: Wraps the utility fov_to_projection_matrix function for OpenXR field-of-view to projection matrix conversion with configurable clip planes.

nodes.name: surfman_layer_manager.rs
nodes.summary: Implements a surfman-based layer manager for WebXR: creates, destroys, and manages swap-chain-backed rendering layers with GL depth-stencil textures, framebuffer clearing, and per-frame acquire/recycle of surface textures.

nodes.name: SurfmanGL
nodes.summary: Marker trait for surfman GL device types used by the layer manager.

nodes.name: SurfmanLayerManager
nodes.summary: Generic layer manager over a surfman GL device: manages layers, swap chains, surface textures, depth-stencil textures, viewports, and framebuffer clearing.

nodes.name: SurfmanLayerManager::create_layer
nodes.summary: Creates a new rendering layer: allocates GL depth-stencil texture, creates a detached swap chain with the surfman device, and registers the layer for frame management.

nodes.name: SurfmanLayerManager::begin_frame
nodes.summary: Begins a render frame: acquires surface textures from swap chains, builds SubImages with viewports, clears framebuffers via GlClearer, and returns per-layer render targets.

nodes.name: SurfmanLayerManager::end_frame
nodes.summary: Ends a render frame: flushes GL commands, recycles surface textures back to swap chains, and swaps buffers for presentation.

nodes.name: canvas_state.rs
nodes.summary: Core canvas state management module implementing the CanvasRenderingContext2D drawing state machine, including fill/stroke styles, gradients, patterns, image drawing, text rendering, path operations, transformations, and color parsing for the Servo browser engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive use of #[no_trace] annotations for non-JS-traced fields; leverages Servo's DomRefCell, transform matrices, and font shaping infrastructure to implement the full HTML Canvas 2D API state machine.

nodes.name: CanvasFillOrStrokeStyle
nodes.summary: Internal enum representing the three possible canvas fill or stroke style types: solid Color, CanvasGradient, or CanvasPattern, bridging DOM objects to the servo-canvas rendering traits.

nodes.name: CanvasContextState
nodes.summary: Represents the full mutable 2D canvas context state stack entry, storing all rendering attributes (alpha, composition, transforms, fill/stroke styles, line styles, shadow, font, text alignment, and clip count) for save/restore operations.

nodes.name: CanvasState
nodes.summary: Top-level canvas state container managing the canvas ID, bitmap dimensions, origin-clean flag, image cache, saved state stack, current default path, and buffered command sender to the canvas paint thread.

nodes.name: UnshapedTextRun
nodes.summary: Holds unshaped text run data including font, script, string content, and language tag before shaping into glyph positions.

nodes.name: new_CanvasContextState
nodes.summary: Creates a default CanvasContextState with standard initial values: opaque black fill/stroke, 1.0 global alpha, default composition, identity transform, default font, and zero shadow.

nodes.name: line_options
nodes.summary: Builds a LineOptions struct from the current context state, collecting line width, cap style, join style, miter limit, dash array, and dash offset for the canvas paint thread.

nodes.name: new_CanvasState
nodes.summary: Constructs a new CanvasState, establishing the canvas paint thread channel via constellation messages, setting initial bitmap dimensions, and initializing the state stack, image cache, and command buffer.

nodes.name: set_bitmap_dimensions
nodes.summary: Resets the canvas to a new bitmap size, discarding buffered draw commands and sending a Recreate command to the paint thread with the adjusted dimensions.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Resets the canvas state to initial defaults, discards buffered commands if paintable, and sends a Recreate command to the paint thread.

nodes.name: reset_to_initial_state
nodes.summary: Clears the current default path, saved state stack, and resets the context state to its initial defaults, setting origin-clean to true.

nodes.name: reset_bitmap
nodes.summary: Clears the canvas bitmap by sending a ClearRect command covering the full canvas dimensions, resetting the transform to identity.

nodes.name: create_drawable_rect
nodes.summary: Validates and creates a drawable rectangle from four coordinate values, returning Some(Rect) if all values are finite, or None if any coordinate is NaN or infinite.

nodes.name: is_origin_clean
nodes.summary: Determines if a canvas image source (image, video, canvas, or bitmap) has a clean origin by checking same-origin status or the element's origin-clean flag.

nodes.name: fetch_image_data
nodes.summary: Retrieves raster image data from the image cache, returning a snapshot of the loaded image pixels or None if the image has not been loaded.

nodes.name: request_image_from_cache
nodes.summary: Looks up an image URL in the image cache, returning the rasterized snapshot on cache hit or recording the URL as missing for later retrieval.

nodes.name: draw_image_internal
nodes.summary: Central dispatch function for drawImage() that routes to the appropriate drawing method based on the CanvasImageSource variant (image, video, canvas, offscreen canvas, image bitmap, or URL string).

nodes.name: draw_html_image_element
nodes.summary: Draws an HTMLImageElement onto the canvas using raster image data, validating source/destination rectangles and checking origin cleanliness.

nodes.name: draw_html_video_element
nodes.summary: Draws an HTMLVideoElement frame onto the canvas, extracting the current video frame as a raster snapshot and validating both source and destination rectangles.

nodes.name: draw_offscreen_canvas
nodes.summary: Draws an OffscreenCanvas bitmap onto the canvas, handling full and partial source rectangles, origin-clean propagation, and coordinated resizing between canvases.

nodes.name: draw_html_canvas_element
nodes.summary: Draws an HTMLCanvasElement bitmap onto the canvas, with complex logic for handling resized canvases, origin-clean inheritance, and coordinated pixel-copy across different canvas sizes.

nodes.name: fetch_and_draw_image_data
nodes.summary: Fetches image data by URL and draws it onto the canvas, handling CORS settings, source/destination rectangle adjustment, and origin-clean flag updates.

nodes.name: draw_image_bitmap
nodes.summary: Draws an ImageBitmap onto the canvas, validating that the bitmap is not detached and handling source/destination rectangle adjustments and origin-clean checks.

nodes.name: adjust_source_dest_rects
nodes.summary: Adjusts source and destination rectangles for drawImage operations, computing sensible defaults for unspecified dimensions and preserving aspect ratios.

nodes.name: update_transform
nodes.summary: Applies a new transform matrix to the canvas state and sends a SetTransform command to the paint thread.

nodes.name: fill_rect
nodes.summary: Fills a rectangle at the given coordinates using the current fill style, sending a FillRect command to the paint thread.

nodes.name: stroke_rect
nodes.summary: Strokes a rectangle outline at the given coordinates using the current stroke style, sending a StrokeRect command to the paint thread.

nodes.name: stroke_style
nodes.summary: Returns the current stroke style as a StringOrCanvasGradientOrCanvasPattern union for the WebIDL binding layer.

nodes.name: set_stroke_style
nodes.summary: Sets the current stroke style from a DOM union value (string color, CanvasGradient, or CanvasPattern), parsing color strings and executing verification steps per the HTML spec.

nodes.name: fill_style
nodes.summary: Returns the current fill style as a StringOrCanvasGradientOrCanvasPattern union for the WebIDL binding layer.

nodes.name: set_fill_style
nodes.summary: Sets the current fill style from a DOM union value, parsing color strings and verifying gradient/pattern inputs per the HTML specification.

nodes.name: create_linear_gradient
nodes.summary: Creates a new CanvasGradient with linear interpolation between two coordinate points (x0,y0) and (x1,y1), constructing the DOM object via the global scope.

nodes.name: create_radial_gradient
nodes.summary: Creates a new CanvasGradient with radial interpolation between two circles defined by center points and radii, constructing the DOM object via the global scope.

nodes.name: create_pattern
nodes.summary: Creates a CanvasPattern from an image source with specified repetition mode, extracting the raster snapshot and verifying the image is fully decodable and usable.

nodes.name: restore
nodes.summary: Pops the most recently saved canvas state from the stack, restoring all rendering attributes and popping any clips that were pushed during that state.

nodes.name: fill_text
nodes.summary: Renders filled text at the given coordinates using the current font and fill style, with optional max-width constraint and text shaping via the font context.

nodes.name: stroke_text
nodes.summary: Renders outlined text at the given coordinates using the current font and stroke style, with optional max-width constraint and text shaping via the font context.

nodes.name: measure_text
nodes.summary: Measures the dimensions of text using the current font, returning a TextMetrics object with width, bounding box values, and baseline measurements computed from shaped text runs.

nodes.name: set_font
nodes.summary: Parses a CSS font shorthand string and applies it as the current canvas font style, using the CSS parser to resolve font properties.

nodes.name: font
nodes.summary: Serializes the current canvas font style back to a CSS font shorthand string via the style system's ToCss trait.

nodes.name: set_line_dash
nodes.summary: Sets the line dash pattern from a sequence of segment lengths, validating that the count is even and all values are non-negative per the HTML spec.

nodes.name: set_line_dash_offset
nodes.summary: Sets the line dash phase offset, validating that the value is finite and non-negative.

nodes.name: create_image_data
nodes.summary: Creates a new ImageData object with the given pixel dimensions, allocating the backing pixel buffer with transparent black pixels.

nodes.name: get_image_data
nodes.summary: Retrieves raw pixel data from a canvas rectangle, checking origin-clean status, handling coordinate clamping, and reading back pixel data from the paint thread.

nodes.name: put_image_data
nodes.summary: Writes pixel data to the canvas at the given coordinates, sending a PutImageData command with the full image data buffer.

nodes.name: put_image_data_
nodes.summary: Writes a dirty rectangle of pixel data to the canvas, validating coordinates, handling out-of-bounds clipping, and coalescing multiple dirty rects into a single command.

nodes.name: draw_image
nodes.summary: Entry point for the two-argument drawImage() overload, drawing an image at the destination coordinates with natural dimensions.

nodes.name: draw_image_
nodes.summary: Entry point for the four-argument drawImage() overload, drawing an image at destination coordinates with specified dimensions.

nodes.name: draw_image__
nodes.summary: Entry point for the eight-argument drawImage() overload, drawing a source sub-rectangle of an image at destination coordinates with specified dimensions.

nodes.name: fill_
nodes.summary: Fills the given path using the current fill style and fill rule (nonzero or evenodd), sending a FillPath command to the paint thread.

nodes.name: stroke_
nodes.summary: Strokes the given path using the current stroke style, sending a StrokePath command to the paint thread.

nodes.name: is_point_in_path
nodes.summary: Tests whether a point is inside the current default path using the given fill rule, returning true if the point is within the filled region.

nodes.name: is_point_in_path_
nodes.summary: Tests whether a point is inside a given Path2D object's path using the specified fill rule, returning true if the point is within the filled region.

nodes.name: transform
nodes.summary: Multiplies the current transformation matrix by the given matrix components (a, b, c, d, e, f), sending the updated transform to the paint thread.

nodes.name: set_transform
nodes.summary: Resets the current transformation matrix to the given matrix components, sending the new transform to the paint thread.

nodes.name: set_transform_
nodes.summary: Applies a DOMMatrix to the canvas as the new current transformation matrix, sending the updated transform to the paint thread.

nodes.name: bezier_curve_to
nodes.summary: Adds a cubic Bezier curve to the current path from the current point to (x,y) using control points (cp1x,cp1y) and (cp2x,cp2y).

nodes.name: arc
nodes.summary: Adds a circular arc to the current path with the given center, radius, start and end angles, and optional counter-clockwise direction.

nodes.name: ellipse
nodes.summary: Adds an elliptical arc to the current path with given center, radii, rotation, start/end angles, and optional counter-clockwise direction.

nodes.name: text_with_size
nodes.summary: Renders text with explicit origin and size, shaping the text into glyph runs through the font context and generating TextRun commands with glyph positions.

nodes.name: build_unshaped_text_runs
nodes.summary: Breaks text into unshaped text runs segmented by script boundaries, assigning the appropriate font to each run based on the current font style and script compatibility.

nodes.name: find_anchor_point_for_line_of_text
nodes.summary: Computes the text anchor point based on text alignment and baseline, adjusting the origin position per the HTML Canvas text layout algorithm.

nodes.name: script_and_font_compatible
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given Unicode script is compatible with the provided font, used during text run segmentation.

nodes.name: into_shaped_text_run
nodes.summary: Shapes an unshaped text run into glyph positions using the font context and the previous glyph advance, producing a TextRun for the paint thread.

nodes.name: parse_color
nodes.summary: Parses a CSS color string into an AbsoluteColor value, using the CSS parser with canvas-specific defaults for currentcolor fallback.

nodes.name: serialize
nodes.summary: Serializes an AbsoluteColor to a CSS color string output, handling the canvas serialization rules for currentcolor and transparent values.

nodes.name: adjust_size_sign
nodes.summary: Adjusts the sign of a Size2D based on an origin point, flipping dimensions to negative when the origin indicates a reflection from the default coordinate space.

nodes.name: serialize_font
nodes.summary: Serializes a Servo Font style struct back to a CSS font shorthand string using the style system's ToCss trait for the font property.

nodes.name: adjust_canvas_size
nodes.summary: Adjusts a canvas size to minimum dimensions of 1x1 and clamps to a maximum of 16384x16384 pixels per the HTML canvas specification limits.

nodes.name: canvasgradient.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the CanvasGradient DOM interface for HTML Canvas 2D, supporting linear and radial gradient styles with color stops, plus the ToFillOrStrokeStyle trait for converting DOM gradient objects to rendering-layer fill/stroke styles.

nodes.name: CanvasGradient
nodes.summary: DOM struct representing an HTML Canvas gradient object, holding the gradient style (linear or radial) and a vector of color stops.

nodes.name: CanvasGradientStyle
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing between LinearGradientStyle and RadialGradientStyle for CanvasGradient objects.

nodes.name: ToFillOrStrokeStyle
nodes.summary: Trait for converting DOM gradient/pattern objects into the rendering layer's FillOrStrokeStyle enum, implemented by CanvasGradient and CanvasPattern.

nodes.name: AddColorStop
nodes.summary: Adds a color stop to the gradient at a given offset (0.0-1.0), parsing the color string and pushing the stop into the gradient's stop list.

nodes.name: to_fill_or_stroke_style

nodes.name: canvaspattern.rs

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel file that declares all eight geometry DOM API submodules (DOMMatrix, DOMPoint, DOMQuad, DOMRect and their readonly variants) as pub(crate), serving as the crate-internal entry point for the geometry module.

nodes.name: dommatrix.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the mutable DOMMatrix DOM API, inheriting from DOMMatrixReadOnly to provide self-mutating matrix transformation methods (multiply, translate, scale, rotate, skew, invert) and structured clone serialization per the Geometry Interfaces spec.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dom_struct macro for DOM object inheritance; delegates mutable operations to DOMMatrixReadOnly internal setters via upcast pattern.

nodes.name: DOMMatrix
nodes.summary: Mutable DOM matrix struct wrapping DOMMatrixReadOnly; provides self-mutating transformation methods (TranslateSelf, ScaleSelf, RotateSelf, etc.) and WebIDL constructor with string or numeric sequence initialization.

nodes.name: dommatrixreadonly.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the read-only DOMMatrix DOM API with the underlying Transform3D<f64> matrix storage, providing all geometry transformation computation logic, coordinate getters, matrix stringification, and matrix initialization/validation helper functions.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains spec-compliant matrix validation (validate_and_fixup, validate_and_fixup_2d) per the Geometry Interfaces spec; tracks is2D flag to distinguish 2D from 3D matrices.

nodes.name: DOMMatrixReadOnly
nodes.summary: Read-only DOM matrix struct with Transform3D<f64> storage and is2D flag; provides getters for all 16 matrix elements (M11-M44) plus aliases (A-F), immutable transformation factories (Translate, Scale, Rotate, etc.), and structured clone serialization.

nodes.name: entries_to_matrix
nodes.summary: Converts a slice of f64 entries (6 for 2D or 16 for 3D) into a validated (is2D, Transform3D) tuple per the Geometry spec; returns a TypeError for invalid entry counts.

nodes.name: dommatrix2dinit_to_matrix
nodes.summary: Creates a validated 2D Transform2D matrix from a DOMMatrix2DInit dictionary by delegating to validate_and_fixup_2d.

nodes.name: dommatrixinit_to_matrix
nodes.summary: Creates a validated (is2D, Transform3D) tuple from a DOMMatrixInit dictionary by delegating to validate_and_fixup, handling both 2D and 3D initialization per the Geometry spec.

nodes.name: transform_to_matrix
nodes.summary: Parses a CSS transform string into a validated (is2D, Transform3D) matrix tuple using cssparser and the style crate's transform property parser; returns a SyntaxError on parse failure.

nodes.name: validate_and_fixup
nodes.summary: Validates and fixes up a DOMMatrixInit dictionary per the Geometry spec, checking for 2D/3D consistency, resolving alias member conflicts, and producing a validated (is2D, Transform3D) tuple.

nodes.name: validate_and_fixup_2d
nodes.summary: Validates and fixes up a DOMMatrix2DInit per the Geometry spec, resolving a/m11, b/m12, c/m21, d/m22, e/m41, f/m42 alias conflicts and using SameValueZero comparison.

nodes.name: dompoint.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the mutable DOMPoint DOM API, wrapping DOMPointReadOnly to provide writable x/y/z/w coordinate accessors and structured clone serialization.

nodes.name: DOMPoint
nodes.summary: Mutable DOM point struct wrapping DOMPointReadOnly; provides writable x/y/z/w coordinate setters, a WebIDL constructor, FromPoint factory, and structured clone serialization.

nodes.name: dompointreadonly.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the read-only DOMPoint DOM API with Cell<f64> coordinate storage, providing getters, a MatrixTransform method that applies a matrix to the point, the DOMPointWriteMethods trait for setters, and structured clone serialization.

nodes.name: DOMPointReadOnly
nodes.summary: Read-only DOM point struct with Cell<f64> fields for x, y, z, w coordinates; provides immutable coordinate getters, MatrixTransform for applying a matrix to the point, and structured clone serialization.

nodes.name: DOMPointWriteMethods
nodes.summary: Trait defining writable setter methods (SetX, SetY, SetZ, SetW) for DOMPointReadOnly, implemented to allow mutable access through Cell<f64> fields without exposing internal mutability.

nodes.name: domquad.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOMQuad DOM API representing a quadrilateral defined by four DOMPoint corners (p1-p4), with FromRect/FromQuad factories, GetBounds for computing the bounding DOMRect, and structured clone serialization.

nodes.name: DOMQuad
nodes.summary: DOM quadrilateral struct holding four Dom<DOMPoint> references (p1-p4); provides corner accessors, FromRect/FromQuad factory methods, GetBounds for computing the axis-aligned bounding rectangle, and structured clone serialization.

nodes.name: domrect.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the mutable DOMRect DOM API, wrapping DOMRectReadOnly to provide writable x/y/width/height accessors and structured clone serialization.

nodes.name: DOMRect
nodes.summary: Mutable DOM rectangle struct wrapping DOMRectReadOnly; provides writable x/y/width/height setters, a WebIDL constructor, FromRect factory, and structured clone serialization.

nodes.name: domrectlist.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOMRectList DOM API as an indexed collection of DOMRect objects with Item, IndexedGetter, and Length methods, used primarily for getClientRects results.

nodes.name: DOMRectList
nodes.summary: DOM rectangle list struct storing a Vec<Dom<DOMRect>>; provides indexed access via Item/IndexedGetter, Length, and a first() convenience method for retrieving the first element.

nodes.name: domrectreadonly.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the read-only DOMRect DOM API with Cell<f64> coordinate and dimension storage, providing computed edge getters (Top, Right, Bottom, Left), the create_a_domrectreadonly_from_the_dictionary helper, and structured clone serialization.

nodes.name: DOMRectReadOnly
nodes.summary: Read-only DOM rectangle struct with Cell<f64> fields for x, y, width, height; provides computed edge getters (Top, Right, Bottom, Left) that account for negative dimensions, and structured clone serialization.

nodes.name: create_a_domrectreadonly_from_the_dictionary
nodes.summary: Creates a DOMRectReadOnly directly from a DOMRectInit dictionary by extracting x, y, width, and height fields, bypassing the constructor for efficient dictionary-to-object conversion.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Defines the core exception hierarchy and context class for the Mach build tool framework, including CommandContext for runtime state and multiple MachError subclasses for error handling.

nodes.name: CommandContext
nodes.summary: Holds runtime state (cwd, settings, log_manager, commands) that is passed to command providers during mach execution.

nodes.name: MachError
nodes.summary: Base exception class for all errors raised by the mach tool itself.

nodes.name: NoCommandError
nodes.summary: Raised when no command is provided to mach; signals that the user did not specify a command to run.

nodes.name: UnknownCommandError
nodes.summary: Raised when an unknown command name is passed to mach; stores the command, verb, and optional suggested commands for helpful error messages.

nodes.name: UnrecognizedArgumentError
nodes.summary: Raised when unrecognized arguments are passed to a mach command; stores the command name and the unrecognized arguments.

nodes.name: FailedCommandError
nodes.summary: Raised by commands to signal a handled failure with an exit code and optional reason string; caught by mach to print the message and exit.

nodes.name: MissingFileError
nodes.summary: Raised when mach attempts to load a commands file that does not exist on disk.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Implements the configuration system for mach with typed settings, value validation, and provider-based registration. Provides ConfigSettings as the main interface backed by Python's ConfigParser.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a class-based type system with ConfigType subclasses (StringType, BooleanType, IntegerType, PositiveIntegerType, PathType) that each implement validate, from_config, and to_config methods.

nodes.name: ConfigException
nodes.summary: Base exception class for configuration-related errors in mach.

nodes.name: ConfigType
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for config value types, defining the validate, from_config, and to_config interface that all typed settings must implement.

nodes.name: StringType
nodes.summary: Config type handler for string values; validates that the value is a string and retrieves it from config sections.

nodes.name: BooleanType
nodes.summary: Config type handler for boolean values; validates bool type and converts to/from config string representation.

nodes.name: IntegerType
nodes.summary: Config type handler for integer values; validates that the value is an int and retrieves numeric config values.

nodes.name: PositiveIntegerType
nodes.summary: Config type handler for positive integer values; extends IntegerType with additional validation requiring the value to be greater than zero.

nodes.name: PathType
nodes.summary: Config type handler for filesystem path values; validates string paths and retrieves them from config.

nodes.name: DefaultValue
nodes.summary: Sentinel marker class used to indicate that a config setting should use its registered default value.

nodes.name: reraise_attribute_error
nodes.summary: Decorator that intercepts AttributeError from a wrapped function and re-raises it with additional context from sys.exc_info.

nodes.name: ConfigSettings
nodes.summary: Main configuration interface aggregating multiple config providers; supports loading INI-style files, type validation, section-based access, and registration of external settings providers.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements dict-like access (__getitem__, __setitem__, __delitem__, __len__, __iter__, __contains__) plus attribute-style access (__getattr__, __setattr__) for ergonomic config manipulation. Uses Python's RawConfigParser as the backend.

nodes.name: decorators.py
nodes.summary: Defines the decorator-based API for registering mach commands and settings providers, including Command, SubCommand, CommandArgument, and CommandArgumentGroup decorators, plus the CommandProvider and SettingsProvider class decorators.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a metaclass-like pattern: class decorators (CommandProvider, SettingsProvider) introspect class attributes at definition time and register commands/settings with the central Registrar. Decorator classes (Command, SubCommand, CommandArgument, CommandArgumentGroup) attach _MachCommand metadata to the decorated function.

nodes.name: _MachCommand
nodes.summary: Internal container for mach command metadata including name, subcommand, category, description, conditions, parser, arguments, and argument group names. Uses __slots__ for memory efficiency.

nodes.name: CommandProvider
nodes.summary: Class decorator that scans a class for Command-decorated methods, validates them, and registers each as a command handler with the global Registrar. Also detects subcommands and argument definitions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses inspect.getfullargspec for function signature introspection and validates that the decorated class provides required attributes like mach_context, parser, etc.

nodes.name: Command
nodes.summary: Decorator class that marks a method as a mach command; creates a _MachCommand metadata instance and attaches it to the decorated function.

nodes.name: SubCommand
nodes.summary: Decorator class that marks a method as a subcommand within a command group; associates the subcommand name and description with the parent command.

nodes.name: CommandArgument
nodes.summary: Decorator class that defines a positional or optional argument for a mach command; inserts the argument definition into the command's _MachCommand metadata.

nodes.name: CommandArgumentGroup
nodes.summary: Decorator class that groups related command arguments under a named group for organized help output and argument parsing.

nodes.name: SettingsProvider
nodes.summary: Class decorator that validates a settings provider class has a config_settings attribute and registers it with the global Registrar.

nodes.name: dispatcher.py
nodes.summary: Implements the command dispatch and help system for mach, centered on CommandAction which handles argument parsing, command routing, help output (main, command-level, subcommand-level), and command suggestion via difflib.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Python's argparse framework extensibly: CommandAction subclasses argparse.Action to intercept help-related arguments, CommandFormatter/NousageFormatter customize help formatting, and the dispatch logic handles nested subcommand parsing with dynamic argument group population.

nodes.name: DispatchSettings
nodes.summary: Settings provider class decorated with @SettingsProvider that defines the config_settings list consumed by the dispatcher.

nodes.name: CommandFormatter
nodes.summary: Custom argparse HelpFormatter that adds custom usage formatting for mach commands.

nodes.name: CommandAction
nodes.summary: Core dispatch action class that intercepts mach command-line arguments, routes to the correct command handler, handles main/command/subcommand help display, parses command-specific arguments dynamically, and provides command suggestions for typos.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses argparse.Action as base class to hook into argparse's argument processing. Implements multi-level help (main, command, subcommand) and fuzzy command suggestion via difflib.get_close_matches.

nodes.name: NoUsageFormatter
nodes.summary: Custom argparse HelpFormatter that suppresses usage line output by overriding _format_usage.

nodes.name: format_docstring
nodes.summary: Formats a docstring by stripping common leading whitespace and removing leading/trailing blank lines for clean help output display.

nodes.name: logging.py
nodes.summary: Implements a structured logging framework for mach built on Python's logging module, providing JSON and human-readable formatters, terminal colorization, and a LoggingManager that orchestrates multiple log handlers and structured loggers.
nodes.languageNotes: Provides both structured (JSON/terminal) and unstructured logging modes. StructuredJSONFormatter outputs JSON log records; StructuredTerminalFormatter colorizes output using the blessed library. ConvertToStructuredFilter transparently converts legacy log calls to structured format.

nodes.name: format_seconds
nodes.summary: Formats a number of seconds into a human-readable MM:SS.DD string for displaying elapsed time.

nodes.name: ConvertToStructuredFilter
nodes.summary: Logging filter that transparently converts unstructured log records to structured format by parsing message attributes.

nodes.name: StructuredJSONFormatter
nodes.summary: Logging formatter that outputs structured log records as JSON strings with action and params fields.

nodes.name: StructuredHumanFormatter
nodes.summary: Human-readable logging formatter for structured log records, displaying elapsed time, action name, and formatted message.

nodes.name: StructuredTerminalFormatter
nodes.summary: Terminal-aware logging formatter that colorizes structured log output based on action type (using green for success, red for errors, yellow for warnings) and shows elapsed time.

nodes.name: LoggingManager
nodes.summary: Central logging orchestrator for mach that manages JSON and terminal log handlers, registers structured loggers, and supports toggling between structured and unstructured logging modes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Python's logging hierarchy: sets up a root logger with a NullHandler to suppress default output, then adds mach-specific handlers. Supports both structured (JSON/terminal) and unstructured (raw) logging modes that can be toggled at runtime.

nodes.name: main.py
nodes.summary: Main entry point for the Mach build tool framework. Contains the central Mach class that orchestrates command loading (from files, directories, and entry points), settings management, argument parsing, command dispatch, and error handling/reporting.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses importlib.util for dynamic module loading from file paths (uuid-named modules). Implements a custom ArgumentParser that suppresses usage for unrecognized arguments. ContextWrapper provides lazy attribute resolution to avoid circular import issues with command class instantiation.

nodes.name: ArgumentParser
nodes.summary: Custom argparse.ArgumentParser that overrides error() and format_help() to provide mach-specific behavior: suppresses usage on unrecognized arguments and strips irrelevant global option help from command-specific help output.

nodes.name: ContextWrapper
nodes.summary: Lazy-proxy wrapper around a context object that defers attribute resolution to avoid circular dependencies during command class instantiation.

nodes.name: Mach
nodes.summary: Central orchestrator class for the mach build tool. Manages command loading from Python files/directories/entry points, settings configuration, argument parsing, structured logging setup, command dispatch, and error reporting with stack trace filtering.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a comprehensive error handling pipeline: separates command frames from framework frames in tracebacks, prints user-friendly error headers, and supports --debug for Python debugger integration. Settings discovery walks parent directories to find mach configuration files.

nodes.name: registrar.py
nodes.summary: Central registry for mach command handlers and settings providers. MachRegistrar stores registered commands organized by category, manages command instantiation with condition checking, and handles final dispatch including Python debugger support.

nodes.name: MachRegistrar
nodes.summary: Container and dispatcher for mach commands and settings providers. Registers command handlers by category, validates conditions before execution, instantiates command classes with context, and executes commands with timing and optional pdb debugging support.
