nodes.languageNotes: Implements condition-based command gating: commands can declare conditions (e.g., required files, environment) that are checked before execution. Condition failures produce formatted messages explaining what prerequisites are missing.

nodes.name: terminal.py
nodes.summary: Consolidates terminal interaction code for mach, providing a custom LoggingHandler that coordinates with TerminalFooter for in-terminal status displays and progress rendering.

nodes.name: LoggingHandler
nodes.summary: Custom logging handler that integrates with terminal window dressing by clearing a footer area before writing log lines and redrawing the footer afterward, enabling persistent status displays alongside streaming log output.

nodes.name: TerminalFooter
nodes.summary: Manages a persistent footer area at the bottom of the terminal using ANSI escape sequences via the blessed library, supporting clear and draw operations for status lines.

nodes.name: util.py
nodes.summary: Provides small utility functions for the mach framework, currently containing a cross-Python-version environment variable setter that handles string/bytes encoding differences between Python 2 and 3.

nodes.name: setenv
nodes.summary: Compatibility shim for setting os.environ values across Python 2 and 3, handling string/bytes encoding differences using platform-appropriate encoding (mbcs on Windows, utf-8 elsewhere).

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: OpenHarmony (OHOS) media backend entry point implementing the Servo Backend trait. Provides a full media backend with player creation (OhosAvPlayer), MIME/codec capability checking via OhosRegistryScanner, and media instance lifecycle management through a shutdown thread.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the Backend and BackendInit traits from servo_media; uses a dedicated shutdown thread with mpsc channels to handle instance cleanup.

nodes.name: avplayer.rs
nodes.summary: Low-level wrapper around the OpenHarmony AVPlayer native C API. Manages player lifecycle (create, prepare, play, pause, stop, seek, release), native window surface rendering for video frames, and FFI callback wiring for info events and frame-available notifications.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of unsafe FFI calls to ohos_media_sys and ohos_window_sys; double-boxing pattern for passing Rust closures as C void pointers; conditional compilation for sdk_api_21 vs dummy source; unsafe Send+Sync implementations.

nodes.name: dummy_source.rs
nodes.summary: No-op dummy MediaSourceWrapper used when compiling without sdk_api_21 support. All methods are stubs that do nothing, providing a compile-time placeholder for the media data source interface.
nodes.languageNotes: Conditionally compiled via #[cfg(not(sdk_api_21))]; mirrors the real source.rs API surface with empty implementations.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the ohos_media sub-crate. Declares avplayer, source_builder, and conditionally compiles either source (sdk_api_21) or dummy_source modules.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses cfg-gated module declarations to select between real and dummy data source implementations based on SDK API level.

nodes.name: source.rs
nodes.summary: Real media data source implementation for sdk_api_21+. Provides a MediaSourceWrapper that feeds data to the AVPlayer via OH_AVPlayer_SetDataSource, with a PlaybackBuffer that manages in-memory buffering with seek-aware logic and a read-at callback bridging Rust closures to C FFI.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses double-boxing of closures for FFI passing; PlaybackBuffer implements a position-aware ring buffer with deadlock-safe lock release before seek callback; handles concurrent access from AVPlayer thread and script thread.

nodes.name: source_builder.rs
nodes.summary: Builder pattern for configuring and constructing a MediaSourceWrapper. Allows callers to inject closures for enough-data notifications and seek-data requests, then builds the appropriate MediaSourceWrapper variant based on conditional compilation.
nodes.languageNotes: Builder pattern with fluent setter methods; build() conditionally constructs either the sdk_api_21 MediaSourceWrapper with callbacks or the dummy no-op version.

nodes.name: player.rs
nodes.summary: High-level OhosAvPlayer implementation bridging the low-level OhosPlayer (AVPlayer wrapper) to Servo's Player and MediaInstance traits. Manages playback state machine, event dispatch (state changes, metadata, position, seek), video frame acquisition with YUV-to-BGRA conversion in a dedicated render thread, and data source setup with seek callback integration.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements Player and MediaInstance traits from servo_media_player; spawns a dedicated Media Worker Thread for frame processing with crossbeam channels; VideoSink performs NV12-to-BGRA conversion with coded height alignment to 32-pixel multiples for HarmonyOS codec padding.

nodes.name: registry_scanner.rs
nodes.summary: OpenHarmony media codec capability registry. Maintains a static LazyLock map of supported MIME types and their associated audio/video codecs, with a prefix-matching algorithm that allows wildcard codec suffixes for family-level matching (e.g., avc* matches avc1.4d401e).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses LazyLock for lazy static initialization; supports wildcard codec matching via strip_suffix('*') for family-level codec detection; registers containers (video/mp4, video/mkv, video/ts) and audio formats (aac, mp3, ogg/vorbis, wav, flac, amr, ape).

nodes.name: OhosBackend
nodes.summary: Main OpenHarmony media backend struct. Holds a map of client media instances keyed by ClientContextId, an atomic instance ID counter, and a channel sender for shutdown signaling. Implements BackendInit for construction and Backend for all media operations.

nodes.name: OhosPlayer
nodes.summary: Low-level wrapper around a native OH_AVPlayer pointer. Manages native image surface, media data source, info/frame callback closures (as raw pointers), native window handle, and AVPlayer lifecycle state. Provides methods for playback control, volume, rate, seeking, buffer acquisition, and FFI callback registration.

nodes.name: MediaSourceWrapper
nodes.summary: Real media data source for sdk_api_21+. Wraps an OH_AVDataSourceExt with a read-at callback bridged from a boxed Rust closure via double-boxing to a C function pointer. Owns a PlaybackBuffer for in-memory data management and a raw closure handle pointer for FFI lifetime management with Drop cleanup.

nodes.name: PlaybackBuffer
nodes.summary: Thread-safe playback buffer accessed concurrently by the AVPlayer client thread (reading via read_data) and the script thread (writing via push_buffer). Tracks buffer head position, seek state, active request flag, and an optional enough-data callback. Implements seek detection and stale-data rejection during active seeks.

nodes.name: MediaSourceBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder struct for MediaSourceWrapper construction. Holds optional closures for enough-data notification and seek-data request, settable via fluent builder methods, then consumed by build() to produce the appropriate MediaSourceWrapper.

nodes.name: StateManager
nodes.summary: Bridges the internal AVPlayer state machine to the external PlayerState exposed to the media element. Tracks both the low-level AVPlayerState and the high-level paused boolean.

nodes.name: OhosAvPlayer
nodes.summary: High-level player implementation for Servo's media framework. Wraps an OhosPlayer (low-level AVPlayer), manages event dispatch via GenericCallback, optional VideoSink for frame rendering, metadata tracking, and a StateManager. Implements both Player (full playback control API) and MediaInstance (lifecycle: mute/suspend/resume) traits.

nodes.name: VideoSink
nodes.summary: Video frame rendering sink that acquires decoded frames from OhosPlayer, converts NV12 YUV to BGRA, and submits VideoFrames to the video renderer. Spawns a persistent Media Worker Thread that processes frame-available events via a crossbeam channel, performing YUV conversion with coded height alignment for HarmonyOS codec padding.

nodes.name: OhosRegistryScanner
nodes.summary: Static registry of MIME types and supported codecs for the OpenHarmony AVPlayer. Lazily initialized via LazyLock and exposed as a global OHOS_REGISTRY_SCANNER static. Provides prefix-aware codec matching including wildcard suffix support for family-level detection.

nodes.name: OhosBackend::init
nodes.summary: BackendInit trait implementation. Creates the OhosBackend with an empty instance map, spawns a dedicated ShutdownThread that listens on an mpsc channel for BackendMsg::Shutdown to clean up media instances by context ID, and returns the boxed Backend trait object.

nodes.name: OhosBackend::create_player
nodes.summary: Backend trait implementation for player creation. Rejects streaming (non-seekable) media with todo!, assigns a unique player ID via atomic counter, constructs an OhosAvPlayer with video/audio renderers and backend shutdown channel, initializes its info event callback and data source, then wraps it in Arc<Mutex<dyn Player>>.

nodes.name: OhosBackend::can_play_type
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given MIME type with optional codecs parameter is supported by the OHOS AVPlayer. Parses the MIME string, extracts comma-separated codecs, and queries the global OHOS_REGISTRY_SCANNER. Returns Maybe (container only), Probably (with matching codecs), or No based on registry match results.

nodes.name: OhosPlayer::initialize_check_state_action
nodes.summary: State-driven initialization step runner. When the player reaches AV_INITIALIZED state and a native window has been set (but not yet applied), attaches the window surface to the AVPlayer and calls prepare(), advancing to the next init phase. Idempotent via has_set_window flag.

nodes.name: OhosPlayer::set_rate
nodes.summary: Sets the AVPlayer playback speed by mapping a continuous f64 rate to discrete AVPlaybackSpeed enum values. Rates >= 1.0 round down to the nearest supported forward speed (1.0x through 3.0x), rates < 1.0 round up (0.125x through 1.0x), with a 0.0 floor.

nodes.name: OhosPlayer::connect_info_event_callback
nodes.summary: Registers a Rust closure as an FFI info-event callback on the native AVPlayer. Double-boxes the closure (Box<Box<dyn Fn>>), converts to a raw pointer for passing as C void* user_data, and defines an extern C trampoline that reconstructs and invokes the closure. Stores the raw pointer for Drop cleanup.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the double-boxing pattern: Box<Box<dyn Fn>> to convert a fat pointer closure into a thin raw pointer for C FFI; the intermediate Box provides a stable memory address for the user_data pointer.

nodes.name: OhosPlayer::setup_window_buffer_listener
nodes.summary: Sets up the native rendering surface pipeline: creates a consumer surface (OH_ConsumerSurface_Create), configures buffer usage for CPU read access, registers a frame-available callback (extern C trampoline with double-boxed closure), acquires the native window handle, and triggers initialize_check_state_action to continue the init sequence.
nodes.languageNotes: Sets DEFAULT_USAGE to NATIVEBUFFER_USAGE_CPU_READ for software YUV-to-BGRA conversion on the CPU; uses double-boxing for the frame-available callback closure.

nodes.name: OhosPlayer::acquire_buffer
nodes.summary: Acquires a decoded video frame buffer from the native image surface via OH_NativeImage_AcquireNativeWindowBuffer. Waits on the fence fd with poll() (3s timeout), references/unreferences the native buffer object for safe access, and extracts buffer metadata (fd, dimensions, stride, format, virtual address) into a FrameInfo struct. Returns None on failure.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses libc::poll on the fence fd to ensure the GPU has finished rendering before reading; the reference/unreference dance around buffer handle extraction ensures safe access without ownership.

nodes.name: MediaSourceWrapper::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a MediaSourceWrapper from a MediaSourceBuilder. Creates a PlaybackBuffer, then builds a read-at closure that slices data from the buffer and triggers seek callbacks when needed. Double-boxes the closure for FFI, defines an extern C OH_AVDataSourceReadAt trampoline, and initializes the OH_AVDataSourceExt struct with the callback. Stores the raw closure pointer for Drop cleanup.
nodes.languageNotes: Double-boxes the read-at closure for FFI; the read closure carefully releases the PlaybackBuffer lock before calling seek_data (a cross-thread IPC callback) to avoid deadlock with concurrent push_data calls.

nodes.name: PlaybackBuffer::read_data
nodes.summary: Reads data from the playback buffer at a given byte position. If the position is outside the buffered range or there is no data at that position, clears the buffer, updates the head, sets the seeking flag, and returns a seek position so the caller can request new data. Otherwise copies available data into the destination slice and returns the byte count.

nodes.name: PlaybackBuffer::push_buffer
nodes.summary: Appends incoming media data to the playback buffer. Rejects data while a seek is in progress (to prevent stale data from corrupting the buffer). If the buffer exceeds capacity, invokes the enough-data closure and returns false to signal backpressure. Returns true on successful append.

nodes.name: MediaSourceBuilder::build
nodes.summary: Consumes the builder and constructs the appropriate MediaSourceWrapper. On sdk_api_21 passes self (with callbacks) to the real source constructor; otherwise constructs the no-op dummy source. Conditional compilation selects the variant at compile time.

nodes.name: OhosAvPlayer::setup_info_event
nodes.summary: Registers the central AVPlayer info event handler closure. Dispatches on AVPlayerOnInfoType: state changes (updating StateManager and sending PlaybackState events), resolution changes (updating metadata width/height), live stream detection, duration updates, buffering and volume notifications, position updates, and seek-completion events. Bridges native AVPlayer callbacks to Servo PlayerEvent dispatch.
nodes.languageNotes: Massive match expression on AVPlayerOnInfoType handling 10+ event variants; each variant extracts values from OH_AVFormat via unsafe FFI calls and sends the corresponding PlayerEvent via the GenericCallback sender.

nodes.name: OhosAvPlayer::setup_data_source
nodes.summary: Configures the media data source for the player. Creates a SeekChannel for coordinating seek requests, builds a MediaSourceWrapper via the builder pattern with closures for enough-data and seek-data events (which send PlayerEvent::EnoughData and PlayerEvent::SeekData respectively), sets the source on the inner OhosPlayer, and kickstarts the first NeedData event.

nodes.name: OhosAvPlayer::seek
nodes.summary: Seeks the player to a given time in seconds. Converts to milliseconds for the native AVPlayer seek call. If the player is not paused and was in AV_COMPLETED state, auto-restarts playback after seeking to handle end-of-stream re-seek scenarios.

nodes.name: VideoSink::setup
nodes.summary: Configures the video rendering pipeline. Registers a frame-available listener on the OhosPlayer, spawns a persistent Media Worker Thread that loops on a crossbeam channel receiving RenderMsg events. On FrameAvailable, acquires the native buffer, computes coded height with 32-pixel alignment, validates buffer size, reads NV12 YUV planes via raw pointers, converts to BGRA using yuv_nv12_to_bgra with BT.709 matrix, creates a VideoFrame, renders it via the video frame renderer, releases the buffer, and dispatches VideoFrameUpdated.
nodes.languageNotes: Computes coded height aligned to FRAME_HEIGHT_MULTIPLE (32) for HarmonyOS codec padding; splits NV12 into separate Y and UV planes from raw memory; uses the yuv crate for NV12-to-BGRA conversion with Bt709 matrix and full range.

nodes.name: OhosRegistryScanner::are_mime_and_codecs_supported
nodes.summary: Checks whether a MIME container type and its codec set are supported by the AVPlayer. First looks up the container in the registry, then verifies every requested codec against the supported list using exact match or wildcard prefix matching (trailing * stripped for family-level matching like hev1* matching hev1.2.4.L150).

nodes.name: OhosRegistryScanner::initialize_av_player_container_and_codecs
nodes.summary: Populates the codec registry with all supported containers and their codec lists. Registers video containers (mp4, mkv, ts) with HEVC and AVC video codecs plus AAC/MP3 audio, and audio-only containers (m4a, aac, mp3, ogg/vorbis, wav, flac, amr, ape) with their respective codecs.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Rust module barrel declaring all seven public sub-modules (texttrack, texttrackcue, texttrackcuelist, texttracklist, trackevent, vttcue, vttregion) that comprise the WebVTT DOM implementation in Servo.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pub(crate) visibility to expose sub-modules within the crate only.

nodes.name: texttrack.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TextTrack DOM interface representing a timed text track as defined by the HTML spec, managing track kind, mode, cues, and association with HTMLTrackElement.

nodes.name: texttrackcue.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the abstract TextTrackCue DOM interface serving as the base class for timed text cues, providing id, track, start/end time, and pause-on-exit properties.

nodes.name: texttrackcuelist.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TextTrackCueList DOM interface as an ordered collection of TextTrackCue objects with indexed access, lookup by id, and standard list mutation operations.

nodes.name: texttracklist.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TextTrackList DOM interface as a live, ordered collection of TextTrack objects with event-dispatching add/remove operations and filtering by track kind.

nodes.name: trackevent.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TrackEvent DOM interface dispatched when tracks are added or removed, carrying a MediaTrack enum that can hold VideoTrack, AudioTrack, or TextTrack references.

nodes.name: vttcue.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the VTTCue DOM interface extending TextTrackCue with WebVTT-specific styling properties including vertical direction, line, position, size, alignment, region, and snap-to-lines.

nodes.name: vttregion.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the VTTRegion DOM interface defining a sub-area of the video viewport for cue rendering, with properties for id, width, lines, anchor points, and scroll behavior.

nodes.name: TextTrack
nodes.summary: DOM struct representing a text track with kind, label, language, id, mode, a mutable cue list, an optional parent TextTrackList, and an associated HTMLTrackElement.

nodes.name: TextTrackCue
nodes.summary: Abstract base DOM struct for text track cues holding id, optional parent track reference, start/end times, and pause-on-exit flag. Serves as the superclass for VTTCue.

nodes.name: TextTrackCueList
nodes.summary: DOM struct wrapping a reflectored DOM collection of TextTrackCue references, providing indexed access, insert-if-unique add, find by identity, and remove-by-index.

nodes.name: TextTrackList
nodes.summary: DOM struct extending EventTarget to hold a live list of TextTrack references with event-dispatching add/remove operations and filtering support by track kind.

nodes.name: TrackEvent
nodes.summary: DOM struct extending Event to carry an optional MediaTrack value (video, audio, or text track) when track addition or removal events fire on media elements.

nodes.name: MediaTrack
nodes.summary: Internal enum distinguishing video (Dom<VideoTrack>), audio (Dom<AudioTrack>), and text (Dom<TextTrack>) track types carried by TrackEvent.

nodes.name: VTTCue
nodes.summary: DOM struct extending TextTrackCue with WebVTT rendering properties: region, vertical direction, snap-to-lines, line position and alignment, horizontal position and alignment, size, text alignment, and cue text content.

nodes.name: LineAndPositionSetting
nodes.summary: Enum representing either a numeric Double value or the Auto keyword for VTTCue line and position settings, convertible from f64 and from the WebIDL binding type.

nodes.name: VTTRegion
nodes.summary: DOM struct defining a WebVTT region sub-area with id, width, lines count, region anchor (x,y), viewport anchor (x,y), and scroll flag for cue rendering placement.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a new TextTrack struct with the given id, kind, label, language, mode, and optional parent track_list, initializing default mutable cells for cue list and associated track.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public constructor wrapping a new TextTrack in a reflect_dom_object_with_cx call to create a GC-rooted, script-visible DOM object with the given window and track properties.

nodes.name: get_cues
nodes.summary: Lazily initializes and returns the TextTrackCueList for this track using or_init, creating a new empty cue list bound to the current window on first access.

nodes.name: set_text_track_mode
nodes.summary: Sets the text track mode and, when changing from disabled to showing/hidden, triggers the track processing model on the associated HTMLTrackElement to load cues.

nodes.name: AddCue
nodes.summary: WebIDL method adding a cue to this track. If the cue already belongs to another track, removes it from that track first, then appends to this track's cue list.

nodes.name: RemoveCue
nodes.summary: WebIDL method removing a cue from this track's cue list by identity. Returns NotFound error if the cue is not present in the list.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a new TextTrackCue struct with the given id, start_time, end_time, and optional parent track reference, initializing default mutable cells.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public constructor wrapping a new TextTrackCue in a reflect_dom_object_with_cx call to create a GC-rooted DOM object with the given window and cue properties.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a new TextTrackCueList struct populating its internal Vec from the given slice of cue references via Dom::from_ref mapping.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public constructor creating a reflect_dom_object-wrapped TextTrackCueList initialized with the given cues for the specified window.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Adds a cue to the list only if it is not already present (checked via identity-based find), preventing duplicate entries.

nodes.name: find
nodes.summary: Searches the cue list by DOM pointer identity and returns the index of the matching cue, or None if not found.

nodes.name: GetCueById
nodes.summary: WebIDL method returning the first cue whose id matches the given string, or None if no cue has that id or the id is empty.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a new TextTrackList extending EventTarget, populating the internal Vec from the given track slice via Dom::from_ref mapping.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public constructor creating a reflect_dom_object-wrapped TextTrackList initialized with the given tracks for the specified window.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Adds a track to the list if not already present, registers the track's back-reference to this list, notifies the media element, and queues addtrack/change events via the media element task source.

nodes.name: remove
nodes.summary: Removes a track from the list by identity, clears its back-reference to this list, and queues removetrack/change events via the media element task source.

nodes.name: tracks_for_kinds
nodes.summary: Filters the track list to return only tracks whose Kind matches any of the given TextTrackKind values, used to select tracks of a specific type (subtitles, captions, etc.).

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a TrackEvent struct extending Event, converting an optional VideoTrackOrAudioTrackOrTextTrack union into the internal MediaTrack enum (Video, Audio, or Text variant).

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public constructor delegating to new_with_proto with None prototype, creating a TrackEvent with the given type, bubbles, cancelable, and track parameters.

nodes.name: new_with_proto
nodes.summary: Creates a reflect_dom_object-wrapped TrackEvent with a custom prototype, initializes the event fields (type, bubbles, cancelable), and upcasts to Event to complete DOM setup.

nodes.name: Constructor
nodes.summary: WebIDL constructor invoked from JavaScript new TrackEvent(...), parsing the init dictionary to extract the track and delegating to new_with_proto with an Atom-typed event name.

nodes.name: GetTrack
nodes.summary: WebIDL getter returning the track as a VideoTrackOrAudioTrackOrTextTrack union, mapping the internal MediaTrack enum variant back to the appropriate union variant with DomRoot extraction.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a new VTTCue struct extending TextTrackCue, initializing all WebVTT-specific styling cells with defaults: empty region, horizontal direction, snap-to-lines enabled, auto line/position, and middle alignment.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public constructor wrapping a new VTTCue in a reflect_dom_object_with_proto_and_cx call to create a GC-rooted DOM object with the given window, prototype, and timing/text parameters.

nodes.name: Constructor
nodes.summary: WebIDL constructor invoked from JavaScript new VTTCue(startTime, endTime, text), delegating to the internal new function with the given prototype and parsed DOMString text.

nodes.name: SetPosition
nodes.summary: WebIDL setter for the position property with range validation. Rejects values outside [0, 100] with IndexSize error, otherwise converts the value into a LineAndPositionSetting.

nodes.name: SetSize
nodes.summary: WebIDL setter for the size property with range validation. Rejects values outside [0, 100] with IndexSize error, otherwise sets the internal size cell.

nodes.name: from_f64
nodes.summary: From<f64> implementation for LineAndPositionSetting, converting a finite f64 value into the Double variant using Finite::wrap.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a new VTTRegion struct with a Reflector, default empty id, width 100, 3 lines, and all anchor points and scroll initialized to default values.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public constructor wrapping a new VTTRegion in a reflect_dom_object_with_proto_and_cx call to create a GC-rooted DOM object with the given window and prototype.

nodes.name: SetWidth
nodes.summary: WebIDL setter for region width with range validation. Rejects values outside [0, 100] with IndexSize error, otherwise sets the internal width cell.

nodes.name: SetRegionAnchorX
nodes.summary: WebIDL setter for region anchor X with range validation. Rejects values outside [0, 100] with IndexSize error, otherwise sets the internal cell.

nodes.name: SetRegionAnchorY
nodes.summary: WebIDL setter for region anchor Y with range validation. Rejects values outside [0, 100] with IndexSize error, otherwise sets the internal cell.

nodes.name: SetViewportAnchorX
nodes.summary: WebIDL setter for viewport anchor X with range validation. Rejects values outside [0, 100] with IndexSize error, otherwise sets the internal cell.

nodes.name: SetViewportAnchorY
nodes.summary: WebIDL setter for viewport anchor Y with range validation. Rejects values outside [0, 100] with IndexSize error, otherwise sets the internal cell.

nodes.name: error.rs
nodes.summary: Defines WebGPU error types and error scope filtering, including ErrorScope, ErrorFilter, Error, and PopError enums. Handles conversion of wgpu-core errors into GPU error scopes for the WebGPU specification.

nodes.name: ids.rs
nodes.summary: Defines WebGPU resource ID wrapper types via the webgpu_resource! macro, including WebGPUAdapter, WebGPUDevice, WebGPUBuffer, WebGPUTexture, and 20+ other typed ID wrappers. Re-exports pass-encoder marker types from wgpu_core.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a declarative macro webgpu_resource! to generate newtype wrappers around wgpu_core IDs, each implementing MallocSizeOf, Eq, and serde traits.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the shared WebGPU module. Declares submodules (error, ids, messages, render_commands) and re-exports all public items. Defines core types including WebGPU channel handle, Adapter, ContextConfiguration, DeviceLostReason, ShaderCompilationInfo, Pipeline, Mapping, and RequestDeviceError.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module that declares the recv, to_dom, and to_script submodules and re-exports all their public items for the WebGPU IPC message layer.

nodes.name: recv.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the comprehensive WebGPURequest enum with 60+ variants covering all IPC messages received by the WebGPU thread from the ScriptThread, including buffer/texture operations, pipeline creation, render/compute passes, and resource lifecycle management.
nodes.languageNotes: The WebGPURequest enum is extremely large (375+ lines, ~60 variants) spanning the full WebGPU API surface including async pipeline creation callbacks and resource drop operations.

nodes.name: to_dom.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the WebGPUDeviceResponse type alias for IPC messages sent back to WebGPU DOM objects, wrapping the device, queue, and an optional device descriptor result.

nodes.name: to_script.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the WebGPUMsg enum with variants for IPC messages sent to the ScriptThread, including resource free/drop notifications, uncaptured errors, and device lost events.

nodes.name: render_commands.rs
nodes.summary: Defines RenderCommand and RenderBundleCommand enums for WebGPU render pass operations, along with apply_render_command and apply_render_bundle_command functions that dispatch commands to the wgpu_core Global API.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a command pattern where serializable RenderCommand/RenderBundleCommand enums are dispatched to corresponding wgpu_core render pass/bundle encoder methods via exhaustive match arms.

nodes.name: ErrorScope
nodes.summary: Represents a GPU error scope that collects errors filtered by a specific ErrorFilter. Provides a new() constructor for creating empty scopes.

nodes.name: ErrorFilter
nodes.summary: Enum defining the three GPU error filter types: Validation, OutOfMemory, and Internal, as specified by the WebGPU standard.

nodes.name: Error
nodes.summary: Enum representing GPU errors with associated message strings for Validation, OutOfMemory, and Internal error types. Implements filter retrieval, message access, and conversion from wgpu_core errors.

nodes.name: PopError
nodes.summary: Enum for the result of popping an error scope, indicating whether the scope was Lost or Empty.

nodes.name: WebGPU
nodes.summary: Channel-based handle to the WebGPU thread, wrapping a GenericSender for WebGPURequest messages. Provides an exit() method to send an Exit request.

nodes.name: Adapter
nodes.summary: Represents a WebGPU adapter with info, ID, supported features, limits, and a channel to the WebGPU thread for submitting requests.

nodes.name: ContextConfiguration
nodes.summary: Rendering context configuration holding device and queue IDs, image format, opacity, and size. Provides stride() and buffer_size() helpers and converts to ImageDescriptor for WebRender.

nodes.name: DeviceLostReason
nodes.summary: Enum representing WebGPU device loss reasons: Unknown or Destroyed.

nodes.name: ShaderCompilationInfo
nodes.summary: Holds shader compilation error information with line numbers, positions, offsets, and messages. Provides a from() constructor that extracts location data from CreateShaderModuleError with UTF-8 to UTF-16 offset conversion.

nodes.name: Pipeline
nodes.summary: Generic struct representing a WebGPU compute or render pipeline, parameterized by pipeline ID type, holding the ID and a label string.

nodes.name: Mapping
nodes.summary: Represents a GPU buffer mapping with shared memory data, host map mode, and byte range.

nodes.name: RequestDeviceError
nodes.summary: Enum for errors when requesting a WebGPU device: LimitsExceeded, UnsupportedFeature, or Other. Implements From conversion from wgpu_core's RequestDeviceError.

nodes.name: PendingTexture
nodes.summary: Holds a texture pending presentation with the texture ID, command encoder ID, command buffer ID, and rendering context configuration.

nodes.name: WebGPURequest
nodes.summary: Massive enum defining all IPC request variants received by the WebGPU worker thread. Covers adapter/device management, buffer/texture operations, pipeline creation (sync and async), render/compute pass commands, resource lifecycle (create/destroy/drop), error scopes, external textures, and query sets.

nodes.name: WebGPUMsg
nodes.summary: Enum of IPC messages sent to the ScriptThread, including resource free/drop notifications for all WebGPU resource types, uncaptured error reporting, device lost events with reason and message, and an Exit signal.

nodes.name: RenderCommand
nodes.summary: Enum defining all serializable render pass commands: SetPipeline, SetBindGroup, SetViewport, SetScissorRect, SetBlendConstant, SetStencilReference, SetIndexBuffer, SetVertexBuffer, Draw, DrawIndexed, DrawIndirect, DrawIndexedIndirect, ExecuteBundles, PushDebugGroup, PopDebugGroup, and InsertDebugMarker.

nodes.name: apply_render_command
nodes.summary: Dispatches a RenderCommand to the corresponding wgpu_core Global render pass method. Exhaustively matches all command variants and delegates to the appropriate render_pass_*_with_id call.

nodes.name: RenderBundleCommand
nodes.summary: Enum defining serializable render bundle commands: SetPipeline, SetBindGroup, SetIndexBuffer, SetVertexBuffer, Draw, DrawIndexed, DrawIndirect, DrawIndexedIndirect, PushDebugGroup, PopDebugGroup, and InsertDebugMarker. A subset of RenderCommand without viewport/scissor/blend/stencil operations.

nodes.name: apply_render_bundle_command
nodes.summary: Dispatches a RenderBundleCommand to the corresponding wgpu_core Global render bundle encoder method. Exhaustively matches all command variants and delegates to the appropriate render_bundle_encoder_*_with_id call.

nodes.name: actions.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the WebDriver Actions API, processing input action sequences (key, pointer, wheel) into DOM events dispatched through the embedder.

nodes.name: PointerInputState
nodes.summary: Represents the state of a pointer input source including subtype, pressed buttons, pointer ID, and current coordinates.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new pointer input source with a unique pointer ID based on subtype and existing IDs.

nodes.name: compute_tick_duration
nodes.summary: Computes the maximum duration across all actions in a tick per the WebDriver spec.

nodes.name: dispatch_actions
nodes.summary: Dispatches actions by tick to a browsing context, processing each tick with computed durations.

nodes.name: process_pending_actions
nodes.summary: Processes pending pointer move and scroll actions that span multiple execution cycles within a tick.

nodes.name: dispatch_tick_actions
nodes.summary: Dispatches all actions within a single tick, dispatching key, pointer, and wheel actions in order.

nodes.name: dispatch_keydown_action
nodes.summary: Dispatches a key down action by sending a KeyboardEvent through the embedder.

nodes.name: dispatch_keyup_action
nodes.summary: Dispatches a key up action with special handling for modifier keys needing scroll page action.

nodes.name: dispatch_pointercancel_action
nodes.summary: Dispatches a pointer cancel action by sending touch cancel or mouse up events through the embedder.

nodes.name: dispatch_pointerdown_action
nodes.summary: Dispatches a pointer down action handling mouse, pen, and touch input types.

nodes.name: dispatch_pointerup_action
nodes.summary: Dispatches a pointer up action with cleanup of pressed button state after the event.

nodes.name: dispatch_pointermove_action
nodes.summary: Dispatches a pointer move action as either instant or initiating an incremental move series.

nodes.name: perform_pointer_move
nodes.summary: Performs incremental pointer movement over a duration, computing intermediate positions per vsync interval.

nodes.name: dispatch_scroll_action
nodes.summary: Dispatches a wheel scroll action with origin-relative coordinate resolution support.

nodes.name: perform_scroll
nodes.summary: Performs incremental scroll over a duration using vsync-interval steps for smooth scrolling.

nodes.name: get_origin_relative_coordinates
nodes.summary: Resolves pointer origin coordinates relative to an element or viewport per the WebDriver spec.

nodes.name: get_element_in_view_center_point
nodes.summary: Calculates the in-view center point of an element for scroll-into-view and pointer positioning.

nodes.name: extract_an_action_sequence
nodes.summary: Extracts and validates a single action sequence from WebDriver command parameters.

nodes.name: process_an_input_source_action_sequence
nodes.summary: Processes a single input source action sequence, converting WebDriver actions into internal action items.

nodes.name: capabilities.rs
nodes.summary: Defines Servo-specific WebDriver browser capabilities implementing the BrowserCapabilities trait for new session negotiation.

nodes.name: ServoCapabilities
nodes.summary: Holds Servo browser capability flags used during WebDriver session creation: browser name, version, platform, insecure certs, webauthn support.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs default ServoCapabilities with browser name 'servo', auto-detected platform name, and default capability flags.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Core WebDriver server module providing the Handler struct implementing W3C WebDriver commands (navigation, element interaction, script execution, cookies, screenshots) and Servo extension routes.
nodes.languageNotes: The Handler struct has 91 methods implementing the full W3C WebDriver protocol. Uses IPC channels for embedder/constellation communication and crossbeam for threaded load-status monitoring.

nodes.name: Handler
nodes.summary: Central WebDriver handler managing session state, embedder communication via IPC channels, load-status monitoring, pending input events, and action sequences.

nodes.name: ServoExtensionRoute
nodes.summary: Enum defining Servo-specific WebDriver extension routes: get/set/reset prefs, shutdown, custom handlers set-mode, and reset all cookies.

nodes.name: ServoExtensionCommand
nodes.summary: Enum representing Servo-specific WebDriver extension commands with associated parameter payloads.

nodes.name: extension_routes
nodes.summary: Defines HTTP method and URL pattern to ServoExtensionRoute variant mappings for the warp web framework.

nodes.name: start_server
nodes.summary: Public entry point spawning a WebDriver HTTP server thread on the given port with embedder sender and event loop waker.

nodes.name: command
nodes.summary: Implements WebDriverExtensionRoute::command to deserialize body data into the appropriate ServoExtensionCommand variant.

nodes.name: serialize
nodes.summary: Serializes a SendableJSValue (JSValue wrapper) into JSON handling elements, shadow roots, frames, windows, arrays, and objects.

nodes.name: deserialize
nodes.summary: Deserializes JSON values into WebDriverPrefValue mapping f64/i64/u64/str/bool to corresponding PrefValue variants via serde visitor.

nodes.name: handle_new_session
nodes.summary: Processes new WebDriver session: validates capabilities, creates session, sets up initial browsing context, returns session metadata.

nodes.name: handle_get
nodes.summary: Handles GET navigation command with optional futures-based wait for document readiness.

nodes.name: wait_document_ready
nodes.summary: Blocks until the document ready event fires or timeout occurs, using IPC-based load status monitoring.

nodes.name: wait_for_navigation
nodes.summary: Waits for navigation completion polling the load status receiver until document is interactive or complete.

nodes.name: handle_set_window_rect
nodes.summary: Sets window position and size via embedder commands, handling minimized/maximized state transitions.

nodes.name: handle_maximize_window
nodes.summary: Maximizes the current window via embedder commands and queries resulting viewport dimensions.

nodes.name: handle_new_window
nodes.summary: Creates a new top-level browsing context (tab/window) with optional URL navigation, returning the new window handle.

nodes.name: handle_switch_to_frame
nodes.summary: Switches current browsing context to a child frame identified by element reference, ordinal index, or null for top-level.

nodes.name: handle_switch_to_parent_frame
nodes.summary: Switches current browsing context to the parent frame or returns to top-level if already at root.

nodes.name: handle_switch_to_window
nodes.summary: Switches to a window by handle, activating the target webview as the focused browsing context.

nodes.name: implicit_wait
nodes.summary: Implements the implicit wait algorithm polling for element presence up to the session's configured implicit wait timeout.

nodes.name: handle_find_elements
nodes.summary: Finds all elements matching a locator strategy (CSS, XPath, link text, etc.) with implicit wait support.

nodes.name: handle_find_elements_from_element
nodes.summary: Finds all descendant elements of a given element matching a locator strategy.

nodes.name: handle_find_elements_from_shadow_root
nodes.summary: Finds all elements within a shadow root matching a locator strategy.

nodes.name: handle_add_cookie
nodes.summary: Adds a cookie to the current browsing context, converting WebDriver cookie parameters to the cookie crate format.

nodes.name: handle_release_actions
nodes.summary: Releases all pressed keys, buttons, and touch points sending synthetic up events for each active input source.

nodes.name: handle_execute_script
nodes.summary: Executes a synchronous JavaScript snippet in the current browsing context and returns the serialized result.

nodes.name: handle_execute_async_script
nodes.summary: Executes an asynchronous JavaScript snippet, resolving when the script invokes the provided callback argument.

nodes.name: javascript_evaluation_result_to_webdriver_response
nodes.summary: Converts a JavaScriptEvaluationResult from the script thread into a WebDriverResponse, handling errors and value extraction.

nodes.name: handle_element_send_keys
nodes.summary: Sends keystrokes to an element by dispatching a sequence of key events (keyDown/keyUp) for each character.

nodes.name: handle_element_click
nodes.summary: Clicks an element by scrolling it into view and performing a pointer down/up sequence at its center point.

nodes.name: perform_element_click
nodes.summary: Performs low-level element click: scroll into view, compute center point, dispatch pointer and mouse events.

nodes.name: take_screenshot
nodes.summary: Takes a screenshot of the current viewport or element, returning a base64-encoded PNG image via the script thread.

nodes.name: handle_command
nodes.summary: Main WebDriver command dispatcher pattern-matching on WebDriverCommand variants and delegating to handle_* methods.

nodes.name: convert_keyboard_event_to_string
nodes.summary: Converts a keyboard_types::KeyboardEvent into a WebDriver-compatible string representation for send_keys.

nodes.name: handle_reset_prefs
nodes.summary: Resets specified Servo preferences to their default values handling boolean, string, integer and float types.

nodes.name: handle_custom_handlers_set_mode
nodes.summary: Sets the custom protocol handlers automation mode for controlling automatic registration of custom scheme handlers.

nodes.name: wait_until_browsing_context_is_open
nodes.summary: Polls the embedder to check if a browsing context is open with configurable timeout and retry interval.

nodes.name: script_argument_extraction.rs
nodes.summary: Implements JSON deserialization of WebDriver script arguments, converting web element, shadow root, frame, and window references into JavaScript expressions.

nodes.name: extract_script_arguments
nodes.summary: Extracts the script body and deserializes arguments from JavascriptCommandParameters, converting web element references to JS calls.

nodes.name: deserialize_web_element
nodes.summary: Deserializes a web element JSON reference into a window.webdriverElement() JavaScript call, validating the element is known.

nodes.name: deserialize_shadow_root
nodes.summary: Deserializes a shadow root reference validating it exists before generating a window.webdriverShadowRoot() call.

nodes.name: deserialize_web_frame
nodes.summary: Deserializes a web frame reference by parsing the frame ID as a BrowsingContextId and verifying it is open.

nodes.name: deserialize_web_window
nodes.summary: Deserializes a web window reference, verifying it maps to a known window handle before generating a window.webdriverWindow() call.

nodes.name: json_deserialize
nodes.summary: Recursively deserializes a JSON value into a JavaScript expression string dispatching on array, object, or primitive types.

nodes.name: server.rs
nodes.summary: HTTP server infrastructure for the WebDriver protocol: warp-based routing, message dispatch via channels, session validation, CORS support, and host/origin allowlisting.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses warp (tokio-based) for async HTTP serving with a Dispatcher channel pattern routing WebDriver messages to a background handler thread.

nodes.name: WebDriverHandler
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting WebDriver command handling with handle_command and teardown_session methods, parameterized over extension route type.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Main dispatcher loop receiving WebDriver messages from a channel, processing through the handler, and sending responses back.

nodes.name: check_session
nodes.summary: Validates the session ID on incoming requests, rejecting mismatched or missing session identifiers with appropriate errors.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Starts the warp HTTP server on the given address, spawning handler threads and setting up route filters with CORS support.

nodes.name: build_warp_routes
nodes.summary: Constructs warp filter chains mapping HTTP method+path to WebDriver command dispatch, including standard and extension routes.

nodes.name: is_host_allowed
nodes.summary: Validates the request Host header against an allowed hosts list, defaulting to localhost if not configured.

nodes.name: build_route
nodes.summary: Constructs a single warp route filter for a specific HTTP method and path handling body extraction and response serialization.

nodes.name: session.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the WebDriverSession struct holding per-session state (timeouts, page load strategy, input state, user prompt handler) and the W3C session creation algorithm.

nodes.name: WebDriverSession
nodes.summary: Represents an active WebDriver session with session ID, current browsing context, timeout configuration, page load strategy, input state table, and user prompt handler.

nodes.name: create_session
nodes.summary: Implements the W3C WebDriver create-a-session algorithm: processes capabilities (proxy, insecure certs, prompt behavior, page load strategy, timeouts) and returns the new session ID.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new WebDriverSession with a random UUID, default timeouts, normal page load strategy, and empty input state.

nodes.name: timeout.rs
nodes.summary: Defines WebDriver timeout configuration (script, page load, implicit wait) with serialization/deserialization per the W3C specification.

nodes.name: TimeoutsConfiguration
nodes.summary: Holds the four WebDriver timeout values (script, page load, implicit wait, sleep interval) where None means wait indefinitely.

nodes.name: deserialize_as_timeouts_configuration
nodes.summary: Deserializes a JSON object into TimeoutsConfiguration, handling null (infinite) and numeric values for script, pageLoad, and implicit keys.

nodes.name: user_prompt.rs
nodes.summary: Handles WebDriver user prompt (alert, confirm, prompt, beforeUnload) interactions: dismissing, accepting, reading/sending text, and automatic prompt handling per the W3C spec.

nodes.name: deserialize_unhandled_prompt_behaviour
nodes.summary: Parses a JSON object or string into a UserPromptHandler map, validating prompt types and handler names per the W3C spec.

nodes.name: get_user_prompt_handler
nodes.summary: Looks up the appropriate prompt handler for a given prompt type with fallback chain: type then default then beforeUnload special case then fallbackDefault then dismiss.

nodes.name: handle_dismiss_alert
nodes.summary: Dismisses the current user prompt (alert/confirm/prompt) returning void or a NoSuchAlert error if no prompt is active.

nodes.name: handle_accept_alert
nodes.summary: Accepts the current user prompt returning void or a NoSuchAlert error if no prompt is active.

nodes.name: handle_get_alert_text
nodes.summary: Retrieves the text message of the current user prompt, returning it as a Generic value response.

nodes.name: handle_send_alert_text
nodes.summary: Sends text to a prompt-type user prompt, rejecting alert/confirm types and unsupported prompt types with appropriate errors.

nodes.name: handle_any_user_prompts
nodes.summary: Handles unexpected user prompts during command execution: looks up configured handler and either dismisses/accepts or returns an UnexpectedAlertOpen error.

nodes.name: ast.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the XPath abstract syntax tree types including core expression enums, binary operators, axis specifiers, node tests, qualified names, literal values, and core function identifiers.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust enum-heavy AST definitions with 12 exported types forming the complete XPath 1.0 expression tree.

nodes.name: Expression
nodes.summary: Top-level XPath expression enum with variants for Binary, Negate, Path, LocationStep, Filter, Literal, Variable, ContextItem, and Function expressions.

nodes.name: BinaryOperator
nodes.summary: Binary operator enum covering logical (Or, And), comparison (Equal, NotEqual, LessThan, etc.), set (Union), and arithmetic (Add, Subtract, Multiply, Divide, Modulo) operators.

nodes.name: PathExpression
nodes.summary: Structure representing an XPath path expression with absolute/relative flag, descendant-or-self step indicator, and ordered step list.

nodes.name: PredicateListExpression
nodes.summary: Simple wrapper holding a vector of predicate expressions for step filtering.

nodes.name: FilterExpression
nodes.summary: Structure wrapping an expression with an associated predicate list for filtering operations.

nodes.name: LocationStepExpression
nodes.summary: Location step expression containing an axis specifier, node test, and optional predicate list.

nodes.name: Axis
nodes.summary: XPath axis specifier enum covering all 13 axes: Child, Descendant, Attribute, Self, DescendantOrSelf, FollowingSibling, Following, Namespace, Parent, Ancestor, PrecedingSibling, Preceding, AncestorOrSelf.

nodes.name: NodeTest
nodes.summary: Node test enum with variants for name-based, wildcard, and kind-based node matching.

nodes.name: QName
nodes.summary: Qualified name structure with optional namespace prefix and local part, implementing Display for XML-style output.

nodes.name: KindTest
nodes.summary: Kind test enum for processing-instruction (with optional name), comment, text, and node type matching.

nodes.name: Literal
nodes.summary: Literal value enum holding Integer, Decimal, or String constants used in XPath expressions.

nodes.name: CoreFunction
nodes.summary: Enumeration of all XPath core function identifiers including position/last, string, number, boolean, and node-set functions (28 variants).

nodes.name: context.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the XPath evaluation context (EvaluationCtx) and predicate context (PredicateCtx) types used to track the current node and predicate position during expression evaluation.

nodes.name: EvaluationCtx
nodes.summary: Evaluation context holding the current context node and optional predicate context for XPath expression evaluation.

nodes.name: PredicateCtx
nodes.summary: Predicate context tracking the current index and size within a predicate evaluation loop.

nodes.name: EvaluationCtx::new
nodes.summary: Creates a new EvaluationCtx instance from a context node with no initial predicate context.

nodes.name: EvaluationCtx::subcontext_for_node
nodes.summary: Creates a sub-context for evaluating an expression relative to a different node, preserving the predicate context.

nodes.name: eval.rs
nodes.summary: Core XPath expression evaluator that recursively evaluates AST nodes against a DOM tree, implementing binary operations, location path traversal across all 13 axes, node tests, predicates, and literal evaluation.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements evaluate() for Expression, PathExpression, LocationStepExpression, FilterExpression, and Literal types using trait-based dispatch over a generic DOM type parameter.

nodes.name: NameTestComparisonMode
nodes.summary: Enum specifying HTML vs. XHTML name comparison mode for element name matching in node tests.

nodes.name: try_extract_nodeset
nodes.summary: Attempts to extract a NodeSet from a Value, returning an error if the value is not a node set.

nodes.name: Expression::evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a top-level Expression against the DOM context, dispatching to binary operations, union, path, filter, function, literal, variable, negation, and context item evaluation.

nodes.name: PathExpression::evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a path expression by resolving the starting node set and iteratively applying each location step through the axis.

nodes.name: LocationStepExpression::evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a location step by selecting nodes along the specified axis, applying node tests, and filtering through predicates.

nodes.name: FilterExpression::evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a filter expression by first evaluating the inner expression, then applying predicate filtering to narrow the result set.

nodes.name: Literal::evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a literal AST node by converting Integer, Decimal, or String variant directly to the corresponding XPath Value.

nodes.name: element_name_test
nodes.summary: Tests whether an element name matches an expected qualified name, respecting HTML case-insensitivity rules.

nodes.name: apply_node_test
nodes.summary: Applies a NodeTest (Name, Wildcard, or Kind) against a DOM node, returning whether the node passes the test.

nodes.name: PredicateListExpression::apply
nodes.summary: Applies a list of predicates to a set of matched nodes, filtering out nodes that do not satisfy each predicate expression.

nodes.name: functions.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the complete XPath 1.0 core function library including string manipulation (concat, substring, translate, normalize-space), numeric functions (number, sum, floor, ceiling, round), boolean functions, node-set functions (count, id, local-name, namespace-uri, name), and context functions (last, position, lang).
nodes.languageNotes: Large evaluate() dispatch function (195 lines) routes CoreFunction variants to their implementations using a match statement.

nodes.name: local_name
nodes.summary: Extracts the local name from a DOM node (element, attribute, or processing instruction).

nodes.name: name
nodes.summary: Returns the qualified name of a node including the namespace prefix if present.

nodes.name: namespace_uri
nodes.summary: Returns the namespace URI of a node, or empty string if the node has no namespace.

nodes.name: substring_before
nodes.summary: Returns the substring of s1 that precedes the first occurrence of s2.

nodes.name: substring_after
nodes.summary: Returns the substring of s1 that follows the first occurrence of s2.

nodes.name: substring
nodes.summary: Returns a substring from source starting at a 1-based character position with optional length constraint.

nodes.name: normalize_space
nodes.summary: Strips leading/trailing whitespace and collapses internal whitespace sequences to single spaces.

nodes.name: lang_matches
nodes.summary: Tests whether the context language matches a target language code using XPath lang() semantics with case-insensitive prefix matching.

nodes.name: translate
nodes.summary: Character-by-character translation mapping characters from one string to corresponding positions in another, with drop behavior for unmapped characters.

nodes.name: CoreFunction::evaluate
nodes.summary: Main dispatch function that evaluates any core XPath function by matching the CoreFunction variant and delegating to the appropriate implementation with argument validation.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Main library entry point defining the public API traits (Dom, Node, Element, Attribute, Document, ProcessingInstruction, NamespaceResolver), the Error enum, default trait implementations, and the evaluate_parsed_xpath orchestration function.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines DOM abstraction traits that embedders must implement, with default empty implementations for all Node traversal methods.

nodes.name: Dom
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting the overall DOM document, parameterized by a Node type.

nodes.name: Node
nodes.summary: Core DOM node trait with methods for tree traversal (parent, children, traverse_preorder, inclusive_ancestors, preceding_nodes, following_nodes, siblings), content access (text_content, language), type checks (is_comment, is_text), and conversions (as_element, as_attribute, as_processing_instruction).

nodes.name: NamespaceResolver
nodes.summary: Trait for resolving namespace prefixes to URIs during QName resolution.

nodes.name: ProcessingInstruction
nodes.summary: Trait representing a processing instruction node with a target name.

nodes.name: Document
nodes.summary: Trait representing a document node with the ability to look up elements by ID.

nodes.name: Element
nodes.summary: Trait representing an element node with namespace, local name, attribute access, and HTML document detection.

nodes.name: Attribute
nodes.summary: Trait representing an attribute node with prefix, namespace, and local name accessors.

nodes.name: Error
nodes.summary: Error enum with variants for NotANodeset, CannotUseVariables, InvalidQName, and Internal wrapping a string message.

nodes.name: evaluate_parsed_xpath
nodes.summary: Top-level function that creates an evaluation context, evaluates a parsed XPath expression against a DOM node, deduplicates and sorts the resulting node set.

nodes.name: parser.rs
nodes.summary: Implements a recursive-descent XPath 1.0 expression parser that converts a token stream into an AST, handling operator precedence (shunting-yard style), union expressions, path expressions with absolute/relative steps, location steps with axes, node tests, predicates, and function calls with argument parsing.
nodes.languageNotes: The largest file in the module (765 non-empty lines) with 19 functions implementing full XPath 1.0 grammar parsing.

nodes.name: Error
nodes.summary: Parser error enum covering tokenization, unknown functions, argument count mismatches, unexpected input, and namespace resolution failures.

nodes.name: Parser
nodes.summary: Parser state struct holding the token stream, current position, namespace resolver reference, and HTML document mode flag.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Public entry point that tokenizes input, creates a Parser, parses an expression, and validates no trailing input remains.

nodes.name: Parser::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new Parser by tokenizing the input string and storing the namespace resolver and HTML document flag.

nodes.name: Parser::resolve_qualified_name
nodes.summary: Resolves a namespace prefix to its URI using the NamespaceResolver, returning an error on failure.

nodes.name: Parser::parse_expression
nodes.summary: Parses an XPath expression using a shunting-yard algorithm with operator precedence, handling binary operators, union, path, function, literal, variable, negation, and parenthesized sub-expressions.

nodes.name: Parser::parse_union_expression
nodes.summary: Parses union (|) expressions by chaining path expressions separated by the union operator.

nodes.name: Parser::parse_path_expression
nodes.summary: Parses XPath path expressions handling absolute/relative paths, // abbreviation, and sequences of location steps separated by /.

nodes.name: Parser::parse_filter_or_step_expression
nodes.summary: Parses either a filter expression (primary expression with predicates) or a step expression, distinguishing based on token type.

nodes.name: Parser::parse_step_expression
nodes.summary: Parses a single location step including optional axis specifier, node test (name, wildcard, or kind test), and predicate list.

nodes.name: Parser::parse_node_test
nodes.summary: Parses a node test: processing-instruction(), comment(), text(), or node(), with optional name literal for PI tests.

nodes.name: Parser::parse_predicates
nodes.summary: Parses a bracketed predicate list, collecting multiple [expr] segments into a PredicateListExpression.

nodes.name: Parser::parse_function_call
nodes.summary: Parses a function call including argument list with comma separators, mapping function names to CoreFunction variants with arity validation.

nodes.name: create_binary_expression
nodes.summary: Creates a Binary Expression node from left-hand-side, operator, and right-hand-side, or creates a Negate expression for the subtraction operator with missing LHS.

nodes.name: tokenizer.rs
nodes.summary: XPath 1.0 lexical analyzer (tokenizer) that converts raw XPath string input into a stream of typed tokens: operators (and, or, mod, div, arithmetic, comparison), NCName tokens, numeric and string literals, axis identifiers, parentheses, brackets, and special symbols.

nodes.name: Error
nodes.summary: Tokenizer error enum for invalid variable references, invalid NCNames, expected operators, unterminated string literals, and illegal characters.

nodes.name: CNameToken
nodes.summary: Qualified name token holding an optional namespace prefix and local name string.

nodes.name: OperatorToken
nodes.summary: Operator token enum with precedence method, covering named operators (and, or, mod, div) and symbolic comparison/arithmetic operators.

nodes.name: LiteralToken
nodes.summary: Literal token enum for integer, decimal, and string literal values parsed from the input.

nodes.name: Token
nodes.summary: Complete token enum covering all XPath lexical tokens: variable references, qualified names, operators, literals, axis identifiers, abbreviated steps (parent, self), function calls, parentheses, brackets, comma, at-sign, and kind test keywords.

nodes.name: Tokenizer::consume_ncname
nodes.summary: Consumes an NCName (non-colonized name) from the input, validating start and continuation characters with optional wildcard support.

nodes.name: Tokenizer::consume_single_token
nodes.summary: Core token consumption method handling all token types: variable references, names/operators, numeric and string literals, axis specifiers, abbreviated steps, and single-character tokens.

nodes.name: Tokenizer::consume_string_literal
nodes.summary: Consumes a single/double-quoted string literal from the input with error for unterminated strings.

nodes.name: Tokenizer::consume_numeric_literal
nodes.summary: Parses a numeric literal (integer or decimal) from the input, handling both standard and scientific notation with logging for parse failures.

nodes.name: match_operator_name
nodes.summary: Matches a name string to its corresponding OperatorToken variant (and, or, mod, div) or returns an error.

nodes.name: OperatorToken::precedence
nodes.summary: Returns the operator precedence level for XPath operator precedence parsing (lower is tighter binding).

nodes.name: Token::is_start_of_location_step
nodes.summary: Tests whether a token can begin a location step (axis identifier, name test, kind test, abbreviated step, etc.).

nodes.name: Token::followed_by_operator
nodes.summary: Tests whether a token is typically followed by an operator, used for disambiguation between operator names and function/axis names.

nodes.name: tokenize
nodes.summary: Main tokenizer entry point that iterates through input characters, skipping whitespace and producing a Vec of Token values.

nodes.name: value.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the XPath 1.0 value system: Value enum (Boolean, Number, String, NodeSet) and the NodeSet collection with document-order sorting, deduplication, iteration, filtering, and type conversion methods (boolean, number, string) per XPath 1.0 semantics.

nodes.name: Value
nodes.summary: XPath value enum representing the four XPath 1.0 data types: Boolean, Number (f64), String, and NodeSet.

nodes.name: NodeSet
nodes.summary: Ordered node set collection with document-order sorting, deduplication (via opaque node hashing), iteration, filtering (retain), and conversion methods.

nodes.name: NodeSet::sort
nodes.summary: Sorts nodes in document order using unstable sort by tree-order comparison.

nodes.name: NodeSet::first
nodes.summary: Returns the first node in document order, using either cached sorted state or performing a min_by on tree order.

nodes.name: NodeSet::deduplicate
nodes.summary: Removes duplicate nodes from the set using opaque node identifiers in a HashSet while preserving order.

nodes.name: NodeSet::retain
nodes.summary: Filters the node set in-place, keeping only nodes for which the predicate closure returns true.

nodes.name: parse_number_from_string
nodes.summary: Parses a trimmed string to f64, returning NaN for whitespace-only or invalid input.

nodes.name: num_vals
nodes.summary: Collects numeric values from a set of nodes by parsing each nodes text content as a number.

nodes.name: Value::eq
nodes.summary: Equality comparison implementing XPath 1.0 semantics: node-set comparisons use string-value or numeric comparison, scalars convert as needed.

nodes.name: Value::convert_to_boolean
nodes.summary: Converts a Value to boolean per XPath rules: false for empty node-sets, empty strings, zero/NaN numbers; true otherwise.

nodes.name: Value::convert_to_number
nodes.summary: Converts a Value to f64: boolean to 1/0, string parsed as number, node-set converted to string first then parsed, with NaN default.

nodes.name: Value::convert_to_string
nodes.summary: Converts a Value to String: booleans to "true"/"false", numbers with Infinity handling, strings returned as-is, node-set uses first node text content.

nodes.name: backend.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the abstract GenericDrawTarget trait specifying the complete canvas rendering interface (fill, stroke, text, images, clipping), and a generic Convert trait for type conversions across crate boundaries.

nodes.name: GenericDrawTarget
nodes.summary: Trait defining the full canvas 2D drawing API surface that all backends (GPU WGPU, CPU Vello) must implement, including fill/stroke operations, text rendering, image blitting, clipping, and snapshot export.

nodes.name: Convert
nodes.summary: A local version of the standard library's Into trait that enables type conversion implementations between types defined outside the canvas crate.

nodes.name: canvas_data.rs
nodes.summary: Core canvas rendering engine that manages draw target operations, handles all painting commands (fill, stroke, text, images), implements shadow rendering with offscreen buffers, pattern bounding, and image data export.

nodes.name: Filter
nodes.summary: Enum for image filtering modes (Bilinear, Nearest) used when drawing surfaces onto the canvas.

nodes.name: CanvasData
nodes.summary: Struct holding the canvas draw target, paint API reference, and image key -- the central data structure for canvas rendering state.

nodes.name: RectToi32
nodes.summary: Extension trait providing a ceil method to convert floating-point rectangles to integer (i32) rectangles.

nodes.name: CanvasData::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new CanvasData instance with a draw target sized to at least MIN_WR_IMAGE_SIZE and a reference to the paint API.

nodes.name: CanvasData::set_image_key
nodes.summary: Registers the canvas image with the paint API by obtaining serializable image data, adding the image, and replacing any previous image key.

nodes.name: CanvasData::draw_image
nodes.summary: Draws a snapshot image onto the canvas with optional image smoothing, shadow effects, and composition options; handles both direct draw and shadow-draw paths.

nodes.name: CanvasData::fill_text
nodes.summary: Renders filled text runs onto the canvas, optionally bounding the fill operation with pattern clipping via maybe_bound_shape_with_pattern.

nodes.name: CanvasData::stroke_text
nodes.summary: Renders outlined (stroked) text runs onto the canvas with line options controlling stroke style, using pattern bounding for gradient fills.

nodes.name: CanvasData::fill_rect
nodes.summary: Fills a rectangle with optional shadow rendering and pattern/gradient styles; handles zero-size gradient short-circuit and shadow offscreen rendering.

nodes.name: CanvasData::stroke_rect
nodes.summary: Strokes a rectangle outline with pattern/gradient styles, shadow support, and line options; uses pattern bounding for gradients and handles shadow offscreen composition.

nodes.name: CanvasData::fill_path
nodes.summary: Fills an arbitrary path with a fill rule, supporting pattern/gradient styles with optional pattern bounding when the path has a known bounding box.

nodes.name: CanvasData::stroke_path
nodes.summary: Strokes an arbitrary path outline with line options, pattern/gradient styles, and pattern bounding for gradient-based strokes.

nodes.name: CanvasData::clip_path
nodes.summary: Applies a path-based clipping region to the canvas draw target for subsequent drawing operations.

nodes.name: CanvasData::recreate
nodes.summary: Recreates the draw target at a new size (or current size), replacing it with a similar draw target and updating the image rendering in the paint API.

nodes.name: CanvasData::update_image_rendering
nodes.summary: Sends the current canvas image data to the paint API for compositing, using profiling trace spans for performance monitoring.

nodes.name: CanvasData::put_image_data
nodes.summary: Places raw pixel data onto the canvas by creating a source surface from a snapshot and copying it to the specified rectangle region.

nodes.name: CanvasData::read_pixels
nodes.summary: Reads pixel data from a rectangular region of the canvas, returning a Snapshot; handles out-of-bounds and empty regions by returning an empty snapshot.

nodes.name: CanvasData::draw_with_shadow
nodes.summary: Renders content with a drop shadow by creating an offscreen draw target, drawing the shadow source, and compositing the shadow result back onto the main canvas.

nodes.name: CanvasData::maybe_bound_shape_with_pattern
nodes.summary: Conditionally applies pattern/repeat bounds to a drawing operation: if x/y bounds are set, clips to a bounded region and draws the pattern within it; otherwise draws unbounded.

nodes.name: write_image
nodes.summary: Generic helper function that writes a snapshot to a draw target with optional image smoothing and composition options, using a temporary source surface.

nodes.name: canvas_paint_thread.rs
nodes.summary: Manages a dedicated canvas painting thread that spawns on startup, processes canvas commands via IPC channels, and routes rendering operations to per-canvas backends (Vello GPU or Vello CPU).

nodes.name: CanvasPaintThread
nodes.summary: Struct managing the canvas paint thread lifecycle, holding a map of active canvases, a monotonically increasing canvas ID counter, and a clone of the paint API sender.

nodes.name: Canvas
nodes.summary: Enum representing a canvas backed by either a GPU Vello renderer or a CPU Vello renderer, dispatching all drawing operations to the appropriate CanvasData implementation.

nodes.name: CanvasPaintThread::start
nodes.summary: Spawns the dedicated Canvas painting thread, sets up IPC channels for canvas messages and constellation commands, and runs the event loop processing Create, Exit, and canvas drawing commands.

nodes.name: CanvasPaintThread::process_command
nodes.summary: Dispatches canvas commands (Recreate, Close, SetImageKey, FillText, StrokeText, FillRect, StrokeRect, ClearRect, FillPath, StrokePath, Clip, DrawImage, ReadPixels, PutImageData, etc.) to the appropriate canvas by ID.

nodes.name: CanvasPaintThread::create_canvas
nodes.summary: Creates a new canvas of the given size, inserts it into the canvas registry, and returns its unique CanvasId for future command routing.

nodes.name: Canvas::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new Canvas enum variant based on the dom_canvas_backend configuration preference, instantiating either a Vello GPU or Vello CPU CanvasData backend.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the canvas component, declaring all modules and re-exporting canvas_data and canvas_paint_thread as the public API surface.

nodes.name: peniko_conversions.rs
nodes.summary: Implements type conversion trait implementations (Convert) from Servo canvas types (colors, brushes, gradients, text, image sources) to the Peniko rendering library's types.

nodes.name: convert::FontDataAndIndex->FontData
nodes.summary: Converts a FontDataAndIndex plus font template blob into a Peniko FontData wrapped in an Arc for shared ownership.

nodes.name: convert::FillOrStrokeStyle->Brush
nodes.summary: Converts a FillOrStrokeStyle (solid color, linear gradient, radial gradient, or surface/image) into a Peniko Brush for use by the Vello renderer.

nodes.name: convert::LineOptions->StrokeStyle
nodes.summary: Converts canvas LineOptions (width, join style, cap style, dash pattern, miter limit) into a Peniko StrokeStyle for stroke operations.

nodes.name: convert::AbsoluteColor->Color
nodes.summary: Converts an AbsoluteColor to a Peniko Color, handling sRGB legacy color space conversion.

nodes.name: convert::CompositionOptions->Composites
nodes.summary: Converts canvas CompositionOptions (composition and blending styles) into a Peniko Composite tuple for layer compositing.

nodes.name: convert::Transform2D->Affine
nodes.summary: Converts a Euclidean Transform2D to a Kurbo Affine transform for use by the Vello renderer and vello_cpu.

nodes.name: vello_backend.rs
nodes.summary: GPU-accelerated canvas backend implementing GenericDrawTarget using the Vello renderer on top of wgpu, with WGPU device management, scene building, texture rendering, and buffer readback.

nodes.name: VelloDrawTarget
nodes.summary: GPU canvas draw target holding wgpu device/queue, Vello renderer, scene graph, render texture, and buffer state -- implements the full GenericDrawTarget API using GPU acceleration.

nodes.name: State
nodes.summary: Enum tracking the Vello draw target's rendering state: Drawing (scene active), RenderedToTexture, or RenderedToBuffer (pixels available for readback).

nodes.name: VelloDrawTarget::new_with_renderer
nodes.summary: Constructs a VelloDrawTarget with an existing wgpu device/queue/renderer, creating the render texture, staging buffer, Vello scene, and configuring image overrides and memory thresholds.

nodes.name: VelloDrawTarget::new
nodes.summary: Creates a VelloDrawTarget from scratch by initializing wgpu instance, adapter, device, and Vello renderer, using environment-based backend selection and build configuration flags.

nodes.name: VelloDrawTarget::clear_rect
nodes.summary: Clears a rectangular region of the canvas; if the region covers the entire viewport, resets the scene and clips; otherwise draws a white-filled rectangle.

nodes.name: VelloDrawTarget::copy_surface
nodes.summary: Copies a source surface region to a destination on the canvas within a clip-ignoring layer, using either surfaces with affine transforms or raw pixel blobs.

nodes.name: VelloDrawTarget::draw_surface
nodes.summary: Draws a source surface onto the canvas with optional composition blending, image filtering, affine transform, and non-uniform scaling for the destination rectangle.

nodes.name: VelloDrawTarget::fill_text
nodes.summary: Renders filled text using Vello glyph drawing with a shared font cache, converting each text run's glyphs and positions into draw commands with composition and transform.

nodes.name: VelloDrawTarget::stroke_text
nodes.summary: Renders outlined text using Vello glyph drawing with stroke styles, using the shared font cache to avoid re-uploading font data for repeated text runs.

nodes.name: VelloDrawTarget::render_to_texture
nodes.summary: Renders the accumulated Vello scene to a GPU texture, resets the scene for subsequent drawing, and pushes a new clip layer covering the full viewport.

nodes.name: VelloDrawTarget::render_to_buffer
nodes.summary: Renders the scene to a texture, then copies it to a GPU buffer for CPU readback; handles texture-to-buffer copy with proper alignment and submits the command encoder.

nodes.name: VelloDrawTarget::map_read
nodes.summary: Maps the GPU render buffer for CPU read access using async buffer mapping with a oneshot channel, then invokes a user callback with the mapped byte slice.

nodes.name: vello_cpu_backend.rs
nodes.summary: CPU-based canvas backend implementing GenericDrawTarget using the Vello CPU software renderer (vello_cpu), with pixmap-based rendering, blend layers, and direct pixel data access.

nodes.name: State
nodes.summary: Enum tracking the Vello CPU draw target's rendering state: Drawing (modifications pending) or Rendered (pixmap flushed and ready for readback).

nodes.name: VelloCPUDrawTarget
nodes.summary: CPU canvas draw target holding a vello_cpu RenderContext, Resources, Pixmap, clip stack, and state -- implements the full GenericDrawTarget API using software rendering.

nodes.name: VelloCPUDrawTarget::ensure_drawing
nodes.summary: Ensures the draw target is in Drawing state by re-rendering the last pixmap as an image source when transitioning from Rendered state, resetting the clip environment.

nodes.name: VelloCPUDrawTarget::clear_rect
nodes.summary: Clears a rectangular region of the canvas; if the region covers the viewport, flushes and resets; otherwise draws a clear layer with the specified blend mode.

nodes.name: VelloCPUDrawTarget::draw_surface
nodes.summary: Draws a source surface onto the canvas with optional alpha multiplication, composition blending, image filtering, and paint transform for non-uniform destination scaling.

nodes.name: VelloCPUDrawTarget::fill_text
nodes.summary: Renders filled text using vello_cpu glyph_run with a shared font cache, converting text run glyphs and positions into CPU-side draw commands with composition and transform.

nodes.name: VelloCPUDrawTarget::stroke_text
nodes.summary: Renders outlined text using vello_cpu glyph_run with stroke styles, leveraging the shared font cache and stroke_glyphs for outlined glyph rendering.

nodes.name: convert::FillOrStrokeStyle->PaintType
nodes.summary: Converts a FillOrStrokeStyle to a vello_cpu PaintType, handling solid colors, linear/radial gradients with stops, and image surfaces via pixmap conversion.

nodes.name: paint
nodes.summary: Helper that converts a FillOrStrokeStyle to a vello_cpu Paint and optionally multiplies its alpha for solid colors, gradients, or image-based paints.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel declaring and re-exporting all six submodules of the script DOM security namespace: csp, csp reporting types, csp violation reporting, sanitizer, security policy violation events, and x-frame-options.

nodes.name: csp.rs
nodes.summary: Core Content Security Policy (CSP) integration layer providing the CspReporting trait and its implementation for Option<CspList>, along with CSP violation reporting infrastructure and metadata parsing for CSP headers.
