nodes.languageNotes: Implements CspReporting as a trait on Option<CspList> using the extension trait pattern, enabling ergonomic CSP checks throughout the engine. Heavy use of the external content_security_policy crate for policy evaluation.

nodes.name: csppolicyviolationreport.rs
nodes.summary: Defines CSP violation report data structures (SecurityPolicyViolationReport, CSPReportUriViolationReportBody) with bidirectional conversion impls to WebIDL bindings and a builder-pattern CSPViolationReportBuilder for constructing violation reports.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the builder pattern for CSPViolationReportBuilder with fluent API methods. Implements both Convert<SecurityPolicyViolationEventInit> and Convert<CSPViolationReportBody> for bidirectional WebIDL binding conversion.

nodes.name: cspviolationreporttask.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the CSP violation reporting task that fires SecurityPolicyViolationEvent on targets and posts violation reports to report-uri/report-to endpoints via HTTP fetch, following the W3C CSP reporting algorithm.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements TaskOnce for async CSP violation reporting. Contains a CSPReportUriFetchListener that implements both FetchResponseListener and ResourceTimingListener traits for POSTing CSP reports.

nodes.name: sanitizer.rs
nodes.summary: Complete implementation of the WICG Sanitizer API (Element.setHTML, setHTMLUnsafe) providing DOM sanitization with configurable element/attribute allow/remove lists, processing instruction filtering, JavaScript URL handling, and built-in safe default/baseline configurations.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the full Sanitizer API spec with a core recursive sanitize_core algorithm (~370 lines), extensive configuration validation, canonicalization traits for element/attribute/PI name normalization, and built-in safe configurations covering HTML, SVG, and MathML namespaces.

nodes.name: securitypolicyviolationevent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the SecurityPolicyViolationEvent DOM struct and its WebIDL binding implementation, representing the event fired when a CSP violation occurs with fields for document URI, blocked URI, violated directive, source location, and disposition.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dom_struct attribute macro for DOM integration. The SecurityPolicyViolationEventMethods impl provides the WebIDL-specified constructor and property getters.

nodes.name: xframeoptions.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the X-Frame-Options header checking algorithm to determine whether a navigation response for a child navigable should be allowed based on frame-ancestors CSP directives and X-Frame-Options header values.

nodes.name: check_a_navigation_response_adherence_to_x_frame_options
nodes.summary: Checks whether a navigation response adheres to X-Frame-Options header values and frame-ancestors CSP directives for child navigables, implementing the HTML spec algorithm for clickjacking prevention.

nodes.name: SecurityPolicyViolationEvent
nodes.summary: DOM event representing a CSP violation with fields for document URI, referrer, blocked URI, effective/violated directives, original policy, source file location, sample, disposition, and status code. Implements the W3C SecurityPolicyViolationEvent interface.

nodes.name: CSPViolationReportTask
nodes.summary: Task struct that fires securitypolicyviolation events and posts CSP violation reports to report-uri and report-to endpoints. Implements TaskOnce for async execution on the DOM manipulation task source.

nodes.name: CSPReportUriFetchListener
nodes.summary: Fetch response listener for CSP report-uri POST requests, implementing FetchResponseListener and ResourceTimingListener to handle CSP violation report delivery and resource timing submission.

nodes.name: SecurityPolicyViolationReport
nodes.summary: Internal representation of a CSP violation with sample, blocked URL, referrer, status code, document URL, source file, directives, policy, and disposition. Implements bidirectional conversion to both SecurityPolicyViolationEventInit and CSPViolationReportBody WebIDL types.

nodes.name: CSPReportUriViolationReportBody
nodes.summary: Serde-serializable struct representing the deprecated CSP report-uri violation report body with kebab-case JSON field naming. Constructed via From<SecurityPolicyViolationReport> with URL stripping for reports.

nodes.name: CSPViolationReportBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder-pattern struct for constructing SecurityPolicyViolationReport instances with fluent setter methods for report-only, sample, resource, line/column number, source file, effective directive, and original policy fields. The build() method resolves disposition and referrer from the global scope.
nodes.languageNotes: Fluent builder API with consuming self methods returning CSPViolationReportBuilder for method chaining. The build() method cross-references the GlobalScope to derive disposition and referrer values.

nodes.name: CspReporting
nodes.summary: Trait defining the CSP reporting interface with methods for JavaScript/WASM evaluation checks, navigation request/response blocking, inline element type behavior checks, trusted type policy creation, sink type mismatch checks, and base URL validation. Implemented for Option<CspList> and used throughout the script engine.

nodes.name: GlobalCspReporting
nodes.summary: Trait providing the report_csp_violations method for reporting CSP violations from any global scope, implemented on GlobalScope to queue CSPViolationReportTask instances on the DOM manipulation task source.

nodes.name: compute_scripted_caller_source_position
nodes.summary: Uses the JavaScript engine to describe the scripted caller and extract source file, line number, and column number for CSP violation reporting source position attribution.

nodes.name: obtain_blocked_uri_for_violation_resource_with_sample
nodes.summary: Maps a CSP ViolationResource enum variant (inline, URL, trusted-type policy/sink, eval, wasm-eval) to a (sample, blocked_uri) tuple for use in violation report construction per the CSP3 spec.

nodes.name: csp_violation_report_tasks
nodes.summary: Core CSP violation processing function that converts a list of Violation objects into CSPViolationReportTask instances by building SecurityPolicyViolationReports with source position data, computing the target element/window/document, and constructing task objects for queued execution.

nodes.name: parse_and_potentially_append_to_csp_list
nodes.summary: Parses CSP header values into CspList instances and concatenates them with an existing CspList, silently ignoring headers with invalid Unicode.

nodes.name: parse_csp_list_from_metadata
nodes.summary: Parses both enforce (Content-Security-Policy) and report-only (Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only) CSP headers from response metadata into a combined CspList, implementing the parse-response-csp algorithm.

nodes.name: Sanitizer
nodes.summary: DOM struct implementing the WICG Sanitizer API with configurable HTML sanitization. Provides the Sanitizer constructor, get/set configuration, getSanitizerInstanceFromOptions factory, set_and_filter_html for Element.setHTML integration, and methods for allowing/removing elements, attributes, processing instructions, comments, data attributes, and removing unsafe configurations.

nodes.name: sanitize_core
nodes.summary: Recursive core sanitization algorithm that walks DOM children, handling DocumentType, Text, Comment, ProcessingInstruction, and Element nodes per the WICG Sanitizer spec. Applies element allow/remove/replace rules, attribute filtering, JavaScript URL removal, and recurses into template contents and shadow roots.

nodes.name: SanitizerConfigAlgorithm
nodes.summary: Trait defining the SanitizerConfig manipulation algorithms: validation, element/attribute removal, unsafe element/attribute removal per baseline config, and configuration canonicalization. Implemented on SanitizerConfig to drive all configuration mutation operations.

nodes.name: NameMember
nodes.summary: Trait providing uniform access to name and namespace fields across SanitizerElementWithAttributes, SanitizerElement, and SanitizerAttribute types, with comparison/sorting support and custom data attribute detection.

nodes.name: NameCanonicalization
nodes.summary: Trait for canonicalizing sanitizer names from string or dictionary form into the canonical dictionary representation with explicit namespace. Implemented for SanitizerElement and SanitizerAttribute with default namespace support.

nodes.name: NameSlice
nodes.summary: Trait providing slice-level operations for sanitizer name lists: containment checking, duplicate detection, and non-empty intersection testing. Implemented for [T] slices to support the SanitizerConfig specification algorithms.

nodes.name: NameVec
nodes.summary: Trait providing mutable Vec-level operations for sanitizer name lists: item removal, item addition, duplicate removal, set intersection, and set difference. Implements the SanitizerConfig list manipulation algorithms from the spec.

nodes.name: built_in_safe_default_configuration
nodes.summary: Produces the built-in safe default SanitizerConfig with allowed elements across HTML, SVG, and MathML namespaces, each with permitted attributes, plus a global attribute allow-list of presentation and styling attributes. Used as the default configuration for SetHTML and Sanitizer construction.

nodes.name: built_in_safe_baseline_configuration
nodes.summary: Produces the built-in safe baseline SanitizerConfig with a remove-elements list of dangerous elements (embed, frame, iframe, object, script) that must be removed from any configuration, and an empty remove-attributes list to be filled at runtime.

nodes.name: dissimilaroriginlocation.rs
nodes.summary: Provides a cross-origin Location stub for dissimilar-origin windows, returning security errors for all URL accessors to prevent cross-origin information leaks.

nodes.name: DissimilarOriginLocation
nodes.summary: DOM struct representing a cross-origin Location that returns security errors for all accessors, preventing information leaks from other script threads.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new DissimilarOriginLocation via reflect_dom_object_with_cx, binding it to a DissimilarOriginWindow for the DOM object graph.

nodes.name: dissimilaroriginwindow.rs
nodes.summary: Implements a dissimilar-origin Window proxy that provides limited cross-origin access to Window properties while throwing security exceptions for most accessors, acting as a belt-and-braces security layer before proper cross-origin wrapper support.

nodes.name: DissimilarOriginWindow
nodes.summary: DOM struct representing a cross-origin Window with limited property access, holding a cloned GlobalScope and providing belt-and-braces security before proper cross-origin wrapper (XOW) support.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new DissimilarOriginWindow with a cloned global scope, initializing the window proxy, pipeline ID, and mutable origin for cross-origin access control.

nodes.name: GetParent
nodes.summary: Returns the parent WindowProxy with cross-origin security checks, returning null if no opener exists or the browsing context is top-level.

nodes.name: PostMessage_
nodes.summary: Handles postMessage with WindowPostMessageOptions, validating target origin and structured cloning the message data for cross-origin delivery.

nodes.name: Focus
nodes.summary: Requests focus on the dissimilar-origin window by sending a RemoteFocusOperation message to the constellation for cross-process focus management.

nodes.name: post_message_impl
nodes.summary: Core implementation of postMessage that validates target origin, strips the source origin, performs structured clone, and sends the message to the constellation for delivery.

nodes.name: post_message
nodes.summary: Posts a message to a target origin using structured serialization from a custom auto-rooter value, handling transferable objects and origin validation.

nodes.name: history.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML History interface for session history management, supporting pushState/replaceState, history traversal, and popstate event firing per the HTML specification.

nodes.name: History
nodes.summary: DOM struct implementing the HTML History interface, managing session history state, scroll position restoration, and popstate/hashchange event coordination.

nodes.name: traverse_history
nodes.summary: Sends a traverse-history message to the constellation based on the given traversal direction (forward or backward) to navigate session history.

nodes.name: activate_state
nodes.summary: Activates a history state entry by ID and URL, navigating the document and firing popstate events with the stored state data as specified by the HTML spec.

nodes.name: push_or_replace_state
nodes.summary: Implements pushState and replaceState per the HTML spec, validating URLs, serializing state data with structured clone, updating the session history, and firing appropriate events.

nodes.name: can_have_url_rewritten
nodes.summary: Validates whether a document URL can be rewritten for pushState/replaceState, checking same-origin constraints and other HTML spec restrictions.

nodes.name: GetLength
nodes.summary: Retrieves the current joint session history length from the constellation, including the current entry in the count.

nodes.name: location.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML Location interface for URL manipulation, handling same-origin navigation, hash changes, referrer policy, and URL component getters/setters with security checks.

nodes.name: NavigationType
nodes.summary: Enum classifying navigation types: normal navigation, script-initiated reload, and constellation-initiated reload, used for referrer policy and history handling decisions.

nodes.name: Location
nodes.summary: DOM struct implementing the HTML Location interface for URL manipulation, with same-origin security checks on getters/setters, fragment navigation, and referrer policy handling.

nodes.name: navigate_a_location
nodes.summary: Navigates a Location to a given URL, performing referrer policy checks and URL parsing before delegating to the full navigate method for constellation communication.

nodes.name: navigate
nodes.summary: Core navigation logic for Location, handling URL parsing, fragment-only navigation detection, new browsing context creation, and constellation pipeline navigation messages.

nodes.name: document_if_same_origin
nodes.summary: Returns the associated Document only if the Location is same-origin with the entry settings object, used as a guard for URL component getters/setters.

nodes.name: setter_common
nodes.summary: Common URL setter pattern that parses the base URL, applies a mutating closure to modify the URL component, then navigates to the resulting URL.

nodes.name: reload_without_origin_check
nodes.summary: Reloads the current document without performing origin checks, used internally for test and debug scenarios where cross-origin restrictions must be bypassed.

nodes.name: Assign
nodes.summary: Navigates the window to the given URL by creating a new URL relative to the current document base URL and delegating to the navigate method.

nodes.name: Reload
nodes.summary: Reloads the current document by extracting the current URL from the document and sending a reload message to the constellation.

nodes.name: Replace
nodes.summary: Replaces the current history entry with a navigation to the given URL, using HistoryHandling::Replace to avoid creating a new history entry.

nodes.name: SetHash
nodes.summary: Sets the URL hash fragment, performing same-origin checks, parsing the URL, and only navigating if the new hash differs from the current one to avoid redundant reloads.

nodes.name: SetHost
nodes.summary: Sets the URL host component with same-origin validation, parsing and reconstructing the URL then navigating to the modified URL.

nodes.name: SetHostname
nodes.summary: Sets the URL hostname component with same-origin validation, parsing and reconstructing the URL then navigating to the modified URL.

nodes.name: SetHref
nodes.summary: Sets the full URL string with same-origin validation, parsing and navigating to the new URL via the Location setter algorithm.

nodes.name: SetPathname
nodes.summary: Sets the URL pathname component with same-origin validation, parsing and reconstructing the URL then navigating to the modified URL.

nodes.name: SetPort
nodes.summary: Sets the URL port component with same-origin validation, handling the default port being omitted from the serialized URL string.

nodes.name: SetProtocol
nodes.summary: Sets the URL protocol component with same-origin validation, parsing and reconstructing the URL then navigating to the modified URL.

nodes.name: SetSearch
nodes.summary: Sets the URL search (query string) component with same-origin validation, parsing and reconstructing the URL then navigating to the modified URL.

nodes.name: windowproxy.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the WindowProxy exotic object that mediates all access to Window objects across browsing contexts, handling cross-origin security checks, auxiliary browsing context creation, and SpiderMonkey JS proxy traps per the HTML specification.

nodes.name: WindowProxy
nodes.summary: The core WindowProxy DOM struct that mediates all access to Window objects, handling cross-origin security, browsing context navigation, and SpiderMonkey JS proxy integration for the HTML spec WindowProxy exotic object.

nodes.name: CreatorBrowsingContextInfo
nodes.summary: Auxiliary struct capturing the URL and origin of the creator browsing context, used for security checks on new auxiliary browsing contexts created via window.open().

nodes.name: WindowProxyHandler
nodes.summary: SpiderMonkey proxy handler implementation for WindowProxy, providing both same-origin (forwarding) and cross-origin (security-restricted) trap configurations.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Internal constructor initializing WindowProxy fields: browsing context ID, opener, frame element, parent, creator info, and initial state flags.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new WindowProxy for a Window, setting up the browsing context, registering with the opener, and delaying load events during initialization.

nodes.name: new_dissimilar_origin
nodes.summary: Creates a WindowProxy for a dissimilar-origin window, cloning the global scope and origin while preserving cross-origin navigation structure.

nodes.name: create_auxiliary_browsing_context
nodes.summary: Creates an auxiliary browsing context for window.open(), sending a ScriptToConstellationMessage to request a new pipeline with appropriate opener and creator info.

nodes.name: opener
nodes.summary: Returns the opener WindowProxy, applying cross-origin checks: returns null if the opener was disowned or if origins differ and the opener does not share the same top-level traversable.

nodes.name: open
nodes.summary: Implements window.open() per the HTML spec, parsing open features, resolving the target URL, choosing a browsing context, and creating new browsing contexts as needed.

nodes.name: choose_browsing_context
nodes.summary: Selects an existing or new browsing context for window.open() based on the target name, handling noopener and auxiliary context creation logic.

nodes.name: document_origin
nodes.summary: Returns the origin of the document in this browsing context, or the creator origin from a dissimilar-origin context that lacks direct document access.

nodes.name: set_window
nodes.summary: Sets the Window object for this proxy, establishing the JS proxy handler and updating all registered script-side WindowProxy references to the new window.

nodes.name: set_currently_active
nodes.summary: Marks this WindowProxy as the currently active one in its browsing context group, updating JS object references for active window state.

nodes.name: unset_currently_active
nodes.summary: Removes the active status from this WindowProxy, clearing the JS object from script-side proxies to prevent stale references.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Constructs CreatorBrowsingContextInfo from parent and opener references, capturing the creator URL and origin for security tracking of auxiliary browsing contexts.

nodes.name: tokenize_open_features
nodes.summary: Tokenizes the window.open() features string per the HTML spec, parsing comma-separated key=value pairs into a normalized vector of feature tokens.

nodes.name: parse_open_feature_boolean
nodes.summary: Parses a boolean feature from tokenized open features, recognizing yes/no values and positional boolean flags per the HTML specification.

nodes.name: GetSubframeWindowProxy
nodes.summary: Retrieves or creates a subframe WindowProxy by browsing context ID, traversing the frame tree relative to this proxy to find nested browsing contexts.

nodes.name: get_own_property_descriptor
nodes.summary: SpiderMonkey proxy trap for [[GetOwnProperty]], dispatching to cross-origin or same-origin handlers based on the accessor origin security checks.

nodes.name: define_property
nodes.summary: SpiderMonkey proxy trap for [[DefineOwnProperty]], dispatching property definitions with cross-origin security enforcement on window properties.

nodes.name: has
nodes.summary: SpiderMonkey proxy trap for [[HasProperty]], checking property existence with cross-origin window restrictions applied to limit property visibility.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: SpiderMonkey proxy trap for [[Get]], dispatching property reads to same-origin or cross-origin handlers based on the accessor origin and security policy.

nodes.name: set
nodes.summary: SpiderMonkey proxy trap for [[Set]], dispatching property writes with cross-origin security enforcement to prevent unauthorized modifications.

nodes.name: get_prototype_if_ordinary
nodes.summary: SpiderMonkey proxy trap checking if the proxy has an ordinary prototype, consulting inner window state and cross-origin rules for prototype chain visibility.

nodes.name: x_origin_proxy_handler
nodes.summary: Returns a static WindowProxyHandler configured for cross-origin access, with traps that enforce security restrictions on property access, enumeration, and definition.

nodes.name: proxy_handler
nodes.summary: Returns a static WindowProxyHandler configured for same-origin access, with traps that transparently forward property operations to the underlying Window object.

nodes.name: has_xorigin
nodes.summary: Cross-origin [[HasProperty]] handler that restricts property visibility to cross-origin-accessible properties (like window, self, location) and named subframe windows.

nodes.name: get_xorigin
nodes.summary: Cross-origin [[Get]] handler returning property values for cross-origin-accessible properties only, throwing SecurityError for unauthorized property access attempts.

nodes.name: set_xorigin
nodes.summary: Cross-origin [[Set]] handler that allows setting cross-origin-accessible properties (like location) while silently blocking writes to restricted properties.

nodes.name: delete_xorigin
nodes.summary: Cross-origin [[Delete]] handler that blocks all property deletions with a silent failure, per cross-origin WindowProxy semantics in the HTML spec.

nodes.name: getOwnPropertyDescriptor_xorigin
nodes.summary: Cross-origin [[GetOwnPropertyDescriptor]] handler restricting descriptor visibility to cross-origin-accessible properties only, hiding internal window properties.

nodes.name: defineProperty_xorigin
nodes.summary: Cross-origin [[DefineOwnProperty]] handler blocking all property definitions with a TypeError for non-configurable properties, per the HTML spec.

nodes.name: preventExtensions_xorigin
nodes.summary: Cross-origin [[PreventExtensions]] handler blocking extension prevention on cross-origin WindowProxy objects, maintaining the mutable nature of the proxy.

nodes.name: finalize
nodes.summary: SpiderMonkey finalize hook that cleans up the WindowProxy when the JS object is garbage-collected, releasing DOM references.

nodes.name: trace
nodes.summary: SpiderMonkey trace hook for GC marking of the WindowProxy object graph to ensure reachable DOM objects are not prematurely collected.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Root module of the Servo C Foreign Function Interface (FFI) crate. Declares all submodules and defines the ServoBuilder and ServoEventLoopWaker types, providing C-compatible lifecycle functions for embedders to create, configure, build, and destroy Servo engine instances.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Rust extern "C" ABI with #[unsafe(no_mangle)] for C embedder interop; cbindgen:opaque markers prevent direct struct access from C.

nodes.name: ServoBuilder
nodes.summary: Opaque struct that builds a Servo instance, holding optional options, preferences, and an event loop waker. Mirror of the internal servo::ServoBuilder adapted for the C FFI boundary.

nodes.name: ServoEventLoopWaker
nodes.summary: A callback-based waker struct used by Servo to notify the embedder thread when new work is available. Implements the servo::EventLoopWaker trait with a C function pointer callback.

nodes.name: servo_builder_create
nodes.summary: Allocates and returns a new ServoBuilder handle populated with default values. The caller takes ownership and must free it with servo_builder_free or consume it with servo_builder_build.

nodes.name: servo_builder_set_preferences
nodes.summary: Transfers ownership of a ServoPreferences handle into the builder, replacing any previously set preferences. Validates that both builder and preferences pointers are non-null.

nodes.name: servo_builder_set_options
nodes.summary: Transfers ownership of a ServoOptions handle into the builder, replacing any previously set options. Validates pointer validity before the ownership transfer.

nodes.name: servo_builder_set_event_loop_waker
nodes.summary: Sets the event loop waker callback on the builder by copying the ServoEventLoopWaker struct by value. Used by the embedder to receive wake notifications for event loop pumping.

nodes.name: servo_builder_build
nodes.summary: Consumes the builder handle and constructs the final Servo instance by transferring options, preferences, and event loop waker into the internal ServoBuilder, then returns an opaque Servo pointer.

nodes.name: servo_builder_free
nodes.summary: Destroys a ServoBuilder instance that was not consumed by servo_builder_build, freeing all associated memory. Null-pointer check guards against double-free.

nodes.name: options.rs
nodes.summary: C FFI bindings for configuring Servo engine options at initialization time. Exposes a type alias ServoOptions wrapping servo::Opts and 21 extern C functions for setting runtime-invariant configuration such as multiprocess mode, sandbox, profiling, and paths.
nodes.languageNotes: All option setters use unsafe pointer dereferencing with safety contracts documented in doc comments; string parameters converted from CStr with UTF-8 validation.

nodes.name: servo_options_create
nodes.summary: Allocates a new ServoOptions handle with default values. Returns a raw pointer that the caller must free with servo_options_free.

nodes.name: servo_options_enable_time_profiling_to_file
nodes.summary: Enables the time profiler to write TSV profiling data to a specified file path upon Servo termination. Validates the file path as a NUL-terminated UTF-8 C string.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_time_profiler_trace_path
nodes.summary: Sets the output path for a self-contained HTML timeline visualization of profiling traces. Only effective when time profiling is enabled.

nodes.name: servo_options_enable_time_profiling_to_stdout
nodes.summary: Enables periodic profiling output to stdout at the specified interval in seconds, using OutputOptions::Stdout.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_hard_fail
nodes.summary: Enables or disables hard-fail mode where Servo exits on thread failure instead of displaying about:failure.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_multiprocess
nodes.summary: Enables or disables multiprocess mode in Servo, controlling whether content processes run in separate OS processes.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_force_ipc
nodes.summary: Forces the use of ipc-channel instead of crossbeam-channel even in single-process mode. Has no effect in multiprocess mode.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_background_hang_monitor
nodes.summary: Enables or disables the background hang monitor that detects unresponsive threads in Servo.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_sandbox
nodes.summary: Enables or disables Servo's content process sandbox for security isolation.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_temporary_storage
nodes.summary: When enabled, Servo uses temporary storage where on-disk data does not persist across restarts.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_ignore_certificate_errors
nodes.summary: Configures whether SSL/TLS certificate validation errors are ignored, useful for development and testing.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_unminify_js
nodes.summary: Enables or disables automatic JavaScript unminification for debugging purposes.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_unminify_css
nodes.summary: Enables or disables automatic CSS stylesheet unminification for debugging purposes.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_certificate_path
nodes.summary: Sets the path to a PEM-encoded SSL CA certificate store. The path string is converted from CStr with UTF-8 validation.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_local_script_source
nodes.summary: Sets the directory path containing local (unminified) script sources, used together with the unminify-js feature for debugging.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_shaders_path
nodes.summary: Sets the directory path from which WebRender shaders are loaded from disk, converted to a PathBuf. Useful for shader development and debugging.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_config_dir
nodes.summary: Sets the path to the default configuration directory used by Servo for persistent settings and data storage.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_random_pipeline_closure_probability
nodes.summary: Sets the probability of randomly closing a pipeline, used for fuzzing and testing the constellation's robustness against unexpected pipeline closures.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_random_pipeline_closure_seed
nodes.summary: Sets the seed for the random number generator used by random pipeline closure, enabling reproducible fuzzing runs.

nodes.name: servo_options_set_debug_option
nodes.summary: Enables or disables a specific diagnostics logging option identified by an integer constant. Uses try_from to validate the option and logs a warning on invalid values.

nodes.name: servo_options_free
nodes.summary: Destroys a ServoOptions handle and frees all associated memory. Null-pointer check prevents double-free.

nodes.name: preferences.rs
nodes.summary: C FFI bindings for reading and writing Servo preference values. Exposes a type alias ServoPreferences wrapping servo::Preferences and provides typed getter/setter functions for bool, string, i64, and u64 preferences, plus a private C string allocator helper.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CStr for string conversion, libc::malloc for C string allocation, and typed PrefValue enum variants (Bool, Str, Int, UInt) with runtime type assertions.

nodes.name: servo_preferences_create
nodes.summary: Allocates a new ServoPreferences handle with default values. Returns a raw pointer the caller owns and must free with servo_preferences_free.

nodes.name: servo_preferences_free
nodes.summary: Destroys a ServoPreferences handle and frees its memory. Validates the pointer is non-null before deallocation.

nodes.name: servo_preferences_set_bool
nodes.summary: Sets a boolean preference by name. Validates the name is valid UTF-8, that the preference exists, and that the type matches 'bool' before setting.

nodes.name: servo_preferences_get_bool
nodes.summary: Retrieves a boolean preference by name. Performs existence and type checking, returning the value from PrefValue::Bool or panicking on type mismatch.

nodes.name: servo_preferences_set_string
nodes.summary: Sets a string preference by name from a NUL-terminated C string value. Converts both name and value from CStr, validates UTF-8, checks existence and type, then stores as PrefValue::Str.

nodes.name: servo_preferences_get_string
nodes.summary: Retrieves a string preference by name and returns a newly allocated heap-allocated C string. The caller must free the returned string using the C standard library free(). Calls create_libc_string for allocation.

nodes.name: create_libc_string
nodes.summary: Private helper that allocates a NUL-terminated copy of a Rust &str using libc::malloc. Handles allocation failure and overflow by returning NULL. Used internally for returning strings across the FFI boundary.

nodes.name: servo_preferences_set_i64
nodes.summary: Sets a signed 64-bit integer preference by name. Validates name encoding, preference existence, and type match against 'i64' before storing as PrefValue::Int.

nodes.name: servo_preferences_get_i64
nodes.summary: Retrieves a signed 64-bit integer preference by name. Performs existence and type validation, returning the value from PrefValue::Int.

nodes.name: servo_preferences_set_u64
nodes.summary: Sets an unsigned 64-bit integer preference by name. Validates name, preference existence, and type match against 'u64' before storing as PrefValue::UInt.

nodes.name: servo_preferences_get_u64
nodes.summary: Retrieves an unsigned 64-bit integer preference by name. Performs existence and type validation, returning the value from PrefValue::UInt.

nodes.name: rendering_context.rs
nodes.summary: C FFI bindings for managing rendering contexts in Servo. Defines the opaque RenderingContext struct wrapping a reference-counted servo::RenderingContext trait object, with functions for creating a software rendering context and freeing the handle.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Rc<dyn RenderingContext> for shared ownership of the rendering backend; software rendering context supports headless operation.

nodes.name: RenderingContext
nodes.summary: Opaque struct that wraps a reference-counted trait object implementing servo::RenderingContext, abstracting over OpenGL, GLES, or software rendering backends for use across the FFI boundary.

nodes.name: servo_rendering_context_create_software
nodes.summary: Creates a new software rendering context for headless rendering at the given pixel dimensions. Returns NULL on failure with an error logged, or an opaque RenderingContext pointer on success.

nodes.name: servo_rendering_context_free
nodes.summary: Destroys a RenderingContext handle and frees its memory. Validates the pointer is non-null before deallocation.

nodes.name: servo.rs
nodes.summary: C FFI bindings for core Servo instance lifecycle operations. Provides functions to free a Servo instance, spin the event loop once to process messages and render, and initialize logging for the engine.
nodes.languageNotes: All functions require the caller to be on the same thread that created the Servo instance via servo_builder_build.

nodes.name: servo_free
nodes.summary: Destroys the Servo instance returned by servo_builder_build and frees its memory. Thready affinity: must be called from the same thread that created the instance.

nodes.name: servo_spin_event_loop
nodes.summary: Spins the Servo event loop once to process incoming messages and perform rendering updates. The embedder should call this periodically to drive the engine.

nodes.name: servo_setup_logging
nodes.summary: Initializes the logging system for the Servo instance, enabling diagnostic output based on the configured log level.

nodes.name: webview.rs
nodes.summary: C FFI bindings for creating and managing WebView instances in Servo. Defines the ServoWebViewBuilder opaque struct and exposes extern C functions for builder lifecycle, URL loading, painting, screenshot capture, and WebView destruction.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Rc for shared rendering context ownership; screenshot function uses an async callback pattern with raw pixel data in RGBA format.

nodes.name: ServoWebViewBuilder
nodes.summary: Opaque struct that accumulates configuration for building a WebView: a cloned Servo handle, a reference-counted rendering context, an optional initial URL, and an optional delegate for event notifications.

nodes.name: servo_webview_builder_create
nodes.summary: Creates a new ServoWebViewBuilder for the given Servo instance and rendering context. Takes ownership of the rendering context; clones the Servo handle. Must be called from the thread that created both inputs.

nodes.name: servo_webview_builder_set_url
nodes.summary: Sets the initial URL for the WebView from a NUL-terminated C string. Returns 0 on successful URL parsing or -1 on parse failure.

nodes.name: servo_webview_builder_set_delegate
nodes.summary: Registers a ServoWebViewDelegate with callback function pointers for receiving WebView event notifications such as load status changes and new frame readiness.

nodes.name: servo_webview_builder_build
nodes.summary: Consumes the builder and constructs a WebView instance. Applies the configured URL and delegate (wrapping it in Rc) to the internal WebViewBuilder, then returns an opaque WebView pointer.

nodes.name: servo_webview_builder_free
nodes.summary: Destroys a ServoWebViewBuilder that was not consumed by servo_webview_builder_build, freeing all associated memory.

nodes.name: servo_webview_paint
nodes.summary: Paints the WebView contents to the rendering context's surface. Should be called after receiving a notify_new_frame_ready delegate callback or when a repaint is needed.

nodes.name: servo_webview_load
nodes.summary: Navigates the WebView to a URL specified as a NUL-terminated C string. Returns 0 on success or -1 if the URL could not be parsed.

nodes.name: servo_webview_take_screenshot
nodes.summary: Asynchronously captures a full-viewport screenshot. Invokes the C callback with RGBA pixel data, dimensions, and error code. The callback receives either valid image data or NULL with error info. Callback is invoked on the event loop thread.

nodes.name: servo_webview_free
nodes.summary: Destroys a WebView instance and frees its memory. Must be called from the same thread that created the WebView.

nodes.name: webview_delegate.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the ServoWebViewDelegate struct with C function pointer fields for receiving WebView event callbacks. Implements the servo::WebViewDelegate trait to bridge C callbacks to the Rust trait system, supporting load status change and new-frame-ready notifications.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses #[repr(C)] for FFI-compatible layout; optional callback fields allow embedders to register only the notifications they need; webview pointer in callbacks is temporary and must not be retained.

nodes.name: ServoWebViewDelegate
nodes.summary: FFI-compatible delegate struct containing user_data, an optional load-status-changed callback, and an optional new-frame-ready callback. Implements WebViewDelegate to forward trait method calls to the C function pointers.

nodes.name: notify_load_status_changed
nodes.summary: WebViewDelegate trait implementation that forwards load status change notifications to the C callback if set. Converts the Rust WebView handle to a raw pointer for the C callback and passes load_status as an integer.

nodes.name: notify_new_frame_ready
nodes.summary: WebViewDelegate trait implementation that forwards new-frame-ready notifications to the C callback if set. Converts the Rust WebView handle to a raw pointer for the callback and passes user_data.

nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: Pytest configuration and session fixtures for the Servo devtools integration test suite. Provides CLI options, starts/stops local HTTP web servers for test pages, manages the servoshell browser process, and allocates devtools ports for parallel test workers.

nodes.name: test_connection.py
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying the basic devtools connection to a running Servo instance â€” confirms the browser tab is listed and a selected tab exists.

nodes.name: test_console_tab.py
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the devtools Console tab, covering console.log output for objects, booleans, numbers, arrays, maps, functions, sprintf substitutions, self-referential objects, window objects, and exception handling.

nodes.name: test_debugger_tab.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive integration tests for the devtools Debugger tab with 40+ tests covering breakpoint pausing, frame scoped eval, stepping hooks (step in/over/out), source lists for all script introduction types (inline, external, worker, module, eval, injected, event handler, dom timer, javascript URL), source content retrieval, breakable line positions, and blackboxing behavior.

nodes.name: test_inspector_tab.py
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the devtools Inspector tab covering event listener inspection, DOM attribute modifications from both devtools and JavaScript, walker mutation notifications, DOM observation after navigation, breakpoint-list and blackboxing actor reuse, and inner/outer HTML retrieval.

nodes.name: test_network_tab.py
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the devtools Network tab covering tab navigation (navigateTo, goBack, goForward) and stylesheet resource watching for both inline and linked stylesheets including content retrieval.

nodes.name: utils.py
nodes.summary: Shared test utilities for the Servo devtools integration test suite. Provides the Devtools connection context manager wrapping geckordp RDPClient, immutable Source and FrozenMultiset data types, helper functions for thread attachment, source discovery, breakpoint management, debugger pause/step/resume orchestration, and assertion helpers for sources lists, source content, and breakable line positions.

nodes.name: Handler
nodes.summary: HTTP request handler subclass for the local test web servers, extending SimpleHTTPRequestHandler with the test directory as root and optional request logging controlled by utils.LOG_REQUESTS.

nodes.name: TestConnection
nodes.summary: Pytest test class verifying that a devtools connection to servoshell successfully lists browser tabs, including at least one selected tab.

nodes.name: TestConsoleTab
nodes.summary: Pytest test class with 10 test methods validating console.log output across multiple JavaScript types (objects, booleans, numbers, arrays, maps, functions), sprintf substitutions, self-referential objects, window object logging, and exception throw detection via the devtools WebConsole actor.

nodes.name: TestDebuggerTab
nodes.summary: Massive pytest test class with 40+ methods exercising every aspect of the devtools Debugger tab: breakpoint pause/resume, frame scoped evaluation, manual pause/interrupt, stepping hooks (next/step/finish), comprehensive source list enumeration for all script introduction types (inlineScript, srcScript, importedModule, Worker, injectedScript, eval, Function, javascriptURL, eventHandler, domTimer), source content retrieval, breakable line positions, and blackboxing (single-line, multi-line, partial unblackbox, stepping prevention).

nodes.name: TestInspectorTab
nodes.summary: Pytest test class with 9 test methods validating the devtools Inspector tab: event listener detection on DOM nodes, attribute modification affecting DOM state, mutation notifications from JavaScript attribute changes, walker observation after cross-origin navigation, actor instance reuse for breakpoint-list and blackboxing, and inner/outer HTML retrieval.

nodes.name: TestNetworkTab
nodes.summary: Pytest test class with 3 test methods validating the devtools Network tab: forward/back navigation via navigateTo/goBack/goForward, inline stylesheet resource watching with rule count verification, linked stylesheet resource detection and getText content retrieval.

nodes.name: Devtools
nodes.summary: Dataclass-based context manager that establishes and tears down a devtools protocol connection to Servo. The connect() classmethod creates an RDPClient, discovers the root/tab/watcher actors, watches for frame and worker targets, and returns a fully initialized Devtools instance. The context manager (__enter__/__exit__) ensures the client disconnects and marks the instance as exited to prevent reuse.

nodes.name: devtools_port
nodes.summary: Session-scoped pytest fixture that computes the devtools server port by adding the parallel worker index to a base port of 6000, and stores it in utils.DEVTOOLS_PORT for thread-local access.

nodes.name: web_server_urls
nodes.summary: Session-scoped pytest fixture returning base URLs for the local test web servers. Non-master workers poll socket connections until the servers are available, with a configurable timeout.

nodes.name: _start_web_servers
nodes.summary: Starts one TCPServer per port in utils.WEB_SERVERS on localhost, each serving files from the test directory. Sets SO_REUSEADDR to avoid EADDRINUSE errors from TIME_WAIT sockets, and runs each server in a daemon thread.

nodes.name: run_servoshell
nodes.summary: Pytest fixture yielding a callable that launches servoshell in headless mode with devtools enabled, polls the devtools server until the connection succeeds, then terminates the process on teardown with a configurable timeout.

nodes.name: evaluate_and_capture_console_log_output
nodes.summary: Helper that connects to devtools, watches for console message resources, evaluates JavaScript asynchronously via the WebConsole actor, and returns the first console-message resource captured within a timeout.

nodes.name: wait_for_source
nodes.summary: Watches source resources from the devtools watcher, returning the actor ID of the first source whose URL contains the given url_pattern within a configurable timeout.

nodes.name: wait_and_assert_no_pause
nodes.summary: Calls a trigger function, then waits for the specified duration to confirm that no debugger pause event fires. Raises AssertionError if an unexpected pause occurs; passes silently on TimeoutError.

nodes.name: frozen_multiset
nodes.summary: Creates an immutable, hashable multiset from an iterable by converting a collections.Counter to a sorted tuple of (item, count) pairs, enabling comparison of multisets in test assertions.

nodes.name: assert_sources_list
nodes.summary: Connects to devtools (or reuses an existing connection), watches source resources across all targets, collects source URLs grouped by target into frozen multisets, and asserts that the actual source distribution matches the expected Counter of FrozenMultisets.

nodes.name: assert_source_content
nodes.summary: Connects to devtools, discovers the source actor matching the expected Source (introductionType and url), retrieves its content via the 'source' RDP message, and asserts it equals the expected content string.

nodes.name: assert_source_breakable_lines_and_positions
nodes.summary: Connects to devtools, discovers the source actor for the expected Source, retrieves breakable lines via 'getBreakableLines' and breakpoint positions via 'getBreakpointPositionsCompressed' RDP messages, and asserts both match the expected values.

nodes.name: background_hang_monitor.rs
nodes.summary: Core background hang monitor worker that receives registration, activity, and wait messages from monitored components via channels, performs periodic hang checkpoints (transient/permanent), and supports sampling-based profiling with native stack traces.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses crossbeam channel select! macro for multi-port event-loop dispatch; employs a critical-section pattern for signal-safe native stack sampling.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root declaring conditional sub-modules for platform-specific sampler backends and re-exporting the public background_hang_monitor module along with a conditional SamplerImpl type alias.

nodes.name: sampler.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Sampler trait for suspending and sampling a thread's native call stack, the NativeStack data structure for collecting instruction/stack pointers, and a DummySampler fallback for unsupported platforms.

nodes.name: sampler_linux.rs
nodes.summary: Linux-specific sampler implementation using SIGPROF signals and POSIX semaphores for inter-thread synchronization to suspend a target thread, walk its native stack via backtrace, and resume it within a critical section.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a signal-based suspend-and-sample protocol using three POSIX semaphores (msg2/msg3/msg4) for handshake between the sampling thread and the sampled thread's SIGPROF handler. Allocations and lock acquisition are forbidden inside the critical section.

nodes.name: sampler_mac.rs
nodes.summary: macOS-specific sampler implementation using Mach thread APIs (thread_suspend, thread_get_state, thread_resume) and frame-pointer-based stack walking to capture native call stacks from suspended threads.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Mach kernel thread_act APIs for suspend/resume; stack unwinding relies on frame-pointer walking (requires --dev or --with-frame-pointer build flags). Supports both x86_64 and aarch64 register state structures.

nodes.name: sampler_windows.rs
nodes.summary: Windows-specific sampler stub that implements the Sampler trait but returns Err for suspend_and_sample_thread, with TODO comments outlining the planned SuspendThread / GetThreadContext / ResumeThread approach.

nodes.name: HangMonitorRegister
nodes.summary: Public handle for initializing the hang monitor worker and registering components for monitoring. Implements BackgroundHangMonitorRegister and BackgroundHangMonitorClone traits.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorWorker
nodes.summary: Core worker struct managing a map of monitored components, channel ports for component messages and control commands, sampling state, and hang detection logic with transient/permanent alert dispatch to the constellation.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorChan
nodes.summary: Per-component channel wrapper that tags messages with a MonitoredComponentId and conditionally sends activity/wait/unregister notifications to the hang monitor worker.

nodes.name: Sampler
nodes.summary: Public trait defining the suspend_and_sample_thread interface for platform-specific thread sampling, returning a NativeStack on success or an error if sampling is not possible.

nodes.name: NativeStack
nodes.summary: Collects up to 1024 instruction-pointer/stack-pointer pairs from a native stack walk and can convert them into a demangled HangProfile for hang alert reporting.

nodes.name: PosixSemaphore
nodes.summary: Thread-safe wrapper around a POSIX semaphore (sem_t) providing post, wait, and EINTR-resilient wait_through_intr operations for the signal-handshake protocol.

nodes.name: LinuxSampler
nodes.summary: Linux-specific Sampler implementation that installs a SIGPROF signal handler per thread and uses tgkill + semaphore handshake to suspend, sample, and resume a target thread's native stack.

nodes.name: MacOsSampler
nodes.summary: macOS-specific Sampler implementation that uses Mach thread_act APIs to suspend a thread, retrieve its register state, perform frame-pointer-based stack walking, and resume it.

nodes.name: WindowsSampler
nodes.summary: Windows-specific Sampler stub with thread_id placeholder and a suspend_and_sample_thread implementation that always returns Err, serving as a not-yet-implemented platform backend.

nodes.name: HangMonitorRegister::init
nodes.summary: Spawns the BackgroundHangMonitorWorker on a dedicated thread named 'BackgroundHangMonitor', sets up an unbounded channel for component registration, and returns a boxed register handle plus a join handle.

nodes.name: HangMonitorRegister::register_component
nodes.summary: Implements BackgroundHangMonitorRegister trait: creates a per-component channel wrapper, sends a Register message with a default sampler, thread name, and hang timeouts, and returns a boxed monitor handle.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorWorker::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new BackgroundHangMonitorWorker with default-empty component maps, timestamp initialization, and a routed control port for receiving external ToggleSampler and Exit commands.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorWorker::run
nodes.summary: Main event loop using crossbeam select! to dispatch component messages, control commands (ToggleSampler, Exit), and periodic ticks for hang checkpoints or sampling, returning false when all monitored components have disconnected.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorWorker::handle_msg
nodes.summary: Processes incoming MonitoredComponentMsg variants: Register (inserts component with sampler/timeouts, propagates exit signal if shutting down), Unregister (removes component), NotifyActivity (resets hang timers), and NotifyWait (marks component as waiting).

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorWorker::perform_a_hang_monitor_checkpoint
nodes.summary: Iterates all monitored components, checks elapsed time since last activity against transient and permanent hang thresholds, samples the native stack for permanent hangs, and dispatches HangMonitorAlert messages to the constellation channel.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorWorker::finish_sampled_profile
nodes.summary: Serializes all accumulated native stack samples into a JSON profile payload (rate, start time, per-sample name/event-loop-id/time/frames) and sends it as a HangMonitorAlert::Profile to the constellation.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorWorker::sample
nodes.summary: Takes a snapshot of all monitored components by calling suspend_and_sample_thread on each, pushing successful NativeStack results into a bounded deque for later profile serialization.

nodes.name: NativeStack::process_register
nodes.summary: Records an instruction pointer and stack pointer pair into the NativeStack buffer, returning an error if the maximum frame count (1024) has been reached.

nodes.name: NativeStack::to_hangprofile
nodes.summary: Converts the collected instruction pointers into a HangProfile by resolving each address via the backtrace crate and optionally demangling symbol names with rustc_demangle when the sampler feature is enabled.

nodes.name: PosixSemaphore::new
nodes.summary: Initializes a new POSIX semaphore with the given initial value using sem_init, returning an IO error if initialization fails.

nodes.name: PosixSemaphore::wait_through_intr
nodes.summary: Wraps sem_wait with EINTR retry logic: on interrupt, yields the thread and retries; on any other error or success, returns immediately.

nodes.name: LinuxSampler::suspend_and_sample_thread
nodes.summary: Implements the Sampler trait for Linux: sends SIGPROF via tgkill to the monitored thread, waits for semaphore handshake, walks the native stack using backtrace::trace_unsynchronized in a critical section (no allocation or locking), then signals the thread to resume.

nodes.name: sigprof_handler
nodes.summary: SIGPROF signal handler (extern C) that participates in the semaphore handshake: posts msg2 to signal readiness, waits on msg3 for sampling completion, then posts msg4 to confirm resumption.

nodes.name: MacOsSampler::suspend_and_sample_thread
nodes.summary: Implements the Sampler trait for macOS: installs an abort-on-panic hook, suspends the target Mach thread, retrieves register state, performs frame-pointer stack walking, resumes the thread, and restores the original panic hook.

nodes.name: get_registers
nodes.summary: Retrieves the register state (instruction pointer, stack pointer, frame pointer) from a suspended Mach thread using thread_get_state, with conditional compilation for x86_64 (x86_THREAD_STATE64) and aarch64 (ARM_THREAD_STATE64).

nodes.name: frame_pointer_stack_walk
nodes.summary: Walks the native call stack using frame pointers: starting from the register state, follows linked frame pointers within the thread's stack bounds (obtained via pthread_get_stackaddr_np / pthread_get_stacksize_np), recording each frame's instruction and stack pointers into a NativeStack.

nodes.name: actor.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the actor registry system for the devtools server â€” the Actor trait, ActorRegistry for async message routing, error types, thread-safe actor downcasting, and unique actor name generation. Contains the core actor abstraction used by all devtools actor types.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses thread-local reentrancy guards for debug deadlock detection, PhantomData for type-safe downcasting, and AtomicU32 for monotonic actor name generation.

nodes.name: ActorError
nodes.summary: Error enum for the Firefox DevTools Protocol including missingParameter, badParameterType, unrecognizedPacketType, and Internal variants. Maps each variant to its wire-protocol error name string.

nodes.name: Actor
nodes.summary: Common trait for all devtools actors providing immutable name access, message handling dispatch, and stream cleanup. Acts as the central abstraction for the actor-based remote debugging architecture.

nodes.name: DowncastableActorArc
nodes.summary: Smart-pointer wrapper around Arc<dyn Actor> that enables seamless downcasting to concrete actor types via Deref. Panics with a descriptive message if downcasting to the wrong concrete type.

nodes.name: RegisteredActor
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around Arc<dyn Actor> stored in the ActorRegistry's HashSet, with custom PartialEq, Eq, Hash, and Borrow implementations keyed on actor name for O(1) actor lookup.

nodes.name: ActorRegistry
nodes.summary: Thread-safe registry of all active devtools actors backed by a parking_lot RwLock. Provides actor registration, name-based lookup with downcasting, serialization, message routing, and mappings between script IDs, source actors, and browser contexts.

nodes.name: new_actor_name
nodes.summary: Generates a unique actor name by combining the type's base name with a monotonically increasing atomic counter. Special-cases WorkerTarget to prepend a slash for Firefox DevTools client compatibility.

nodes.name: id.rs
nodes.summary: Maps Servo's internal pipeline, browsing-context, and webview IDs to sequential devtools protocol integer IDs via IdMap. Provides newtype wrappers (DevtoolsBrowserId, DevtoolsBrowsingContextId, DevtoolsOuterWindowId) for type-safe ID representation.

nodes.name: IdMap
nodes.summary: Bidirectional mapping structure that assigns monotonically increasing integer IDs to Servo's internal ID types (WebViewId, BrowsingContextId, PipelineId) using FxHashMap with checked arithmetic for overflow safety.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Main crate entry point for the actor-based Firefox DevTools remote debugging server. Provides start_server for spinning up a TCP listener, DevtoolsInstance for the main event loop routing messages through the actor registry, and handles script events, console resources, network events, debugger pauses, and memory reporting.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the Firefox DevTools Server protocol via reverse-engineering. Uses crossbeam channels for thread communication and parking_lot for synchronization. The actors module declares 27 sub-modules for different actor types.

nodes.name: UniqueId
nodes.summary: Discriminated union identifying either a pipeline or a worker as the source of a devtools event, used as a key for console resource routing.

nodes.name: DevtoolsInstance
nodes.summary: Central server instance managing the actor registry, ID mappings, TCP connections, and message dispatch. Handles all DevtoolsControlMsg variants including new globals, navigation, console output, network events, DOM mutations, debugger pauses, and memory reporting.

nodes.name: start_server
nodes.summary: Public entry point that spawns the devtools server thread. Creates a crossbeam channel for control messages, starts the DevtoolsInstance with memory reporting integration, and returns the sender handle for external control.

nodes.name: handle_client
nodes.summary: Processes JSON packets from a single devtools client connection in a read loop. Sends the initial root actor greeting, dispatches incoming packets through the registry, handles disconnection cleanup, and notifies the instance on client exit.

nodes.name: allow_devtools_client
nodes.summary: Authorizes incoming devtools TCP connections by first checking for a pre-shared auth token via stream peek, then falling back to a user permission prompt through the embedder proxy if no token is present.

nodes.name: debugger_value_to_json
nodes.summary: Converts a DebuggerValue enum (void, null, boolean, number with NaN/Infinity/-0 handling, string, object) into the serde_json::Value format expected by the Firefox DevTools Protocol, registering ObjectActors on-the-fly for object values.

nodes.name: network_handler.rs
nodes.summary: Processes network events (HTTP requests, request updates, responses, and security info) by dispatching them through the watcher actor's resource-array notification system for the Firefox DevTools Protocol network panel.

nodes.name: handle_network_event
nodes.summary: Dispatches a NetworkEvent (HttpRequest, HttpRequestUpdate, HttpResponse, or SecurityInfo) to the appropriate NetworkEventActor, then pushes resource-available or resource-updated notifications through the WatcherActor to all connected clients.

nodes.name: protocol.rs
nodes.summary: Low-level wire protocol implementation for the Firefox DevTools Protocol. Implements JSON packet streaming over TCP via the JsonPacketStream trait, a DevtoolsConnection wrapper with split read/write locking, and ClientRequest enforcing request/reply invariants for actor message dispatch.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the Firefox DevTools stream transport: each JSON packet is prefixed with an ASCII length followed by a colon. Uses try_clone on TcpStream to split read and write into separate Arc<Mutex> handles for independent locking.

nodes.name: JsonPacketStream
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting JSON packet read/write operations over a transport stream. Provides the serialization/deserialization interface used by both DevtoolsConnection (TCP) and ClientRequest (request-scoped wrapper).

nodes.name: DevtoolsConnection
nodes.summary: Thread-safe TCP stream wrapper for the devtools protocol. Splits a single TcpStream into separate receiver and sender Arc<Mutex> handles for independent read/write locking, and implements JsonPacketStream for length-prefixed JSON packet serialization.

nodes.name: ClientRequest
nodes.summary: Request-scoped wrapper around DevtoolsConnection that enforces the devtools protocol request/reply invariant: each client request must receive exactly one reply from the target actor. Tracks whether a reply was sent and returns UnrecognizedPacketType on failure. Also implements JsonPacketStream for sending non-reply messages.

nodes.name: resource.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the ResourceAvailable trait and ResourceArrayType enum for the devtools resource notification system. Provides default serialization methods that send resources-available-array and resources-updated-array JSON packets to connected clients.

nodes.name: ResourceArrayType
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing between initial resource availability notifications (Available) and incremental updates (Updated) in the devtools resource notification system.

nodes.name: ResourceAvailable
nodes.summary: Trait for actors that emit resource notifications to devtools clients. Provides default implementations for resource_array (single resource) and resources_array (batch) that serialize and send JSON packets with the appropriate array type.

nodes.name: async_html.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the asynchronous HTML tokenizer that runs the html5ever parser on a dedicated background thread, communicating tree-building operations back to the main thread via channels for non-blocking progressive parsing.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses std::sync::mpsc channels for bidirectional communication between the main-thread Tokenizer and the background thread running html5ever with a Sink that serializes DOM operations (ParseOperation enum) across the thread boundary. The Sink captures parse node metadata (integration point status, template contents) to satisfy TreeSink trait requirements remotely.

nodes.name: Tokenizer
nodes.summary: Main-thread tokenizer that manages the background parsing thread: holds the document reference, channel endpoints (from_parser_thread_receiver, to_parser_thread_sender), a node map for parse-node-to-DOM-node mapping, URL, parsing algorithm, and custom element reaction stack.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates the async tokenizer: sets up bidirectional channels, inserts the document and fragment context nodes into the node map, spawns the background parsing thread, and initializes the Sink for remote DOM operations.

nodes.name: feed
nodes.summary: Feeds input tendrils to the background parser thread and processes incoming operations from the parser thread, handling script detection by draining the input queue and returning the script element for execution on the main thread.

nodes.name: process_operation
nodes.summary: Dispatches ParseOperation variants received from the background parser thread into actual DOM mutations on the main thread: creates elements/comments/PIs/doctypes, inserts nodes, removes from parent, marks scripts as started, reparents children, attaches declarative shadow DOM, sets quirks mode, and handles form association.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Background thread entry point: runs the html5ever tokenizer loop, receiving ToParserThreadMsg variants (Feed, End, SetPlainTextState), feeding tendrils to the tokenizer, and sending back results (TokenizerResult messages and ProcessOperation requests) to the main thread.

nodes.name: Sink
nodes.summary: Background-thread TreeSink implementation that serializes all DOM operations as ParseOperation messages sent to the main thread via a channel, maintaining parse node data (template contents, integration point flags) locally since tree-builder queries cannot block on main-thread round-trips.

nodes.name: ParseOperation
nodes.summary: Enum of all DOM mutation operations that the background parser thread can request the main thread to execute: GetTemplateContents, CreateElement, CreateComment, AppendBeforeSibling, Append, AppendDoctypeToDocument, AddAttrsIfMissing, RemoveFromParent, MarkScriptAlreadyStarted, ReparentChildren, AssociateWithForm, CreatePI, Pop, SetQuirksMode, and AttachDeclarativeShadowRoot.

nodes.name: ParseNode
nodes.summary: Struct pairing a parse node ID with its optional qualified name, used to map parse-tree nodes to DOM nodes across the thread boundary.

nodes.name: FromParserThreadMsg
nodes.summary: Enum of messages from the background parser thread to the main thread: TokenizerResultDone (parsing complete), TokenizerResultScript (script element encountered), EncodingIndicator, End, and ProcessOperation (with a ParseOperation payload).

nodes.name: ToParserThreadMsg
nodes.summary: Enum of messages from the main thread to the background parser thread: Feed (input tendrils), End (finish parsing), and SetPlainTextState.

nodes.name: create_element
nodes.summary: Sink-side element creation: allocates a new parse node, records the qualified name, detects template/integration-point elements from attributes, converts html5ever attributes, and sends the CreateElement operation to the main thread.

nodes.name: encoding.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML encoding detection algorithm: BOM sniffing, byte-stream prescan for <meta charset> tags, XML encoding declaration extraction, chardetng-based statistical detection, and a stateful network decoder (Detecting -> Decoding) that feeds decoded tendrils to the tokenizer.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the W3C HTML spec encoding sniffing algorithm in full: BOM detection, prescan for charset in <meta> attributes (with case-insensitive ASCII matching), XML encoding declaration extraction, and falls back to chardetng statistical detection using TLD hints. The NetworkDecoderState uses a two-phase state machine (Detecting -> Decoding) with lossy decoding via encoding_rs.

nodes.name: NetworkDecoderState
nodes.summary: Two-phase decoding state machine: starts in Detecting phase (buffer bytes, sniff encoding) then transitions to Decoding phase (decode bytes to tendrils using the determined encoding).

nodes.name: DetectingState
nodes.summary: Holds the buffered bytes during encoding detection: tracks encoding hints from Content-Type and container document, BOM sniffing state, and a timestamp for the delayed-prescan timeout.

nodes.name: determine_the_character_encoding
nodes.summary: Implements the full HTML encoding determination algorithm: checks BOM, applies encoding hints from Content-Type, waits for the prescan buffer threshold, prescans the byte stream for <meta charset> or calls get_xml_encoding, falls back to chardetng statistical detection with TLD-based hints, and sets the document encoding.

nodes.name: prescan_the_byte_stream_to_determine_the_encoding
nodes.summary: Implements the W3C byte-stream prescan algorithm: scans for <!--> comments, <meta tags with charset/content attributes, and extracts the character encoding from matching meta elements using case-insensitive ASCII comparison against known encoding labels.

nodes.name: get_an_attribute
nodes.summary: Parses a single HTML attribute from a byte stream during the encoding prescan: handles whitespace skipping, quoted and unquoted attribute values, and uppercase-to-lowercase conversion, returning the attribute name and value.

nodes.name: extract_a_character_encoding_from_a_meta_element
nodes.summary: Extracts a character encoding label from a <meta> element's content attribute value, searching for 'charset=' followed by a valid encoding label terminated by whitespace or semicolon.

nodes.name: get_xml_encoding
nodes.summary: Extracts the character encoding from an XML declaration (<?xml encoding='...'?>): handles both single and double quotes, skips whitespace and BOM, and validates the encoding label against known encodings.

nodes.name: DecodingState
nodes.summary: Holds the active decoder and the determined encoding once detection is complete, with optional residual bytes from the detection phase.

nodes.name: push
nodes.summary: Pushes a byte chunk through the decoder: in Detecting state, buffers bytes and tries to determine encoding; in Decoding state, decodes bytes through the lossy decoder and collects output tendrils.

nodes.name: html.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the synchronous HTML tokenizer (wrapping html5ever directly on the main thread) and the HTML fragment serialization algorithm that produces well-formed HTML markup from DOM subtrees, including shadow root serialization support.

nodes.name: Tokenizer
nodes.summary: Synchronous HTML tokenizer wrapping the html5ever HtmlTokenizer and TreeBuilder, used for fragment parsing and non-async document parsing; handles script and encoding-indicator result extraction.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates the synchronous HTML tokenizer: configures html5ever with the document's quirks mode, scripting flag, URL, custom element reaction stack, and either a TreeBuilder::new (full doc) or TreeBuilder::new_for_fragment (fragment) with an optional form element context.

nodes.name: serialize_html_fragment
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML fragment serialization algorithm: uses a SerializationIterator to walk the DOM tree in pre-order, emitting start/end element tags, doctypes, text nodes, comments, and processing instructions via a Serializer trait. Supports serializable shadow roots with mode/is/delegatesfocus/clonable attributes and the is='' custom element attribute.

nodes.name: SerializationIterator
nodes.summary: Iterator for HTML fragment serialization: maintains a stack of SerializationCommands (OpenElement, CloseElement, SerializeNonelement, SerializeShadowRoot) and walks the DOM tree in document order, handling template contents, shadow root children, and element attribute serialization.

nodes.name: SerializationCommand
nodes.summary: Enum of commands for the serialization iterator stack: OpenElement (with qualified name and attributes), CloseElement (with qualified name), SerializeNonelement (text/comment/PI node), and SerializeShadowRoot (shadow root info).

nodes.name: HtmlSerialize
nodes.summary: Trait for types that can be serialized to HTML, providing a serialize method that takes a Serializer and optional traversal scope.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Central module for the Servo HTML parser, defining the ServoParser DOM object, ParserContext for navigation-driven document loading, and the synchronous Tokenizer/Sink infrastructure that bridges html5ever tree building with the DOM.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the full HTML tree construction algorithm with custom element reaction stacks, declarative shadow DOM support, script execution suspension, and prefetch-aware progressive parsing. Uses a Tokenizer enum to dispatch between synchronous HTML, async HTML, and XML tokenizers.

nodes.name: ServoParser
nodes.summary: The main DOM-backed HTML parser struct holding the document reference, network decoder pipeline, script and network input queues, tokenizer dispatch, and parser state flags (suspended, aborted, stopped).

nodes.name: parse_html_document
nodes.summary: Initiates parsing of a full HTML document by creating a ServoParser with either an async or sync tokenizer and feeding the complete input string.

nodes.name: parse_html_fragment
nodes.summary: Parses an HTML fragment into a DocumentFragment, creating a temporary document, cloning context element attributes (sandboxing, quirks mode, custom element reaction stack), and running the synchronous HTML tokenizer.

nodes.name: parse_sync
nodes.summary: Core synchronous parse loop that drains the network input queue, calls the tokenizer feed method, checks for suspension or abortion, and triggers finish when the last chunk is received.

nodes.name: tokenize
nodes.summary: Tokenizes a single feed invocation: calls the tokenizer, handles reflow timer expiry, performs microtask checkpoints, increments the script nesting level, and manages suspension for pending parsing-blocking scripts.

nodes.name: finish
nodes.summary: Finalizes parsing: ends the tokenizer, sets the document ready state to 'interactive', clears the current parser reference, starts the end-loading phase, and sends source content to devtools.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Implements document.write â€” buffers input when a pending parsing-blocking script exists, otherwise feeds it directly to the tokenizer with profiling instrumentation.

nodes.name: abort
nodes.summary: Aborts parsing by setting the aborted flag, clearing input queues, ending the tokenizer, detaching the current parser from the document, and resetting ready state to 'complete'.

nodes.name: ParserContext
nodes.summary: Orchestrates navigation-driven document loading: holds navigation params (policy container, content type, sandboxing flags, referrer), manages the parser lifecycle, and dispatches to content-type-specific load methods (HTML, XML, text, media, JSON, inline unknown).

nodes.name: load_document
nodes.summary: Classifies the MIME type from the content-type header (using MimeClassifier) and dispatches to the appropriate load_* method, handling the Apache bug flag workaround and inline unknown content fallback.

nodes.name: process_response
nodes.summary: Processes the HTTP response for a navigation: extracts Content-Type, builds the policy container with CSP/referrer policy, determines origin from sandboxing flags, handles CSP navigation blocking, X-Frame-Options checks, Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy, and sets up the reporting endpoints list.

nodes.name: process_response_eof
nodes.summary: Handles end-of-response: triggers load_document if not already loaded, sets the last-chunk-received flag, runs parse_sync, and submits resource timing via PerformanceNavigationTiming.

nodes.name: load_media_document
nodes.summary: Handles direct media file navigation (image, audio, video): creates a wrapper HTML document with an img/audio/video element pointing to the resource URL, inserts it as the body child, and processes link headers.

nodes.name: insert_an_element_at_the_adjusted_insertion_location
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML spec algorithm for inserting elements during tree construction: validates pre-insertion, pushes custom element reaction queues for custom elements, calls Node::insert, and pops the reaction queue.

nodes.name: insert
nodes.summary: Inserts a NodeOrText (node or text tendril) into the DOM at the adjusted insertion location, merging consecutive text nodes when appropriate.

nodes.name: create_element_for_token
nodes.summary: Creates an element for a tree-builder token: resolves custom element definitions (including the 'is' attribute for customized built-ins), pushes/pops custom element reaction queues, handles form-associated custom elements and resettable elements, and supports the throw-on-dynamic-markup-insertion counter.

nodes.name: attach_declarative_shadow_inner
nodes.summary: Implements declarative shadow DOM attachment: validates the host element has no existing shadow root, parses attributes (mode, delegatesfocus, serializable, clonable), attaches a shadow root, and sets the template contents as the shadow root's children.

nodes.name: Tokenizer
nodes.summary: Enum dispatching between the three tokenizer implementations: synchronous Html, asynchronous AsyncHtml (with dedicated parser thread), and Xml.

nodes.name: Sink
nodes.summary: Tree sink implementation for the synchronous HTML parser: implements the full html5ever TreeSink trait with methods for element creation, comment/PI creation, DOM insertion, form association, template contents retrieval, shadow DOM attachment, quirks mode setting, and Text node cloning into select elements.

nodes.name: parse_xml_document
nodes.summary: Initiates XML document parsing by creating a ServoParser with the XML tokenizer and feeding the complete input string.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Constructs the internal ServoParser state: initializes the network decoder, input buffers, parser flags (suspended, aborted, stopped), prefetch decoder/tokenizer for speculative resource loading, and devtools content capture when browsing context exists.

nodes.name: ParsingAlgorithm
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing between Normal (full document) and Fragment parsing algorithms, used to adjust DOM insertion behavior.

nodes.name: NavigationParams
nodes.summary: Holds parameters extracted from a navigation response: policy container, Content-Type, Link headers, final sandboxing flag set, resource header bytes, and about:base URL.

nodes.name: FragmentContext
nodes.summary: Describes the context for fragment parsing: the context element, optional form element, and whether the context element allows scripting.

nodes.name: ElementAttribute
nodes.summary: Represents a parsed HTML attribute with a qualified name and DOMString value, used as input to element creation during tokenization.

nodes.name: prefetch.rs
nodes.summary: Implements a speculative HTML tokenizer that runs ahead of the main parser to detect and initiate early fetches for scripts, stylesheets, and images, reducing page load latency through resource prefetching.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a lightweight html5ever tokenizer with a custom PrefetchSink that intercepts start tags for

nodes.name: Tokenizer
nodes.summary: Prefetch tokenizer wrapping a TraceableTokenizer (JSTraceable wrapper around html5ever's HtmlTokenizer with a PrefetchSink).

nodes.name: PrefetchSink
nodes.summary: TreeSink implementation for speculative prefetching: intercepts tags in process_token to issue early Fetch requests for scripts (with nonce/integrity metadata), stylesheets, preload links, and images via the resource thread pool.
