Captures <base> URL for resolution and tracks prefetching state to stop after a script is encountered.

nodes.name: process_token
nodes.summary: Dispatches on HTML start tags to trigger speculative resource fetches:

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates the prefetch tokenizer: initializes the PrefetchSink with pipeline/webview IDs, document URL, referrer info, resource threads, and a default HtmlTokenizer â€” all wrapped in a TraceableTokenizer for JS GC tracing.

nodes.name: xml.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the XML tokenizer wrapping html5ever's XmlTokenizer and XmlTreeBuilder for XML document parsing, handling script and encoding-indicator tokenizer results.

nodes.name: Tokenizer
nodes.summary: XML tokenizer wrapping html5ever's XmlTokenizer and XmlTreeBuilder with a Sink, managing the parsing algorithm and current line tracking.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel declaring all Trusted Types submodules (trustedhtml, trustedscript, trustedscripturl, trustedtypepolicy, trustedtypepolicyfactory) as crate-public, forming the trustedtypes domain module for Servo's DOM layer.

nodes.name: trustedhtml.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TrustedHTML DOM struct per the W3C Trusted Types specification, providing safe HTML string wrapping, WebIDL binding methods (Stringifier, ToJSON), and a compliant-string algorithm that delegates to TrustedTypePolicyFactory.

nodes.name: trustedscript.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TrustedScript DOM struct with the W3C can-compile-strings CSP algorithm that validates eval() and Function() calls against Trusted Types policies, plus WebIDL binding methods (Stringifier, ToJSON).

nodes.name: trustedscripturl.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TrustedScriptURL DOM struct for safe script URL wrapping, with a compliant-string algorithm that delegates to TrustedTypePolicyFactory and WebIDL binding methods (Stringifier, ToJSON).

nodes.name: trustedtypepolicy.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TrustedTypePolicy DOM struct and TrustedType enum per the W3C spec, including the Get Trusted Type policy value algorithm, Create a Trusted Type algorithm, and WebIDL binding methods (CreateHTML, CreateScript, CreateScriptURL).

nodes.name: trustedtypepolicyfactory.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TrustedTypePolicyFactory DOM struct, the central factory for creating Trusted Type policies and processing Trusted Type compliant strings. Contains CSP integration algorithms for attribute mutation validation, default policy processing, and sink-type enforcement. Also provides a GlobalScope extension method to access the factory from Window and Worker scopes.

nodes.name: TrustedHTML
nodes.summary: DOM struct representing a TrustedHTML value per the W3C Trusted Types spec, wrapping a DOMString with a Reflector for garbage-collection integration.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new TrustedHTML DOM object via reflect_dom_object_with_cx, initializing it with the given DOMString data.

nodes.name: get_trusted_type_compliant_string
nodes.summary: Converts a TrustedHTMLOrString union value into a compliant DOMString, unwrapping trusted data or delegating string values to the TrustedTypePolicyFactory for policy enforcement.

nodes.name: data
nodes.summary: Returns a reference to the underlying DOMString data of the TrustedHTML object.

nodes.name: convert
nodes.summary: Implements the Convert trait to transform TrustedHTMLOrNullIsEmptyString into TrustedHTMLOrString, unwrapping TrustedHTML or converting NullIsEmptyString into a plain String.

nodes.name: TrustedScript
nodes.summary: DOM struct representing a TrustedScript value per the W3C Trusted Types spec, wrapping a DOMString for safe JavaScript code representation with CSP validation support.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new TrustedScript DOM object via reflect_dom_object_with_cx with the given JS context and DOMString data.

nodes.name: get_trusted_type_compliant_string
nodes.summary: Converts a TrustedScriptOrString union into a compliant DOMString, unwrapping trusted data or delegating to TrustedTypePolicyFactory for policy enforcement on raw strings.

nodes.name: data
nodes.summary: Returns a reference to the underlying DOMString data of the TrustedScript object.

nodes.name: can_compile_string_with_trusted_type
nodes.summary: Implements the W3C Can Compile Strings algorithm for CSP Trusted Types enforcement. Validates eval() and Function() compilation by checking body and parameter arguments against TrustedScript data, delegating to the CSP list for final evaluation-allowed decisions.

nodes.name: TrustedScriptURL
nodes.summary: DOM struct representing a TrustedScriptURL value per the W3C Trusted Types spec, wrapping a DOMString for safe script URL representation.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new TrustedScriptURL DOM object via reflect_dom_object_with_cx with the given DOMString data.

nodes.name: get_trusted_type_compliant_string
nodes.summary: Converts a TrustedScriptURLOrUSVString union into a compliant DOMString, delegating USVString values to TrustedTypePolicyFactory while directly returning trusted data for already-trusted URLs.

nodes.name: data
nodes.summary: Returns a reference to the underlying DOMString data of the TrustedScriptURL object.

nodes.name: TrustedTypePolicy
nodes.summary: DOM struct representing a Trusted Type Policy per the W3C spec, holding a policy name and optional callback references for createHTML, createScript, and createScriptURL. Implements the Get Trusted Type policy value and Create a Trusted Type algorithms.

nodes.name: TrustedType
nodes.summary: Enumeration of the three Trusted Type variants defined by the W3C spec: TrustedHTML, TrustedScript, and TrustedScriptURL. Derives AsRefStr for string conversion and provides a method to match against IDL union types.

nodes.name: matches_idl_trusted_type
nodes.summary: Checks whether this TrustedType variant matches a given IDL union type (TrustedHTMLOrTrustedScriptOrTrustedScriptURLOrString), used for type validation before processing compliant string conversions.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new TrustedTypePolicy DOM object with the given policy name and options (createHTML, createScript, createScriptURL callbacks).

nodes.name: get_trusted_type_policy_value
nodes.summary: Implements the W3C Get Trusted Type policy value algorithm. Dispatches to the appropriate callback (createHTML, createScript, createScriptURL) based on the expected type, invoking it with the input string and additional arguments, or returning an error if the callback is missing and throwIfMissing is set.

nodes.name: create_trusted_type
nodes.summary: Implements the W3C Create a Trusted Type algorithm. Calls get_trusted_type_policy_value to obtain a policy value, stringifies it, and passes it to a creation callback (e.g., TrustedHTML::new) to produce a new DOM object of the expected type.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a generic type parameter R and a FnOnce closure to avoid code duplication across the three Trusted Type variants.

nodes.name: CreateHTML
nodes.summary: WebIDL binding method implementing the TrustedTypePolicy.createHTML() API. Delegates to create_trusted_type with TrustedHTML::new as the creation callback.

nodes.name: CreateScript
nodes.summary: WebIDL binding method implementing the TrustedTypePolicy.createScript() API. Delegates to create_trusted_type with TrustedScript::new as the creation callback.

nodes.name: CreateScriptURL
nodes.summary: WebIDL binding method implementing the TrustedTypePolicy.createScriptURL() API. Delegates to create_trusted_type with TrustedScriptURL::new as the creation callback.

nodes.name: TrustedTypePolicyFactory
nodes.summary: DOM struct serving as the central Trusted Type Policy Factory per the W3C spec. Manages policy creation (CreatePolicy), default policy storage, policy name tracking, CSP-integrated compliant string processing, attribute mutation validation, and trusted type checking (IsHTML, IsScript, IsScriptURL).

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new TrustedTypePolicyFactory DOM object via reflect_dom_object_with_cx, initializing an empty policy list and no default policy.

nodes.name: convert
nodes.summary: Implements the Convert trait for TrustedHTMLOrTrustedScriptOrTrustedScriptURLOrString into DOMString, extracting the underlying data from any of the three trusted type variants or passing through a plain string.

nodes.name: create_trusted_type_policy
nodes.summary: Implements the W3C Create a Trusted Type Policy algorithm. Validates policy creation against CSP, enforces single default policy rule, creates a new TrustedTypePolicy, sets it as default if named 'default', and appends the policy name to the factory's tracking list.

nodes.name: get_trusted_type_data_for_attribute
nodes.summary: Implements the W3C Get Trusted Type data for attribute algorithm. Maps HTML/SVG/MathML element-attribute combinations to the required Trusted Type variant and sink name (e.g., iframe srcdoc requires TrustedHTML, script src requires TrustedScriptURL).

nodes.name: get_trusted_types_compliant_attribute_value
nodes.summary: Implements the W3C Validate attribute mutation algorithm. Resolves the expected Trusted Type for an attribute mutation, returns already-trusted values if type matches, converts untrusted strings through the compliant string pipeline, or passes through the raw value if no type requirement exists.

nodes.name: process_value_with_default_policy
nodes.summary: Implements the W3C Process value with a default policy algorithm. Retrieves the global scope's default TrustedTypePolicy, invokes get_trusted_type_policy_value with the expected type and sink, and returns the stringified result or propagates errors.

nodes.name: get_trusted_type_compliant_string
nodes.summary: Implements the W3C Get Trusted Type compliant string algorithm, the central enforcement point for Trusted Types. Checks if the sink group requires trusted types via CSP, attempts default policy processing, and either passes through the value or blocks with a TypeError based on CSP mismatch violation disposition.

nodes.name: is_trusted_script
nodes.summary: W3C TrustedTypePolicyFactory.isScript() helper. Attempts to root a JS handle value as a TrustedScript DOM object, returning the rooted object on success or an error unit on failure.

nodes.name: CreatePolicy
nodes.summary: WebIDL binding method implementing the TrustedTypePolicyFactory.createPolicy() API. Delegates to create_trusted_type_policy with the provided policy name, options, and global scope.

nodes.name: GetAttributeType
nodes.summary: WebIDL binding method implementing the TrustedTypePolicyFactory.getAttributeType() API. Normalizes tag name, attribute, and namespace inputs, then queries the attribute data table to return the expected Trusted Type name for a given element-attribute combination.

nodes.name: GetPropertyType
nodes.summary: WebIDL binding method implementing the TrustedTypePolicyFactory.getPropertyType() API. Normalizes inputs and matches element-property pairs against the W3C-specified table (e.g., iframe srcdoc -> TrustedHTML, innerHTML -> TrustedHTML) to return the expected Trusted Type.

nodes.name: trusted_types
nodes.summary: Extension method on GlobalScope that retrieves the TrustedTypePolicyFactory for the current global. Downcasts to Window or WorkerGlobalScope and calls their respective TrustedTypes() accessors.

nodes.name: embedder_controls.rs
nodes.summary: Defines data models for embedder-level UI control requests and responses: select elements, color pickers, file pickers, input method editors, context menus, and simple dialogs (alert/confirm/prompt).
nodes.languageNotes: Pure type-definition module with 18 Rust enums/structs, all public. Uses enum variants to model request-response control surfaces.

nodes.name: EmbedderControlId
nodes.summary: Unique identifier for an embedder control instance, scoped by webview_id, pipeline_id, and index.

nodes.name: EmbedderControlRequest
nodes.summary: Enum of all possible embedder control request types: SelectElement, ColorPicker, FilePicker, InputMethod, and ContextMenu.

nodes.name: SelectElementOption
nodes.summary: Represents a single option in a select element with id, label, and disabled state.

nodes.name: SelectElementOptionOrOptgroup
nodes.summary: Enum discriminating between a select option and an optgroup.

nodes.name: ContextMenuRequest
nodes.summary: Request to show a context menu, carrying element information and menu items.

nodes.name: ContextMenuItem
nodes.summary: Enum for context menu items: Item or Separator.

nodes.name: ContextMenuAction
nodes.summary: Enum of all possible context menu actions: navigation (back/forward/reload), link operations, clipboard, selection, and image actions.

nodes.name: ContextMenuElementInformation
nodes.summary: Metadata about the element that triggered a context menu: flags, link URL, and image URL.

nodes.name: InputMethodRequest
nodes.summary: Request to show an IME with type, text, insertion point, multiline flag, and virtual keyboard setting.

nodes.name: FilePickerRequest
nodes.summary: Request to show a file picker dialog with filter patterns, multiple selection, and test-mode options.

nodes.name: SelectElementRequest
nodes.summary: Request to show a select element dropdown with available options and selected indices.

nodes.name: EmbedderControlResponse
nodes.summary: Enum of embedder control response types matching the request variants.

nodes.name: SelectedFile
nodes.summary: Represents a file selected via the file picker with id, filename, modification time, size, and MIME type.

nodes.name: SimpleDialogRequest
nodes.summary: Enum of simple dialog requests: Alert, Confirm, and Prompt, each with message and title fields.

nodes.name: AlertResponse
nodes.summary: Response enum for an alert dialog (always Ok).

nodes.name: ConfirmResponse
nodes.summary: Response enum for a confirm dialog: Ok or Cancel.

nodes.name: PromptResponse
nodes.summary: Response enum for a prompt dialog: Ok (with input string) or Cancel.

nodes.name: input_events.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the complete input event type hierarchy: keyboard, mouse, touch, wheel, IME, gamepad, and editing action events for the Servo embedder layer.
nodes.languageNotes: Comprehensive input event modeling with 24 types (structs/enums) and 15 methods. Top-level InputEvent enum discriminates across 9 input categories.

nodes.name: InputEventId
nodes.summary: Unique identifier for an input event, generated via atomic counter.

nodes.name: InputEventOutcome
nodes.summary: Outcome of processing an input event: the event id and its result.

nodes.name: InputEvent
nodes.summary: Top-level enum discriminating across 9 input event types: EditingAction, Gamepad, Ime, Keyboard, MouseButton, MouseLeftViewport, MouseMove, Touch, and Wheel.

nodes.name: InputEventAndId
nodes.summary: Pairs an InputEvent with its InputEventId for tracking.

nodes.name: EditingActionEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of editing clipboard actions: Copy, Cut, and Paste.

nodes.name: KeyboardEvent
nodes.summary: Keyboard input event wrapping key state, code, location, modifiers, repeat, and composition flags.

nodes.name: MouseButtonEvent
nodes.summary: Mouse button event with action (down/up), button, and point coordinates.

nodes.name: MouseButton
nodes.summary: Enum of mouse buttons: Left, Middle, Right, Back, Forward, and Other (with button index).

nodes.name: MouseButtonAction
nodes.summary: Enum of mouse button actions: Down and Up.

nodes.name: MouseMoveEvent
nodes.summary: Mouse move event with point coordinates and touch compatibility flag.

nodes.name: MouseLeftViewportEvent
nodes.summary: Event fired when the mouse leaves the viewport, tracking iframe focus transition.

nodes.name: TouchEventType
nodes.summary: Enum of touch event types: Down, Move, Up, and Cancel.

nodes.name: TouchPointerType
nodes.summary: Enum of touch pointer types: Pen and Touch.

nodes.name: TouchEvent
nodes.summary: Touch event with event type, touch id, point coordinates, pointer type, and cancelable flag.

nodes.name: WheelMode
nodes.summary: Enum of wheel scroll modes: DeltaPixel, DeltaLine, and DeltaPage.

nodes.name: WheelDelta
nodes.summary: Wheel scroll delta values with x, y, z components and a scroll mode.

nodes.name: WheelEvent
nodes.summary: Wheel scroll event with delta values and point coordinates.

nodes.name: ImeEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of IME (Input Method Editor) events: Composition and Dismissed.

nodes.name: GamepadInputBounds
nodes.summary: Gamepad input bounds defining axis and button count ranges.

nodes.name: GamepadSupportedHapticEffects
nodes.summary: Flags indicating which haptic effects a gamepad supports (dual rumble, trigger rumble).

nodes.name: GamepadEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of gamepad lifecycle events: Connected (with bounds/haptics), Disconnected, and Updated (with axis/button state).

nodes.name: GamepadUpdateType
nodes.summary: Enum of gamepad update types: Axis (with index and value) and Button (with index, value, and pressed state).

nodes.name: point
nodes.summary: Returns touch/click coordinates from an InputEvent if it is a mouse or touch variant.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Core embedder API module defining the communication protocol between the Servo browser engine and its embedder. Contains geometry types, the central EmbedderMsg enum (~30 variants), media session types, notification types, JavaScript evaluation types, and WebDriver-related types.
nodes.languageNotes: Massive type-definition module (1211 lines) with 54 types and 38 functions. Central EmbedderMsg enum encodes the full embedder-to-browser communication surface. Uses newtype wrappers for type-safe IDs.

nodes.name: WebViewPoint
nodes.summary: Enum for webview coordinate points: Device (physical pixels) or Page (CSS pixels).

nodes.name: WebViewRect
nodes.summary: Enum for webview coordinate rectangles: Device or Page.

nodes.name: WebViewVector
nodes.summary: Enum for webview coordinate vectors: Device or Page.

nodes.name: Scroll
nodes.summary: Enum of scroll actions: Delta (with offset), Start (to top), and End (to bottom).

nodes.name: ShutdownState
nodes.summary: Enum tracking shutdown lifecycle: NotShuttingDown, ShuttingDown, FinishedShuttingDown.

nodes.name: Cursor
nodes.summary: Enum of 34 CSS cursor types matching the full CSS cursor specification.

nodes.name: EventLoopWaker
nodes.summary: Trait for waking the embedder event loop, with clone_box and wake methods.

nodes.name: GenericEmbedderProxy
nodes.summary: Struct holding a sender channel and event loop waker for proxying messages to the embedder.

nodes.name: RefreshDriver
nodes.summary: Trait for observing the next frame from the compositor refresh driver.

nodes.name: AuthenticationResponse
nodes.summary: Struct for HTTP authentication credentials: username and password.

nodes.name: AllowOrDeny
nodes.summary: Enum for binary permission decisions: Allow or Deny.

nodes.name: RegisterOrUnregister
nodes.summary: Enum for protocol handler registration actions: Register or Unregister.

nodes.name: ProtocolHandlerUpdateRegistration
nodes.summary: Struct carrying a protocol handler update with scheme, URL, and register/unregister action.

nodes.name: ViewportDetails
nodes.summary: Viewport geometry: CSS size, HiDPI scale factor, device pixel size. Provides layout_size() for the compositor.

nodes.name: ScreenMetrics
nodes.summary: Screen size and available size (excluding OS chrome) for the display.

nodes.name: TraversalId
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper for a UUID-based traversal identifier used in focus navigation.

nodes.name: PixelFormat
nodes.summary: Enum of pixel formats: K8, KA8, RGB8, RGBA8, and BGRA8.

nodes.name: Image
nodes.summary: Struct representing a raster image with width, height, pixel format, raw data bytes, and byte range.

nodes.name: ConsoleLogLevel
nodes.summary: Enum of console log levels: Log, Debug, Info, Warn, Error, Trace, and Dir.

nodes.name: BluetoothDeviceDescription
nodes.summary: Struct describing a bluetooth device with address and optional name.

nodes.name: EmbedderMsg
nodes.summary: Central enum encoding ~30 message types from embedder to browser: status, geometry, dialogs, clipboard, cursor, favicon, fullscreen, load status, bluetooth, permissions, devtools, gamepad haptics, notifications, console API, embedder controls, input events, and accessibility tree updates.

nodes.name: MediaMetadata
nodes.summary: Media session metadata: title, artist, and album strings.

nodes.name: MediaSessionPlaybackState
nodes.summary: Enum of media playback states: None_, Playing, and Paused.

nodes.name: MediaPositionState
nodes.summary: Media position state with duration, playback rate, and current position.

nodes.name: MediaSessionEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of media session events: SetMetadata, PlaybackStateChange, and SetPositionState.

nodes.name: PermissionFeature
nodes.summary: Enum of 13 web permission features: Geolocation, Notifications, Push, Midi, Camera, Microphone, Speaker, DeviceInfo, BackgroundSync, Bluetooth, PersistentStorage, ScreenWakeLock, Gamepad.

nodes.name: InputMethodType
nodes.summary: Enum of HTML input method types: Color, Date, DatetimeLocal, Email, Month, Number, Password, Search, Tel, Text, Time, Url, Week.

nodes.name: DualRumbleEffectParams
nodes.summary: Parameters for dual rumble haptic effects: duration, start delay, strong/weak magnitude.

nodes.name: GamepadHapticEffectType
nodes.summary: Enum of gamepad haptic effect types (currently only DualRumble).

nodes.name: WebResourceRequest
nodes.summary: Struct describing a web resource request with HTTP method, headers, URL, destination, referrer, main-frame flag, and redirect flag.

nodes.name: WebResourceResponseMsg
nodes.summary: Enum of web resource response stream messages: Start, SendBodyData, FinishLoad, CancelLoad, DoNotIntercept.

nodes.name: WebResourceResponse
nodes.summary: Struct for web resource responses with URL, headers, status code, and status message. Builder-style setters.

nodes.name: Theme
nodes.summary: Enum of color scheme themes: Light and Dark, with From impls for prefers-color-scheme.

nodes.name: MediaSessionActionType
nodes.summary: Enum of 9 media session action types: Play, Pause, SeekBackward, SeekForward, PreviousTrack, NextTrack, SkipAd, Stop, SeekTo.

nodes.name: LoadStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of page load status states: Started, HeadParsed, and Complete.

nodes.name: Notification
nodes.summary: Struct for web notifications with title, body, tag, language, interaction/silent flags, icon/badge/image URLs and resources, and action list.

nodes.name: NotificationAction
nodes.summary: Struct for notification action buttons with name, title, icon URL, and icon resource.

nodes.name: ScreenGeometry
nodes.summary: Struct for screen geometry: total size, available size, and window rectangle.

nodes.name: UntrustedNodeAddress
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around usize representing an untrusted DOM node address. Implements serde serialize/deserialize for IPC.

nodes.name: PaintHitTestResult
nodes.summary: Result of a paint hit test: pipeline ID, viewport point, and optional external scroll ID.

nodes.name: AnimationState
nodes.summary: Enum of animation state flags: AnimationsPresent, AnimationCallbacksPresent, NoAnimationsPresent, NoAnimationCallbacksPresent.

nodes.name: JSValue
nodes.summary: Enum of JavaScript value types: Undefined, Null, Boolean, Number, String, Element, ShadowRoot, Frame, Window, Array, Object.

nodes.name: JavaScriptErrorInfo
nodes.summary: Struct for JavaScript error details: message, filename, stack trace, line number, column.

nodes.name: JavaScriptEvaluationResultSerializationError
nodes.summary: Enum of JS value serialization errors: DetachedShadowRoot, StaleElementReference, UnknownType, OtherJavaScriptError.

nodes.name: JavaScriptEvaluationError
nodes.summary: Enum of JS evaluation errors: DocumentNotFound, CompilationFailure, EvaluationFailure, InternalError, WebViewNotReady, SerializationError.

nodes.name: ScreenshotCaptureError
nodes.summary: Enum of screenshot capture errors: CouldNotReadImage, WebViewDoesNotExist.

nodes.name: RgbColor
nodes.summary: Struct for an RGB color with red, green, blue components for compositor background color.

nodes.name: ScriptToEmbedderChan
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around a GenericCallback sender for script-to-embedder IPC.

nodes.name: NewWebViewDetails
nodes.summary: Struct for newly created webview details: webview_id, viewport_details, user_content_manager_id.

nodes.name: UrlRequest
nodes.summary: Struct for a URL navigation request with destination URL and optional headers.

nodes.name: WakeLockType
nodes.summary: Enum of wake lock types (currently only Screen).

nodes.name: WakeLockDelegate
nodes.summary: Trait for the wake lock delegate with acquire() and release() methods.

nodes.name: as_device_point
nodes.summary: Converts a WebViewPoint to DevicePoint by applying a scale factor.

nodes.name: as_device_rect
nodes.summary: Converts a WebViewRect to DeviceRect by applying a scale factor.

nodes.name: as_device_vector
nodes.summary: Converts a WebViewVector to DeviceVector by applying a scale factor.

nodes.name: from_id
nodes.summary: Constructs an UntrustedNodeAddress from a raw usize id.

nodes.name: send
nodes.summary: Sends a message through the GenericEmbedderProxy sender channel and wakes the event loop.

nodes.name: resources.rs
nodes.summary: Manages bundled static resources (bluetooth blocklist, HSTS preload, error pages, debugger JS, etc.) with a Resource enum and a ResourceReaderMethods trait for platform-specific resource I/O.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a Resource enum to enumerate bundled assets and a ResourceReaderMethods trait to abstract platform I/O for sandboxed access.

nodes.name: Resource
nodes.summary: Enum of bundled static resources: BluetoothBlocklist, DomainList, HstsPreloadList, BadCertHTML, NetErrorHTML, BrokenImageIcon, CrashHTML, DirectoryListingHTML, AboutMemoryHTML, DebuggerJS, JsonViewerHTML.

nodes.name: ResourceReaderMethods
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting platform-specific resource I/O with read(), sandbox_access_files(), and sandbox_access_files_dirs().

nodes.name: read_bytes
nodes.summary: Reads raw bytes for a Resource via the global RESOURCE_READER.

nodes.name: read_string
nodes.summary: Reads a Resource as a UTF-8 string by delegating to read_bytes.

nodes.name: sandbox_access_files
nodes.summary: Grants sandbox file access for a Resource via the global RESOURCE_READER.

nodes.name: sandbox_access_files_dirs
nodes.summary: Grants sandbox directory access for a Resource via the global RESOURCE_READER.

nodes.name: filename
nodes.summary: Returns the filesystem path for a Resource variant, mapping each enum variant to its bundled file.

nodes.name: user_contents.rs
nodes.summary: Defines types for user content management: user scripts and user stylesheets with unique IDs, content sources, and MallocSizeOf support for memory tracking.

nodes.name: UserContentManagerId
nodes.summary: Newtype identifier for a user content manager, generated from an atomic counter.

nodes.name: UserContents
nodes.summary: Struct holding collections of user scripts and user stylesheets.

nodes.name: UserStyleSheetId
nodes.summary: Newtype identifier for a user stylesheet, generated from an atomic counter.

nodes.name: UserStyleSheet
nodes.summary: Struct representing a user-injected stylesheet with id, source text, and optional URL.

nodes.name: UserScriptId
nodes.summary: Newtype identifier for a user script, generated from an atomic counter.

nodes.name: UserScript
nodes.summary: Struct representing a user-injected script with id, script text, source file path, and MallocSizeOf support.

nodes.name: size_of
nodes.summary: Computes the memory allocation size of a UserScript for MallocSizeOf, including path buffers.

nodes.name: webdriver.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the WebDriver protocol command and response types: WebDriverCommandMsg (27 variants), WebDriverScriptCommand (40+ variants), user prompts, frame IDs, and load status tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: Enumerates 27 top-level WebDriver commands and 40+ script-level commands as enum variants, providing the type-safe contract between the WebDriver server and the embedder.

nodes.name: WebDriverUserPrompt
nodes.summary: Enum of WebDriver user prompt types: Alert, BeforeUnload, Confirm, Default, File, Prompt, FallbackDefault.

nodes.name: WebDriverUserPromptAction
nodes.summary: Enum of WebDriver user prompt actions: Accept, Dismiss, Ignore.

nodes.name: CustomHandlersAutomationMode
nodes.summary: Enum of custom protocol handler automation modes: AutoAccept, AutoReject, None.

nodes.name: NewWindowTypeHint
nodes.summary: Enum of new window type hints for WebDriver: Auto, Tab, Window.

nodes.name: WebDriverCommandMsg
nodes.summary: Central enum of 27 WebDriver commands covering window/viewport geometry, navigation, script execution, input events, screenshot, new/close/focus webviews, user prompts, browsing context, shutdown, and cookie management.

nodes.name: WebDriverScriptCommand
nodes.summary: Enum of 40+ script-level WebDriver commands: cookies, element operations (clear/click/rect/css/attribute/property/text/tag/role), find elements (CSS/link/tag/XPath), shadow root, execute script, frame/window management, page source, title, send keys, load status, protocol handler automation.

nodes.name: WebDriverFrameId
nodes.summary: Enum for WebDriver frame identifiers: Short (numeric) or Element (by reference).

nodes.name: WebDriverLoadStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of WebDriver page load status states: NavigationStart, NavigationStop, Complete, Timeout, Blocked.

nodes.name: WebDriverSenders
nodes.summary: Struct holding WebDriver senders: load status senders, script evaluation interrupt sender, pending traversals.

nodes.name: new_from_str
nodes.summary: Parses a WebDriverUserPrompt from a string by matching against known prompt type names.

nodes.name: layout_damage.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the LayoutDamage bitflags type with conversions from RestyleDamage, used to track which layout modes need recalculation.

nodes.name: LayoutDamage
nodes.summary: Bitflags representing individual layout actions needed after restyling, extending RestyleDamage with layout-specific flags like recomputing inline content sizes and box damage propagation.

nodes.name: AccessibilityDamage
nodes.summary: Bitflags tracking accessibility tree invalidation states including text, children, subtree, and full rebuild damage levels.

nodes.name: only_layout_modes
nodes.summary: Filters LayoutDamage to only the layout-mode bits (the lower 4 bits inherited from RestyleDamage), masking out layout-specific flags.

nodes.name: layout_dom.rs
nodes.summary: Defines LayoutDomTypeBundle, a type bundle struct carrying DOM element and node types for the layout system.

nodes.name: LayoutDomTypeBundle
nodes.summary: Trait bundling all concrete layout DOM type implementations (LayoutNode, LayoutElement, DangerousStyleNode, DangerousStyleElement) into a single parameterizable type for the Layout trait.

nodes.name: layout_element.rs
nodes.summary: Provides LayoutElement, the core trait for element-level layout queries including style data access, DOM metadata retrieval, pseudo-element chain handling, and element type interrogation.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust trait with 18 methods providing a comprehensive element-level API for layout operations.

nodes.name: LayoutElement
nodes.summary: Trait exposing element-level layout information: style data, DOM metadata, type ID, attributes, pseudo-element chain, shadow host detection, and root element checks. Used for layout calculations on individual elements.

nodes.name: DangerousStyleElement
nodes.summary: Extension of LayoutElement that allows parent node access for stylo and selectors. Marked unsafe because parent access can cause race conditions when layout worker threads are running.

nodes.name: layout_node.rs
nodes.summary: Provides LayoutNode, the primary trait for node-level layout operations: tree traversal, style resolution, text content, media/image/canvas/SVG data retrieval, table span queries, and input detection.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust trait with 35 methods covering layout tree navigation, content-specific data queries, and widget detection.

nodes.name: LayoutNode
nodes.summary: Trait providing node-level layout operations: flat tree and DOM child traversal, style resolution, text content, media/image/canvas/SVG data retrieval, table span queries, input detection, and layout data initialization.

nodes.name: DangerousStyleNode
nodes.summary: Extension of LayoutNode allowing parent node access for stylo and selectors. Marked as unsafe because parent access during parallel layout can cause data races.

nodes.name: pseudo_element_chain.rs
nodes.summary: Defines PseudoElementChain, a struct tracking primary and secondary pseudo-element types for CSS generated content (::before, ::after) in the layout tree.

nodes.name: PseudoElementChain
nodes.summary: Struct tracking primary and optional secondary pseudo-element types for CSS generated content (::before, ::after), with methods to query innermost, nest/unnest pseudo-elements, remove the innermost, and check emptiness.

nodes.name: unnested
nodes.summary: Creates a single-level PseudoElementChain with only a primary pseudo-element and no secondary.

nodes.name: innermost
nodes.summary: Returns the innermost (deepest) pseudo-element in the chain: the secondary if present, otherwise the primary.

nodes.name: with_pseudo
nodes.summary: Returns a new PseudoElementChain with an additional pseudo-element nested into the chain, handling ::before/::after nesting rules for CSS generated content.

nodes.name: without_innermost
nodes.summary: Returns a chain with the innermost pseudo-element removed. If secondary exists, returns only the primary; if only primary, returns an empty chain.

nodes.name: is_empty
nodes.summary: Returns true if the chain has no pseudo-elements (primary is None), meaning it represents the element itself.

nodes.name: generic_callback.rs
nodes.summary: Defines a generic profiled callback wrapper that instruments callback sends with time profiling via the time_profile macro.

nodes.name: GenericCallback
nodes.summary: A generic wrapper around servo_base's GenericCallback that adds time profiling instrumentation to every send operation.

nodes.name: generic_channel.rs
nodes.summary: Provides a profiled GenericReceiver wrapper and a channel factory function that instruments message reception with time profiling.

nodes.name: GenericReceiver
nodes.summary: A wrapper around generic_channel::GenericReceiver that adds time profiling to recv operations while exposing try_recv and into_inner for unprofiled access.

nodes.name: channel
nodes.summary: Creates a profiled generic channel pair, wrapping the receiver side with GenericReceiver for automatic time profiling on message receipt.

nodes.name: ipc.rs
nodes.summary: Provides profiled IPC receiver wrappers and channel factory functions that add time profiling instrumentation to IPC message and byte reception.

nodes.name: IpcReceiver
nodes.summary: A wrapper around ipc_channel::IpcReceiver that instruments recv calls with time profiling while exposing try_recv and to_ipc_receiver for unprofiled access.

nodes.name: channel
nodes.summary: Creates a profiled IPC channel pair, wrapping the receiver side with IpcReceiver for automatic time profiling on message receipt.

nodes.name: IpcBytesReceiver
nodes.summary: A wrapper around ipc_channel::IpcBytesReceiver that instruments raw byte recv calls with time profiling.

nodes.name: bytes_channel
nodes.summary: Creates a profiled IPC bytes channel pair, wrapping the receiver side with IpcBytesReceiver for automatic time profiling on byte receipt.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the shared profiling module. Declares sub-modules, defines the central time_profile macro, tracing span/event macros, and provides dummy tracing types for builds without tracing support.

nodes.name: mem.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the memory profiling subsystem including the OpaqueSender abstraction, ProfilerChan front-end, reporter registration with auto-unregister on drop, report data structures, and the ProfilerMsg protocol enum.

nodes.name: OpaqueSender
nodes.summary: A trait abstracting over different message sender types (crossbeam Sender, IpcSender, GenericSender) used by the memory profiler to communicate with target threads.

nodes.name: ProfilerChan
nodes.summary: Front-end handle for communicating with the memory profiler thread. Wraps a GenericSender<ProfilerMsg> and provides send, reporter registration, and scoped memory reporting methods.

nodes.name: ProfilerRegistration
nodes.summary: An RAII handle that registers a memory reporter on creation and automatically unregisters it on drop, ensuring cleanup when the registration goes out of scope.

nodes.name: ReportKind
nodes.summary: Enumerates the categories of memory measurement including jemalloc heap, system heap, non-heap, unknown-location, and non-explicit sizes.

nodes.name: ProcessReports
nodes.summary: A collection of memory reports for a specific process, identified by PID. Provides a constructor that auto-populates the current process ID.

nodes.name: ReportsChan
nodes.summary: A channel wrapper for sending ProcessReports to the memory profiler. Panics on send failure to ensure memory reporting data is never silently lost.

nodes.name: Reporter
nodes.summary: A memory reporter encapsulating a GenericCallback that receives ReporterRequest messages and collects memory reports on demand.

nodes.name: ProfilerMsg
nodes.summary: The message protocol enum for the memory profiler thread, supporting reporter registration, unregistration, memory report requests, and shutdown.

nodes.name: perform_memory_report
nodes.summary: Initializes memory profiling tools with seen-pointer deduplication and invokes a user-provided closure to collect MallocSizeOf measurements, then cleans up thread-local state.

nodes.name: time.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the time profiling subsystem including ProfilerCategory enum, ProfilerChan front-end, ProfilerMsg protocol, timing metadata types, and the core profile/send_profile_data functions.

nodes.name: TimerMetadata
nodes.summary: Metadata associated with profiler timing events, including the URL being processed, whether it is in an iframe, and whether this is an incremental or first reflow.

nodes.name: ProfilerChan
nodes.summary: Front-end handle for communicating with the time profiler thread. Wraps an optional GenericSender<ProfilerMsg> and gracefully handles missing senders.

nodes.name: ProfilerData
nodes.summary: Enum representing profiler data responses: either no records available or a vector of recorded durations.

nodes.name: ProfilerMsg
nodes.summary: The message protocol enum for the time profiler thread, supporting time reports, data queries, print commands, blocked layout query logging, and shutdown.

nodes.name: ProfilerCategory
nodes.summary: A comprehensive enum of profiler event categories covering painting, layout, script execution, parsing, networking, IPC, and web performance metrics, each with a unique hex code for efficient wire representation.

nodes.name: TimerMetadataFrameType
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing whether profiler timing data originates from the root window or an iframe.

nodes.name: TimerMetadataReflowType
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing between incremental reflows and the initial first reflow for profiler timing attribution.

nodes.name: profile
nodes.summary: Core profiling function that measures execution time of a callback using CrossProcessInstant, optionally enters a tracing span, and sends timing data to the profiler channel.

nodes.name: send_profile_data
nodes.summary: Sends a ProfilerMsg::Time message to the profiler channel containing the category, metadata, and start/end CrossProcessInstant timestamps.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the WebGL component that declares submodules and re-exports the WebGLComm type from webgl_mode.

nodes.name: webgl_limits.rs
nodes.summary: Defines GL limits detection logic that queries the GPU driver for capabilities like max texture size, varying components, and draw buffers to populate WebGL limit structures.

nodes.name: inprocess.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the in-process WebGL communication channel (WebGLComm) that spawns WebGL threads and manages swap chains, context busy maps, and WebXR layer grand managers.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module index for webgl_mode that declares the inprocess submodule and re-exports WebGLComm.

nodes.name: webgl_thread.rs
nodes.summary: Core WebGL thread implementation that manages GL contexts, processes WebGL commands, handles swap buffers, creates/destroys contexts, and integrates with WebRender for compositing â€” by far the largest and most complex file in the component at over 3300 lines.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses glow for OpenGL bindings, surfman for cross-platform surface management, and webrender for compositing. Contains a 1466-line WebGLImpl::apply method that dispatches every WebGL command via a massive match statement.

nodes.name: webxr.rs
nodes.summary: Bridge between WebGL and WebXR (VR/AR) that manages XR layer factories, layer managers, and frame lifecycle â€” creating, destroying, and synchronizing XR layers with GL contexts.

nodes.name: GLLimitsDetect
nodes.summary: Trait providing the detect method that queries GPU driver parameters via GL calls to populate a GLLimits structure with hardware capabilities.

nodes.name: detect
nodes.summary: Queries the GL driver for hardware limits â€” max texture size, varying vectors, draw buffers, element index, uniform buffers, MSAA samples, and many others â€” returning a populated GLLimits struct for a given WebGL version.

nodes.name: try_gl_parameter
nodes.summary: Generic helper that safely queries a single GL parameter, checks for GL errors, and returns the result as an Option of the requested numeric type.

nodes.name: WebGLComm
nodes.summary: Struct that owns the in-process WebGL communication infrastructure â€” thread handles, swap chains, context busy maps, and the WebXR layer grand manager.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a WebGLComm by creating an IPC channel, swap chains, context busy map, and spawning a WebGLThread on its own dedicated thread, optionally initializing WebXR support.

nodes.name: GLContextData
nodes.summary: Holds the surfman device, GL context, glow GL handle, GL state tracker, and context attributes for a single active WebGL context.

nodes.name: GLState
nodes.summary: Tracks mutable GL state (color write mask, clear color, scissor, stencil, depth settings, default VAO) and provides invariant restoration methods to ensure WebGL contexts start in a clean state before user code runs.

nodes.name: WebGLThread
nodes.summary: The central WebGL thread struct that owns all device maps, GL contexts, cached context info, IPC channels, swap chains, and the WebXR bridge â€” orchestrating all WebGL operations on a dedicated thread.

nodes.name: WebGLThreadInit
nodes.summary: Initialization parameters for a WebGLThread including the paint API handle, external image ID manager, IPC sender/receiver, swap chains, surfman details map, busy context map, and optional WebXR init.

nodes.name: WebGLImpl
nodes.summary: A zero-sized struct acting as the namespace for WebGL command execution â€” its apply method contains the massive match statement that dispatches every WebGL command to the appropriate GL call.

nodes.name: FramebufferRebindingInfo
nodes.summary: Captures the current framebuffer binding state (flags and viewport) via detect, and restores it via apply â€” used during swap chain resize and buffer swap operations.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a WebGLThread from initialization parameters, setting up device maps, context storage, IPC channel routing, and conditionally initializing the WebXR bridge.

nodes.name: default
nodes.summary: Creates a default GLState with WebGL 1.0 defaults â€” all color channels enabled, scissor disabled, depth and stencil tests disabled, and clear values zeroed.

nodes.name: restore_depth_invariant
nodes.summary: Restores the depth buffer state invariant for WebGL contexts â€” re-applies the stored depth write mask and enables/disables depth test as originally configured.

nodes.name: restore_stencil_invariant
nodes.summary: Restores the stencil buffer state invariant â€” re-applies stencil masks for front and back faces and enables/disables stencil test as originally configured.

nodes.name: ensure_point_sprite_and_program_point_size_enabled
nodes.summary: Enables GL_POINT_SPRITE and GL_PROGRAM_POINT_SIZE on desktop GL contexts where needed for WebGL compatibility, silently ignoring errors on ES contexts.

nodes.name: handle_msg
nodes.summary: Main message dispatcher for the WebGL thread's event loop â€” routes incoming WebGLMsg variants to the appropriate handler for context creation, resize, removal, commands, swap buffers, and WebXR operations.

nodes.name: get_or_create_device_for_painter
nodes.summary: Retrieves or creates a surfman device for a given painter ID, using the painter's surfman connection details and caching the device in a map.

nodes.name: handle_webxr_command
nodes.summary: Routes WebXR commands (create/destroy layer managers, create/destroy layers, begin/end frame) to the WebXR bridge for XR layer lifecycle management.

nodes.name: handle_webgl_command
nodes.summary: Makes the requested context current and delegates WebGL command execution to WebGLImpl::apply, invalidating cached context info when the command may affect it.

nodes.name: create_webgl_context
nodes.summary: Orchestrates full WebGL context creation â€” selecting GL API type, creating surfman context/surface, setting up glow bindings, clamping viewport, detecting hardware limits, resizing the swap chain, and initializing default state.

nodes.name: resize_webgl_context
nodes.summary: Resizes a WebGL context's backing surface and swap chain, re-clamps the viewport, captures and restores framebuffer bindings, and updates the WebRender image for composition.

nodes.name: remove_webgl_context
nodes.summary: Gracefully tears down a WebGL context â€” handles busy-state synchronization with WebRender, destroys all XR layers, deletes the paint image, destroys the swap chain, and destroys the surfman context.

nodes.name: handle_swap_buffers
nodes.summary: Handles buffer swapping for one or more WebGL contexts in a canvas epoch â€” makes contexts current, captures framebuffer state, swaps surfman buffers, clears surfaces if drawing buffer is not preserved, and updates WebRender images.

nodes.name: make_current_if_needed
nodes.summary: Makes a WebGL context current on its device if it is not already the bound context, returning an immutable reference to the context data.

nodes.name: make_current_if_needed_mut
nodes.summary: Mutable variant of make_current_if_needed that returns a mutable reference for command execution that modifies GL state.

nodes.name: update_webrender_image_for_context
nodes.summary: Updates the WebRender external image for a context after rendering â€” generates new external image data and pushes it to the paint API for compositing.

nodes.name: WebGLImpl::apply
nodes.summary: Massive 1466-line WebGL command dispatcher â€” a giant match statement that translates every WebGLCommand variant (buffer ops, texture ops, shader ops, uniform setting, draw calls, etc.) into the corresponding glow/GL API calls on the current context.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains one of the largest match arms in the Servo codebase, dispatching hundreds of WebGL command variants to glow GL calls.

nodes.name: initialize_framebuffer
nodes.summary: Initializes a WebGL framebuffer by binding the default framebuffer and attaching optional color, depth, and stencil renderbuffers with appropriate internal formats.

nodes.name: link_program
nodes.summary: Links a WebGL shader program and collects detailed link information â€” active attributes, uniforms, uniform blocks, and transform feedback varyings â€” returning a comprehensive ProgramLinkInfo structure.

nodes.name: bind_framebuffer
nodes.summary: Binds a WebGL framebuffer attachment request â€” handles Default, Explicit, and SwapChain binding cases with proper framebuffer, renderbuffer, and texture attachment setup.

nodes.name: prepare_pixels
nodes.summary: Prepares raw pixel data for texture upload â€” handles alpha premultiplication/unmultiplication, Y-axis flipping, pixel format conversion, and unpacking alignment according to WebGL spec requirements.

nodes.name: image_to_tex_image_data
nodes.summary: Converts raw image data (from HTMLImageElement, ImageBitmap, etc.) into texImage2D-compatible pixel data â€” handles format conversion, premultiplication, and type casting for all supported DOM image source types and WebGL texture formats.
nodes.languageNotes: Supports conversion from multiple DOM image source formats (RGBA8, BGRA8, RGB8, etc.) into WebGL texture data types, with careful handling of alpha premultiplication and byte ordering.

nodes.name: premultiply_inplace
nodes.summary: Applies alpha premultiplication to pixel data in-place using native-endian byte operations, supporting multiple data types (u8, u16, f16, f32) and both RGBA and BGRA pixel formats.

nodes.name: flip_pixels_y
nodes.summary: Flips pixel rows vertically (Y-axis inversion) with proper unpacking alignment stride calculation, used for WebGL's UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL pixel storage parameter.

nodes.name: clamp_viewport
nodes.summary: Clamps a WebGL context's viewport and scissor rectangle to safe maximum dimensions, preventing oversized viewports that could cause rendering artifacts.

nodes.name: FramebufferRebindingInfo::detect
nodes.summary: Captures the current GL framebuffer binding state â€” framebuffer flags and viewport dimensions â€” before a surfman operation that may disrupt bindings.

nodes.name: FramebufferRebindingInfo::apply
nodes.summary: Restores framebuffer bindings, viewport, scissor, and clear color after a surfman operation â€” re-binds the default framebuffer and re-applies the captured state.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge
nodes.summary: Bridge struct that owns WebXR layer manager factories and active managers â€” coordinates XR layer creation, destruction, and frame lifecycle across WebGL contexts.

nodes.name: WebXRBridgeInit
nodes.summary: Initialization handle for the WebXR bridge that provides IPC channels for communicating with the WebGL thread and can spawn a layer grand manager.

nodes.name: WebXRBridgeGrandManager
nodes.summary: Top-level manager that creates WebXR layer managers by sending factory messages to the WebGL thread and receiving layer manager instances via IPC.

nodes.name: WebXRBridgeManager
nodes.summary: Per-context WebXR layer manager that sends layer lifecycle commands (create, destroy, begin frame, end frame) to the WebGL thread and tracks active layers.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a WebXRBridge from initialization data, extracting the factory receiver and setting up the manager map with a starting ID.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge::create_layer_manager
nodes.summary: Receives a layer manager factory from the channel, builds the manager, assigns it a unique ID, and stores it in the bridge's manager map.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge::create_layer
nodes.summary: Delegates layer creation to the appropriate manager, passing GL contexts and context ID so the XR layer can be associated with a specific WebGL context.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge::destroy_layer
nodes.summary: Looks up the manager and delegates destruction of a specific XR layer by its layer ID.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge::destroy_all_layers
nodes.summary: Iterates all active managers and destroys every layer associated with a given WebGL context, used during context teardown.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge::begin_frame
nodes.summary: Begins an XR frame for a given layer manager, passing the set of active layers to prepare for rendering.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge::end_frame
nodes.summary: Ends an XR frame for a given layer manager, completing the rendering cycle for the active layers.

nodes.name: WebXRBridgeGrandManager::create_layer_manager
nodes.summary: Sends a CreateLayerManager command to the WebGL thread via IPC, receives the constructed layer manager back, and wraps it as a WebXRBridgeManager.

nodes.name: WebXRBridgeManager::create_layer
nodes.summary: Sends a CreateLayer command with initialization data to the WebGL thread, receives the layer ID back, and tracks the new layer.

nodes.name: WebXRBridgeManager::destroy_layer
nodes.summary: Removes a layer from tracking and sends a DestroyLayer command to the WebGL thread for cleanup.

nodes.name: WebXRBridgeManager::begin_frame
nodes.summary: Sends a BeginFrame command to the WebGL thread with the current layer list and waits for acknowledgment.

nodes.name: WebXRBridgeManager::end_frame
nodes.summary: Sends an EndFrame command to the WebGL thread with the current layer list and waits for acknowledgment.

nodes.name: audio.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the AudioRenderer trait for rendering audio samples with a callback-based interface accepting raw float sample data and channel count.

nodes.name: context.rs
nodes.summary: Defines PlayerGLContext trait and supporting OpenGL context enums (GlContext, NativeDisplay, GlApi) for passing platform-specific GL rendering handles to the media player.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the servo-media player module. Declares sub-modules and defines core player types: Player trait, PlayerEvent enum, PlayerError enum, PlaybackState, StreamType, and SeekLock for coordinating seek operations.

nodes.name: metadata.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Metadata struct carrying media stream properties such as duration, dimensions, format, track lists, and seekability flags.

nodes.name: video.rs
nodes.summary: Defines video frame types: VideoFrame struct wrapping raw or OpenGL texture data, VideoFrameData enum for frame representations, Buffer trait for frame data sources, and VideoFrameRenderer trait for consuming rendered frames.

nodes.name: AudioRenderer
nodes.summary: Trait for audio rendering backends. Implementors receive boxed float sample buffers and render them to the audio output for a given channel.

nodes.name: GlContext
nodes.summary: Enum wrapping platform-specific GL context handles as opaque pointers (Egl for EGL, Glx for GLX, or Unknown).

nodes.name: NativeDisplay
nodes.summary: Enum wrapping native display connection pointers across window systems: EGLDisplay, X11 Display, Wayland wl_display, headless, or unknown.

nodes.name: GlApi
nodes.summary: Enum identifying the GL rendering API in use: OpenGL, OpenGL3, Gles1, Gles2, or None.

nodes.name: PlayerGLContext
nodes.summary: Trait that the client application must implement to provide the media player with GL context, native display, and GL API information for GPU-accelerated rendering.

nodes.name: PlaybackState
nodes.summary: Enum representing the four possible player states: Stopped, Buffering, Paused, and Playing.

nodes.name: PlayerError
nodes.summary: Enum of all error conditions the player can encounter: backend errors, buffer push failures, EOS failures, seek errors, stream/track setting failures, and overflow protection.

nodes.name: SeekLock
nodes.summary: Struct holding an IPC channel sender used to synchronize seek operations between the player backend and the client, released via the unlock method.

nodes.name: PlayerEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of all player-to-client events: end-of-stream, buffering states (EnoughData/NeedData), errors, video frame updates, metadata and duration changes, position/seek callbacks, and state transitions.

nodes.name: StreamType
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing between live streams (non-seekable) and seekable media streams.

nodes.name: Player
nodes.summary: Core trait defining the complete media player interface: playback control (play/pause/stop/seek), volume and mute, data pushing, stream binding, GL rendering support, and audio/video track selection. Implementors must also satisfy MediaInstance.

nodes.name: Metadata
nodes.summary: Struct holding media stream metadata: duration, dimensions (width/height), format string, seekability, video and audio track lists, live-source flag, and an optional title.

nodes.name: VideoFrameData
nodes.summary: Enum wrapping video frame pixel data in one of three forms: raw RGBA bytes (Raw), a standard GL texture ID (Texture), or an OES external texture ID (OESTexture).

nodes.name: Buffer
nodes.summary: Trait for buffer objects that can produce VideoFrameData. Must be Send + Sync for cross-thread usage. The single to_vec method extracts frame data.

nodes.name: VideoFrame
nodes.summary: Struct representing a decoded video frame with width, height, and pixel data (raw or GL texture). Provides accessors for dimensions, raw data extraction, texture ID retrieval, and texture type queries.

nodes.name: VideoFrameRenderer
nodes.summary: Trait for video frame rendering backends. Implementors receive VideoFrame objects and render them to a display surface. Must be Send + 'static.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root that declares the four public submodules of the profile component: mem, system_reporter, time, and trace_dump, with unsafe_code denied except on Windows for the system reporter.

nodes.name: mem.rs
nodes.summary: Provides the memory profiler that spawns a dedicated thread to collect memory reports from registered reporters via a message channel, supporting dynamic registration, periodic reporting, and untracked allocation logging.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a message-passing architecture with GenericReceiver/ProfilerChan pattern; spawns a 'MemoryProfiler' thread on creation.

nodes.name: Profiler
nodes.summary: Memory profiler holding a message port and a registry of named Reporter callbacks; runs an event loop dispatching RegisterReporter, UnregisterReporter, Report, and Exit messages.

nodes.name: Profiler::create
nodes.summary: Factory method that spawns the MemoryProfiler thread, constructs a ProfilerChan, and pre-registers the system memory reporter callback; returns the channel for sending profiler messages.

nodes.name: Profiler::handle_msg
nodes.summary: Core message dispatcher that handles reporter registration/unregistration, triggers synchronous report collection from all reporters, optionally dumps untracked allocations to a log file, and handles shutdown via Exit.

nodes.name: Profiler::collect_reports
nodes.summary: Iterates over all registered reporters, invokes each to collect per-process reports, and aggregates results into a HashMap keyed by process ID.

nodes.name: system_reporter.rs
nodes.summary: Collects OS-level memory measurements (virtual size, resident, proportional set size, heap allocation) across Linux, macOS, and other platforms, reading from /proc filesystem or Mach APIs as appropriate.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavily platform-gated with #[cfg] attributes for Linux, macOS, and fallback paths; uses unsafe extern C FFI for mallinfo on Linux and Mach kernel APIs on macOS.

nodes.name: collect_reports
nodes.summary: Public entry point that gathers all OS-level memory statistics (vsize, resident, PSS, smaps segments, system heap info, custom allocator heap reports) and sends them as ProcessReports through the provided channel.

nodes.name: resident_segments
nodes.summary: Linux-specific function that parses /proc/self/smaps to extract per-segment resident memory usage, aggregating small segments under 512KB into an 'other' bucket and tracking anonymous vs named mappings.

nodes.name: proportional_set_size
nodes.summary: Linux-specific function that reads the proportional set size (PSS) from /proc/self/smaps_rollup by parsing the 'Pss:' line and converting from kB.

nodes.name: time.rs
nodes.summary: Provides the time profiler back-end that aggregates timing data into category buckets, computes statistical summaries (mean, median, min, max), and outputs reports to CSV files or stdout with optional periodic printing.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines a Formattable trait for TimerMetadata display; supports both CSV file output and periodic stdout output via a separate timer thread.

nodes.name: Profiler
nodes.summary: Time profiler that holds a message port, timing buckets keyed by category and metadata, an output configuration, optional trace dump, and a counter of blocked layout queries per URL.

nodes.name: Profiler::create
nodes.summary: Factory method that spawns the TimeProfiler thread and optionally a periodic timer thread for stdout output; supports CSV file output, stdout with a configurable period, and trace-dump-only modes.

nodes.name: Profiler::handle_msg
nodes.summary: Message dispatcher handling Time events (recording durations), Print triggers (outputting statistics), Get queries (retrieving bucket data), BlockedLayoutQuery tracking, and Exit with final printout.

nodes.name: Profiler::get_statistics
nodes.summary: Static method that computes the mean, median, minimum, and maximum Duration values from a sorted slice of timing data with debug assertions for sortedness and non-emptiness.

nodes.name: Profiler::print_buckets
nodes.summary: Outputs formatted profiling statistics: for CSV mode writes tab-separated category data with statistics per bucket; for stdout mode writes aligned column output; also dumps blocked layout query counts.

nodes.name: trace_dump.rs
nodes.summary: Writes time profiler traces as a self-contained HTML file using an RAII pattern: writes a prologue on creation, JSON trace entries as comma-delimited lines, and an epilogue with CSS/JS on drop.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses serde Serialize for JSON output; RAII pattern emits HTML prologue/epilogue via Drop impl; embeds static HTML/CSS/JS assets with include_str!.

nodes.name: TraceDump
nodes.summary: RAII wrapper around a file handle that writes the HTML trace dump prologue on creation and the epilogue (with embedded CSS and JS) on drop.

nodes.name: TraceDump::new
nodes.summary: Creates a new trace dump file at the given path and writes the HTML prologue (including embedded CSS) via write_prologue.

nodes.name: TraceDump::write_one
nodes.summary: Serializes a single profiler trace entry (category, metadata, start/end timestamps in nanoseconds since epoch) as a JSON object followed by a comma to the trace dump file.

nodes.name: svggraphicselement.rs
nodes.summary: Defines SVGGraphicsElement, the intermediate base class between SVGElement and concrete graphical SVG elements, providing a shared inheritance layer for shape and image elements.

nodes.name: svgimageelement.rs
nodes.summary: Implements SVGImageElement, the DOM class for the SVG <image> element, handling image resource fetching, attribute mutation, and plain attribute parsing for x, y, width, and height.

nodes.name: svgsvgelement.rs
nodes.summary: Implements SVGSVGElement, the DOM class for the root SVG <svg> element, providing subtree serialization to data URLs, <use> element processing, rasterization cache invalidation, and layout data retrieval.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a serialization-and-caching pipeline that clones the SVG subtree, resolves <use> elements, serializes to XML, and base64-encodes it as a data: URL for the rendering engine.

nodes.name: SVGGraphicsElement
nodes.summary: Intermediate base DOM class for graphical SVG elements (shapes, images, text), extending SVGElement via composition and providing a super_type that upcasts to SVGElement.

nodes.name: SVGImageElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for the SVG <image> element, extending SVGGraphicsElement and implementing image resource fetching, attribute mutation handling, and presentational hint delegation.

nodes.name: SVGSVGElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for the root SVG <svg> element, extending SVGGraphicsElement with UUID-based identity, cached serialized data URLs, and lifecycle hooks for children_changed and unbind_from_tree.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Constructor for SVGGraphicsElement that chains to new_inherited_with_state with an empty ElementState, initializing the SVGElement base fields.

nodes.name: new_inherited_with_state
nodes.summary: Constructor for SVGGraphicsElement with explicit ElementState, delegating to SVGElement::new_inherited_with_state to initialize the base SVG element fields.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public DOM constructor for SVGImageElement using reflect_node_with_proto, wiring up the JS reflector and boxing the native element.

nodes.name: attribute_mutated
nodes.summary: Handles DOM attribute mutations for the SVG image element, delegating to the super type and triggering image resource re-fetch when href or xlink:href attributes change.

nodes.name: attribute_affects_presentational_hints
nodes.summary: Determines whether a given attribute change on an SVGImageElement triggers presentational hint re-synthesis, checking width/height alongside the super-type check.

nodes.name: parse_plain_attribute
nodes.summary: Parses plain HTML attributes for SVGImageElement, handling x, y as u32 values and width, height via SVG unit parsing, delegating to the super type for unknown attributes.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Constructor for SVGSVGElement that initializes the graphics element base, generates a new UUID v4 for the element identity, and initializes an empty cached serialized data URL.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public DOM constructor for SVGSVGElement using reflect_node_with_proto, wiring up the JS reflector and boxing the native element.

nodes.name: serialize_and_cache_subtree
nodes.summary: Serializes the SVG subtree by cloning into a DocumentFragment, processing <use> elements to resolve references, XML-serializing the result, base64-encoding it, and caching it as a data: URL for the rendering engine.

nodes.name: process_single_use_element
nodes.summary: Resolves a single SVG <use> element by looking up the referenced element by ID via href, checking for cyclic references (referenced element must not be an ancestor of the <use> element), cloning the referenced subtree, and appending it to the root node.

nodes.name: invalidate_cached_serialized_subtree_and_rasterization_result
nodes.summary: Invalidates both the cached serialized data URL and any rasterized images derived from it, evicting from the image cache, layout cache, and marking the node dirty.

nodes.name: data
nodes.summary: Produces SVGSVGData for the layout engine, including computed width/height attributes and the cached serialized data URL, used by the rendering pipeline to rasterize the SVG.

nodes.name: attribute_mutated
nodes.summary: Handles attribute mutations for the SVG root element by delegating to the super type and invalidating the cached serialized subtree and rasterization results.

nodes.name: attribute_affects_presentational_hints
nodes.summary: Determines whether a given attribute change on the root SVG element triggers presentational hint re-synthesis, checking viewport attributes alongside the super-type check.

nodes.name: parse_plain_attribute
nodes.summary: Parses plain HTML attributes for SVGSVGElement, specifically handling width and height as CSS length-percentage values with quirky parsing support via cssparser, delegating to the super type for unknown attributes.

nodes.name: unbind_from_tree
nodes.summary: Virtual method called when the SVG root element is removed from the DOM tree, delegating to the super-type and invalidating the cached serialized subtree.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module file that declares the URL DOM submodules (url, urlhelper, urlpattern, urlsearchparams) and re-exports all public items from the url submodule.

nodes.name: url.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the WHATWG URL API DOM interface as a dom_struct with URL parsing, serialization, object URL creation/revocation, and all URL component property getters and setters delegating to UrlHelper.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the dom_struct procedural macro to generate DOM bindings; delegates URL component access to UrlHelper and ServoUrl/url crate quirks.

nodes.name: urlhelper.rs
nodes.summary: Provides a stateless UrlHelper struct with static getter and setter methods that delegate to the url::quirks module for URL component manipulation, serving as a common utility layer between DOM bindings and the URL parsing crate.

nodes.name: urlpattern.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the URLPattern API DOM interface per the URLPattern specification, supporting URL pattern matching with test and exec operations, plus bidirectional type conversion between DOM bindings and the third-party urlpattern crate.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains two private submodules (bindings_to_third_party, third_party_to_bindings) that bridge DOM WebIDL types and the urlpattern crate types via conversion functions.

nodes.name: urlsearchparams.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the URLSearchParams DOM interface for query string manipulation per the WHATWG URL specification, supporting append, delete, get, getAll, has, set, sort, and iteration over key-value pairs.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses DomRefCell<Vec<(String, String)>> for internal list storage and MutableWeakRef<URL> for bidirectional coupling with the URL object; implements the Iterable trait for JavaScript iteration.

nodes.name: URL
nodes.summary: The URL DOM interface dom_struct representing a parsed URL with a reflector, a ServoUrl cell, and an optional URLSearchParams reference, implementing all URL API methods per the WHATWG URL specification.

nodes.name: UrlHelper
nodes.summary: A stateless marker struct with static methods that bridge between the DOM URL bindings and the url::quirks module for reading and writing individual URL components.

nodes.name: URLPattern
nodes.summary: The URLPattern DOM interface dom_struct wrapping a urlpattern::UrlPattern for URL matching, supporting test and exec operations and exposing pattern component getters per the URLPattern specification.

nodes.name: URLSearchParams
nodes.summary: The URLSearchParams DOM interface dom_struct holding a list of key-value query pairs and a weak reference to the associated URL object, implementing query string CRUD operations per the WHATWG URL specification.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a new URL instance with the given ServoUrl, initializing the reflector and setting up an empty search_params slot.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new URL DOM object from a ServoUrl, wiring up the DOM reflector with the given JS context, global scope, and prototype.

nodes.name: query_pairs
nodes.summary: Extracts and returns all query string key-value pairs from the underlying ServoUrl as an owned vector of (String, String) tuples.

nodes.name: origin
nodes.summary: Returns the ImmutableOrigin of the underlying URL for blob URL origin resolution.

nodes.name: set_query_pairs
nodes.summary: Replaces the URL's query string with the given key-value pairs, clearing the query if the list is empty or extending the query pairs mutably.

nodes.name: unicode_serialization_blob_url
nodes.summary: Serializes a blob URL to its Unicode string representation, handling opaque vs. non-opaque origins by including the origin's ASCII serialization in the URL.

nodes.name: Constructor
nodes.summary: The WebIDL constructor for URL, parsing the input URL string with an optional base URL and returning a new DOM URL object or a TypeError on parse failure.

nodes.name: CanParse
nodes.summary: Static method that checks whether a given URL string (with optional base) can be successfully parsed without constructing a full DOM URL object.

nodes.name: Parse
nodes.summary: Static method that parses a URL string with optional base and returns a new DOM URL object or None if parsing fails, per the URL specification's parse steps.

nodes.name: CreateObjectURL
nodes.summary: Static method that creates a blob: URL for the given Blob object, using the global origin and generating a unique blob URL identifier.

nodes.name: RevokeObjectURL
nodes.summary: Static method that revokes a previously created blob URL by parsing it, extracting the blob identifier, and sending a RevokeBlobURL message to the file manager thread.

nodes.name: SetHref
nodes.summary: Sets the URL's href property by parsing the new value and updating the internal ServoUrl, synchronizing the associated URLSearchParams in the process.

nodes.name: SearchParams
nodes.summary: Lazily initializes and returns the URLSearchParams object associated with this URL, creating it on first access per the URL specification.

nodes.name: run_api_url_parser
nodes.summary: Standalone helper function implementing the API URL parser algorithm from the WHATWG URL specification, parsing a URL string with an optional base URL.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a new URLPattern instance wrapping the given urlpattern::UrlPattern.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Initializes a URLPattern DOM object by mapping DOM input types to the third-party crate, processing the pattern input, and parsing the URLPattern with optional options.

nodes.name: Constructor
nodes.summary: WebIDL constructor for URLPattern that parses input with an optional base URL and any provided options.

nodes.name: Constructor_
nodes.summary: Alternate WebIDL constructor for URLPattern that parses input with options only (no base URL parameter).

nodes.name: Test
nodes.summary: Tests whether a given input URL (with optional base) matches this URLPattern, returning a boolean or a TypeError on invalid input.

nodes.name: Exec
nodes.summary: Executes URL pattern matching against the given input, returning a structured URLPatternResult with matched component groups or None if no match.

nodes.name: HasRegExpGroups
nodes.summary: Returns whether the associated URL pattern uses regular expression groups in any of its components.

nodes.name: bindings_to_third_party::map_urlpatterninit
nodes.summary: Converts a DOM-generated URLPatternInit struct into the third-party urlpattern::quirks::UrlPatternInit by unwrapping USVString fields to plain strings.

nodes.name: bindings_to_third_party::map_urlpattern_input
nodes.summary: Maps a DOM USVStringOrURLPatternInit union type to the third-party StringOrInit enum by dispatching on the variant and converting accordingly.

nodes.name: third_party_to_bindings::map_component_result
nodes.summary: Converts a urlpattern::UrlPatternComponentResult to the DOM URLPatternComponentResult, including mapping optional group values to USVStringOrUndefined variants.

nodes.name: third_party_to_bindings::map_urlpatterninit
nodes.summary: Converts a third-party urlpattern::quirks::UrlPatternInit back to the DOM URLPatternInit by wrapping string fields in USVString.

nodes.name: third_party_to_bindings::map_urlpattern_result
nodes.summary: Converts a complete urlpattern::UrlPatternResult to the DOM URLPatternResult with all eight component results mapped and inputs reconstructed.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a new URLSearchParams instance, initializing the list from the URL's query pairs if a URL reference is provided, or as an empty list otherwise.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new URLSearchParams associated with the given URL, using a default prototype from the global scope.

nodes.name: new_with_proto
nodes.summary: Constructs a new URLSearchParams with an explicit prototype, wiring up the DOM reflector and creating the inherited data structure.

nodes.name: set_list
nodes.summary: Replaces the internal query parameter list with a new vector of key-value pairs.

nodes.name: Constructor
nodes.summary: WebIDL constructor for URLSearchParams that accepts a sequence of pairs, a record, or a string init value, parsing the query string via form_urlencoded when given a string.

nodes.name: GetAll
nodes.summary: Returns all values associated with the given query parameter name as a vector of USVString, filtering the internal list by key.

nodes.name: Set
nodes.summary: Sets a query parameter's value, removing all existing entries with the same name first, then appending the new pair, and triggering URL update steps.

nodes.name: Sort
nodes.summary: Sorts the query parameter list by key using UTF-16 code unit ordering per the URL specification, then triggers URL update steps.

nodes.name: serialize_utf8
nodes.summary: Serializes the internal query parameter list to a URL-encoded UTF-8 string using form_urlencoded::Serializer.

nodes.name: update_steps
nodes.summary: Performs the URL update steps by synchronizing the query parameter list back to the associated URL's query string, maintaining bidirectional consistency.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module declaring and re-exporting the four worklet submodules: paintsize, paintworkletglobalscope, worklet, and workletglobalscope.

nodes.name: paintsize.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the PaintSize DOM struct representing the concrete object size for CSS Paint API paint callbacks, with width and height properties.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dom_struct proc macro to generate DOM bindings boilerplate.

nodes.name: paintworkletglobalscope.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the PaintWorkletGlobalScope for the CSS Paint API, managing paint definitions, cached rendering results, and invoking user-registered paint callbacks with JS rendering contexts.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains unsafe JS API calls (Construct1, Call, NewArrayObject) and intricate caching logic with result memoization for paint image rendering.

nodes.name: worklet.rs
nodes.summary: Core Worklet implementation with a custom three-thread pool (primary, hot backup, cold backup) for responsive worklet execution, module loading, and paint task scheduling.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a custom lock-free role-swapping thread pool pattern using crossbeam channels and atomic swappers to ensure the primary worklet thread never blocks on GC or script loading.

nodes.name: workletglobalscope.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the base WorkletGlobalScope and its initialization context, dispatching worklet tasks to either Paint or Test worklet globals based on scope type.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Downcast trait for runtime type dispatch between PaintWorkletGlobalScope and TestWorkletGlobalScope variants.

nodes.name: PaintSize
nodes.summary: DOM struct holding the concrete object size (width and height as finite f64 values) passed to CSS Paint API paint callbacks.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a stack-allocated PaintSize from a CSS pixel Size2D, converting f32 dimensions to finite f64 values.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a heap-allocated, GC-traced PaintSize DOM object bound to a PaintWorkletGlobalScope.

nodes.name: PaintWorkletGlobalScope
nodes.summary: The global scope for CSS Paint API worklets, managing paint definitions, class instances, and cached rendering results with memoization based on name, size, device-pixel-ratio, properties, and arguments.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new PaintWorkletGlobalScope, initializing the worklet global base, image cache, paint definitions map, and cached rendering state with default values.

nodes.name: perform_a_worklet_task
nodes.summary: Dispatches PaintWorkletTask variants: DrawAPaintImage checks a 5-field cache before rendering, while SpeculativelyDrawAPaintImage pre-renders when cached state differs.

nodes.name: draw_a_paint_image
nodes.summary: Computes device-pixel dimensions from CSS pixel size and delegates to invoke_a_paint_callback for the actual JS paint callback invocation.
