nodes.name: invoke_a_paint_callback
nodes.summary: Core paint callback invoker: enters the JS realm, validates the paint definition, constructs or reuses a paint class instance, sets up the rendering context, creates a PaintSize, marshals CSSStyleValue arguments, and calls the user-defined paint function via the JS API.

nodes.name: invalid_image
nodes.summary: Returns a DrawAPaintImageResult with no image key, signaling an invalid or failed paint image to the caller.

nodes.name: painter
nodes.summary: Creates a boxed WorkletPainter implementing Painter and SpeculativePainter traits, wrapping a Mutex-guarded WorkletExecutor to schedule paint and speculative-paint tasks on the primary worklet thread.

nodes.name: RegisterPaint
nodes.summary: Registers a paint definition from a JS class constructor: validates the name uniqueness, extracts inputProperties/inputArguments/alpha, verifies the constructor and paint function, stores the PaintDefinition, and informs the script thread of the new paint worklet.

nodes.name: PaintWorkletTask
nodes.summary: Enum of tasks dispatchable to a paint worklet thread: DrawAPaintImage (with sender for result) and SpeculativelyDrawAPaintImage (fire-and-forget pre-rendering).

nodes.name: PaintDefinition
nodes.summary: Stores a registered paint definition: the JS class constructor, paint function, constructor validity flag, alpha flag, input argument count, and a recycled PaintRenderingContext2D.

nodes.name: PaintDefinition::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a boxed PaintDefinition with the provided JS class constructor, paint function, alpha flag, argument count, and rendering context, setting the constructor validity flag to true.

nodes.name: Worklet
nodes.summary: The Worklet DOM interface: binds a Window, a global scope type, and a droppable field containing the worklet ID and thread pool reference for lifecycle management.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a stack-allocated Worklet with a new UUID-based WorkletId and a OnceCell for lazy thread-pool initialization.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a heap-allocated, GC-traced Worklet DOM object bound to a Window.

nodes.name: AddModule
nodes.summary: Implements the Worklet.addModule() web API: resolves the module URL, creates a promise, lazily initializes the thread pool via the script thread, and dispatches fetch-and-invoke to all three worklet pool threads.

nodes.name: WorkletId
nodes.summary: A UUID-based unique identifier for worklet instances, used as a key for global scope lookups across threads.

nodes.name: PendingTasksStruct
nodes.summary: Atomic counter tracking pending worklet script loads across the three-thread pool; used to synchronize AddModule promise resolution once all threads complete.

nodes.name: WorkletThreadPool
nodes.summary: A three-thread worklet pool with role-based channels: three data senders (primary, hot backup, cold backup) and three per-thread control senders for script loading and lifecycle management.

nodes.name: WorkletThreadPool::spawn
nodes.summary: Spawns three WorkletThread instances with distinct roles (primary, hot backup, cold backup), creating channel pairs for data and control communication between the pool and each thread.

nodes.name: WorkletThreadPool::fetch_and_invoke_a_worklet_script
nodes.summary: Sends a FetchAndInvokeAWorkletScript control message to all three worklet threads, then wakes them; promise resolution is coordinated via the PendingTasksStruct atomic counter.

nodes.name: WorkletData
nodes.summary: Enum of fast-path data messages sent to worklet thread roles: Task, StartSwapRoles, FinishSwapRoles, WakeUp, and Quit.

nodes.name: WorkletControl
nodes.summary: Enum of slow-path control messages sent to specific worklet threads: ExitWorklet for cleanup and FetchAndInvokeAWorkletScript for script loading with all required parameters.

nodes.name: WorkletThread
nodes.summary: A single worklet execution thread holding its current role, control receiver, role senders, global scope map, a JS runtime, and GC threshold tracking.

nodes.name: WorkletThread::spawn
nodes.summary: Spawns a named OS thread, initializes the JS runtime and thread state (SCRIPT | IN_WORKER), creates a rooted WorkletThread, and enters the main event loop via run().

nodes.name: WorkletThread::run
nodes.summary: Main event loop: processes data messages (Task, role-swapping, WakeUp, Quit), delegates control messages to cold backup or initiates role swaps to become cold backup, and triggers GC when memory exceeds threshold.

nodes.name: WorkletThread::gc
nodes.summary: Performs a JS garbage collection cycle and dynamically adjusts the GC threshold to twice the current memory usage (minimum 1MB).

nodes.name: WorkletThread::get_worklet_global_scope
nodes.summary: Looks up or creates a WorkletGlobalScope for a given WorkletId, caching it in the thread-local global_scopes HashMap.

nodes.name: WorkletThread::fetch_and_invoke_a_worklet_script
nodes.summary: Fetches a worklet script via the resource fetcher, evaluates it in the worklet global scope, and coordinates promise resolution across the thread pool using the atomic PendingTasksStruct counter.

nodes.name: WorkletThread::process_control
nodes.summary: Processes a WorkletControl message: ExitWorklet removes the global scope, FetchAndInvokeAWorkletScript obtains or creates the global scope and delegates to fetch_and_invoke_a_worklet_script.

nodes.name: WorkletThread::run_in_script_thread
nodes.summary: Marshals a task box into a CommonScriptMsg and sends it to the main script thread via the WorkletEvent category on the DOMManipulation task source.

nodes.name: WorkletExecutor
nodes.summary: A cloneable handle for scheduling worklet tasks onto the primary thread of the worklet thread pool, wrapping a WorkletId and the primary sender channel.

nodes.name: WorkletGlobalScope
nodes.summary: Base global scope for worklets wrapping a GlobalScope, holding the base URL, script thread sender, worklet executor, pipeline ID, and origin.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Factory that creates the appropriate WorkletGlobalScope subtype (Paint or Test) based on WorkletGlobalScopeType, enters an auto realm, and defines all exposed web interfaces.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a stack-allocated WorkletGlobalScope, initializing the inner GlobalScope with all channel handles (devtools, profilers, constellation, embedder, resources, storage) and a new opaque origin.

nodes.name: evaluate_js
nodes.summary: Evaluates a JavaScript string in the worklet's global scope using the WORKLET introduction type, entering an auto realm first.

nodes.name: register_paint_worklet
nodes.summary: Sends a RegisterPaintWorklet message to the main script thread with the paint name, input properties, and a boxed Painter trait object for layout to invoke.

nodes.name: perform_a_worklet_task
nodes.summary: Dispatches a WorkletTask to the appropriate global scope subtype using Downcast: Paint tasks go to PaintWorkletGlobalScope, Test tasks to TestWorkletGlobalScope.

nodes.name: WorkletGlobalScopeInit
nodes.summary: Configuration bundle holding all channel handles (script thread, resource, storage, profilers, devtools, embedder, constellation) and the image cache needed to initialize a WorkletGlobalScope.

nodes.name: WorkletGlobalScopeType
nodes.summary: Enum discriminating paint worklets from test worklets, used to route WorkletGlobalScope::new to the correct subtype constructor.

nodes.name: WorkletTask
nodes.summary: Top-level enum for tasks dispatchable to any worklet global scope: Test (behind testbinding feature) and Paint variants.

nodes.name: from_script_message.rs
nodes.summary: Defines all message types sent from the ScriptThread to the Constellation, including service worker management, iframe loading, navigation history, message port routing, WebDriver commands, and structured data transfer messages. This is the primary inter-process communication catalog for script-to-constellation signaling.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the shared constellation types crate. Defines messages from the embedding layer to the Constellation (EmbedderToConstellationMessage), plus supporting types for traversal direction, window sizing, message port messaging, scroll state, paint metrics, and user content manager actions. Re-exports the from_script_message and structured_data submodules.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for structured data serialization and transfer used in postMessage and BroadcastChannel. Defines StructuredSerializedData, the central container holding serialized bytes and all transferred/serialized DOM objects (blobs, files, ports, images, crypto keys, etc.) with clone-for-broadcast support.

nodes.name: serializable.rs
nodes.summary: Implements serializable DOM objects for structured cloning per the HTML spec. Defines the BroadcastClone trait, Serializable enum covering File, Blob, DOMPoint, DOMRect, DOMQuad, DOMMatrix, DOMException, ImageBitmap, ImageData, and CryptoKey, along with their serializable representations and Web Crypto API key handle types (RSA, EC, AES, HMAC, ML-KEM, ML-DSA, ChaCha20-Poly1305, Argon2).

nodes.name: transferable.rs
nodes.summary: Implements transferable DOM objects for structured cloning per the HTML spec. Defines the Transferrable enum (ImageBitmap, MessagePort, OffscreenCanvas, ReadableStream, WritableStream, TransformStream), the MessagePortImpl struct implementing full port lifecycle (entangle, disentangle, transfer, start, close), and TransformStreamData for paired readable/writable streams.

nodes.name: ScriptToConstellationChan
nodes.summary: A Script-to-Constellation communication channel wrapping an IPC sender with webview and pipeline identifiers for message routing.

nodes.name: LoadData
nodes.summary: Encapsulates all data required to initiate a page load, including the load origin, URL, HTTP method/headers, request body, referrer policy, sandboxing flags, and security context inherited from the parent document.

nodes.name: NavigationHistoryBehavior
nodes.summary: Enum specifying whether a navigation should push a new entry, replace the current entry, or be handled automatically in the joint session history.

nodes.name: ScopeThings
nodes.summary: Holds scope-related context for service worker operations including the script URL, worker load origin, devtools channel, browsing context, and webview identifiers.

nodes.name: SWManagerSenders
nodes.summary: Aggregates IPC sender channels for the service worker manager, including resource threads, paint API, system font service, and its own sender/receiver pair.

nodes.name: ServiceWorkerMsg
nodes.summary: Messages to the service worker manager covering timeouts, DOM/worker message forwarding, algorithm handling, and exit requests.

nodes.name: ServiceWorkerAlgorithmResult
nodes.summary: Result type for service worker algorithm operations, carrying either a Job, a matched registration result, or a message from a worker.

nodes.name: Job
nodes.summary: Represents a service worker job with its type (register/unregister/update), scope URL, script URL, client referrer, and associated storage key. Supports equality comparison and factory construction.

nodes.name: ServiceWorkerRegistrationInfo
nodes.summary: Holds registration metadata for a service worker, including its ID, references to installing/waiting/active workers, storage key, and scope/script URLs.

nodes.name: IFrameLoadInfo
nodes.summary: Carries information for loading an iframe, including parent pipeline, browsing context, webview IDs, new pipeline ID, privacy mode, security context, history handling, and snapshot parameters.

nodes.name: IFrameLoadInfoWithData
nodes.summary: Extends IFrameLoadInfo with the actual LoadData, old pipeline ID for replacement, viewport details, and theme for the iframe's new document.

nodes.name: WorkerGlobalScopeInit
nodes.summary: Initialization parameters for a worker global scope, bundling IPC channels for resource threads, storage, memory/time profilers, devtools, constellation communication, webgl, and worker identity (ID, pipeline, origin, security context).

nodes.name: KeyboardScroll
nodes.summary: Enum of keyboard-initiated scroll directions including arrow keys (Up/Down/Left/Right), PageUp/PageDown, Home, and End.

nodes.name: ScriptToConstellationMessage
nodes.summary: Central message enum for all script-to-constellation communication with 40+ variants covering service worker algorithms, message port lifecycle (transfer, creation, routing, entanglement), broadcast channel routing, storage events, animation control, canvas paint threads, focus management, browsing context queries, page loads, history traversal, iframe management, WebDriver integration, media sessions, WebGPU, memory reporting, garbage collection, and wake locks.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a LoadData instance for initiating a page load with full origin, URL, method, headers, referrer, security context, and sandboxing parameters.

nodes.name: new_for_new_unrelated_webview
nodes.summary: Constructs a LoadData for navigating a newly created unrelated webview, with minimal configuration and empty sandboxing flags.

nodes.name: create_job
nodes.summary: Factory method that creates a new Job for service worker registration, unregistration, or update with the given scope, script, client, referrer, and storage key.

nodes.name: EmbedderToConstellationMessage
nodes.summary: Central message enum for all embedder-to-constellation communication with 30+ variants covering lifecycle (Exit, NewWebView, CloseWebView), navigation (LoadUrl, TraverseHistory, Reload, AllowNavigationResponse), rendering (TickAnimation, ChangeViewportDetails, ThemeChange, RefreshCursor), input (ForwardInputEvent), WebDriver, media sessions, profiling, fullscreen, memory reporting, paint metrics, JavaScript evaluation, preferences, accessibility, and user content manager actions.

nodes.name: UserContentManagerAction
nodes.summary: Actions for the user content manager: adding/destroying/removing user scripts and user style sheets.

nodes.name: MessagePortMsg
nodes.summary: Messages for the message port lifecycle covering transfer completion, pending transfer completion, disentanglement completion, and new task delivery.

nodes.name: ScrollStateUpdate
nodes.summary: Carries scroll state updates from the embedder, identifying the scrolled node and its offset vectors.

nodes.name: PortTransferInfo
nodes.summary: Holds transfer state for message ports, including the queued port messages and a flag indicating whether the port has been disentangled.

nodes.name: StructuredSerializedData
nodes.summary: Central container for structured serialized data per the HTML spec's StructuredSerializeWithTransfer algorithm. Holds SpiderMonkey-serialized bytes plus HashMap-based collections of blobs, files, file lists, DOM geometry types (points, rects, quads, matrices), exceptions, transferred ports, transform streams, image bitmaps, offscreen canvases, image data, and crypto keys. Supports emptiness checks and broadcast cloning.

nodes.name: is_empty
nodes.summary: Checks whether the StructuredSerializedData contains any transferred objects of a given Transferrable type, using a helper to test each optional HashMap field.

nodes.name: clone_all_of_type
nodes.summary: Generic helper that clones all values of a BroadcastClone-implementing type from one StructuredSerializedData instance into another, using the type's source/destination trait methods.

nodes.name: clone_for_broadcast
nodes.summary: Public entry point for broadcast channel data cloning. Iterates all transferable types to warn if any transferred objects are present (they should never appear in broadcast), clones the serialized bytes, then iterates all serializable types to clone their values into a new StructuredSerializedData.

nodes.name: BroadcastClone
nodes.summary: Trait for types that can be cloned for broadcast channel reuse. Requires an associated Id type and methods to clone for broadcast, extract source data from StructuredSerializedData, and set cloned data into the destination.

nodes.name: Serializable
nodes.summary: Enum of all DOM interfaces that can be serialized for structured cloning, covering File, FileList, Blob, DOMPoint/DOMPointReadOnly, DOMRect/DOMRectReadOnly, DOMQuad, DOMMatrix/DOMMatrixReadOnly, DOMException, QuotaExceededError, ImageBitmap, ImageData, and CryptoKey. Ordering matters: derived types come before parent types.

nodes.name: BroadcastChannelMsg
nodes.summary: A message sent through a broadcast channel, containing the origin of the sender, the channel name, and the structured-cloned data.

nodes.name: BlobImpl
nodes.summary: Enum representing a blob's backing data: in-memory bytes, a file on disk, or a slice of another blob. Provides constructors for each variant and accessors for blob ID, MIME type, and data.

nodes.name: SerializableCryptoKey
nodes.summary: Serializable representation of a Web Crypto API key, carrying key type (public/private/secret), extractability, algorithm details, usage flags, and the cryptographic handle (RSA, EC, AES, HMAC, ML-KEM, ML-DSA, ChaCha20-Poly1305, or Argon2).

nodes.name: SerializableCryptoKeyHandle
nodes.summary: Enum of all supported cryptographic key handle types for Web Crypto structured cloning, covering RSA (private/public), NIST P-256/P-384/P-521 EC keys, Ed25519/X25519, Ed448/X448, AES-128/192/256, HKDF secrets, PBKDF2, HMAC, ML-KEM (512/768/1024), ML-DSA (44/65/87), ChaCha20-Poly1305, and Argon2 passwords.

nodes.name: SerializableDigestAlgorithm
nodes.summary: Enum of serializable digest algorithms for Web Crypto: SHA (variants via SerializableAlgorithm), SHA-3, cSHAKE, TurboSHAKE, and KangarooTwelve with their configurable parameters.

nodes.name: SerializableKeyAlgorithmAndDerivatives
nodes.summary: Enum aggregating all key algorithm types for structured cloning: basic KeyAlgorithm, RSA with modulus/exponent, EC with named curve, AES with key length, and HMAC with hash function.

nodes.name: clone_values
nodes.summary: Dispatch method on the Serializable enum that returns a closure for cloning all values of the corresponding type between StructuredSerializedData instances. Each variant dispatches to the appropriate BroadcastClone::clone_all_of_type implementation.

nodes.name: new_from_bytes
nodes.summary: Constructs a BlobImpl from in-memory byte data, creating a new BlobId and wrapping the bytes in a BlobData::Memory variant.

nodes.name: new_from_file
nodes.summary: Constructs a BlobImpl backed by a file on disk, initializing a BlobData::File variant with a new BlobId and an empty RefCell cache for deferred reading.

nodes.name: new_sliced
nodes.summary: Constructs a BlobImpl representing a byte-range slice of a parent blob, storing the relative position range and parent BlobId in a BlobData::Sliced variant.

nodes.name: clone_for_broadcast
nodes.summary: Clones a BlobImpl for broadcast channel use. For in-memory blobs, clones the bytes; for file/sliced blobs, returns None since they cannot be broadcast. Handles the type_string and blob_id transfer.

nodes.name: Transferrable
nodes.summary: Enum of all DOM interfaces that can be transferred (not just serialized) in structured cloning: ImageBitmap, MessagePort, OffscreenCanvas, ReadableStream, WritableStream, and TransformStream.

nodes.name: MessagePortImpl
nodes.summary: The data and logic backing a DOM MessagePort, managing port state (Detached/Enabled/Disabled), entanglement with another port, message buffering (incoming and transfer queues), and port identification. Implements the full HTML spec port lifecycle: entangle, disentangle, start, close, set-has-been-shipped, complete_transfer, and handle_incoming.

nodes.name: MessagePortState
nodes.summary: Enum representing the state of a message port per the HTML spec: Detached, Enabled (with transfer-completion flag), or Disabled (with transfer-completion flag).

nodes.name: TransformStreamData
nodes.summary: Holds paired readable and writable message port endpoints for a transferred transform stream.

nodes.name: complete_transfer
nodes.summary: Completes a port transfer by draining the transfer task queue, moving each task's messages from the outgoing buffer into the incoming buffer of the entangled port, and clearing the has-been-shipped flag.

nodes.name: handle_incoming
nodes.summary: Processes an incoming message task for the port. If the port is entangled, enqueues the task on the entangled port's buffer; otherwise buffers it locally. Creates a new VecDeque when first queuing.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Starts the message port by transitioning from Disabled to Enabled state and draining any buffered messages into the entangled port's incoming queue. Returns the drained messages for delivery.

nodes.name: font_descriptor.rs
nodes.summary: Defines FontDescriptor (rendering parameters for a font instance), CSSFontFaceDescriptors (CSS @font-face rule descriptors), and LowercaseFontFamilyName (case-insensitive font family name wrapper).

nodes.name: FontDescriptor
nodes.summary: Describes the rendering parameters of a font instance: weight, stretch, style, variant-caps, point size, variation settings, synthesis, and optical sizing. Contrasts with FontTemplateDescriptor which describes only intrinsic font data properties.

nodes.name: CSSFontFaceDescriptors
nodes.summary: Represents optional descriptors from a CSS @font-face rule (family name, weight/stretch/style ranges, unicode range). Used to create FontTemplates from font data specified in @font-face rules.

nodes.name: LowercaseFontFamilyName
nodes.summary: A case-insensitive font family name wrapper that stores the name in lowercase. Implements Deref to str, Display, and From conversions for case-normalized font family matching.

nodes.name: from (FontStyleStruct)
nodes.summary: Constructs a FontDescriptor from a computed Font style struct, converting font variation settings from the style system's representation to WebRender's FontVariation format.

nodes.name: from (Descriptors)
nodes.summary: Converts Stylo's Descriptors into CSSFontFaceDescriptors, computing weight/stretch/style ranges and mapping unicode ranges from the parsed @font-face descriptor values.

nodes.name: font_identifier.rs
nodes.summary: Defines FontIdentifier (enum for local, web, and array-buffer font sources) and platform-specific LocalFontIdentifier implementations for Linux/FreeType, macOS/CoreText, and Windows/DirectWrite.

nodes.name: FontIdentifier
nodes.summary: Enum identifying a font source: Local (system-installed font), Web (loaded from URL), or ArrayBuffer (in-memory font data identified by UUID).

nodes.name: LocalFontIdentifier
nodes.summary: Platform-specific identifier for locally-installed fonts. On Linux/FreeType: path, face_index, named_instance_index. On macOS: postscript_name and path. On Windows: wrapped dwrote FontDescriptor. Exported via pub use from the platform module.

nodes.name: ttc_index_from_postscript_name
nodes.summary: Maps a PostScript font name to an index within a TrueType Collection (TTC) file on macOS. Iterates through collection fonts comparing PostScript name records; defaults to index 0 on failure.

nodes.name: font_template.rs
nodes.summary: Defines FontTemplate (font face data with identifier, descriptor, and optional @font-face rule), FontTemplateDescriptor (weight/stretch/style matching ranges), and the CSS font matching distance algorithm ported from Gecko.

nodes.name: FontTemplateRef
nodes.summary: A reference-counted, interior-mutable handle to a FontTemplate via Arc<AtomicRefCell<FontTemplate>>. Implements Deref for transparent access and FontTemplateRefMethods for CSS font matching.

nodes.name: FontTemplateDescriptor
nodes.summary: Describes how to select a font from a family using computed weight, stretch, and style ranges plus optional unicode range. Implements the CSS font matching distance algorithm for font selection.

nodes.name: FontTemplate
nodes.summary: Complete font template combining a FontIdentifier (source), FontTemplateDescriptor (matching parameters), and optional @font-face rule reference. Provides methods for computing font variations per the CSS Fonts Level 4 algorithm.

nodes.name: FontTemplateRefMethods
nodes.summary: Trait providing the CSS font matching API on FontTemplateRef: descriptor access, font descriptor matching, distance calculation, unicode range checks, and @font-face rule retrieval.

nodes.name: FontMatchDistanceMethod
nodes.summary: Trait for computing CSS font matching distances. Generic over range types (stretch, weight, style) with match_distance and to_float methods. Ported from Gecko's gfxFontUtils.h.

nodes.name: IsOblique
nodes.summary: Trait providing an is_oblique check on FontStyle values, returning true when the style is an oblique angle (neither NORMAL nor ITALIC).

nodes.name: FontTemplateDescriptor::distance_from
nodes.summary: Computes a weighted distance score between this font template and a target FontDescriptor for CSS font matching. Uses stretch (factor 1e8) >> style (1e4) >> weight (1e0) weighting per the CSS Fonts spec.

nodes.name: FontTemplateDescriptor::override_values_with_css_font_template_descriptors
nodes.summary: Overrides the descriptor's weight, stretch, style, and unicode_range with values from CSS @font-face descriptors when present, allowing stylesheet rules to refine font matching.

nodes.name: FontTemplate::new_for_local_web_font
nodes.summary: Creates a new FontTemplate for a local() web font by cloning an existing local font template and overriding its descriptor values with the @font-face rule's CSS descriptors.

nodes.name: FontTemplate::compute_variations
nodes.summary: Computes the final set of OpenType font variation settings per the CSS Fonts Level 4 algorithm. Applies variations from font-variation-settings, @font-face descriptors, font-weight, font-width (stretch), and font-optical-sizing in ascending precedence order.

nodes.name: FontStretch::match_distance
nodes.summary: Computes stretch distance [0,2000] for CSS font matching. Prefers wider stretches above NORMAL and narrower below; applies reverse-distance penalty when searching in the non-preferred direction.

nodes.name: FontWeight::match_distance
nodes.summary: Computes weight distance [0,1600] for CSS font matching. Heavier target weights prefer bolder faces; lighter targets prefer thinner faces. Weights in [400,500] have special bidirectional matching behavior per the CSS Fonts algorithm.

nodes.name: FontStyle::match_distance
nodes.summary: Computes style distance [0,500] for CSS font matching. Handles italic, normal, and oblique angle comparisons with reverse-search and negate penalties. The most complex of the three distance functions due to oblique angle directionality.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the fonts component. Re-exports all public types from submodules (font_descriptor, font_identifier, font_template, system_font_service_proxy) and defines core types: ByteIndex, TextByteRange, FontData, FontDataAndIndex, WebFontSetDifference, and FontFaceRuleWithOrigin.

nodes.name: ByteIndex
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around usize representing a byte offset in a text run. Can refer to a position within a glyph. Derives numeric operations for arithmetic.

nodes.name: TextByteRange
nodes.summary: A range of UTF-8 byte offsets in a text run, used to identify glyphs by their original character positions. Implements Iterator, DoubleEndedIterator, and provides intersection and containment methods.

nodes.name: FontData
nodes.summary: Stores raw font file data in a GenericSharedMemory handle for zero-copy IPC transfer. Wraps Arc<GenericSharedMemory> with from_bytes constructor and AsRef<[u8]> for byte access.

nodes.name: FontDataAndIndex
nodes.summary: Combines raw font file data with an index for TrueType Collection files. The index is 0 for single-font files and identifies a specific font within a TTC.

nodes.name: FontDataError
nodes.summary: Simple error enum for font data loading failures, currently with a single FailedToLoad variant.

nodes.name: WebFontSetDifference
nodes.summary: Describes changes to the set of active @font-face rules after a FontContext rebuild, tracking which rules were added and removed. Supports efficient delta updates.

nodes.name: FontFaceRuleWithOrigin
nodes.summary: Pairs a locked @font-face rule with its stylesheet origin (Author, UserAgent, or User). Provides read_with for guarded access through the correct StylesheetGuards based on origin.

nodes.name: TextByteRange::intersect
nodes.summary: Computes the intersection of two TextByteRanges, returning the overlapping range or an empty default range if they do not overlap.

nodes.name: system_font_service_proxy.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the IPC protocol (SystemFontServiceMessage) and client-side proxy (SystemFontServiceProxy) for communicating with the system font service thread. Provides cached font template lookup, font instance/key generation, and memory reporting.

nodes.name: SystemFontServiceMessage
nodes.summary: IPC message enum for the system font service: GetFontTemplates, GetFontInstance, PrefetchFontKeys, GetFontKey, GetFontInstanceKey, CollectMemoryReport, Exit, and Ping health check.

nodes.name: SystemFontServiceProxySender
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around GenericSender<SystemFontServiceMessage> with a to_proxy method for constructing a SystemFontServiceProxy from the sender.

nodes.name: SystemFontServiceProxy
nodes.summary: Per-document client proxy to the system font service thread. Maintains a template cache (HashMap keyed by FontTemplateCacheKey) and provides methods for font instance retrieval, font key generation, and graceful shutdown.

nodes.name: SystemFontServiceProxy::get_system_font_instance
nodes.summary: Requests a FontInstanceKey from the system font service for a given identifier, size, flags, and variations. Sends a GetFontInstance message and blocks on the response; panics if the font service thread has exited.

nodes.name: SystemFontServiceProxy::find_matching_font_templates
nodes.summary: Finds font templates matching a descriptor and family, with caching. Checks the internal template cache first; on miss, sends GetFontTemplates IPC message, wraps results in FontTemplateRef, and caches them for future lookups.

nodes.name: SystemFontServiceProxy::generate_font_key
nodes.summary: Requests a new FontKey from the system font service for a given painter. Sends a GetFontKey message and blocks synchronously on the response.

nodes.name: SystemFontServiceProxy::generate_font_instance_key
nodes.summary: Requests a new FontInstanceKey from the system font service for a given painter. Sends a GetFontInstanceKey message and blocks synchronously on the response.

nodes.name: display_list.rs
nodes.summary: Defines data structures consumed by the Paint component, including the ScrollTree for managing spatial node transforms, ScrollableNodeInfo for scroll tracking, and PaintDisplayListInfo for bundling display list metadata sent from layout to the renderer.

nodes.name: largest_contentful_paint_candidate.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the LCPCandidate and LargestContentfulPaint structs for tracking web performance metrics related to the largest visible content element during page load.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the paint module that defines the PaintMessage enum for IPC communication with the renderer, the CrossProcessPaintApi for cross-process WebRender interaction, PaintProxy for message dispatch, and traits for external image handling and WebView integration.

nodes.name: rendering_context.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the RenderingContext trait as the abstraction over OpenGL/GLES rendering surfaces, with concrete implementations for windowed (WindowRenderingContext), offscreen (OffscreenRenderingContext), and software (SoftwareRenderingContext) rendering backed by the surfman library.

nodes.name: viewport_description.rs
nodes.summary: Implements parsing of the HTML viewport meta tag into a ViewportDescription struct, handling initial-scale, minimum-scale, maximum-scale, and user-scalable properties per the CSS Viewport specification.

nodes.name: ScrollType
nodes.summary: Bitflag type representing scroll sensitivity modes -- InputEvents for user-driven scrolling and Script for programmatic scrolling -- with conversion from CSS Overflow values.

nodes.name: SpatialTreeNodeInfo
nodes.summary: Enum discriminating between the three types of spatial tree nodes: ReferenceFrame (transform-only), Scroll (scrollable), and Sticky (position-sticky).

nodes.name: StickyNodeInfo
nodes.summary: Holds sticky positioning metadata (frame rect, margins, offset bounds) and implements the cumulative sticky offset calculation used by the spatial tree for CSS position:sticky elements.

nodes.name: ScrollableNodeInfo
nodes.summary: Data for scrollable spatial tree nodes including external id, content/clip rects, axis sensitivity, current offset, and methods to scroll by delta or to WebRender locations.

nodes.name: ScrollTreeNode
nodes.summary: A node in the ScrollTree representing a spatial element (reference frame, scrollable area, or sticky element) with parent/child links, cached transforms, and methods for scrolling and debugging.

nodes.name: ScrollTree
nodes.summary: A tree of spatial nodes mirroring WebRender's spatial tree, providing Paint-side scroll management with cumulative transform calculation, scroll offset synchronization, and debug printing capabilities.

nodes.name: PaintDisplayListInfo
nodes.summary: Bundles Paint-side metadata for a display list including pipeline id, viewport details, content size, scroll tree, epoch, and contentful/paintable flags used for paint timing metrics.

nodes.name: LCPCandidate
nodes.summary: Represents a Largest Contentful Paint candidate element with its identity, visual area size, and optional resource URL, used to track the largest visible content during page load.

nodes.name: LargestContentfulPaint
nodes.summary: Records the final Largest Contentful Paint timing with element identity, area, paint timestamp, and optional URL, constructed from an LCPCandidate at paint time.

nodes.name: PaintProxy
nodes.summary: Proxy for sending PaintMessage values to the Paint component via an IPC sender channel, implementing OpaqueSender and providing route_msg for deserialized IPC forwarding with event loop waking.

nodes.name: PaintMessage
nodes.summary: Large enum defining all IPC messages sent to the Paint component including display list submission, scrolling, image/font resource management, viewport updates, LCP tracking, and frame generation requests.

nodes.name: CrossProcessPaintApi
nodes.summary: Cross-process API wrapper around a GenericCallback<PaintMessage> enabling script threads to send display lists, scroll events, font/image updates, LCP candidates, and viewport descriptions to the parent process WebRender instance.

nodes.name: WebRenderExternalImageApi
nodes.summary: Trait bridging GL clients (WebGL, Media, WebGPU) with WebRender's ExternalImageHandler API, requiring lock/unlock methods to synchronize external image access.

nodes.name: WebRenderExternalImageHandlers
nodes.summary: Implements WebRender's ExternalImageHandler by dispatching lock/unlock calls to registered handlers for WebGL, media, and WebGPU external images, with a shared id manager for unique image identifiers.

nodes.name: WebRenderExternalImageIdManager
nodes.summary: Thread-safe manager that generates unique ExternalImageIds and tracks their associated handler types (WebGL, Media, WebGPU) using a shared FxHashMap behind an Arc<RwLock>.

nodes.name: ImageUpdate
nodes.summary: Enum of serializable image resource operations sent to WebRender: AddImage, DeleteImage, UpdateImage, and UpdateImageForAnimation (descriptor-only update for animated images).

nodes.name: SerializableImageData
nodes.summary: Serializable enum wrapping image data as either raw bytes (via GenericSharedMemory) or an external handle (ExternalImageData), with conversion to WebRender's ImageData type.

nodes.name: WebViewTrait
nodes.summary: Trait exposing embedding-layer WebView functionality (id, screen geometry, animation state) to the Servo renderer, breaking the dependency cycle between renderer and embedding.

nodes.name: PinchZoomInfos
nodes.summary: Holds pinch-zoom factor and the viewport rect relative to the layout viewport for a root pipeline, with a constructor creating initial identity-transform state from a viewport size.

nodes.name: PainterSurfmanDetailsMap
nodes.summary: Thread-safe map from PainterId to PainterSurfmanDetails (Connection and Adapter) using Arc<Mutex<HashMap>>, with get, insert, and remove operations.

nodes.name: RenderingContext
nodes.summary: Core trait abstracting an OpenGL/GLES rendering surface with methods for preparation, pixel readback, resizing, buffer presentation, context activation, and GL API access, serving as the foundation for all rendering backends in Servo.

nodes.name: SurfmanRenderingContext
nodes.summary: Internal rendering context using the surfman library to create and manage an OpenGL/GLES device, context, and surface, providing methods for surface creation, binding, resizing, swap chain management, and framebuffer-based pixel readback.

nodes.name: SoftwareRenderingContext
nodes.summary: A RenderingContext implementation using a software OpenGL adapter via surfman for consistent but slower rendering, with a swap chain for double-buffered presentation and framebuffer readback.

nodes.name: WindowRenderingContext
nodes.summary: A RenderingContext implementation that renders to a native window via raw-window-handle and surfman, supporting optional refresh drivers, window replacement, and creation of offscreen sub-contexts.

nodes.name: OffscreenRenderingContext
nodes.summary: A RenderingContext that renders to an offscreen framebuffer and can blit results back to a parent WindowRenderingContext, enabling rendering to only a portion of the window surface.

nodes.name: ViewportDescription
nodes.summary: Parsed representation of the HTML viewport meta tag holding initial-scale, minimum-scale, maximum-scale, and user-scalable properties, with FromStr parsing per the CSS Viewport specification and zoom clamping.

nodes.name: UserScalable
nodes.summary: Enum representing whether user zoom is allowed (Yes/No), with TryFrom<&str> conversion accepting yes/no strings and numeric 1.0/0.0 values.

nodes.name: adapter.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the BluetoothAdapter enum and BtleplugAdapter struct providing a unified abstraction over native (btleplug) and mock (blurmock) Bluetooth adapter backends with feature-gated implementations.

nodes.name: bluetooth.rs
nodes.summary: Core Bluetooth type definitions including enums and native/mock structs for Device, GATT Service, Characteristic, Descriptor, and Discovery Session, each wrapping btleplug or blurmock backends behind a common interface.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Main Bluetooth module entry point implementing the Web Bluetooth API specification â€” device discovery, GATT server connect/disconnect, characteristic/descriptor read/write, notifications, and requestDevice filtering â€” via BluetoothManager with async message loop.

nodes.name: test.rs
nodes.summary: Web Bluetooth test harness providing mock device setup factories (heart rate, glucose, blocklisted, unicode devices) matching Chromium's layout test adapter configurations for WPT test execution.

nodes.name: BtleplugAdapter
nodes.summary: Native Bluetooth adapter wrapper around btleplug's platform Adapter, providing async methods for adapter info, power state, device enumeration, and discovery session creation.

nodes.name: BluetoothAdapter
nodes.summary: Enum abstracting over native (Btleplug) and mock (FakeBluetoothAdapter) Bluetooth adapters, dispatching adapter operations to the active backend with cfg-gated arms.

nodes.name: BtleplugDiscoverySession
nodes.summary: Native discovery session struct wrapping btleplug Adapter to start and stop BLE scanning.

nodes.name: BtleplugDevice
nodes.summary: Native Bluetooth device wrapper around btleplug Peripheral, providing async access to device properties, connection management, GATT service discovery, and advertisement data.

nodes.name: BtleplugGATTService
nodes.summary: Native GATT service wrapper tracking instance ID, btleplug Service metadata, and peripheral reference, exposing UUID, primary status, and characteristic enumeration.

nodes.name: BtleplugGATTCharacteristic
nodes.summary: Native GATT characteristic wrapper exposing UUID, property flags, descriptor enumeration, and async read/write/notify operations via btleplug Peripheral.

nodes.name: BtleplugGATTDescriptor
nodes.summary: Native GATT descriptor wrapper providing UUID, flags, and async read/write operations through btleplug's descriptor API.

nodes.name: BluetoothDiscoverySession
nodes.summary: Enum abstracting over native and mock discovery sessions, dispatching start/stop scan operations to the active backend.

nodes.name: BluetoothDevice
nodes.summary: Enum abstracting over native and mock Bluetooth devices with methods for identity, connection state, GATT services, advertisement data, and mock test property setters.

nodes.name: BluetoothGATTService
nodes.summary: Enum abstracting over native and mock GATT services with UUID queries, included services, characteristic retrieval, and mock test property manipulation.

nodes.name: BluetoothGATTCharacteristic
nodes.summary: Enum abstracting over native and mock GATT characteristics with property bitflags, descriptor access, async read/write/notify, and mock test property setters.

nodes.name: BluetoothGATTDescriptor
nodes.summary: Enum abstracting over native and mock GATT descriptors with UUID, value read/write, and mock test property manipulation methods.

nodes.name: Flags
nodes.summary: Bitflags struct representing Bluetooth GATT characteristic properties: Broadcast, Read, Write, Notify, Indicate, and related flags.

nodes.name: BluetoothThreadFactory
nodes.summary: Trait and GenericSender impl that spawns the Bluetooth manager thread with a tokio runtime for native builds or a sync message loop for mock-only builds, bridging GenericReceiver to tokio mpsc.

nodes.name: BluetoothManager
nodes.summary: Central Bluetooth manager that implements the Web Bluetooth API: handles requestDevice with scan-filter matching, GATT server connect/disconnect with timeout retry, GATT child enumeration (services/characteristics/descriptors), value read/write, notification toggling, and device caching with ID mapping.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses cfg-gated async/sync message loops: tokio runtime with mpsc channel bridge for native builds, futures::executor::block_on for mock-only builds.

nodes.name: matches_filter
nodes.summary: Implements the Web Bluetooth 'matches a filter' algorithm checking device name, name prefix, service UUIDs, manufacturer data, and service data against a BluetoothScanfilter.

nodes.name: data_filter_matches
nodes.summary: Implements the BluetoothDataFilterInit matching algorithm comparing masked prefix bytes against advertised manufacturer or service data.

nodes.name: matches_filters
nodes.summary: Tests a device against a sequence of scan filters, returning true if any filter matches.

nodes.name: async_sleep
nodes.summary: Async sleep utility that uses tokio::time::sleep for native builds and std::thread::sleep for mock-only builds, bridging async and sync contexts.

nodes.name: test
nodes.summary: Public async test entry point that configures mock adapters and devices matching Chromium's layout test data sets (NotPresent, NotPowered, Empty, GlucoseHeartRate, HeartRate, Unicode, Blocklist, etc.) for WPT execution.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the config component, declaring the opts, pref_util, and prefs public modules that together provide Servo's configuration systems.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust crate root using declarative module system with pub mod declarations and deny(unsafe_code).

nodes.name: opts.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the global Opts configuration struct and diagnostics logging system, initialized once at startup and immutable at runtime via a OnceLock singleton.

nodes.name: pref_util.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the PrefValue enum and conversion implementations for typed preference values used by the runtime preference system, with JSON deserialization support.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses declarative macros (impl_pref_from!, impl_from_pref!) for boilerplate reduction across type conversions.

nodes.name: prefs.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the global Preferences struct and observer system for runtime-changeable configuration values, including platform-specific user agent string generation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a custom derive macro (ServoPreferences) to auto-generate diff logic. Over 100 preference fields with a const_default function spanning 180 lines.

nodes.name: Opts
nodes.summary: Global options struct holding all immutable Servo startup configuration including profiling, multiprocess mode, sandbox, shader paths, and certificate settings.

nodes.name: DiagnosticsLoggingOption
nodes.summary: Enum of 12 diagnostic logging categories including style trees, layout trees, display lists, script event profiling, GC profiling, and accessibility tree logging.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses strum derive macros (EnumIter, EnumString, EnumMessage, AsRefStr) for string conversion and iteration over enum variants.

nodes.name: DiagnosticsLogging
nodes.summary: Manages the runtime configuration of diagnostic logging options using a boolean array indexed by DiagnosticsLoggingOption variants.

nodes.name: OutputOptions
nodes.summary: Enum specifying profiler output destination: either a file (by name) or stdout (with interval in seconds).

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new DiagnosticsLogging instance, reading the SERVO_DIAGNOSTICS environment variable in debug builds to auto-enable diagnostic options.

nodes.name: extend_from_string
nodes.summary: Parses a comma-separated string of diagnostic option names and enables each matching DiagnosticsLoggingOption flag.

nodes.name: default(Opts)
nodes.summary: Returns the default Opts configuration with hard_fail enabled, multiprocess disabled, sandbox disabled, and all optional paths set to None.

nodes.name: initialize_options
nodes.summary: Initializes the global Opts singleton via OnceLock, panicking if called more than once to enforce single-initialization semantics.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns a static reference to the global Opts singleton, lazily initializing with defaults if not already set.

nodes.name: PrefValue
nodes.summary: Enum representing typed preference values: Float, Int, UInt, Str, Bool, and nested Array, with conversions from/to JSON values and primitive Rust types.

nodes.name: from_booleanish_str
nodes.summary: Parses a string into a PrefValue, recognizing booleans, integers, floats, and falling back to a string representation.

nodes.name: PreferencesObserver
nodes.summary: Trait for components that wish to be notified when global preferences change at runtime, receiving an array of changed preference name-value pairs.

nodes.name: Preferences
nodes.summary: Large struct holding over 100 runtime-changeable preferences covering DOM features, layout, JS engine, networking, WebGPU, WebXR, fonts, and threading configuration.

nodes.name: UserAgentPlatform
nodes.summary: Enum representing target platforms (Desktop, Android, OpenHarmony, Ios) with methods to determine the default platform and generate corresponding user-agent strings.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns a read-locked guard to the global Preferences singleton, allowing thread-safe read access to current preference values.

nodes.name: add_observer
nodes.summary: Registers a PreferencesObserver to receive notifications whenever global preferences are updated.

nodes.name: set
nodes.summary: Updates global preferences, computes diffs, synchronizes Stylo CSS preferences, and notifies all registered observers of changed values.

nodes.name: const_default
nodes.summary: Returns a compile-time constant default Preferences struct with all 100+ fields set to their initial values, used as the baseline for runtime customization.

nodes.name: editing_caret_blink_time
nodes.summary: Returns the caret blink time as an Option<Duration>, returning None when the preference value is zero or negative (blink disabled).

nodes.name: default(Preferences)
nodes.summary: Returns default Preferences by calling const_default then overlaying environment variables for HTTP/HTTPS proxy and no_proxy settings.

nodes.name: default(UserAgentPlatform)
nodes.summary: Determines the default UserAgentPlatform variant at compile time using cfg target_os and target_env checks for Android, OpenHarmony, iOS, or Desktop.

nodes.name: to_user_agent_string
nodes.summary: Generates a platform-specific user-agent string matching Firefox 140.0 format for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, OpenHarmony, and iOS.

nodes.name: capture.rs
nodes.summary: Defines media track constraint types (ConstrainRange, ConstrainBool, Constrain, MediaTrackConstraintSet) for specifying capture parameters like width, height, aspect ratio, frame rate, and sample rate.

nodes.name: device_monitor.rs
nodes.summary: Defines media device enumeration types (MediaDeviceKind, MediaDeviceInfo) and the MediaDeviceMonitor trait for discovering available audio/video input/output devices.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root declaring capture, device_monitor, and registry submodules; defines core traits MediaStream, MediaSocket, and MediaOutput along with the MediaStreamType enum, and re-exports the registry module.

nodes.name: registry.rs
nodes.summary: Implements a thread-safe global media stream registry backed by a LazyLock<Mutex<HashMap>>, providing register_stream, unregister_stream, and get_stream functions keyed by UUID-based MediaStreamId.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses std::sync::LazyLock for lazy static initialization of the global registry, with Arc<Mutex<>> for thread-safe shared ownership.

nodes.name: ConstrainRange<T>
nodes.summary: Generic struct representing a media constraint range with optional min, max, and ideal values of type T.

nodes.name: ConstrainBool
nodes.summary: Enum representing a boolean media constraint as either an ideal or exact value.

nodes.name: MediaTrackConstraintSet
nodes.summary: Struct bundling width, height, aspect ratio, frame rate, and sample rate constraints into a single media track constraint set, with #[derive(Default)].

nodes.name: Constrain<T>
nodes.summary: Generic enum representing a media constraint as either a single concrete value or a ConstrainRange with min/max/ideal bounds.

nodes.name: MediaDeviceKind
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing between audio input, audio output, and video input device kinds with Clone, Copy, and Debug derives.

nodes.name: MediaDeviceInfo
nodes.summary: Struct holding media device identification information including device ID string, device kind, and human-readable label.

nodes.name: MediaDeviceMonitor
nodes.summary: Trait for media device monitors that can enumerate available media devices, returning an optional vector of MediaDeviceInfo.

nodes.name: MediaStream
nodes.summary: Core trait representing a media stream with dynamic typing support via Any+Send, exposing identity (set_id), type query (ty), and downcast methods (as_any, as_mut_any).

nodes.name: MediaSocket
nodes.summary: Trait representing a yet-to-be-connected source side of a MediaStream, with dynamic typing support via Any+Send.

nodes.name: MediaOutput
nodes.summary: Trait for consumers that can receive and inspect media streams by their MediaStreamId; described as a leaky abstraction for development-time stream inspection.

nodes.name: MediaStreamType
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing between Video and Audio media stream types, with Clone, Copy, Debug, and PartialEq derives.

nodes.name: MediaStreamId
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around UUID used as a globally unique media stream identifier, with Clone, Copy, Hash, Eq, PartialEq, and MallocSizeOf derives; implements Default via Uuid::new_v4.

nodes.name: register_stream
nodes.summary: Registers an Arc<Mutex<dyn MediaStream>> in the global registry, assigns it a new MediaStreamId, and returns the ID.

nodes.name: unregister_stream
nodes.summary: Removes a media stream from the global registry by its MediaStreamId.

nodes.name: get_stream
nodes.summary: Looks up and returns a cloned Arc<Mutex<dyn MediaStream>> from the global registry by MediaStreamId, or None if not found.

nodes.name: client_storage.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the client storage thread messaging protocol for Servo's storage subsystem, including enums for storage types, bucket modes, storage identifiers, error types, and the ClientStorageThreadMessage enum used to communicate between the main thread and the client storage backend thread.

nodes.name: indexeddb.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the complete IndexedDB type system for Servo's storage layer, including key types, key ranges, transaction modes, object store metadata, connection lifecycle messages, and sync/async operation enums that form the protocol between the script thread and the IndexedDB backend thread.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses extensive Rust enums with associated data to model the IndexedDB protocol, with a 21-variant SyncOperation enum representing the complete set of IndexedDB backend operations.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root that re-exports the storage module tree (client_storage, indexeddb, webstorage_thread) and defines the StorageThreads facade struct that bundles the three storage thread channels into a single interface for high-level storage operations.

nodes.name: webstorage_thread.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Web Storage (localStorage/sessionStorage) messaging types for Servo, including the WebStorageType enum, OriginDescriptor struct, and the comprehensive WebStorageThreadMsg enum that represents all operations on the web storage backend thread.

nodes.name: ClientStorageThreadHandle
nodes.summary: A thread-safe handle wrapping a GenericSender for dispatching ClientStorageThreadMessage operations to the client storage background thread. Provides methods for obtaining storage bottle maps, creating/deleting databases, checking persistence, and estimating storage usage.

nodes.name: StorageType
nodes.summary: Enum representing the Web Storage type as defined in the Storage specification: Local (persistent) or Session (per-session).

nodes.name: Mode
nodes.summary: Enum for the storage bucket mode per the Storage specification: BestEffort (default, may be evicted) or Persistent (protected from eviction). Implements FromStr for parsing string representations.

nodes.name: StorageIdentifier
nodes.summary: Enum identifying the type of storage endpoint per the Storage specification: Caches, IndexedDB, LocalStorage, ServiceWorkerRegistrations, or SessionStorage.

nodes.name: CreateBucketError
nodes.summary: Generic error enum for bucket creation failures, with variants for BucketAlreadyExists and Internal (wrapping an arbitrary error type).

nodes.name: ClientStorageErrorr
nodes.summary: Comprehensive generic error enum for client storage operations covering bottle/bucket/database existence failures, directory I/O failures, session storage window requirements, and a generic internal error variant.

nodes.name: StorageProxyMap
nodes.summary: Struct mapping a storage bottle ID to its corresponding ClientStorageThreadHandle, as defined in the Storage specification's storage proxy map concept.

nodes.name: ClientStorageThreadMessage
nodes.summary: Message enum for all operations dispatched to the client storage background thread: ObtainBottleMap, CreateDatabase, DeleteDatabase, Persisted, Persist, Estimate, and Exit. Each variant carries the necessary parameters and a response sender.

nodes.name: obtain_a_storage_bottle_map
nodes.summary: Requests a storage bottle map from the client storage thread for a given storage type, optional webview, storage identifier, and origin. Creates a oneshot channel and sends an ObtainBottleMap message, returning the receiver.

nodes.name: create_database
nodes.summary: Requests creation of a named database within the specified storage bottle. Sends a CreateDatabase message over the thread channel and returns a receiver for the result (path and creation flag).

nodes.name: delete_database
nodes.summary: Requests deletion of a named database within the specified storage bottle. Sends a DeleteDatabase message and returns a receiver for the result.

nodes.name: persist
nodes.summary: Requests that storage for the given origin be made persistent, forwarding the specified permission grant status. Sends a Persist message with a callback sender for the boolean result.

nodes.name: StorageType::as_str
nodes.summary: Returns the string representation of the StorageType: 'local' for Local and 'session' for Session.

nodes.name: Mode::as_str
nodes.summary: Returns the string representation of the bucket Mode: 'best-effort' for BestEffort and 'persistent' for Persistent.

nodes.name: Mode::from_str
nodes.summary: Parses a string into a bucket Mode per the Storage specification: 'best-effort' maps to BestEffort, 'persistent' maps to Persistent. Returns an error for unrecognized values.

nodes.name: StorageIdentifier::as_str
nodes.summary: Returns the string representation for each StorageIdentifier variant: 'caches', 'indexeddb', 'localstorage', 'serviceworkerregistration', or 'sessionstorage'.

nodes.name: BackendError
nodes.summary: Error enum representing all possible backend (SQLite) failures in IndexedDB operations: DbNotFound, StoreNotFound, QuotaExceeded, Abort, and DbErr (wrapping a string error). Implements Display and Error traits.

nodes.name: KeyPath
nodes.summary: Enum representing an IndexedDB key path, which can be either a single String or a Sequence of strings for compound keys.

nodes.name: IndexedDBTxnMode
nodes.summary: Enum for IndexedDB transaction modes as defined in the W3C spec: Readonly, Readwrite, and Versionchange.

nodes.name: IndexedDBKeyType
nodes.summary: Enum representing the valid IndexedDB key types: Number (f64), String, Binary (Vec<u8>), Date (f64), and Array (Vec<IndexedDBKeyType>). Implements PartialOrd and PartialEq with full comparison semantics across all type combinations.

nodes.name: IndexedDBKeyRange
nodes.summary: Struct representing an IndexedDB key range with optional lower and upper bounds, each with a flag indicating whether the bound is open (exclusive). Provides factory methods (only, lower_bound, upper_bound) and query methods (contains, is_singleton, as_singleton).

nodes.name: IndexedDBRecord
nodes.summary: Struct representing a single record in an IndexedDB object store, containing the key, primary_key, and value.

nodes.name: IndexedDBIndex
nodes.summary: Struct describing an IndexedDB index with its name, key_path, multi_entry flag, and unique constraint flag.

nodes.name: IndexedDBObjectStore
nodes.summary: Struct describing an IndexedDB object store with its name, key_path, key generator configuration (has_key_generator, key_generator_current_number), and a list of indexes.

nodes.name: PutItemResult
nodes.summary: Enum representing the result of a put operation: either a successful Key insertion or CannotOverwrite when the key already exists.

nodes.name: AsyncReadOnlyOperation
nodes.summary: Enum of asynchronous read-only IndexedDB operations: GetKey, GetItem, GetAllKeys, GetAllItems, Count, and Iterate. Each variant carries a callback sender and a notify_error method for reporting failures.

nodes.name: AsyncReadWriteOperation
nodes.summary: Enum of asynchronous read-write IndexedDB operations: PutItem, RemoveItem, and Clear. Each variant carries a callback sender and a notify_error method.

nodes.name: AsyncOperation
nodes.summary: Top-level enum wrapping either a ReadOnly (AsyncReadOnlyOperation) or ReadWrite (AsyncReadWriteOperation) variant, with a delegating notify_error method.

nodes.name: CreateObjectResult
nodes.summary: Enum for the result of creating an object store or index: Created (newly created) or AlreadyExists.

nodes.name: ConnectionMsg
nodes.summary: Message enum for IndexedDB connection lifecycle events: VersionError, AbortError, Connection (established), Upgrade (version upgrade transaction), VersionChange, Blocked, DatabaseError, and TxnMaybeCommit. Each variant carries connection metadata such as database name, UUID, and version numbers.

nodes.name: TxnCompleteMsg
nodes.summary: Struct carrying the completion result of an IndexedDB transaction, including the origin, database name, transaction ID, and the backend result.

nodes.name: DatabaseInfo
nodes.summary: Simple struct containing the name and version of an IndexedDB database.

nodes.name: SyncOperation
nodes.summary: Comprehensive enum of synchronous IndexedDB operations (21 variants) representing the complete backend protocol: GetDatabases, UpgradeVersion, GetObjectStore, Commit, Abort, CreateTransaction, CreateIndex, DeleteIndex, CreateObjectStore, DeleteObjectStore, OpenDatabase, DeleteDatabase, CloseDatabase, Version, AbortPendingUpgrades, NotifyEndOfVersionChange, and Exit. Each variant carries typed sender channels and operation-specific parameters.
nodes.languageNotes: This is the central operation enum for the IndexedDB backend protocol with 21 variants, each carrying typed channel senders for synchronous request-response patterns.

nodes.name: IndexedDBThreadMsg
nodes.summary: Top-level message enum for the IndexedDB background thread, wrapping Sync (SyncOperation), Async (AsyncOperation), EngineTxnBatchComplete, and CollectMemoryReport variants.

nodes.name: BackendError::fmt
nodes.summary: Display implementation for BackendError, rendering each variant as a human-readable string: 'DbNotFound', 'StoreNotFound', 'QuotaExceeded', 'Abort', or the wrapped DbErr message.

nodes.name: IndexedDBKeyType::partial_cmp
nodes.summary: PartialOrd implementation for IndexedDBKeyType that defines the full comparison semantics between all key type combinations (Number, String, Binary, Date, Array), handling type mismatches by ordering by type discriminant and comparing arrays element-wise.

nodes.name: IndexedDBKeyType::eq
nodes.summary: PartialEq implementation for IndexedDBKeyType that delegates to partial_cmp and checks for Ordering::Equal, handling type mismatches (different variants are never equal).

nodes.name: IndexedDBKeyRange::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new IndexedDBKeyRange with the given lower and upper bounds and open/closed flags. Validates that non-None bounds are of the same key type if both are present, returning None on type mismatch.

nodes.name: IndexedDBKeyRange::lower_bound
nodes.summary: Factory method creating an IndexedDBKeyRange with only a lower bound (and no upper bound), with a flag controlling whether the lower bound is open or closed.

nodes.name: IndexedDBKeyRange::upper_bound
nodes.summary: Factory method creating an IndexedDBKeyRange with only an upper bound (and no lower bound), with a flag controlling whether the upper bound is open or closed.

nodes.name: IndexedDBKeyRange::contains
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given key falls within this key range, respecting the open/closed flags for both the lower and upper bounds. Handles None bounds as unbounded in the respective direction.

nodes.name: AsyncReadOnlyOperation::notify_error
nodes.summary: Sends an error result through the callback channel for all variants of AsyncReadOnlyOperation. Each variant (GetKey, GetItem, GetAllKeys, GetAllItems, Count, Iterate) dispatches an Err to its respective callback sender.

nodes.name: AsyncReadWriteOperation::notify_error
nodes.summary: Sends an error result through the callback channel for all variants of AsyncReadWriteOperation (PutItem, RemoveItem, Clear), dispatching an Err to each variant's callback sender.

nodes.name: AsyncOperation::notify_error
nodes.summary: Delegates error notification to the inner operation: dispatches to AsyncReadOnlyOperation::notify_error or AsyncReadWriteOperation::notify_error based on the variant.

nodes.name: StorageThreads
nodes.summary: Facade struct that bundles the three storage thread channels (client_storage, idb, and web_storage) into a single interface. Implements GenericSend for all three message types and provides high-level methods for storage operations like persisted, persist, estimate, and web storage management.

nodes.name: StorageThreads::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new StorageThreads instance by accepting three typed GenericSender channels for client storage, IndexedDB, and web storage thread communication.

nodes.name: StorageThreads::persist
nodes.summary: Requests that storage for the given origin be made persistent by forwarding a Persist message (with origin and permission grant status) to the client storage thread.

nodes.name: StorageThreads::webstorage_origins
nodes.summary: Retrieves the list of origin descriptors for a given WebStorageType by sending a ListOrigins message to the web storage thread and synchronously receiving the result.

nodes.name: StorageThreads::clear_webstorage_for_sites
nodes.summary: Clears web storage data for the specified sites by sending a ClearDataForSites message to the web storage thread. Collects site strings, creates a channel, sends the message, and waits for confirmation.

nodes.name: WebStorageType
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing between Session and Local web storage types.

nodes.name: OriginDescriptor
nodes.summary: Simple struct representing an origin descriptor with just a name field, used to identify storage origins for web storage management.

nodes.name: WebStorageThreadMsg
nodes.summary: Message enum for all web storage (localStorage/sessionStorage) operations dispatched to the background thread: Length, Key, Keys, GetItem, SetItem, RemoveItem, Clear, Clone (for sessionStorage cloning between browsing contexts), ListOrigins, ClearDataForSites, Exit, and CollectMemoryReport.

nodes.name: canvas_context.rs
nodes.summary: Main process implementation of GPUCanvasContext providing WebGPU canvas presentation, texture download, staging buffer management, and external image handling for the Servo browser engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust module managing GPU buffer lifecycle, texture-to-buffer copies, canvas present loops, and external image lock/unlock semantics for the WGPU backend.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the webgpu component; declares submodules, re-exports wgpu_core and wgpu_types, and provides the start_webgpu_thread entry point that spawns the WGPU worker thread.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust crate root with pub mod declarations, re-exports of external crates (wgpu_core as wgc, wgpu_types as wgt), and top-level thread spawning function gated by a preferences check.

nodes.name: poll_thread.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the WGPU poll thread with a Poller that parks when idle and repeatedly calls poll_all_devices to drive GPU work submission and completion callbacks.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses atomic work counting and thread parking/unparking to implement an efficient poll loop; WorkToken provides RAII-based work tracking.

nodes.name: wgpu_thread.rs
nodes.summary: Main WebGPU worker thread event loop that receives WebGPU commands via IPC channels, dispatches them to wgpu-core's Global API, and manages device lifecycle, error scopes, and resource creation/destruction.
nodes.languageNotes: Monolithic run() method (~1300 lines) handling a large match statement over WebGPURequest variants; manages device lost callbacks, adapter/device creation, compute/render pass dispatch, and resource cleanup.

nodes.name: StagingBuffer
nodes.summary: Wraps a GPU buffer with state tracking through the mapping lifecycle (Unassigned, Available, Mapping, Mapped) for canvas texture downloads.

nodes.name: MappedBuffer
nodes.summary: Holds a mapped GPU buffer's raw data pointer along with image metadata (size, format, opacity) for reading back rendered canvas content.

nodes.name: WebGpuExternalImages
nodes.summary: Thread-safe manager for locking and unlocking WebGPU external images, mapping context IDs to presentation data for compositing integration.

nodes.name: PresentationStagingBuffer
nodes.summary: Pairs an epoch identifier with a StagingBuffer for tracking in-progress presentation operations; supports reference-counted cleanup via maybe_destroy.

nodes.name: ContextData
nodes.summary: Per-context state holding the image key, canvas size, pool of inactive staging buffers, current presentation buffer, and an epoch counter for frame sequencing.

nodes.name: Poller
nodes.summary: Manages a dedicated thread that polls wgpu devices for completed work; uses atomic counters and thread parking to avoid busy-waiting when idle.

nodes.name: WorkToken
nodes.summary: RAII guard that increments the poller's work counter on creation and decrements it on drop, ensuring the poll thread stays awake while GPU work is pending.

nodes.name: DeviceScope
nodes.summary: Associates a GPU device ID with its owning pipeline and an error scope stack for WebGPU error propagation and push/pop error scope semantics.

nodes.name: WGPU
nodes.summary: Central WebGPU worker thread state holding IPC channels, the wgpu-core Global instance, device registry, paint API handle, external image map, and the Poller.

nodes.name: ensure_available
nodes.summary: Ensures a staging buffer is in the Available state by dropping or recreating the underlying GPU buffer to match the requested configuration.

nodes.name: prepare_load_texture_command_buffer
nodes.summary: Creates and records a GPU command buffer that copies a texture to a staging buffer, then finishes the encoder for submission to the queue.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Reads back mapped GPU buffer data into a Snapshot, handling row padding/stride to produce an unpadded pixel buffer for the compositor.

nodes.name: lock
nodes.summary: Locks a WebGPU external image by context ID, returning either the mapped buffer data or the current presentation snapshot for the compositor.

nodes.name: unlock
nodes.summary: Unlocks a previously locked WebGPU external image, destroying stale presentation buffers and cleaning up the locked ID from the tracking set.

nodes.name: get_or_make_available_buffer
nodes.summary: Finds or creates an available staging buffer from the inactive pool, preferring preallocated compatible buffers and falling back to unassigned ones.

nodes.name: destroy
nodes.summary: Destroys a context by sending FreeBuffer messages for all staging buffers to the script thread and removing the associated paint image.

nodes.name: replace_presentation
nodes.summary: Atomically replaces the current presentation staging buffer with a new one, destroying the previous one if it exists to avoid resource leaks.

nodes.name: create_context
nodes.summary: Creates a new WebGPU canvas context by initializing ContextData with buffer IDs and registering it in the global context map under the given context ID.

nodes.name: set_image_key
nodes.summary: Associates an ImageKey with a WebGPU context and registers or updates the external image descriptor in the compositor's paint API.

nodes.name: get_image
nodes.summary: Retrieves the current image for a WebGPU context: either the mapped buffer snapshot, the presentation buffer contents, or a cleared placeholder; sends result via a channel.

nodes.name: present
nodes.summary: Presents a WebGPU canvas frame by updating the compositor image, handling both direct (already-mapped) presentation and async texture download paths.

nodes.name: texture_download
nodes.summary: Initiates an asynchronous GPU texture-to-buffer copy, mapping the staging buffer and scheduling a callback to deliver the downloaded pixel data.

nodes.name: destroy_context
nodes.summary: Removes and destroys a WebGPU context from the global map, cleaning up all associated staging buffers and paint resources.

nodes.name: start_webgpu_thread
nodes.summary: Entry point that checks the WebGPU preference, creates IPC channels, and spawns the WGPU worker thread running the WGPU::run event loop.
nodes.languageNotes: Gated behind pref!(dom_webgpu_enabled); returns None early if preference is disabled or channel creation fails.

nodes.name: poll_all_devices
nodes.summary: Calls wgpu Global::poll_all_devices under a mutex lock, updating the more_work flag based on whether all device queues are empty.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs the WGPU worker state by initializing the wgpu-core Global instance with backend selection, instance flags, and the Poller thread.
nodes.languageNotes: WGPU::new constructor; selects GPU backend from preferences, configures wgpu InstanceDescriptor, and initializes the poller and device registry.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Main event loop processing WebGPURequest messages from the receiver channel; dispatches adapter/device/buffer/texture/command-encoder/compute-pass/render-pass operations to wgpu-core.
nodes.languageNotes: Massive match statement (~1300 lines) covering 40+ WebGPURequest variants; handles device lost callbacks, push/pop error scope, and resource lifecycle management.

nodes.name: dispatch_error
nodes.summary: Routes a WebGPU error to the appropriate error scope on the device's scope stack, or sends an UncapturedError message to the script thread if no scope matches.

nodes.name: common.rs
nodes.summary: Provides shared utility functions for the crown Rust compiler linting plugin, including DefId path matching, derive-expansion detection, inter-crate trait lookup, and trait-implementation checks borrowed from clippy.

nodes.name: main.rs
nodes.summary: Entry point for the crown compiler plugin binary that wraps rustc via RUSTC_WRAPPER, conditionally registers notrace and unrooted-must-root lints based on feature flags, and drives compilation through rustc_driver.

nodes.name: trace_in_no_trace.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the deny-level trace_in_no_trace compiler lint that prevents JSTraceable (JS-managed) types from being stored inside must_not_have_traceable-marked wrapper structs, walking both struct fields and enum variant tuples.

nodes.name: unrooted_must_root.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the deny-level unrooted_must_root compiler lint that enforces safe usage of unrooted JS-managed pointers across structs, enums, function arguments, trait-associated types, bindings, and cast expressions, with special-cased allow-lists for ref-like, boxed-in-constructors, and Rc wrappers.
nodes.languageNotes: Deeply nested match-def-path chains handle many standard-library container types as semantically ref-like; the lint walks HIR bodies to check function arguments, pattern bindings, and cast expressions.

nodes.name: match_def_path
nodes.summary: Checks whether a DefId's absolute path matches a given sequence of Symbol segments, comparing crate name and path components for equality.

nodes.name: in_derive_expn
nodes.summary: Returns true when the given span originates from a derive-macro expansion, used to skip lint checks inside auto-generated code.

nodes.name: find_first_crate
nodes.summary: Scans the compilation unit's crate list and returns the CrateNum for the first crate whose name matches the given symbol.

nodes.name: trait_in_crate
nodes.summary: Finds a trait definition within a specific crate by iterating the crate's trait list and matching the trait's name symbol.

nodes.name: implements_trait
nodes.summary: Public convenience wrapper that checks whether a type implements a trait by delegating to the more general implements_trait_with_env_from_iter with the current LateContext typing environment.

nodes.name: implements_trait_with_env_from_iter
nodes.summary: Core trait-implementation checker that builds a TraitRef with supplied generic arguments, erases inference variables, then evaluates the obligation through the type-inference context; returns true when the trait must-apply-modulo-regions.
nodes.languageNotes: Adapted from clippy's common utility helpers; handles regional escape and uses evaluate_obligation with must_apply_modulo_regions check.

nodes.name: MyCallbacks
nodes.summary: Unit struct implementing rustc_driver::Callbacks whose config hook conditionally registers the unrooted-must-root and trace-in-no-trace lints based on feature flags, skipping proc-macro crates.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Binary entry point that initializes rustc logging, strips the 'rustc' wrapper argument when invoked via RUSTC_WRAPPER, injects a cfg(crown) flag, and runs the compiler with MyCallbacks.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers the TRACE_IN_NO_TRACE and EMPTY_TRACE_IN_NO_TRACE lints with the compiler's lint store and installs the NotracePass late-lint-pass.

nodes.name: NotracePass
nodes.summary: Lint pass struct holding pre-resolved Symbols used to check that must_not_have_traceable wrappers do not store JSTraceable types.

nodes.name: get_must_not_have_traceable
nodes.summary: Parses the must_not_have_traceable attribute from a type's attribute list and extracts the generic-position index (defaulting to 0 for no-argument form), returning the index of the type parameter that must be non-traceable.

nodes.name: incorrect_no_trace
nodes.summary: Walks the generic type tree looking for ADTs that have the must_not_have_traceable annotation; when found, checks whether the indicated inner type is primitive (emitting EMPTY_TRACE_IN_NO_TRACE) or JSTraceable (emitting TRACE_IN_NO_TRACE denial).

nodes.name: check_item
nodes.summary: LateLintPass check_item hook: for every struct definition, iterates its fields and runs incorrect_no_trace on each field's type to validate NoTrace wrapper usage.

nodes.name: check_variant
nodes.summary: LateLintPass check_variant hook: for tuple enum variants, iterates tuple fields and runs incorrect_no_trace on each, catching NoTrace misuse inside enums.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers the UNROOTED_MUST_ROOT deny-level lint and installs the UnrootedPass late-lint-pass into the compiler's lint store.

nodes.name: UnrootedPass
nodes.summary: Lint pass struct holding pre-resolved Symbols used to enforce that must_root-annotated types are properly rooted across structs, enums, function signatures, pattern bindings, and casts.

nodes.name: associated_type_has_attr
nodes.summary: Walks a type's generic arguments looking for ADTs or type aliases that carry a specific crown annotation (e.g., must_root or allow_unrooted_interior) on the associated type itself.

nodes.name: is_unrooted_ty
nodes.summary: Recursively walks a type to determine if it or any nested type is unrooted (marked with must_root). Handles many special cases: Rc<T> checks allow_unrooted_in_rc, Box<T> is allowed only inside constructors, and ref-like containers (Ref, RefMut, Iter, Entry variants, slice iterators) are treated as opaque borrows.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive match-def-path chains special-case many std/alloc types; the walker skips current subtrees when an allow annotation is found to avoid false positives.

nodes.name: check_item
nodes.summary: LateLintPass check_item hook: for struct definitions that lack must_root/allow_unrooted_interior themselves, iterates fields and emits UNROOTED_MUST_ROOT when any field type is unrooted, requiring the struct to propagate the annotation.

nodes.name: check_variant
nodes.summary: LateLintPass check_variant hook: for tuple enum variants whose parent enum is not must_root-annotated, iterates fields and emits UNROOTED_MUST_ROOT when any field type is unrooted.

nodes.name: check_trait_item
