nodes.summary: LateLintPass check_trait_item hook: for associated-type declarations in traits, traverses all non-blanket implementations and verifies that must_root, allow_unrooted_interior, and allow_unrooted_in_rc annotations match between the trait declaration and each impl, emitting lint violations on mismatch.
nodes.languageNotes: Drives the associated_type_has_attr check across every impl of the trait, comparing three annotation flags independently and emitting specific error messages for each mismatch direction.

nodes.name: check_fn
nodes.summary: LateLintPass check_fn hook: validates that function arguments are not unrooted types (unless inside derive macros) with a special 'in_new_function' flag that allows Box<T> in constructors named new/new_*/default/Wrap. Also spawns a FnDefVisitor to check expressions inside the function body.

nodes.name: FnDefVisitor
nodes.summary: Intra-procedural HIR visitor for checking individual expressions and pattern bindings inside function bodies for unrooted types, carrying a reference to Symbols, the lint context, and the in_new_function flag.

nodes.name: visit_expr
nodes.summary: Visitor method that checks cast expressions for unrooted types (trait casts from must_root types are forbidden) and recursively walks sub-expressions; future extension points for assignment and call checking are commented out.

nodes.name: visit_pat
nodes.summary: Visitor method that detects pattern bindings (by-value or by-mut without ref) that move unrooted types onto the stack, emitting UNROOTED_MUST_ROOT lint violations for each such binding.

nodes.name: datachannel.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the core data types for WebRTC data channels, including message and state enums, the DataChannelInit configuration struct, and the DataChannelEvent enum for signaling.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the Servo WebRTC module. Declares submodules (datachannel, thread), re-exports public types, and defines core traits (WebRtcControllerBackend, WebRtcSignaller, WebRtcBackend), error types, and protocol enums (SdpType, BundlePolicy, signaling/gathering/ICE states).

nodes.name: thread.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the WebRtcController struct that serves as the client-facing entry point, dispatching all WebRTC operations to a dedicated event-loop thread via MPSC channels. Includes the RtcThreadEvent and InternalEvent enums and the handle_rtc_event dispatch function.

nodes.name: DataChannelMessage
nodes.summary: Enum representing a WebRTC data channel message payload, either Text (String) or Binary (Vec<u8>).

nodes.name: DataChannelState
nodes.summary: Enum modeling the WebRTC RTCDataChannelState with Connecting, Open, Closing, Closed, and __Unknown fallback variants.

nodes.name: DataChannelEvent
nodes.summary: Enum representing events that can occur on a data channel: NewChannel, Open, Close, Error (with WebRtcError), OnMessage, and StateChange.

nodes.name: DataChannelInit
nodes.summary: Configuration struct for initializing a WebRTC data channel, with fields for label, ordering, retransmission, protocol negotiation, and channel ID. Implements Default using a UUID-based label.

nodes.name: default
nodes.summary: Default implementation for DataChannelInit that generates a UUID v4 label, sets ordered to true, and leaves optional fields as None.

nodes.name: WebRtcError
nodes.summary: Error enum for WebRTC operations with a single Backend(String) variant. Implements From<T: Display> for generalized error conversion.

nodes.name: WebRtcControllerBackend
nodes.summary: Trait defining the interface that WebRTC backends must implement. Covers session description negotiation (offer/answer), ICE candidate handling, media stream attachment, data channel lifecycle, internal event processing, and shutdown.
nodes.languageNotes: Trait with 12 required methods covering the full WebRTC peer connection lifecycle. Uses Box<dyn FnOnce> callbacks for async result delivery.

nodes.name: WebRtcSignaller
nodes.summary: Trait for WebRTC signaling callbacks. Provides hooks for ICE candidate events, negotiation needed, stream additions, and state updates (signaling, gathering, ICE connection, data channel events) with default no-op implementations for state updates.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the observer pattern with default no-op method implementations for signaling/gathering/ICE state updates and data channel events, so backends only override what they need.

nodes.name: WebRtcBackend
nodes.summary: Trait for WebRTC backend implementations with an associated Controller type and a factory method construct_webrtc_controller that wires a signaller to a controller.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an associated type Controller: WebRtcControllerBackend + 'static to let each backend define its own concrete controller type.

nodes.name: SdpType
nodes.summary: Enum representing WebRTC SDP types: Answer, Offer, Pranswer, and Rollback. Implements as_str() for string conversion and FromStr for parsing.

nodes.name: DescriptionType
nodes.summary: Simple enum distinguishing between Local and Remote session descriptions.

nodes.name: SessionDescription
nodes.summary: Struct representing an RTCSessionDescription with an SDP type and the SDP body string.

nodes.name: IceCandidate
nodes.summary: Struct representing an RTCIceCandidate with SDP m-line index and candidate string. Noted as incomplete with missing fields.

nodes.name: BundlePolicy
nodes.summary: Enum for WebRTC bundle policy: Balanced, MaxCompat, MaxBundle. Implements as_str() for string conversion.

nodes.name: SignalingState
nodes.summary: Enum modeling WebRTC signaling states: Stable, HaveLocalOffer, HaveRemoteOffer, HaveLocalPranswer, HaveRemotePranswer, Closed.

nodes.name: GatheringState
nodes.summary: Enum modeling ICE gathering states: New, Gathering, Complete.

nodes.name: IceConnectionState
nodes.summary: Enum modeling ICE connection states: New, Checking, Connected, Completed, Disconnected, Failed, Closed.

nodes.name: WebRtcController
nodes.summary: Client-facing entry point for all WebRTC interactions. Wraps an MPSC channel sender and delegates operations to a dedicated event-loop thread. Provides methods for configuration, session negotiation, ICE candidate management, media streams, and data channel lifecycle.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an actor-like pattern: all public methods send RtcThreadEvent messages to a dedicated thread via MPSC channel, ensuring thread-safe serialized access to the backend.

nodes.name: RtcThreadEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of all commands that can be sent to the WebRTC event-loop thread: STUN configuration, session description operations, ICE candidate management, offer/answer creation, media stream and data channel operations, internal events, and quit.

nodes.name: InternalEvent
nodes.summary: Enum for backend-to-self signaling on the event loop, including negotiation-needed, ICE candidate events, stream additions, data channel events, description-added (with callback), and signaling/gathering/ICE state updates.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructor for WebRtcController. Creates an MPSC channel, instantiates the backend controller via T::construct_webrtc_controller, spawns a dedicated thread running the handle_rtc_event event loop, and returns the controller handle.

nodes.name: handle_rtc_event
nodes.summary: Core event-loop dispatch function that matches on RtcThreadEvent variants and delegates to the corresponding backend controller method. Returns false on Quit to signal loop termination, and logs errors from backend calls.

nodes.name: blocklist.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Web Bluetooth blocklist specification, parsing a GATT blocklist resource file and providing thread-local lookup to determine if a UUID is blocklisted for reads, writes, or all operations.

nodes.name: BluetoothBlocklist
nodes.summary: Newtype struct wrapping an optional HashMap that maps Bluetooth UUID strings to their blocklist exclusion type, implementing the Web Bluetooth blocklist algorithm.

nodes.name: Blocklist
nodes.summary: Enum representing blocklist exclusion categories: All (both reads and writes), Reads only, or Writes only, per the Web Bluetooth specification.

nodes.name: uuid_is_blocklisted
nodes.summary: Public entry point that checks whether a Bluetooth UUID is blocklisted for a given exclusion type by delegating to the thread-local blocklist instance.

nodes.name: BluetoothBlocklist::is_blocklisted
nodes.summary: Checks if a UUID is fully blocklisted for all operations by looking it up in the internal map and verifying its exclusion type is All.

nodes.name: BluetoothBlocklist::is_blocklisted_for_reads
nodes.summary: Checks if a UUID is blocklisted for read operations by verifying its exclusion type is either All or Reads.

nodes.name: BluetoothBlocklist::is_blocklisted_for_writes
nodes.summary: Checks if a UUID is blocklisted for write operations by verifying its exclusion type is either All or Writes.

nodes.name: parse_blocklist
nodes.summary: Parses the GATT blocklist resource file line by line, validating UUID format with regex, classifying each entry as All/Reads/Writes, and building the blocklist HashMap per the Web Bluetooth specification algorithm.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the shared Bluetooth module, declaring the blocklist and scanfilter submodules and defining all core Bluetooth message types, request/response enums, and type aliases for inter-process communication.

nodes.name: BluetoothError
nodes.summary: Enum representing Bluetooth operation errors including Type, Network, NotFound, NotSupported, Security, and InvalidState.

nodes.name: GATTType
nodes.summary: Enum categorizing GATT hierarchy types: PrimaryService, Characteristic, IncludedService, and Descriptor.

nodes.name: BluetoothDeviceMsg
nodes.summary: Message struct carrying Bluetooth device properties including id and optional name for IPC serialization.

nodes.name: BluetoothServiceMsg
nodes.summary: Message struct representing a GATT service with UUID, primary flag, and instance ID for IPC.

nodes.name: BluetoothCharacteristicMsg
nodes.summary: Message struct carrying GATT characteristic metadata including UUID, instance ID, and all characteristic property flags (broadcast, read, write, notify, indicate, etc.) for IPC.

nodes.name: BluetoothDescriptorMsg
nodes.summary: Message struct containing a GATT descriptor's UUID and instance ID for IPC serialization.

nodes.name: BluetoothRequest
nodes.summary: Enum representing all possible Bluetooth API requests sent via IPC, including device requests, GATT server operations, characteristic read/write, notification management, and advertisement watching.

nodes.name: BluetoothResponse
nodes.summary: Enum representing all possible Bluetooth API response messages sent back via IPC, mirroring the request variants with corresponding result types.

nodes.name: scanfilter.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Web Bluetooth scan filter data structures including ServiceUUIDSequence, BluetoothScanfilter, BluetoothScanfilterSequence, and RequestDeviceoptions, with validation logic for filter validity.

nodes.name: ServiceUUIDSequence
nodes.summary: Newtype struct wrapping a Vec of service UUID strings, used for optional services in Bluetooth device requests.

nodes.name: BluetoothScanfilter
nodes.summary: Struct representing a single Bluetooth scan filter with optional device name, name prefix, required services, and optional manufacturer/service data matching criteria.

nodes.name: BluetoothScanfilterSequence
nodes.summary: Newtype struct wrapping a Vec of BluetoothScanfilter objects, representing an ordered sequence of scan filters for device matching.

nodes.name: RequestDeviceoptions
nodes.summary: Struct encapsulating the parameters for a Bluetooth device request, including a WebViewId, a sequence of scan filters, and optional services to access.

nodes.name: BluetoothScanfilter::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new BluetoothScanfilter with the given name, name prefix, services list, and optional manufacturer and service data.

nodes.name: BluetoothScanfilter::is_empty_or_invalid
nodes.summary: Validates whether the scan filter is either completely empty (no criteria set) or has a name/name-prefix exceeding the 29-byte Bluetooth advertisement length limit.

nodes.name: BluetoothScanfilterSequence::get_services_set
nodes.summary: Computes the union of all service UUID sets across every filter in the sequence by flattening and collecting into a HashSet.

nodes.name: RequestDeviceoptions::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new RequestDeviceoptions with a WebViewId, scan filter sequence, and optional services sequence.

nodes.name: RequestDeviceoptions::get_services_set
nodes.summary: Computes the combined set of service UUIDs from both the scan filters and optional services using set union.

nodes.name: canvas.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the core Canvas 2D rendering types for the Servo browser engine, including the Path type for vector drawing operations, gradient and surface fill styles, composition and blending modes, line styles, canvas commands, and text rendering data structures.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive use of serde Serialize/Deserialize derives for IPC, kurbo for bezier path math, and strum for enum string conversions.

nodes.name: Path
nodes.summary: A wrapper around kurbo's BezPath that implements the HTML Canvas 2D path API including move_to, line_to, bezier curves, arcs, ellipses, rectangles, and hit-testing with fill rule support.

nodes.name: FillRule
nodes.summary: Enum representing the Canvas fill rule: Nonzero (winding) or Evenodd, used for determining point-in-path inclusion.

nodes.name: CompositionOptions
nodes.summary: Struct holding the alpha value and composition/blending operation used for canvas compositing operations.

nodes.name: ShadowOptions
nodes.summary: Struct for canvas shadow parameters including offset, blur radius, and color, with a method to determine if a shadow should actually be drawn per the HTML spec.

nodes.name: LineOptions
nodes.summary: Struct holding line style options for canvas stroke operations: width, cap style, join style, miter limit, dash pattern, and dash offset.

nodes.name: CanvasCommand
nodes.summary: Large enum representing all 2D canvas rendering commands sent via IPC, including draw operations (images, paths, text, rectangles), transformations, clipping, image data read/write, and batch message processing.

nodes.name: CanvasGradientStop
nodes.summary: Struct defining a single color stop in a canvas gradient, with an offset and an absolute color value.

nodes.name: LinearGradientStyle
nodes.summary: Represents a linear gradient fill style defined by start and end points with color stops, used in canvas fill and stroke operations.

nodes.name: RadialGradientStyle
nodes.summary: Represents a radial gradient fill style defined by two circles (center and radius) with color stops, used in canvas fill and stroke operations.

nodes.name: SurfaceStyle
nodes.summary: Represents a surface-based fill style (pattern) defined by surface data, size, repeat modes, and an affine transform, used as a canvas fill source.

nodes.name: FillOrStrokeStyle
nodes.summary: Enum representing the fill or stroke style of a canvas context: a solid color, linear gradient, radial gradient, or surface pattern. Includes methods to detect zero-size gradients and determine rendering bounds.

nodes.name: LineCapStyle
nodes.summary: Enum for canvas line cap styles: Butt, Round, or Square, with string serialization via strum.

nodes.name: LineJoinStyle
nodes.summary: Enum for canvas line join styles: Round, Bevel, or Miter, with string serialization via strum.

nodes.name: RepetitionStyle
nodes.summary: Enum for canvas pattern repetition modes: Repeat, RepeatX, RepeatY, or NoRepeat, with kebab-case string serialization.

nodes.name: CompositionStyle
nodes.summary: Enum for Porter-Duff compositing operators per the Compositing spec, including Clear, Copy, SourceOver, DestinationOver, and other blend modes.

nodes.name: BlendingStyle
nodes.summary: Enum for blending modes per the Compositing spec, including Multiply, Screen, Overlay, and other separable blend modes.

nodes.name: CompositionOrBlending
nodes.summary: Enum combining composition and blending operations into a single type, with FromStr parsing that tries composition first then blending, defaulting to SourceOver.

nodes.name: GlyphAndPosition
nodes.summary: Struct mapping a glyph ID to its 2D position in a text run, used for canvas text rendering.

nodes.name: CanvasFont
nodes.summary: Represents a font used in canvas text rendering, identified by FontIdentifier with optional web font data, providing a method to resolve font data and indices.

nodes.name: TextRun
nodes.summary: Represents a single text run in canvas rendering, containing font reference, point size, glyph positions, advance width, and bounding rectangle.

nodes.name: ensure_there_is_a_subpath
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML Canvas spec's 'ensure there is a subpath' algorithm: creates a new subpath starting at (x,y) using move_to if the path is empty.

nodes.name: close_path
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML Canvas closePath method by closing the current subpath and marking the 'need new subpath' flag.

nodes.name: move_to
nodes.summary: Moves the current path point to (x,y), validating coordinates are finite first, returning an error if not.

nodes.name: line_to
nodes.summary: Draws a line from the current point to (x,y), ensuring a subpath exists first and validating coordinate finiteness.

nodes.name: quadratic_curve_to
nodes.summary: Adds a quadratic Bezier curve to the path from the current point to (x,y) using control point (cpx,cpy), with finite validation.

nodes.name: bezier_curve_to
nodes.summary: Adds a cubic Bezier curve to the path from the current point to (x,y) using two control points (cp1x,cp1y) and (cp2x,cp2y), with finite validation.

nodes.name: arc_to
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML Canvas arcTo method with full geometric arc computation including tangent point calculation, circle center derivation, and sweep angle determination using kurbo primitives.

nodes.name: arc
nodes.summary: Adds a circular arc to the path, delegating to ellipse() with equal radii, connecting from the current point to the arc start with a line.

nodes.name: ellipse
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML Canvas ellipse method with support for arbitrary rotation, partial arcs, counterclockwise direction, and angle normalization to handle angles exceeding 2*pi.

nodes.name: rect
nodes.summary: Adds a rectangular subpath defined by (x,y,width,height), creating a closed rectangle with move_to and line_to operations.

nodes.name: is_point_in_path
nodes.summary: Tests whether a given point lies within the current path using the specified fill rule (Nonzero or Evenodd), falling back to segment-based nearest-point checking when winding fails.

nodes.name: is_zero_size_gradient
nodes.summary: Checks whether a FillOrStrokeStyle gradient has zero effective size (identical endpoints or radii, or empty color stops), indicating it should not be rendered.

nodes.name: x_bound
nodes.summary: Returns the horizontal bound for a FillOrStrokeStyle surface pattern based on whether repeat-x is enabled; returns None for non-surface styles.

nodes.name: y_bound
nodes.summary: Returns the vertical bound for a FillOrStrokeStyle surface pattern based on whether repeat-y is enabled; returns None for non-surface styles.

nodes.name: from_str
nodes.summary: Parses a string into a CompositionOrBlending value by first attempting to match a CompositionStyle, then falling back to BlendingStyle.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the servo_canvas_traits library that declares the canvas and webgl submodules and defines the ConstellationCanvasMsg enum for inter-process canvas creation and teardown communication.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses #![deny(unsafe_code)] to enforce memory safety in the crate.

nodes.name: ConstellationCanvasMsg
nodes.summary: IPC message enum for the constellation to request canvas creation (with size and a reply sender) or request clean canvas exit via a confirmation channel.

nodes.name: webgl.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the complete WebGL IPC message and type system for the Servo browser engine, including the WebGL command enum with 170+ GL operations, WebXR commands, context management types, texture format descriptors, resource ID types, and GL capability limits for both WebGL1 and WebGL2.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a macro-based resource ID definition system with glow FFI mapping, serde for IPC serialization, and contains extensive GL enum parameter mappings.

nodes.name: WebGLChan
nodes.summary: Entry-point channel newtype wrapping a GenericSender for transmitting WebGLMsg messages to the WebGL renderer, providing a send method for message dispatch.

nodes.name: WebGLPipeline
nodes.summary: Wrapper type held by a Script Pipeline to obtain a cloned WebGLChan for sending messages to the WebGL thread within that pipeline.

nodes.name: WebGLCommandBacktrace
nodes.summary: Struct carrying debug information attached to each WebGL command, including a Rust backtrace and optional JavaScript backtrace string for error diagnosis.

nodes.name: WebGLThreads
nodes.summary: Manages the WebGL rendering threads, providing methods to create pipelines, exit cleanly, clear painter resources, and handle finished rendering notifications.

nodes.name: WebGLMsg
nodes.summary: Top-level WebGL IPC message enum with variants for context creation, resizing, removal, image key assignment, buffer swapping, WebGL command execution, WebXR commands, and clean exit.

nodes.name: GlType
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing between standard OpenGL (Gl) and OpenGL ES (Gles) backend API types for WebGL context creation.

nodes.name: WebGLCreateContextResult
nodes.summary: Result returned after creating a WebGL context, containing a command sender, hardware capability limits, supported GLSL version, and API type (GL or GLES).

nodes.name: WebGLVersion
nodes.summary: Enum representing WebGL API versions: WebGL1 (OpenGL ES 2.0 based) and WebGL2 (OpenGL ES 3.0 based), with spec documentation links.

nodes.name: WebGLSLVersion
nodes.summary: Struct holding the major and minor GLSL shader language version numbers supported by a WebGL context backend.

nodes.name: WebGLMsgSender
nodes.summary: Helper struct for sending WebGL commands to a specific context identified by WebGLContextId, providing methods for commands, resize, image key setting, and context removal.

nodes.name: TruncatedDebug
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper that provides a truncated Debug display for byte slices, limiting output to 512 bytes to prevent oversized debug output.

nodes.name: WebGLCommand
nodes.summary: Massive enum defining all WebGL commands that can be sent to the render thread, covering buffer management, shaders, textures, uniforms, framebuffers, drawing, queries, samplers, vertex arrays, and state management across WebGL1 and WebGL2.

nodes.name: WebXRCommand
nodes.summary: Enum for WebXR layer management commands executed on the WebGL thread due to thread affinity requirements: layer manager and layer creation/destruction, frame begin/end.

nodes.name: WebGLContextId
nodes.summary: Newtype struct wrapping a u64 as a unique WebGL context identifier, with bidirectional conversion to/from WebXR context IDs.

nodes.name: WebGLError
nodes.summary: Enum representing standard WebGL error codes: InvalidEnum, InvalidFramebufferOperation, InvalidOperation, InvalidValue, OutOfMemory, and ContextLost.

nodes.name: WebGLFramebufferBindingRequest
nodes.summary: Enum for framebuffer binding requests: either an Explicit framebuffer ID or the Default framebuffer.

nodes.name: ProgramLinkInfo
nodes.summary: Result struct returned after linking a WebGL shader program, containing link status, counts of active attributes, uniforms, and uniform blocks, plus transform feedback configuration.

nodes.name: ActiveAttribInfo
nodes.summary: Information about an active vertex shader attribute including its name, size, data type, and location index.

nodes.name: ActiveUniformInfo
nodes.summary: Information about an active shader uniform variable including base name, size, data type, and optional uniform block binding index, with a name() method for constructing the display name with array suffix.

nodes.name: ActiveUniformBlockInfo
nodes.summary: Information about an active uniform block in a shader program, containing the block name and its data size in bytes.

nodes.name: SizedDataType
nodes.summary: Enum of sized data types used for texture data storage: Int8, Int16, Int32, Uint8, Uint16, Uint32, and Float32.

nodes.name: AlphaTreatment
nodes.summary: Enum for alpha channel handling in texture/image operations: Premultiply or Unmultiply the alpha channel.

nodes.name: YAxisTreatment
nodes.summary: Enum for Y-axis orientation handling in image data: use AsIs (origin at bottom-left, OpenGL convention) or Flipped (origin at top-left).

nodes.name: GLContextAttributes
nodes.summary: Configuration struct for WebGL context creation, controlling alpha, depth, stencil, antialiasing, premultiplied alpha, and preserve drawing buffer settings.

nodes.name: GLLimits
nodes.summary: Comprehensive struct of 40 WebGL hardware capability limits queried from the GL backend, including maximum texture sizes, uniform counts, vertex attributes, draw buffers, uniform buffer bindings, and timing parameters.

nodes.name: webgl_channel
nodes.summary: Helper function that creates a typed WebGL communication channel (sender/receiver pair) using the servo generic_channel infrastructure for serializable message types.

nodes.name: clear_painter_resources
nodes.summary: Frees all WebGL resources associated with a specific painter ID by sending a ClearPainterResources message and synchronously waiting for acknowledgment via a dedicated channel.

nodes.name: to_unsized
nodes.summary: Converts a sized (internal-format-specific) texture format to its unsized base format (e.g., RGBA8 to RGBA, RGB16f to RGB, DepthComponent32f to DepthComponent), with a comprehensive match covering all GL texture formats.

nodes.name: compatible_data_types
nodes.summary: Returns the set of TexDataType values compatible with a given texture format, handling special rules for packed types (UnsignedShort565, UnsignedShort4444, etc.), float formats, integer formats, and compressed formats.

nodes.name: required_webgl_version
nodes.summary: Returns the minimum WebGL version required for a given texture parameter; most parameters require WebGL2 while basic texture wrap modes and max anisotropy work with WebGL1.

nodes.name: components
nodes.summary: Returns the number of color components for a texture format (1 for single-channel, 2 for RG/DepthStencil/LuminanceAlpha, 3 for RGB, 4 for RGBA).

nodes.name: is_compressed
nodes.summary: Checks whether a texture format uses GPU-native block compression (S3TC DXT1/3/5, ETC1/2, ATC, ASTC variants) by inspecting the GL constant value range.

nodes.name: is_sized
nodes.summary: Determines whether a texture format is a sized internal format that includes bit depth information, excluding unsized base formats and compressed/special formats.

nodes.name: required_webgl_version
nodes.summary: Returns the minimum WebGL version required for a texture format, with S3TC compressed formats available in WebGL1 and most others requiring WebGL2.

nodes.name: sized_data_type
nodes.summary: Maps each texture data type to its corresponding SizedDataType (e.g., Byte to Int8, UnsignedShort to Uint16, Float to Float32), handling all packed and special GL data type variants.

nodes.name: element_size
nodes.summary: Returns the size in bytes of each element for a texture data type: 1 byte for byte/unsigned_byte, 2 bytes for shorts/half-floats/packed 16-bit types, 4 bytes for ints/floats/packed 32-bit types.

nodes.name: components_per_element
nodes.summary: Returns the number of components packed into a single element for a texture data type (e.g., UnsignedShort565 has 3, UnsignedShort4444 has 4, most others have 1).

nodes.name: required_webgl_version
nodes.summary: Returns the minimum WebGL version required for a texture data type; basic types like UnsignedByte, Float, and packed 16-bit types work with WebGL1, while newer types require WebGL2.

nodes.name: name
nodes.summary: Constructs the display name for an active uniform, appending array brackets with the array size when the uniform is an array type, otherwise returning the base name as a borrowed string.

nodes.name: encoding.rs
nodes.summary: Provides URL query string encoding that wraps nonmappable code points in %26%23 and %3B delimiters per the WHATWG URL specification, using encoding_rs for character encoding conversion.

nodes.name: encode_as_url_query_string
nodes.summary: Encodes a string for use in URL query strings via the given encoding, handling unmappable characters by wrapping them in %26%23 and %3B escapes per the URL spec's percent-encode-after-encoding algorithm.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for servo_url, defining the ServoUrl wrapper type around url::Url with Servo-specific features including origin handling, secure context checks, debug formatting, and about:blank matching per web specifications.

nodes.name: UrlError
nodes.summary: Error enum representing failures from URL mutation operations including setting username, IP host, password, and file path conversions.

nodes.name: ServoUrl
nodes.summary: An Arc-wrapped Url type providing Servo-specific URL operations including origin derivation, secure scheme checking, debug compaction, about:blank matching, and potentially-trustworthy URL evaluation.

nodes.name: parse_with_base
nodes.summary: Parses a URL string relative to an optional base ServoUrl, returning a new ServoUrl or a parse error.

nodes.name: origin
nodes.summary: Derives an ImmutableOrigin from this URL, delegating to ImmutableOrigin::new for origin construction per web origin rules.

nodes.name: is_secure_scheme
nodes.summary: Returns true if the URL uses a cryptographically secure scheme (https or wss).

nodes.name: is_local_scheme
nodes.summary: Returns true if the URL uses a local scheme (about, blob, or data) per the Fetch specification.

nodes.name: is_special_scheme
nodes.summary: Returns true if the URL uses a special scheme (ftp, file, http, https, ws, wss) per the WHATWG URL specification.

nodes.name: is_equal_excluding_fragments
nodes.summary: Compares two ServoUrls for equivalence excluding their fragments, per the URL specification's URL-equivalence algorithm.

nodes.name: set_username
nodes.summary: Sets the username component of the URL, returning a UrlError on failure (e.g., if the URL cannot have credentials).

nodes.name: set_ip_host
nodes.summary: Sets the host to a raw IP address, returning a UrlError if the operation is not permitted on this URL.

nodes.name: set_password
nodes.summary: Sets or clears the password component of the URL, returning a UrlError if the URL does not support credentials.

nodes.name: set_fragment
nodes.summary: Sets or clears the fragment identifier of the URL via the mutable inner Url reference.

nodes.name: to_file_path
nodes.summary: Converts the URL to a filesystem path if the scheme is file, returning a UrlError on failure.

nodes.name: join
nodes.summary: Resolves a relative URL string against this ServoUrl, returning a new ServoUrl or a parse error.

nodes.name: from_file_path
nodes.summary: Constructs a ServoUrl from a filesystem path, returning a UrlError if the path cannot be represented as a file URL.

nodes.name: debug_compact
nodes.summary: Returns a shortened URL representation for debug display in constrained spaces, stripping scheme:// for http/https and showing only trailing path components for file URLs.

nodes.name: is_potentially_trustworthy
nodes.summary: Determines if the URL is potentially trustworthy per the Secure Contexts specification, checking about: URLs, data scheme, and delegating to origin-level trust evaluation.

nodes.name: matches_about_blank
nodes.summary: Determines if the URL matches about:blank per the HTML specification, checking scheme, path, empty credentials, and null host.

nodes.name: fmt
nodes.summary: Custom Debug formatter for ServoUrl that truncates long data URLs with a content hash to avoid flooding debug output.

nodes.name: origin.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the origin types for Servo's URL handling, including immutable and mutable origins, domain comparison, opaque origin tracking, and potentially-trustworthy origin evaluation per web security specifications.

nodes.name: ImmutableOrigin
nodes.summary: An enum representing an immutable web origin that is either Opaque (globally unique) or Tuple (scheme, host, port), providing origin comparison, trust evaluation, and URL origin conversion.

nodes.name: DomainComparable
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting domain-aware origin comparison, requiring has_domain and immutable accessors, implemented by OriginSnapshot and MutableOrigin.

nodes.name: OpaqueOrigin
nodes.summary: Struct representing an opaque origin with a unique UUID identifier and flags for secure-context data URL workers and file origin special handling.

nodes.name: OriginSnapshot
nodes.summary: A frozen snapshot of a MutableOrigin at a point in time, pairing an ImmutableOrigin with an optional domain, used for serialization and comparison.

nodes.name: MutableOrigin
nodes.summary: A reference-counted mutable origin wrapping an ImmutableOrigin with a RefCell-guarded optional domain, supporting domain mutation, snapshot conversion, and same-origin comparisons.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an ImmutableOrigin from a Url, creating opaque origins for file URLs and tuple origins from the Url's parsed origin data.

nodes.name: scheme
nodes.summary: Returns the scheme of a tuple origin, or None for opaque origins.

nodes.name: host
nodes.summary: Returns the host of a tuple origin, or None for opaque origins.

nodes.name: port
nodes.summary: Returns the port of a tuple origin, or None for opaque origins.

nodes.name: into_url_origin
nodes.summary: Converts this ImmutableOrigin into the url crate's Origin type, mapping Opaque to Origin::new_opaque and Tuple to Origin::Tuple.

nodes.name: is_file_origin
nodes.summary: Returns true if this is an opaque origin flagged as a file origin, used for special file URL handling per web specs.

nodes.name: is_for_data_worker_from_secure_context
nodes.summary: Returns true if this opaque origin was created from a data: URL worker in a secure context, enabling secure context inheritance.

nodes.name: is_potentially_trustworthy
nodes.summary: Evaluates whether the origin is potentially trustworthy per the Secure Contexts specification, handling opaque file origins, https/wss schemes, loopback IPs, and localhost domains.

nodes.name: ascii_serialization
nodes.summary: Produces the ASCII serialization of the origin per the HTML specification by converting to a url::Origin and delegating serialization.

nodes.name: same_origin_domain
nodes.summary: Compares two MutableOrigins for same-origin-domain equality, checking that both have matching domain values and scheme, or falling back to immutable origin comparison.

nodes.name: effective_domain
nodes.summary: Computes the effective domain per the HTML specification, returning the set domain if present or falling back to the origin's host for tuple origins, or None for opaque origins.

nodes.name: android.yml
nodes.summary: CI workflow that builds Servo for Android (aarch64, armv7, x86_64) using Gradle and the Android SDK/NDK, runs a smoketest on an emulator, uploads APK/AAR artifacts, and optionally triggers bencher performance tracking.

nodes.name: auto-merge-updates.yml
nodes.summary: Automatically approves and merges pull requests opened by dependabot or the WPT sync bot.

nodes.name: bencher.yml
nodes.summary: Reusable workflow that downloads build artifacts, extracts binaries, and runs performance benchmarks (file size, Speedometer, Dromaeo) with results sent to bencher.dev for tracking across PRs and main branch.

nodes.name: book-export.yml
nodes.summary: On push to main, checks for changes in Linux package lists, regenerates dependency files, and opens a PR on the servo/book repository to sync documentation.

nodes.name: dco-merge-group.yml
nodes.summary: Dummy DCO check workflow that triggers on merge_group events to enable GitHub merge queue functionality despite a known DCO app limitation.

nodes.name: dispatch-workflow.yml
nodes.summary: Central dispatch workflow that routes CI jobs to platform-specific workflows (linux, macos, macos-arm64, windows, android, ohos, lint) based on input parameters, enabling a single entry point for all CI runs.

nodes.name: docker.yml
nodes.summary: Builds multi-architecture (amd64/arm64) Docker devcontainer images, uploads them as artifacts, and publishes a multi-arch manifest to GitHub Container Registry (ghcr.io) on push to main.

nodes.name: docs.yml
nodes.summary: Builds Rust documentation with --document-private-items and force-pushes it to the gh-pages branch of servo/doc.servo.org on push to main.

nodes.name: lint.yml
nodes.summary: Reusable lint workflow that runs Clippy (with deny-warnings) and tidy checks on the Servo codebase, with optional self-hosted runner support.

nodes.name: linux-wpt.yml
nodes.summary: Runs Web Platform Tests on Linux with chunking across multiple runners, aggregates filtered and full logs, and reports intermittent test results to a dashboard.

nodes.name: linux.yml
nodes.summary: Primary Linux CI workflow that builds Servo with crown, runs smoketests/unit tests/devtools tests, packages the binary, optionally runs WPT and bencher benchmarks, builds libservo with MSRV, tests the C API, collects code coverage, and runs media examples.

nodes.name: mac-arm64.yml
nodes.summary: macOS Apple Silicon (arm64) CI workflow that builds Servo using sccache for faster compilation, creates a DMG package with smoketesting, runs unit tests and WPT, and optionally benchmarks and tests the C API.

nodes.name: mac-wpt.yml
nodes.summary: Runs Web Platform Tests on macOS (Intel or Apple Silicon) with chunking across 5 runners, merges filtered and full logs, and reports intermittent test results.

nodes.name: mac.yml
nodes.summary: macOS Intel CI workflow that builds Servo, creates a DMG package, runs smoketests/unit tests/WPT, and optionally benchmarks and tests the C API, with self-hosted runner support.

nodes.name: main.yml
nodes.summary: Main CI entry point triggered on push to main, PRs, and merge_group events. Uses a Python try-parser to generate a dynamic CI configuration matrix and dispatches to platform workflows via dispatch-workflow.yml.

nodes.name: ohos.yml
nodes.summary: OpenHarmony OS CI workflow that builds Servo for aarch64/x86_64 OHOS targets and aarch64 HarmonyOS, signs HAP packages, runs on-device hitrace benchmarks and Speedometer via a scenario test harness, and collects results from optional jobs.

nodes.name: pull-request-wpt-export.yml
nodes.summary: On PR events targeting main, checks out both the Servo PR and upstream WPT repository, then runs a Python export script to upstream WPT test changes.

nodes.name: release.yml
nodes.summary: Scheduled nightly and manual release workflow that builds production binaries for all platforms (Windows, macOS, macOS-arm64, Linux, Android, OHOS), creates draft GitHub releases, uploads artifacts with attestations, publishes nightly releases, and optionally publishes to crates.io.

nodes.name: scheduled-wpt-import.yml
nodes.summary: Weekly scheduled workflow (Sunday) that runs the full Linux WPT suite, syncs test expectations from upstream, amends the commit with test results, and opens a PR to merge WPT metadata updates.

nodes.name: try-label.yml
nodes.summary: Triggered when a T-* label is added to a PR; collects labels, parses them into a CI configuration using the try parser, dispatches platform builds, and posts a result comment summarizing success or failure.

nodes.name: try.yml
nodes.summary: Push-to-try-branch workflow that parses a JSON configuration from the commit message (or falls back to full CI), dispatches platform builds via dispatch-workflow.yml, and merges build timing results.

nodes.name: windows.yml
nodes.summary: Windows CI workflow that builds Servo (MSVC), creates an MSI installer and ZIP package, runs smoketests and unit tests, and optionally benchmarks and tests the C API, with ccache and self-hosted runner support.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Builds Servo Android APK and AAR for aarch64, armv7, and x86_64 targets, installs Android SDK/NDK and JDK 17, signs the APK, runs an x86_64 emulator smoketest, and uploads build artifacts.

nodes.name: auto-merge
nodes.summary: Approves and enables auto-merge for PRs from dependabot or servo-wpt-sync using the GitHub CLI.

nodes.name: bencher
nodes.summary: Downloads and extracts platform build artifacts, runs file size and performance benchmarks (Speedometer, Dromaeo), and sends merged results to bencher.dev for tracking against baseline.

nodes.name: upstream
nodes.summary: Detects changes in Linux package lists, regenerates dependency docs, commits to the servo/book repo, and opens a PR for the documentation sync.

nodes.name: DCO
nodes.summary: No-op DCO job that satisfies the merge_group event requirement to enable GitHub merge queues.

nodes.name: devcontainer_ubuntu_build
nodes.summary: Builds Docker devcontainer images for both amd64 and arm64 platforms, saves them as tar archives, and uploads as artifacts for the publish job.

nodes.name: devcontainer_ubuntu_publish
nodes.summary: Downloads platform images, pushes them to ghcr.io with per-arch tags, and publishes a multi-arch manifest list for the devcontainer.

nodes.name: upload-docs
nodes.summary: Bootstraps the build environment, compiles Rust documentation with --document-private-items, and force-pushes to the doc.servo.org gh-pages branch.

nodes.name: lint
nodes.summary: Runs Clippy with deny-warnings and GitHub annotations, then executes tidy checks across the full repository history for code quality enforcement.

nodes.name: linux-wpt
nodes.summary: Downloads the Linux binary, bootstraps WPT dependencies, runs web-platform-tests in parallel chunks with 2x timeout, and uploads both filtered and full test logs as artifacts.

nodes.name: report-test-results
nodes.summary: Merges WPT chunked logs, aggregates stable unexpected results, and reports intermittent test failures to the tracking dashboard via a Python script.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Core Linux build job that compiles Servo with crown, runs smoketests, script tests, unit tests (with nextest retries), devtools tests, packages the binary, and uploads cargo timing and release artifacts.

nodes.name: unit-test-coverage
nodes.summary: Runs unit tests with cargo-llvm-cov for code coverage, produces Codecov-compatible JSON reports, and uploads results to Codecov with the unittests flag.

nodes.name: media-examples
nodes.summary: Installs GStreamer media framework packages and runs all servo-media example binaries to validate multimedia functionality.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Builds Servo on macOS 15 Apple Silicon with sccache compilation caching, runs smoketests with retries, script tests, unit tests, creates a DMG package with smoketest validation, and uploads cargo timing and release artifacts.

nodes.name: mac-wpt
nodes.summary: Downloads the macOS binary, bootstraps the test environment, and runs WPT in 5 parallel chunks with 8x timeout multiplier, uploading filtered and full logs.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Builds Servo on macOS Intel with self-hosted runner support, runs smoketests (with retries), script tests, unit tests, creates and validates a DMG package, and uploads cargo timing and release artifacts.

nodes.name: decision
nodes.summary: Uses a sparse checkout and the Python try_parser.py to generate a dynamic CI configuration matrix determining which platform workflows to run based on the event type.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Iterates over the decision matrix and dispatches each configuration entry to the appropriate platform workflow via dispatch-workflow.yml with fail-fast support.

nodes.name: build-result
nodes.summary: Collects overall CI result by merging cargo build timing artifacts and failing the workflow if any upstream job failed or was cancelled.

nodes.name: build-openharmony
nodes.summary: Builds Servo for aarch64 and x86_64 OpenHarmony targets using the OHOS SDK, installs hvigor for HAP packaging, handles signing configuration, and uploads signed/unsigned HAP artifacts.

nodes.name: build-harmonyos-aarch64
nodes.summary: Builds Servo for aarch64 HarmonyOS on a self-hosted runner with hitrace tracing enabled, uploading the unsigned HAP artifact for downstream test jobs.

nodes.name: bench-harmonyos-aarch64
nodes.summary: Signs and installs the HarmonyOS HAP on a real device via hdc, runs hitrace-bench and Speedometer benchmarks, and posts combined results to bencher.dev with model-specific testbed identification.

nodes.name: scenario-test-harmonyos
nodes.summary: Installs the HarmonyOS HAP on a real device and runs Mossel scenario tests (page loading, redirection, slide interaction) using mitmproxy for network simulation, uploading failure screenshots on error.

nodes.name: upstream
nodes.summary: Clones the Servo PR and upstream WPT repository, then runs the Python WPT export script to upstream test changes to web-platform-tests/wpt.

nodes.name: create-draft-release
nodes.summary: Creates a draft GitHub release with a timestamp-based or custom tag, generating release notes for either nightly builds or regular versioned releases.

nodes.name: publish-nightly-release
nodes.summary: Publishes the draft release on success (marking as latest) or publishes as a pre-release on failure, using the GitHub API to toggle draft status.

nodes.name: publish-crates-io
nodes.summary: Publishes all Servo workspace crates to crates.io using OIDC authentication with automatic token renewal to handle large workspaces, with fail-on-timeout safety.

nodes.name: upload-vendored-source
nodes.summary: Generates a vendored source tarball of all Rust dependencies, creates a build provenance attestation, and uploads the archive to the GitHub release.

nodes.name: sync
nodes.summary: After the Linux WPT run completes, syncs test expectations from upstream WPT, amends metadata based on test results, and opens a PR to merge the WPT update.

nodes.name: parse-comment
nodes.summary: Collects T-* labels from a PR, removes them, converts to a try string, parses via try_parser.py into a CI configuration matrix, and posts a comment announcing the triggered try run.

nodes.name: run-try
nodes.summary: Iterates over the parsed try configuration matrix and dispatches each entry to the appropriate platform workflow via dispatch-workflow.yml.

nodes.name: results
nodes.summary: Evaluates required and optional job results, posts a PR comment with the try run outcome (success, partial success with optional failures, failure, or cancelled).

nodes.name: decision
nodes.summary: Parses an optional JSON configuration from the last line of the commit message on the try branch, or falls back to the full CI configuration from try_parser.py, with workflow_dispatch override support.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Dispatches each matrix entry from the decision configuration to the appropriate platform workflow via dispatch-workflow.yml.

nodes.name: build-result
nodes.summary: Merges cargo build timing artifacts and reports overall try run success or failure based on upstream job results.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Builds Servo on Windows (MSVC) with crown, ccache, and self-hosted runner support, runs smoketests and unit tests (with nextest retries), creates MSI/ZIP packages, and uploads cargo timing and release artifacts.

nodes.name: FUNDING.yml
nodes.summary: Specifies funding sponsorship options for the Servo project, linking to GitHub Sponsors (servo) and Open Collective (servo).

nodes.name: codecov.yml
nodes.summary: Codecov coverage reporting configuration that disables carryforward for all flags by default, ensuring coverage data is not carried between unrelated commits.

nodes.name: dependabot.yml
nodes.summary: Dependabot version updates configuration for the Cargo package ecosystem, scheduling daily dependency bumps with 15 grouped update sets (e.g., wgpu, tokio-rs, serde, zbus) and exclusion rules for stylo crates and semver-minor/major wgpu updates.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Dependabot v2 grouped-updates to batch related crate upgrades into a single PR per group, reducing CI churn from interdependent crates like tokio/tokio-stream/tokio-util or zbus/zvariant.

nodes.name: release.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub automatic release changelog configuration that excludes dependabot[bot] and servo-wpt-sync authors from generated release notes.

nodes.name: bug_report.md
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template for reporting bugs in the Servo browser engine. Includes sections for describing the bug, reproduction steps, and platform information.

nodes.name: feature_request.md
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template for suggesting new features in Servo. Includes a section for describing the proposed feature with links to relevant specifications.

nodes.name: roadmap.md
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template for tracking roadmap items in the Servo project. Collects description, affected area (e.g. Layout, Script, Performance), and assigned people for each roadmap task.

nodes.name: about-memory.html
nodes.summary: Internal browser page for about:memory that displays Servo's memory reports. Features JavaScript-driven collapsible tree view of explicit and non-explicit memory allocations, per-process breakdowns (main and content processes), and buttons to trigger memory measurement and forced garbage collection.

nodes.name: badcert.html
nodes.summary: TLS certificate error page displayed when Servo encounters an invalid or untrusted certificate. Offers a 'Go back' button and an 'Allow certificate temporarily' button that POSTs the certificate bytes to chrome:allowcert via XMLHttpRequest to temporarily bypass the error.

nodes.name: crash.html
nodes.summary: Simple crash error page displayed when the Servo browser engine crashes. Shows a 'Servo crashed!' message with a reload button and renders crash detail information from a template variable.

nodes.name: directory-listing.html
nodes.summary: Directory listing page for displaying file system directory contents in Servo. Uses a JavaScript setData function to populate a table with directory entries showing file type icons, names (as links), sizes, and last-modified timestamps, with a parent-directory navigation link.

nodes.name: gatt_blocklist.txt
nodes.summary: Blocklist of GATT UUIDs (services, characteristics, and descriptors) that websites using the Web Bluetooth API are forbidden from accessing. Sourced from the WebBluetoothCG registries, it blocks HID device access, firmware update services, privacy-sensitive characteristics, and serial number strings for security and privacy protection.

nodes.name: json-viewer.html
nodes.summary: Interactive JSON viewer page for rendering JSON responses in Servo. Provides syntax-highlighted, collapsible tree view for objects and arrays with Pretty/Raw toggle buttons, handling null, boolean, number, string, array, and object types with color-coded styling.

nodes.name: neterror.html
nodes.summary: Simple network error page displayed when Servo cannot load a requested URL. Shows a generic 'Could not load the requested page' message with the specific error reason injected from a template variable.

nodes.name: public_domains.txt
nodes.summary: The Public Suffix List (PSL), an 8,818-line registry of all known public domain suffixes (TLDs and second-level domains like co.uk). Used by Servo to determine domain boundaries for cookie scoping, same-origin policy, and security decisions.

nodes.name: html-mode.css
nodes.summary: Minimal user-agent stylesheet containing rules expected to apply only in HTML documents, specifically hiding form elements nested inside table-related elements per the HTML specification.

nodes.name: presentational-hints.css
nodes.summary: Maps legacy HTML presentational attributes (align, valign, border, frame, rules, nowrap, clear, etc.) to equivalent CSS properties for elements such as div, table, hr, img, iframe, embed, object, ol, li, p, and headings, implementing the HTML specification's presentational hints section.

nodes.name: quirks-mode.css
nodes.summary: Implements quirks-mode rendering rules from the HTML specification, including form margin defaults, table font inheritance resets, border-box sizing for text inputs, image alignment margins, and list-style-position adjustments.

nodes.name: user-agent.css
nodes.summary: Comprehensive form control and UI widget stylesheet defining appearance for all HTML input types (text, radio, checkbox, button, submit, reset, color, file, range), textarea, select, and button elements including hover/active/focus/disabled states, plus slider pseudo-elements, details/summary disclosure widgets, progress bars, and anonymous table box generics.
nodes.languageNotes: Leverages Servo-specific internal pseudo-elements (::-servo-text-control-inner-container, ::-servo-text-control-inner-editor) for text input layout. Uses pseudo-elements (::before, ::after) for checkbox/radio rendering. Contains FIXME notes about replacing pseudo-element hacks with UA shadow trees and enabling content-visibility.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo package manifest for the servo-profile crate, defining the library target (lib.rs), workspace-inherited metadata, and dependencies including platform-specific crates (mach2 for macOS profiling, libc for Unix systems, regex for Linux symbol demangling).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Cargo workspace inheritance for version, edition, and metadata. Platform-specific dependencies gated via target cfg expressions.

nodes.name: trace-dump-epilogue-1.html
nodes.summary: HTML template fragment that closes the JavaScript traces array (`];`), ends a script tag, and opens a subsequent script block â€” the third segment in the trace-dump HTML output assembly generated by Servo's profiling subsystem.

nodes.name: trace-dump-epilogue-2.html
nodes.summary: HTML template fragment that sets the sourceURL pragma for the trace viewer script (`trace-dump.js`), then closes the script, body, and html tags â€” the final segment in the trace-dump HTML output assembly.

nodes.name: trace-dump-prologue-1.html
nodes.summary: HTML template fragment containing the doctype declaration, opening html, head, and meta charset tags, and an opening style tag â€” the first segment in the trace-dump HTML output assembly into which the CSS stylesheet is inlined.

nodes.name: trace-dump-prologue-2.html
nodes.summary: HTML template fragment that closes the style tag, opens body and script tags, and initializes the `window.TRACES` JavaScript array â€” the second segment in the trace-dump HTML output assembly into which trace event JSON data is serialized.

nodes.name: trace-dump.css
nodes.summary: CSS stylesheet for the Servo trace-dump viewer providing layout styles for the timeline slider, colored trace category bars, hover tooltips with event details, and full-viewport flexbox layout â€” originally sourced from the fitzgen/servo-trace-dump repository.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses flexbox layout for the full-viewport trace viewer with CSS hover tooltips for showing trace event metadata.

nodes.name: SOURCES.txt
nodes.summary: Python egg-info manifest that enumerates all 172 source files included in the vendored PLY (Python Lex-Yacc) library distribution, covering the lexer, parser, examples, tests, and documentation.

nodes.name: dependency_links.txt
nodes.summary: Empty egg-info metadata file indicating that the vendored PLY library has no external dependency links.

nodes.name: top_level.txt
nodes.summary: Egg-info metadata file declaring 'ply' as the single top-level Python package name for the vendored PLY (Python Lex-Yacc) library.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive documentation for the Servo page load performance testing framework. Covers prerequisites, basic and advanced usage, CI setup for Servo and Gecko, how the TP5-based test works, comparing results before/after patches, adding custom sync/async tests, unit testing, and techniques for reducing measurement variance.

nodes.name: git_log_to_json.sh
nodes.summary: Shell script that outputs the latest git commit as a structured JSON object containing commit hash, subject line, and author metadata (name, email, timestamp). Used to capture the revision under test for performance result attribution.

nodes.name: prepare_manifest.sh
nodes.summary: Shell script that rewrites the TP5 performance test manifest by replacing bare localhost references with localhost:8000 URLs, adapting the upstream manifest for the local test server's port.

nodes.name: test_all.sh
nodes.summary: Orchestration shell script for running page load performance tests against Servo or Gecko engines. Parses command-line options for engine selection, submission mode, base URL, and date; starts a local HTTP server on a WPT-safe port; invokes the Python test runner; and optionally submits results to S3.

nodes.name: test_perf.sh
nodes.summary: Entry-point shell script for the performance testing pipeline. Downloads and unzips the TP5 test suite from talos-pagesets, clones or updates the WARC test repository, creates a Python virtual environment with boto3 and pywb dependencies, captures the current git revision as JSON, then delegates to test_all.sh for test execution followed by WARC-based tests.

nodes.name: devtools_parser_test.json
nodes.summary: JSONL test fixture containing a sequence of DevTools protocol messages simulating a browser debugging session, including connection, device description, tab listing, watcher setup, and resource monitoring exchanges.

nodes.name: install_macos_gstreamer.sh
nodes.summary: Shell script that downloads and installs GStreamer v1.22.2 runtime and development packages on macOS from the servo-build-deps GitHub releases.

nodes.name: memory_chart.html
nodes.summary: Interactive HTML page that visualizes Servo's hierarchical memory usage data over time using Chart.js line charts, with a dropdown selector to navigate memory categories.

nodes.name: transformData
nodes.summary: Transforms hierarchical memory report data into a Chart.js dataset format by following a path through the report tree and extracting numeric amounts, labeled for MiB usage display.

nodes.name: findData
nodes.summary: Navigates a nested memory report object tree by following a path string (exclamation-mark-delimited keys) to locate a specific memory category node.

nodes.name: makeOptions
nodes.summary: Populates the dropdown selector with hierarchical memory categories derived from report data keys, and wires up the onchange handler to redraw the chart for the selected category.

nodes.name: makeChart
nodes.summary: Renders a Chart.js line chart on the page with the provided dataset and title, replacing any existing chart canvas; configures responsive-off rendering with zero animation for static report display.

nodes.name: show-stale-intermittent-issues.sh
nodes.summary: Shell script that queries the GitHub API for Servo issues labeled I-intermittent with WPT-style titles, filters out recently updated ones, and reports issues that have had no cross-referenced activity for over a month.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo package configuration for the servo-capi crate, defining a C dynamic library (cdylib) that wraps the Servo rendering engine's Rust API via FFI for consumption by embedders in other languages.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Brief documentation describing the servo-capi crate as a C FFI wrapper for Servo's native Rust API, with testing instructions referencing the separate servo-capi-tests crate.

nodes.name: cbindgen.toml
nodes.summary: Configuration for cbindgen to generate C header files from Servo Rust types, specifying dependency parsing rules and renaming exported enums with a 'Servo' prefix for the C API.

nodes.name: frame_scoped.html
nodes.summary: Debugger test fixture that exercises scoped frame breakpoints by recursively scheduling a function via setTimeout.

nodes.name: loop.html
nodes.summary: Debugger test fixture that exercises loop breakpoints by incrementing a counter and re-scheduling itself via setTimeout.

nodes.name: stepping.html
nodes.summary: Debugger test fixture that exercises step-in/step-out behavior with nested function calls and recursive setTimeout scheduling.

nodes.name: test.html
nodes.summary: Main devtools sources test fixture exercising inline classic scripts, external classic scripts, inline module scripts, classic web workers, and a cross-origin external script to validate the sources panel lists all script sources correctly.

nodes.name: test_sources_list_with_classic_worker.html
nodes.summary: Devtools test fixture verifying that classic web workers created via inline scripts appear in the sources list alongside the inline classic script itself.

nodes.name: test_sources_list_with_data_external_module_script.html
nodes.summary: Devtools test fixture verifying that externally referenced module scripts (via src attribute) appear in the sources list.

nodes.name: test_sources_list_with_dynamic_import_module.html
nodes.summary: Devtools test fixture verifying that dynamically imported modules via import() expression appear in the sources list alongside the inline module script.

nodes.name: test_sources_list_with_module_worker.html
nodes.summary: Devtools test fixture verifying that module web workers created from an inline classic script appear in the sources list.

nodes.name: test_sources_list_with_static_import_module.html
nodes.summary: Devtools test fixture verifying that statically imported modules via import statement appear in the sources list alongside the inline module script.

nodes.name: inline_style.html
nodes.summary: Test fixture HTML page with an inline <style> block setting body background to red and h1 color to blue, used by Servo devtools stylesheet inspection tests.

nodes.name: linked_style.html
nodes.summary: Test fixture HTML page linking to an external stylesheet (styles.css) via a <link> tag, used by Servo devtools stylesheet inspection tests covering linked stylesheets.

nodes.name: styles.css
nodes.summary: Test fixture CSS stylesheet setting body background to green and font-size to small, referenced by the linked_style.html devtools test page.

nodes.name: apt_common.txt
nodes.summary: Lists the absolute minimum apt packages required to build Servo on Linux, including build tools, GStreamer multimedia libraries, X11 development headers, and graphics dependencies such as Vulkan and Mesa.

nodes.name: apt_ubuntu_only.txt
nodes.summary: Lists the single apt package (libgstreamer-plugins-good1.0-dev) that is only available on Ubuntu and not on Debian, supplementing the common package list for Ubuntu-specific builds.

nodes.name: wpt.txt
nodes.summary: Lists additional apt packages required for running Web Platform Tests (WPT), including Mesa Vulkan drivers, CJK fonts, and DejaVu extra fonts, with references to related GitHub issues.

nodes.name: iso-8859-8.css
nodes.summary: User-agent CSS implementing the WHATWG HTML spec bidi-rendering rules for documents with ISO-8859-8 character encoding. Applies unicode-bidi: bidi-override to block-level elements and unicode-bidi: normal to text input controls.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements spec-mandated bidirectional text rendering rules specific to the ISO-8859-8 (Hebrew) encoding.

nodes.name: package-prefs.json
nodes.summary: Platform-specific preference overrides for Servo nightly package builds. Defines per-platform configuration blocks (all, macosx, linux, android, windows) with VR-specific settings enabling dom.webvr.enabled and dom.webxr.enabled.

nodes.name: wpt-prefs.json
nodes.summary: Preference overrides for Web Platform Test (WPT) execution, enabling dom_webxr_test and dom_testutils_enabled while disabling caret blink animation and text antialiasing for deterministic test results.

nodes.name: config.css
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the Servo advanced configuration (about:config) page, providing layout for preference tables, search input, value editors, toggle switches, and hidden/default state indicators.

nodes.name: config.html
nodes.summary: Servo's advanced configuration page (about:config) with a searchable, dynamically-rendered table of all browser preferences. Uses custom Web Components (PrefBoolRow, PrefValueRow, PrefUnknownRow) extending HTMLTableRowElement to provide inline editing of boolean, integer, and string preferences via the navigator.servo API.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses customElements.define() with the 'is' attribute extension mechanism to create customized built-in table row elements for three preference types (bool, i64, String).

nodes.name: license.html
nodes.summary: Third-party license attribution page listing all open-source components used by Servo, organized by license type (Apache 2.0, MIT, MPL 2.0, BSD, ISC, etc.) with full license texts and per-crate attribution.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains embedded full text of 14+ open-source licenses and per-dependency attribution for all Rust crates used in Servo's build.

nodes.name: newtab.css
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the Servo new tab page with responsive layout, light/dark color scheme support via prefers-color-scheme media queries, and CSS custom properties for theming.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CSS custom properties (--theme-color-primary, --theme-color-secondary) with @media (prefers-color-scheme) queries to switch between light and dark themes.

nodes.name: newtab.html
nodes.summary: Servo's new tab page featuring the Servo logo, a DuckDuckGo search form with autofocus, and a link to the Servo homepage, with light/dark theme-aware image variants.

nodes.name: preferences.html
nodes.summary: Servo's user-facing preferences page providing toggles for experimental web platform features, HTTP cache control, and a user-agent string selector with presets (Servo, Firefox, Chrome), backed by the navigator.servo preference API and async initialization from internal servo: URLs.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses fetch() to servo:experimental-preferences and servo:default-user-agent internal URLs for async initialization, then populates checkbox and string inputs bound to navigator.servo.getBoolPreference/setBoolPreference APIs.

nodes.name: gradle.properties

nodes.name: gradlew.bat
nodes.summary: Gradle wrapper startup script for Windows that locates the Java runtime, sets JVM options via JAVA_HOME detection, and executes the Gradle wrapper JAR to run build tasks for the Servo Android APK.

nodes.name: servo.properties

nodes.name: media_session_pause.xml

nodes.summary: Android vector drawable defining a 24dp play icon (right-pointing triangle), used as the media session play action button for media playback control.

nodes.name: refresh.xml
nodes.summary: Android vector drawable defining a 24dp refresh/reload icon (circular arrow), used for the page reload button in the browser toolbar.

nodes.name: settings.xml
nodes.summary: Android vector drawable defining a 24dp settings/gear icon (toothed circle), used for the settings menu entry point in the browser UI.

nodes.summary: WebIDL dictionary for credential request options with mediation, signal, and password fields for configuring credential retrieval.

nodes.name: CredentialCreationOptions
nodes.summary: WebIDL dictionary for credential creation options with mediation, signal, and password fields for configuring new credential creation.

nodes.name: Crypto
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the Web Crypto API Crypto object providing subtle crypto access, getRandomValues for CSPRNG, and randomUUID generation.

nodes.name: CryptoKey
nodes.summary: WebIDL serializable interface for the Web Crypto API CryptoKey, representing a cryptographic key with type, extractable, algorithm, and usages attributes.

nodes.name: KeyType
nodes.summary: WebIDL enum for cryptographic key types: public, private, and secret.

nodes.name: KeyUsage
nodes.summary: WebIDL enum for cryptographic key usages including encrypt, decrypt, sign, verify, deriveKey, deriveBits, wrapKey, unwrapKey, encapsulateKey, encapsulateBits, decapsulateKey, and decapsulateBits.

nodes.name: CSPViolationReportBody
nodes.summary: WebIDL dictionary extending ReportBody with fields for Content Security Policy violation reporting including documentURL, blockedURL, effectiveDirective, originalPolicy, disposition, statusCode, and line/column numbers.

nodes.name: CSS
nodes.summary: WebIDL namespace for CSSOM utility methods including escape, supports (property/value and conditionText), paintWorklet, and registerProperty for CSS Houdini custom properties.

nodes.name: PropertyDefinition
nodes.summary: WebIDL dictionary for CSS custom property registration with required name and inherits fields, plus optional syntax and initialValue.

nodes.name: CSSGroupingRule
nodes.summary: Abstract WebIDL interface extending CSSRule with cssRules list, insertRule, and deleteRule operations, serving as base for CSSMediaRule, CSSConditionRule, and CSSLayerBlockRule.

nodes.name: CSSKeyframesRule
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface extending CSSRule for @keyframes animation rules with name attribute, cssRules list, and appendRule/deleteRule/findRule methods.

nodes.name: CSSNamespaceRule
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface extending CSSRule for @namespace rules with namespaceURI and prefix readonly attributes.

nodes.name: CSSPropertyRule
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface extending CSSRule for CSS Houdini @property rules exposing name, syntax, inherits, and initialValue attributes.

nodes.name: CSSRule
nodes.summary: Abstract WebIDL base interface for all CSS rule types providing type constants (STYLE_RULE, IMPORT_RULE, MEDIA_RULE, etc.), cssText, type, and parentStyleSheet attributes. Two partial interfaces add KEYFRAMES_RULE, KEYFRAME_RULE, and SUPPORTS_RULE constants.

nodes.name: CSSRuleList.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for CSSRuleList, a live collection of CSSRule objects returned by cssRules. Exposed to Window contexts.

nodes.name: CSSRuleList
nodes.summary: Interface representing an indexed list of CSSRule objects with an item getter and a length attribute. Exposed to Window.

nodes.name: CSSStyleDeclaration.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for CSSStyleDeclaration, representing a collection of CSS property-value pairs. Includes methods for getting, setting, and removing CSS properties.

nodes.name: CSSStyleDeclaration
nodes.summary: Interface for manipulating CSS property declarations. Provides cssText, length, item getter, getPropertyValue, setProperty, removeProperty, and cssFloat. Exposed to Window.

nodes.name: CSSStyleRule.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for CSSStyleRule, representing a single CSS style rule with a selector and a style declaration block. Inherits from CSSGroupingRule.

nodes.name: CSSStyleRule
nodes.summary: Interface representing a CSS style rule. Provides selectorText attribute for reading/writing the selector and a style attribute (forwarded to cssText) for the declaration block. Inherits CSSGroupingRule.

nodes.name: CSSStyleSheet.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for CSSStyleSheet interface, its constructor dictionary CSSStyleSheetInit, and a legacy partial interface. Includes constructable stylesheet and CSSOM methods for rule manipulation.

nodes.name: CSSStyleSheet
nodes.summary: Interface representing a CSS stylesheet. Provides cssRules, insertRule, deleteRule methods plus constructable stylesheet support via replace/replaceSync. Also includes legacy rules/addRule/removeRule via partial. Inherits StyleSheet.

nodes.name: CSSStyleSheetInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for CSSStyleSheet constructor options, specifying the media (MediaList or DOMString) and disabled flag.

nodes.name: CSSStyleValue.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for CSSStyleValue, the base class of the CSS Typed OM. Gated behind the dom_worklet_enabled preference and exposed to Worklet contexts.

nodes.name: CSSStyleValue
nodes.summary: Base interface for the CSS Typed Object Model. Currently only defines a stringifier. Pref-gated behind dom_worklet_enabled and exposed to Worklet.

nodes.name: CSSSupportsRule.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for CSSSupportsRule, representing an @supports CSS conditional rule. Inherits all members from CSSConditionRule with no additional members.

nodes.name: CSSSupportsRule
nodes.summary: Interface for @supports CSS conditional rules. Empty body; inherits all functionality from CSSConditionRule. Exposed to Window.

nodes.name: CustomElementRegistry.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the CustomElementRegistry interface, the CustomElementConstructor callback, and the ElementDefinitionOptions dictionary. Core API for registering and querying custom HTML elements.

nodes.name: CustomElementRegistry
nodes.summary: Interface for registering and managing custom HTML elements. Provides define, get, getName, whenDefined, upgrade, and initialize methods. Exposed to Window.

nodes.name: CustomElementConstructor
nodes.summary: Callback type for custom element constructors; represents a function that returns an HTMLElement.

nodes.name: ElementDefinitionOptions
nodes.summary: Dictionary for element definition options, currently specifying only an extends attribute for customizing built-in elements.

nodes.name: CustomEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the CustomEvent interface and its init dictionary CustomEventInit. Extends Event to carry arbitrary user-defined detail data.

nodes.name: CustomEvent
nodes.summary: Interface for custom DOM events carrying application-defined data via the detail attribute. Provides a constructor and the legacy initCustomEvent method. Inherits Event. Exposed to all globals.

nodes.name: CustomEventInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for CustomEvent constructor initialization. Inherits EventInit and adds a detail field defaulting to null.

nodes.name: DataTransfer.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for DataTransfer, the object used during drag-and-drop operations to hold dragged data and control the drag feedback.

nodes.name: DataTransfer
nodes.summary: Interface for drag-and-drop data transfer. Manages dropEffect, effectAllowed, items list, and provides getData/setData/clearData methods plus setDragImage for drag feedback. Exposed to Window.

nodes.name: DataTransferItem.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the DataTransferItem interface and FunctionStringCallback callback, representing a single drag data item with kind, type, and retrieval methods.

nodes.name: DataTransferItem
nodes.summary: Interface representing a single item in a DataTransferItemList. Provides kind, type attributes and getAsString/getAsFile retrieval methods. Exposed to Window.

nodes.name: FunctionStringCallback
nodes.summary: Callback type for getAsString; accepts a DOMString data parameter and returns undefined.

nodes.name: DataTransferItemList.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for DataTransferItemList, a list of DataTransferItem objects accessed via the DataTransfer.items attribute.

nodes.name: DataTransferItemList
nodes.summary: Interface representing an indexed list of DataTransferItem objects. Provides length, indexed getter, add (for string and File data), remove, and clear methods. Exposed to Window.

nodes.name: DebuggerAddDebuggeeEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the internal Servo debugger: DebuggerAddDebuggeeEvent (an Event fired when a debuggee is added) and PipelineId (a structured identifier for browser pipelines). Not exposed to web content.

nodes.name: DebuggerAddDebuggeeEvent
nodes.summary: Internal Servo debugger event fired when a new debuggee global is added. Carries the JS global object, pipeline ID, and optional worker ID. Inherits Event. Exposed only to DebuggerGlobalScope.

nodes.name: PipelineId
nodes.summary: Internal interface representing a Servo pipeline identifier with namespace and index components. Exposed only to DebuggerGlobalScope.

nodes.name: DebuggerBlackboxEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the internal Servo DebuggerBlackboxEvent, representing a blackbox request with SpiderMonkey script ID, coverage flag, and source location methods. Not exposed to web content.

nodes.name: DebuggerBlackboxEvent
nodes.summary: Internal Servo debugger event for blackboxing script sources. Carries SpiderMonkey script ID and coversFullSource flag. Includes a same-file partial interface adding start() and end() source-location methods. Inherits Event.

nodes.name: DebuggerClearBreakpointEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for DebuggerClearBreakpointEvent, an internal Servo event carrying SpiderMonkey identifiers for clearing a breakpoint. Not exposed to web content.

nodes.name: DebuggerClearBreakpointEvent
nodes.summary: Internal Servo debugger event for clearing a breakpoint. Carries SpiderMonkey script ID, script ID, and bytecode offset. Inherits Event. Exposed only to DebuggerGlobalScope.

nodes.name: DebuggerEvalEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the internal Servo DebuggerEvalEvent (carrying eval code and context), a partial DebuggerGlobalScope addition (evalResult method), and the EvalResult dictionary. Not exposed to web content.

nodes.name: DebuggerEvalEvent
nodes.summary: Internal Servo debugger event for evaluating JavaScript code. Carries the code string, pipeline ID, optional worker and frame actor IDs. Inherits Event. Exposed only to DebuggerGlobalScope.

nodes.name: EvalResult
nodes.summary: Dictionary holding the result of a debugger eval: serialized value, optional exception message, and hasException boolean flag.

nodes.name: DebuggerFrameEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the internal Servo DebuggerFrameEvent (requesting stack frames) and a partial DebuggerGlobalScope addition (listFramesResult). Not exposed to web content.

nodes.name: DebuggerFrameEvent
nodes.summary: Internal Servo debugger event for querying stack frames. Carries pipeline ID, start offset, and count. Inherits Event. Exposed only to DebuggerGlobalScope.

nodes.name: DebuggerGetEnvironmentEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the internal Servo DebuggerGetEnvironmentEvent, a partial DebuggerGlobalScope addition (registerEnvironmentActor, getEnvironmentResult), and the EnvironmentInfo dictionary. Not exposed to web content.

nodes.name: DebuggerGetEnvironmentEvent
nodes.summary: Internal Servo debugger event for querying scope/environment information. Carries a frame actor ID. Inherits Event. Exposed only to DebuggerGlobalScope.

nodes.name: EnvironmentInfo
nodes.summary: Dictionary describing a debugger environment/scope with type, scope kind, function display name, serialized bindings, and optional serialized object.

nodes.name: DebuggerGetPossibleBreakpointsEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the internal Servo DebuggerGetPossibleBreakpointsEvent, a partial DebuggerGlobalScope addition, and the RecommendedBreakpointLocation dictionary. Not exposed to web content.

nodes.name: DebuggerGetPossibleBreakpointsEvent
