nodes.summary: Internal Servo debugger event for querying possible breakpoint locations in a script. Carries SpiderMonkey script ID. Inherits Event. Exposed only to DebuggerGlobalScope.

nodes.name: RecommendedBreakpointLocation
nodes.summary: Dictionary describing a recommended breakpoint location with script ID, bytecode offset, line/column numbers, and isStepStart flag.

nodes.name: DebuggerGlobalScope.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the internal Servo DebuggerGlobalScope (the global scope for debugger actors), plus NotifyNewSource, PipelineIdInit, and DebuggerSourceLocation dictionaries. Not exposed to web content.

nodes.name: DebuggerGlobalScope
nodes.summary: Internal global scope for Servo's debugger system. Provides notifyNewSource and registerObjectActor methods. Inherits GlobalScope. Not accessible to web pages.

nodes.name: NotifyNewSource
nodes.summary: Dictionary carrying new script source notification data: pipeline ID, worker ID, SpiderMonkey script ID, URL, URL override, source text, and optional introduction type.

nodes.name: PipelineIdInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for initializing a pipeline identifier with namespace and index fields.

nodes.name: DebuggerSourceLocation
nodes.summary: Dictionary representing a source location with line and column numbers. Used by debugger events for blackbox and unblackbox source ranges.

nodes.name: DebuggerInterruptEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the internal Servo DebuggerInterruptEvent, a partial DebuggerGlobalScope addition (pauseAndRespond, registerFrameActor), and PauseReason, FrameInfo, FrameOffset dictionaries. Not exposed to web content.

nodes.name: DebuggerInterruptEvent
nodes.summary: Internal Servo debugger event for execution interruption (breakpoint/pause). Inherits Event with no additional members. Exposed only to DebuggerGlobalScope.

nodes.name: PauseReason
nodes.summary: Dictionary describing the reason for a debugger pause with a required type string and optional onNext flag.

nodes.name: FrameInfo
nodes.summary: Dictionary describing a debugger stack frame: display name, on-stack flag, oldest flag, serialized 'this', terminated flag, type, and source URL.

nodes.name: FrameOffset
nodes.summary: Dictionary representing a position within a debugger frame with frameActorId, column, and line fields.

nodes.name: DebuggerResumeEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for DebuggerResumeEvent, an internal Servo event carrying optional resume limit type and frame actor ID. Not exposed to web content.

nodes.name: DebuggerResumeEvent
nodes.summary: Internal Servo debugger event for resuming execution after a pause. Carries optional resume limit type and frame actor ID. Inherits Event. Exposed only to DebuggerGlobalScope.

nodes.name: DebuggerSetBreakpointEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for DebuggerSetBreakpointEvent, an internal Servo event carrying SpiderMonkey identifiers for setting a breakpoint. Not exposed to web content.

nodes.name: DebuggerSetBreakpointEvent
nodes.summary: Internal Servo debugger event for setting a breakpoint. Carries SpiderMonkey script ID, script ID, and bytecode offset. Inherits Event. Exposed only to DebuggerGlobalScope.

nodes.name: DebuggerUnblackboxEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the internal Servo DebuggerUnblackboxEvent, representing an unblackbox request with SpiderMonkey script ID, coverage flag, and source location methods. Not exposed to web content.

nodes.name: DebuggerUnblackboxEvent
nodes.summary: Internal Servo debugger event for unblackboxing script sources. Carries SpiderMonkey script ID and coversFullSource flag. Includes a same-file partial interface adding start() and end() source-location methods. Inherits Event.

nodes.name: DecompressionStream.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for DecompressionStream, which decompresses a stream of compressed data. Includes the GenericTransformStream mixin for readable/writable stream plumbing.

nodes.name: DecompressionStream
nodes.summary: Interface for decompressing a stream of data using a specified CompressionFormat. Includes GenericTransformStream mixin for readable/writable stream support. Exposed to all globals.

nodes.name: DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope, the global scope for dedicated web workers. Extends WorkerGlobalScope with name, postMessage, messaging event handlers, and close.

nodes.name: DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope
nodes.summary: Global scope interface for dedicated web workers. Provides name attribute, postMessage with transfer support, onmessage/onmessageerror event handlers, and close method. Inherits WorkerGlobalScope.

nodes.name: DissimilarOriginLocation.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the DissimilarOriginLocation interface, a Servo-specific WebIDL binding representing cross-origin Location objects that live in another script thread, exposing href navigation and reload operations without security exceptions.

nodes.name: DissimilarOriginLocation
nodes.summary: Servo-specific interface for cross-origin Location objects. Provides href attribute and assign/replace/reload navigation methods, all throwing on failure.

nodes.name: DissimilarOriginWindow.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the DissimilarOriginWindow interface, a Servo-specific WebIDL binding representing cross-origin Window objects in another script thread, exposing postMessage, close/focus/blur, and window proxy attributes.

nodes.name: DissimilarOriginWindow
nodes.summary: Servo-specific global interface for cross-origin Window objects, extending GlobalScope. Exposes window proxy attributes, location, postMessage (2 overloads), close, blur, focus, and opener.

nodes.name: Document.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the Document interface (core DOM entry point), extending Node with element creation, DOM traversal, event handling, HTML document management, fullscreen support, CSSOM View extensions, selection API, web animations timeline, and sanitizer API static methods.

nodes.name: Document
nodes.summary: Core DOM Document interface extending Node. Provides constructor, document metadata (URL, documentURI, compatMode, characterSet, contentType), element creation methods (createElement, createElementNS, createDocumentFragment, createTextNode, etc.), node import/adoption, event/range creation, and node tree walkers.

nodes.name: DocumentReadyState
nodes.summary: Enum for document loading states: 'loading', 'interactive', 'complete'.

nodes.name: DocumentVisibilityState
nodes.summary: Enum for document visibility states: 'visible', 'hidden'.

nodes.name: ElementCreationOptions
nodes.summary: Dictionary for element creation options, holding a custom element 'is' attribute.

nodes.name: ImportNodeOptions
nodes.summary: Dictionary for importNode options with customElementRegistry and selfOnly flag (default false).

nodes.name: NamedPropertyValue
nodes.summary: Typedef for Document named property getter return type: WindowProxy or Element or HTMLCollection.

nodes.name: DocumentFragment.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the DocumentFragment interface extending Node, a lightweight document container for DOM manipulation that includes NonElementParentNode and ParentNode mixins.

nodes.name: DocumentFragment
nodes.summary: Lightweight DocumentFragment DOM interface extending Node with constructor support, used as a minimal document subtree container.

nodes.name: DocumentOrShadowRoot.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the DocumentOrShadowRoot interface mixin providing shared functionality for Document and ShadowRoot, including element-from-point queries, activeElement, styleSheets, adoptedStyleSheets, and fullscreen element access.

nodes.name: DocumentOrShadowRoot
nodes.summary: Interface mixin shared by Document and ShadowRoot. Provides elementFromPoint, elementsFromPoint, activeElement, styleSheets, and customElementRegistry attributes.

nodes.name: DocumentTimeline.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the DocumentTimeline interface extending AnimationTimeline for web animations, and the DocumentTimelineOptions dictionary for its constructor configuration.

nodes.name: DocumentTimelineOptions
nodes.summary: Dictionary for DocumentTimeline constructor options, with originTime defaulting to 0.

nodes.name: DocumentTimeline
nodes.summary: Web Animations DocumentTimeline interface extending AnimationTimeline, constructed with optional DocumentTimelineOptions.

nodes.name: DocumentType.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the DocumentType interface extending Node, representing a document's doctype with name, publicId, and systemId attributes, and includes the ChildNode mixin.

nodes.name: DocumentType
nodes.summary: DOM DocumentType interface extending Node with constant read-only attributes for the doctype name, publicId, and systemId.

nodes.name: DOMException.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the DOMException exception class interface with 25 DOM error code constants (INDEX_SIZE_ERR through DATA_CLONE_ERR) and read-only code, name, and message attributes.

nodes.name: DOMException
nodes.summary: Serializable DOM exception interface with constructor accepting message and name. Defines 25 unsigned short error code constants and read-only code, name, and message attributes.

nodes.name: DOMImplementation.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the DOMImplementation interface for creating document types, XML documents, and HTML documents, plus a hasFeature compatibility method.

nodes.name: DOMImplementation
nodes.summary: DOMImplementation interface providing factory methods: createDocumentType, createDocument, createHTMLDocument, and the legacy hasFeature method.

nodes.name: DOMMatrix.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the mutable DOMMatrix interface extending DOMMatrixReadOnly with writable 4x4 matrix element attributes, mutable transform methods (multiplySelf, translateSelf, scaleSelf, rotateSelf, skewXSelf, invertSelf, etc.), and DOMMatrixInit/DOMMatrix2DInit dictionaries.

nodes.name: DOMMatrix
nodes.summary: Mutable 4x4 transformation matrix interface extending DOMMatrixReadOnly. Adds static factory methods (fromMatrix, fromFloat32Array, fromFloat64Array), writable matrix element attributes, and mutable self-modifying transform operations.

nodes.name: DOMMatrix2DInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for 2D matrix initialization with unrestricted double fields a-f and m11, m12, m21, m22, m41, m42.

nodes.name: DOMMatrixInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for full 3D matrix initialization extending DOMMatrix2DInit with 3D matrix elements (m13-m44) and is2D flag.

nodes.name: DOMMatrixReadOnly.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the read-only DOMMatrixReadOnly interface with 16-element 4x4 matrix attributes, immutable transform methods returning new DOMMatrix instances, point transformation, float array conversion, and JSON serialization.

nodes.name: DOMMatrixReadOnly
nodes.summary: Read-only 4x4 transformation matrix interface. Provides constructor, static factory methods, read-only matrix element attributes (a-f, m11-m44), is2D/isIdentity flags, and immutable transform methods that return new DOMMatrix instances.

nodes.name: DOMParser.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the DOMParser interface for parsing HTML/XML/SVG strings into Documents, with the SupportedType enum listing valid MIME types.

nodes.name: SupportedType
nodes.summary: Enum for DOMParser supported MIME types: text/html, text/xml, application/xml, application/xhtml+xml, image/svg+xml.

nodes.name: DOMParser
nodes.summary: DOMParser interface with constructor and parseFromString method that accepts a string and SupportedType and returns a parsed Document.

nodes.name: DOMPoint.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the mutable DOMPoint interface extending DOMPointReadOnly with writable x/y/z/w attributes, and the DOMPointInit dictionary for initialization.

nodes.name: DOMPoint
nodes.summary: Mutable point interface extending DOMPointReadOnly with constructor, static fromPoint factory, and writable x, y, z, w attributes.

nodes.name: DOMPointInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for point initialization with x, y, z, w unrestricted doubles (defaulting to 0, 0, 0, 1).

nodes.name: DOMPointReadOnly.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the read-only DOMPointReadOnly interface with constructor, static fromPoint factory, read-only x/y/z/w attributes, matrixTransform method, and JSON serialization.

nodes.name: DOMPointReadOnly
nodes.summary: Read-only point interface with constructor, static fromPoint factory, read-only x,y,z,w coordinates, matrixTransform for applying DOMMatrix transforms, and JSON serialization.

nodes.name: DOMQuad.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the DOMQuad interface for quadrilateral geometry with four DOMPoint corners, static fromRect/fromQuad factories, getBounds, and the DOMQuadInit dictionary.

nodes.name: DOMQuad
nodes.summary: Serializable quadrilateral geometry interface with constructor (4 DOMPointInit params), static fromRect/fromQuad factories, read-only p1-p4 DOMPoint attributes, getBounds returning DOMRect, and JSON serialization.

nodes.name: DOMQuadInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for quadrilateral initialization with p1-p4 DOMPointInit corners defaulting to empty objects.

nodes.name: DOMRect.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the mutable DOMRect interface extending DOMRectReadOnly with writable x/y/width/height attributes and a static fromRect factory.

nodes.name: DOMRect
nodes.summary: Mutable rectangle interface extending DOMRectReadOnly. Adds constructor, static fromRect factory, and writable x, y, width, height attributes.

nodes.name: DOMRectList.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the DOMRectList interface for storing a list of DOMRect objects, with a length attribute and indexed getter for item access.

nodes.name: DOMRectList
nodes.summary: List interface holding DOMRect objects with a read-only length attribute and an indexed getter returning DOMRect?.

nodes.name: DOMRectReadOnly.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the read-only DOMRectReadOnly interface with x/y/width/height/top/right/bottom/left attributes, static fromRect factory, and the DOMRectInit dictionary.

nodes.name: DOMRectReadOnly
nodes.summary: Read-only rectangle interface with constructor, static fromRect factory, read-only x/y/width/height/top/right/bottom/left attributes, and JSON serialization.

nodes.name: DOMRectInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for rectangle initialization with x, y, width, height unrestricted doubles defaulting to 0.

nodes.name: DOMStringList.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the DOMStringList interface for storing a list of DOMStrings, with length, indexed item getter, and contains lookup method.

nodes.name: DOMStringList
nodes.summary: String list interface exposed to Window and Worker. Provides read-only length, indexed getter item, and contains method for membership testing.

nodes.name: DOMStringMap.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the DOMStringMap interface for dataset attribute access, with named getter, setter (CEReactions), and deleter (CEReactions) operations.

nodes.name: DOMStringMap
nodes.summary: Interface for the dataset property on HTML elements. Provides named getter, setter with CEReactions, and deleter for DOMString-keyed attribute manipulation.

nodes.name: DOMTokenList.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the DOMTokenList interface for classList-like token manipulation, supporting add/remove/toggle/replace/supports operations, length, indexed item, contains, stringifier value, and iterable.

nodes.name: DOMTokenList
nodes.summary: Token list interface exposing element class-like semantics. Provides length, indexed getter, contains, add/remove/toggle/replace/supports methods, stringifier value attribute, and iterable support.

nodes.name: Element.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the Element interface extending Node, the core DOM Element with namespace/tag/id/className/classList/slot attributes, DOM attribute manipulation, CSS selector queries, Shadow DOM (attachShadow, shadowRoot), CSSOM View scrolling, pointer capture, fullscreen, HTML parsing (innerHTML, outerHTML, setHTML), and web animations support.

nodes.name: Element
nodes.summary: Core DOM Element interface extending Node. Provides namespace/prefixed/local/tagName attributes, id/className/classList/slot, attribute manipulation (get/set/remove/toggle/has), CSS selector querying (closest/matches), Shadow DOM (attachShadow, shadowRoot), and adjacent HTML/text insertion.

nodes.name: ShadowRootInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for ShadowRoot initialization with required mode, optional delegatesFocus, slotAssignment, clonable, and serializable flags.

nodes.name: GetHTMLOptions
nodes.summary: Dictionary for getHTML options with serializableShadowRoots flag (default false) and shadowRoots sequence.

nodes.name: ScrollIntoViewOptions
nodes.summary: Dictionary extending ScrollOptions for scrollIntoView configuration with block/inline scroll positions and container selection.

nodes.name: ScrollLogicalPosition
nodes.summary: Enum for scroll alignment positions: 'start', 'center', 'end', 'nearest'.

nodes.name: ScrollIntoViewContainer
nodes.summary: Enum for scroll container selection: 'all', 'nearest'.

nodes.name: ElementContentEditable.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the ElementContentEditable interface mixin providing contentEditable and isContentEditable attributes for inline HTML editing.

nodes.name: ElementContentEditable
nodes.summary: Interface mixin for contentEditable elements. Provides the contentEditable attribute with CEReactions and read-only isContentEditable flag.

nodes.name: ElementCSSInlineStyle.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the ElementCSSInlineStyle interface mixin exposing the inline style attribute as a CSSStyleDeclaration via the PutForwards pattern on cssText.

nodes.name: ElementCSSInlineStyle
nodes.summary: Interface mixin providing the style attribute as a CSSStyleDeclaration, with SameObject and PutForwards=cssText for inline CSS access.

nodes.name: ElementInternals.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the ElementInternals interface for custom element internals (shadowRoot, form association, validation, labels, custom states), the ValidityStateFlags dictionary, and the CustomStateSet interface.

nodes.name: ElementInternals
nodes.summary: Interface for custom element internals. Exposes shadowRoot, form association (setFormValue, form), constraint validation (setValidity, willValidate, validity, validationMessage, checkValidity, reportValidity), labels, and custom states (CustomStateSet).

nodes.name: ValidityStateFlags
nodes.summary: Dictionary for constraint validation flags: valueMissing, typeMismatch, patternMismatch, tooLong, tooShort, rangeUnderflow, rangeOverflow, stepMismatch, badInput, customError â€” all defaulting to false.

nodes.name: CustomStateSet
nodes.summary: Interface for custom element state pseudo-class via a setlike collection of DOMString values.

nodes.name: ErrorEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the ErrorEvent interface and ErrorEventInit dictionary for reporting unhandled script errors, per the HTML specification.

nodes.name: ErrorEvent
nodes.summary: An event interface representing a script error, exposing the error message, filename, line/column numbers, and the thrown error object.

nodes.name: ErrorEventInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for initializing an ErrorEvent, extending EventInit with error details including message, filename, line/column numbers, and the error object.

nodes.name: Event.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the core Event interface and EventInit dictionary, the fundamental base type for all DOM events per the DOM specification.

nodes.name: Event
nodes.summary: The core Event interface providing event type, target, phase constants, propagation control (stopPropagation, stopImmediatePropagation), cancellation (preventDefault), and event metadata (bubbles, cancelable, isTrusted, timeStamp).

nodes.name: EventInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for initializing an Event with optional bubbles, cancelable, and composed flags defaulting to false.

nodes.name: EventHandler.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines event handler callback types (EventHandler, OnErrorEventHandler, OnBeforeUnloadEventHandler) and the GlobalEventHandlers and WindowEventHandlers mixin interfaces per the HTML specification, with partial extensions from CSS Animations, CSS Transitions, Selection API, Pointer Events, and Touch Events.

nodes.name: EventHandlerNonNull
nodes.summary: Callback function type for standard event handlers, receiving an Event and returning any value.

nodes.name: OnErrorEventHandlerNonNull
nodes.summary: Callback function type for error event handlers, receiving an Event or DOMString, optional source, line/column numbers, and the error object.

nodes.name: OnBeforeUnloadEventHandlerNonNull
nodes.summary: Callback function type for the beforeunload event handler, receiving an Event and optionally returning a DOMString.

nodes.name: GlobalEventHandlers
nodes.summary: Mixin interface defining the standard set of event handler attributes (onabort, onclick, onkeydown, onload, onerror, etc.) available on HTMLElement, Document, and Window, extended by CSS Animations, CSS Transitions, Selection API, Pointer Events, and Touch Events partials.

nodes.name: WindowEventHandlers
nodes.summary: Mixin interface defining window-specific event handler attributes (onafterprint, onbeforeunload, onhashchange, onmessage, onpopstate, onstorage, etc.) exposed on the Window object.

nodes.name: EventListener.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the EventListener callback interface with a single handleEvent method, per the DOM specification.

nodes.name: EventListener
nodes.summary: Callback interface representing an object that handles events via a handleEvent method, used as the callback type in addEventListener.

nodes.name: EventModifierInit.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the EventModifierInit dictionary extending UIEventInit with keyboard modifier state flags per the UI Events specification.

nodes.name: EventModifierInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for initializing UI events with modifier key states (ctrlKey, shiftKey, altKey, metaKey) and extended key modifier flags (CapsLock, NumLock, ScrollLock, Fn, etc.).

nodes.name: EventSource.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the EventSource interface for server-sent events and EventSourceInit dictionary per the HTML specification.

nodes.name: EventSource
nodes.summary: Interface for receiving server-sent event notifications over HTTP, providing connection state constants (CONNECTING, OPEN, CLOSED), event handlers (onopen, onmessage, onerror), and a close method.

nodes.name: EventSourceInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for initializing an EventSource with a withCredentials flag defaulting to false.

nodes.name: EventTarget.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the EventTarget interface (the base for all objects that can receive events), EventListenerOptions, and AddEventListenerOptions dictionaries per the DOM specification.

nodes.name: EventTarget
nodes.summary: The base interface for objects that can receive and dispatch DOM events, providing addEventListener, removeEventListener, and dispatchEvent methods exposed to Window, Worker, Worklet, and DebuggerGlobalScope.

nodes.name: EventListenerOptions
nodes.summary: Dictionary for event listener options with a capture flag defaulting to false.

nodes.name: AddEventListenerOptions
nodes.summary: Dictionary extending EventListenerOptions with passive, once, and AbortSignal options for fine-grained event listener control.

nodes.name: EXTBlendMinmax.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the EXT_blend_minmax WebGL extension interface exposing MIN_EXT and MAX_EXT blend equation constants.

nodes.name: EXTBlendMinmax
nodes.summary: WebGL extension interface exposing MIN_EXT and MAX_EXT constants for the blend equation, marked as LegacyNoInterfaceObject.

nodes.name: EXTColorBufferHalfFloat.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the EXT_color_buffer_half_float WebGL extension interface providing half-float color buffer format constants.

nodes.name: EXTColorBufferHalfFloat
nodes.summary: WebGL extension interface exposing RGBA16F_EXT, RGB16F_EXT, and related constants for half-float color buffer rendering, marked as LegacyNoInterfaceObject.

nodes.name: ExtendableEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the ExtendableEvent interface and ExtendableEventInit dictionary for Service Worker lifecycle events per the Service Worker specification.

nodes.name: ExtendableEvent
nodes.summary: Base interface for Service Worker events, extending Event with a waitUntil method to extend the event's lifetime until a promise resolves, gated by dom_serviceworker_enabled pref.

nodes.name: ExtendableEventInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary extending EventInit for ExtendableEvent initialization, defined empty for forward compatibility across derived events.

nodes.name: ExtendableMessageEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the ExtendableMessageEvent interface and ExtendableMessageEventInit dictionary for message events in Service Workers per the Service Worker specification.

nodes.name: ExtendableMessageEvent
nodes.summary: Interface representing a message event in a Service Worker, exposing message data, origin, lastEventId, source (Client, ServiceWorker, or MessagePort), and message ports, gated by dom_serviceworker_enabled pref.

nodes.name: ExtendableMessageEventInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary extending ExtendableEventInit for message event initialization with data, origin, lastEventId, source, and ports fields.

nodes.name: EXTFragDepth.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the EXT_frag_depth WebGL extension interface (a marker extension with no constants), per the Khronos specification.

nodes.name: EXTFragDepth
nodes.summary: WebGL extension interface for EXT_frag_depth, a marker extension with no additional constants, marked as LegacyNoInterfaceObject.

nodes.name: EXTShaderTextureLod.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the EXT_shader_texture_lod WebGL extension interface (a marker extension enabling texture LOD queries in shaders).

nodes.name: EXTShaderTextureLod
nodes.summary: WebGL extension interface for EXT_shader_texture_lod, a marker extension enabling shader texture LOD queries, marked as LegacyNoInterfaceObject.

nodes.name: EXTTextureFilterAnisotropic.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic WebGL extension interface exposing anisotropic texture filtering constants.

nodes.name: EXTTextureFilterAnisotropic
nodes.summary: WebGL extension interface exposing TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT and MAX_TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT constants for anisotropic texture filtering, marked as LegacyNoInterfaceObject.

nodes.name: FakeXRDevice.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the FakeXRDevice test interface and supporting dictionaries/enums for the WebXR Test API, enabling simulation of XR devices, views, input, and hit testing in automated tests.

nodes.name: FakeXRDevice
nodes.summary: Test interface for simulating WebXR devices in automated tests, providing methods for setting views, viewer origin, floor origin, bounds geometry, simulating visibility changes and input source connections, and managing hit test worlds.

nodes.name: FakeXRViewInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for initializing a simulated XR view with required eye, projection matrix, view offset transform, resolution, and optional field of view.

nodes.name: FakeXRDeviceResolution
nodes.summary: Dictionary specifying the width and height resolution for a simulated XR device viewport.

nodes.name: FakeXRBoundsPoint
nodes.summary: Dictionary defining a 2D bounds point with x and z coordinates for XR space boundaries.

nodes.name: FakeXRRigidTransformInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for initializing a rigid transform with required position and orientation float arrays for XR spatial tracking.

nodes.name: FakeXRFieldOfViewInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for initializing a field of view with required up, down, left, and right degree angles for XR view configuration.

nodes.name: FakeXRWorldInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for initializing a simulated XR world with required hit test regions for WebXR hit testing simulation.

nodes.name: FakeXRRegionInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for initializing a hit test region with required triangle faces and a region type (point, plane, or mesh).

nodes.name: FakeXRTriangleInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for initializing a triangle in a hit test mesh with exactly 3 vertices as DOMPointInit objects.

nodes.name: FakeXRRegionType
nodes.summary: Enumeration defining the types of hit test regions: point, plane, and mesh for WebXR test simulation.

nodes.name: FakeXRInputController.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the FakeXRInputController test interface and supporting dictionaries/enums for simulating XR input controllers in WebXR automated tests.

nodes.name: FakeXRInputController
nodes.summary: Test interface for simulating XR input controllers, providing methods to set handedness, target ray mode, profiles, grip/pointer origins, supported buttons, and to simulate selection, connection, and disconnection events.

nodes.name: FakeXRInputSourceInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for initializing a simulated XR input source with required handedness, target ray mode, pointer origin, and profiles, plus optional selection state, supported buttons, and grip origin.

nodes.name: FakeXRButtonType
nodes.summary: Enumeration defining supported XR controller button types: grip, touchpad, thumbstick, optional-button, and optional-thumbstick.

nodes.name: FakeXRButtonStateInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary for initializing a simulated XR button state with required button type, pressed/touched booleans, pressed value, and optional x/y values for analog input.

nodes.name: FetchLaterResult.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the FetchLaterResult interface with a single activated attribute, per the Fetch Later API specification.

nodes.name: FetchLaterResult
nodes.summary: Simple interface representing the result of a deferred fetch operation, exposing a read-only activated boolean attribute.

nodes.name: File.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the File interface extending Blob and the FilePropertyBag dictionary per the File API specification, with a partial extension for the webkitRelativePath attribute from the Entries API.

nodes.name: File
nodes.summary: Interface representing a file from the user's filesystem, extending Blob with name and lastModified attributes, and a webkitRelativePath partial extension gated by dom_entries_api_enabled.

nodes.name: FilePropertyBag
nodes.summary: Dictionary extending BlobPropertyBag with a lastModified timestamp for File constructor options.

nodes.name: FileList.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the FileList interface, an indexed collection of File objects with a length attribute, per the File API specification.

nodes.name: FileList
nodes.summary: An indexed list of File objects with an item getter and a read-only length attribute, marked Serializable for transfer between Window and Worker.

nodes.name: FileReader.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the FileReader interface for asynchronously reading File or Blob contents as ArrayBuffer, binary string, text, or data URL, per the File API specification.

nodes.name: FileReader
nodes.summary: Interface for asynchronously reading file/blob contents with readAsArrayBuffer, readAsBinaryString, readAsText, readAsDataURL methods, ready state constants (EMPTY, LOADING, DONE), result/error attributes, and event handler attributes (onload, onerror, onprogress, etc.).

nodes.name: FileReaderSync.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the FileReaderSync interface for synchronously reading File or Blob contents in Worker contexts, per the File API specification.

nodes.name: FileReaderSync
nodes.summary: Interface for synchronously reading file/blob contents in Worker contexts, providing readAsArrayBuffer, readAsBinaryString, readAsText, and readAsDataURL methods that return results directly.

nodes.name: FocusEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the FocusEvent interface and FocusEventInit dictionary for focus-related DOM events per the UI Events specification.

nodes.name: FocusEvent
nodes.summary: Interface for focus-related DOM events, extending UIEvent with a relatedTarget attribute pointing to the secondary EventTarget involved in the focus change.

nodes.name: FocusEventInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary extending UIEventInit for FocusEvent initialization with an optional relatedTarget defaulting to null.

nodes.name: FontFace.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the FontFace interface and supporting FontFaceDescriptors dictionary and FontFaceLoadStatus enum for the CSS Font Loading API, gated by dom_fontface_enabled pref.

nodes.name: FontFaceDescriptors
nodes.summary: Dictionary defining CSS font descriptor properties (style, weight, stretch, unicodeRange, featureSettings, variationSettings, display, ascent/descent/lineGap override) with their default values for FontFace construction.

nodes.name: FontFaceLoadStatus
nodes.summary: Enumeration tracking font loading states: unloaded, loading, loaded, and error.

nodes.name: FontFace
nodes.summary: Interface representing a single font face in the CSS Font Loading API, exposing settable CSS font descriptors (family, style, weight, etc.), a read-only load status, a load() method returning a Promise<FontFace>, and a loaded promise attribute.

nodes.name: FontFaceSet.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the FontFaceSet interface as a set-like collection of FontFace objects with load/clear/delete methods for the CSS Font Loading API, extending EventTarget.

nodes.name: FontFaceSet
nodes.summary: Interface representing a set-like collection of FontFace objects, extending EventTarget with add/delete/clear methods, a load() method accepting a font name and optional text, and a ready promise for async font loading completion.

nodes.name: FontFaceSource.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the FontFaceSource mixin interface providing a fonts attribute of type FontFaceSet, included by Document per the CSS Font Loading API specification.

nodes.name: FontFaceSource
nodes.summary: Mixin interface providing a read-only fonts attribute of type FontFaceSet, included by the Document interface to expose available font faces.

nodes.name: FormData.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the FormData interface used to construct key/value pairs representing form fields and their values, as specified by the XHR standard.

nodes.name: FormDataEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the FormDataEvent interface and its FormDataEventInit dictionary, fired when a form's FormData entry list is constructed.

nodes.name: Function.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL callback definition for the generic Function type representing any callable with variadic any-typed arguments returning any.

nodes.name: GainNode.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the Web Audio API GainNode interface, which represents a change in volume for an audio signal.

nodes.name: Gamepad.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the Gamepad interface, GamepadHand enum, and partial WindowEventHandlers mixin for the Gamepad API, gated behind the CARGO_FEATURE_GAMEPAD feature flag.

nodes.name: GamepadButton.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the GamepadButton interface representing an individual button on a gamepad, gated behind the CARGO_FEATURE_GAMEPAD feature flag.

nodes.name: GamepadEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the GamepadEvent interface and GamepadEventInit dictionary, fired when a gamepad is connected or disconnected.

nodes.name: GamepadHapticActuator.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the GamepadHapticActuator interface, haptic effect enums, and GamepadEffectParameters dictionary for gamepad vibration and trigger rumble feedback.

nodes.name: GamepadPose.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the GamepadPose interface representing the pose (position and orientation) of a WebVR-compatible gamepad in 3D space.

nodes.name: GenericTransformStream.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface mixin definition for GenericTransformStream, providing readable and writable stream attributes as specified by the Streams standard.

nodes.name: Geolocation.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the Geolocation interface, PositionCallback/PositionErrorCallback callbacks, PositionOptions dictionary, and partial Navigator extension for the Geolocation API.

nodes.name: GeolocationCoordinates.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the GeolocationCoordinates interface providing read-only access to geographic position data including latitude, longitude, altitude, heading, and speed.

nodes.name: GeolocationPosition.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the GeolocationPosition interface containing a GeolocationCoordinates and an EpochTimeStamp representing a geolocation reading.

nodes.name: GeolocationPositionError.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the GeolocationPositionError interface with error code constants (PERMISSION_DENIED, POSITION_UNAVAILABLE, TIMEOUT) for geolocation error reporting.

nodes.name: GlobalScope.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the internal Servo-only GlobalScope interface, extending EventTarget and exposed to all global scopes but inaccessible to web pages.

nodes.name: GPUCanvasContext.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGPU GPUCanvasContext interface providing a canvas rendering context for GPU-accelerated graphics, gated behind the dom_webgpu_enabled pref.

nodes.name: HashChangeEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HashChangeEvent interface and HashChangeEventInit dictionary, fired when the URL fragment identifier changes during navigation.

nodes.name: Headers.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the Fetch API Headers interface allowing manipulation of HTTP request and response headers, with typed getters, setters, and iteration.

nodes.name: History.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the History interface providing programmatic navigation via pushState, replaceState, go, back, and forward methods as specified by the HTML standard.

nodes.name: HTMLAnchorElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLAnchorElement interface representing the <a> hyperlink element, including CEReactions attributes, partial interface extensions, and the HTMLHyperlinkElementUtils mixin.

nodes.name: HTMLAreaElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLAreaElement interface representing the <area> image-map hyperlink element, including the HTMLHyperlinkElementUtils mixin and partial interface extensions.

nodes.name: HTMLAudioElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLAudioElement interface representing the <audio> element, extending HTMLMediaElement with a legacy Audio factory function.

nodes.name: HTMLBaseElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLBaseElement interface representing the <base> element that specifies the document base URL for relative URLs.

nodes.name: HTMLBodyElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLBodyElement interface representing the <body> element, including the WindowEventHandlers mixin and partial interface for legacy presentational attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLBRElement.webidl
nodes.summary:
WebIDL definition for the HTMLBRElement interface representing the
line-break element, with a partial interface placeholder for the obsolete clear attribute.

nodes.name: FormData
nodes.summary: DOM interface for constructing sets of key/value pairs representing form fields. Provides append, delete, get, getAll, has, and set methods with Blob and USVString value support, plus iterable pair iteration.

nodes.name: FormDataEvent
nodes.summary: Event interface fired when a form's FormData is constructed. Extends Event and exposes the associated FormData object via a readonly formData attribute.

nodes.name: GainNode
nodes.summary: Web Audio API interface representing a gain (volume) change node. Extends AudioNode with a constructor accepting an optional GainOptions dictionary and a readonly AudioParam gain attribute.

nodes.name: Gamepad
nodes.summary: Gamepad API interface representing a connected gamepad controller. Exposes id, index, connected state, timestamp, mapping, buttons, axes, and haptic vibration actuator attributes.

nodes.name: GamepadHand
nodes.summary: Enumeration indicating which hand the gamepad is held in or associated with, with values for empty/unknown, left, and right.

nodes.name: GamepadButton
nodes.summary: Gamepad API interface representing a single button on a gamepad controller, with readonly boolean pressed/touched state and a double precision value.

nodes.name: GamepadEvent
nodes.summary: Event interface fired on gamepad connection and disconnection events. Extends Event with a readonly Gamepad attribute referencing the affected gamepad.

nodes.name: GamepadHapticActuator
nodes.summary: Gamepad API interface for controlling haptic feedback (vibration). Provides playEffect and reset methods returning Promises, supporting dual-rumble and trigger-rumble effect types.

nodes.name: GamepadHapticsResult
nodes.summary: Enumeration of possible outcomes from a gamepad haptic effect: complete (finished normally) or preempted (interrupted by another effect).

nodes.name: GamepadHapticEffectType
nodes.summary: Enumeration of supported haptic effect types for gamepads: dual-rumble (standard vibration) and trigger-rumble (individual trigger vibration).

nodes.name: GamepadEffectParameters
nodes.summary: Dictionary defining parameters for gamepad haptic effects including duration, start delay, strong/weak motor magnitudes, and left/right trigger intensities.

nodes.name: GamepadPose
nodes.summary: WebVR Gamepad API interface representing the 3D pose (position and orientation) of a gamepad. Exposes hasOrientation/hasPosition flags and Float32Array attributes for position, velocity, acceleration, orientation, and angular data.

nodes.name: GenericTransformStream
nodes.summary: Interface mixin from the Streams specification providing readable and writable stream attributes to transform stream types like TextDecoderStream and TextEncoderStream.

nodes.name: Geolocation
nodes.summary: Geolocation API interface providing getCurrentPosition, watchPosition, and clearWatch methods for obtaining the device's geographic location, with callback-based position and error handling.

nodes.name: PositionOptions
nodes.summary: Dictionary of options for geolocation position requests including enableHighAccuracy flag, timeout duration, and maximumAge for cached positions.

nodes.name: GeolocationCoordinates
nodes.summary: Geolocation API interface providing read-only access to geographic coordinates: accuracy, latitude, longitude, plus nullable altitude, altitudeAccuracy, heading, and speed.

nodes.name: GeolocationPosition
nodes.summary: Geolocation API interface representing a single position reading with a GeolocationCoordinates object and an EpochTimeStamp timestamp.

nodes.name: GeolocationPositionError
nodes.summary: Geolocation API error interface with constants for PERMISSION_DENIED (1), POSITION_UNAVAILABLE (2), and TIMEOUT (3), plus readonly code and message attributes for error details.

nodes.name: HashChangeEvent
nodes.summary: Event interface fired when the URL fragment identifier changes. Extends Event with oldURL and newURL USVString attributes capturing the hash fragment before and after the change.

nodes.name: HashChangeEventInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary extending EventInit for HashChangeEvent initialization with oldURL and newURL fields defaulting to empty string.

nodes.name: Headers
nodes.summary: Fetch API interface for HTTP header manipulation. Provides constructor with HeadersInit parameter and methods for append, delete, get, getSetCookie, has, and set operations on ByteString headers, plus iterable pair iteration.

nodes.name: History
nodes.summary: HTML History interface for session history navigation. Provides length, state, go, back, forward, pushState, and replaceState members for programmatic browser history manipulation.

nodes.name: HTMLAnchorElement
nodes.summary: HTMLAnchorElement interface for the <a> element. Extends HTMLElement with CEReactions attributes for target, rel, relList, hreflang, type, text, and referrerPolicy, and includes the HTMLHyperlinkElementUtils mixin for URL manipulation.

nodes.name: HTMLAreaElement
nodes.summary: HTMLAreaElement interface for the <area> image-map element. Extends HTMLElement with CEReactions attributes for target, rel, relList, and referrerPolicy, plus the HTMLHyperlinkElementUtils mixin and partial noHref boolean attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLBaseElement
nodes.summary: HTMLBaseElement interface for the <base> element. Extends HTMLElement with an HTMLConstructor and a CEReactions href attribute for setting the document base URL.

nodes.name: HTMLBodyElement
nodes.summary: HTMLBodyElement interface for the <body> element. Extends HTMLElement, includes the WindowEventHandlers mixin for event handler attributes, and has partial extensions for legacy presentational attributes (text, bgColor, background).

nodes.name: HTMLButtonElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTML <button> element, providing form submission attributes, validation API, and constructor extending HTMLElement.

nodes.name: HTMLCanvasElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTML <canvas> element, providing 2D/WebGL/WebGL2 rendering context retrieval, image export methods, and OffscreenCanvas transfer.

nodes.name: HTMLCollection.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLCollection, a live collection of Element nodes accessible by index or name, with legacy-unenumerable-named-properties support.

nodes.name: HTMLDataElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTML <data> element, which links machine-readable content via a value attribute, extending HTMLElement.

nodes.name: HTMLDataListElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTML <datalist> element, providing a set of option elements for input autocomplete, extending HTMLElement.

nodes.name: HTMLDetailsElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTML <details> element, providing a disclosure widget with name and open state attributes, extending HTMLElement.

nodes.name: HTMLDialogElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTML <dialog> element, providing modal and non-modal dialog display with show, showModal, and close methods.

nodes.name: HTMLDirectoryElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the obsolete HTML <dir> element, a deprecated directory list element extending HTMLElement with no active members.

nodes.name: HTMLDivElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTML <div> element, a generic flow container with a partial interface providing the obsolete align attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLDListElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTML <dl> element, a description list element extending HTMLElement with a partial interface for obsolete compact attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLDocument.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLDocument, extending Document with legacy-override-builtins to provide named property access to DOM tree elements.

nodes.name: HTMLElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLElement, the base interface for all HTML elements, extending Element with metadata, user interaction, CSSOM, and microdata attributes, plus multiple mixin includes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses WebIDL partial interfaces and includes statements to compose GlobalEventHandlers, ElementContentEditable, ElementCSSInlineStyle, and HTMLOrSVGElement mixins.

nodes.name: HTMLEmbedElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTML <embed> element, an embedded content element extending HTMLElement with a partial interface for obsolete alignment attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLFieldSetElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTML <fieldset> element, a form control group with disabled state, validation API, and elements collection, extending HTMLElement.

nodes.name: HTMLFontElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the obsolete HTML <font> element, providing color, face, and size attributes for text styling, extending HTMLElement.

nodes.name: HTMLFormControlsCollection.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLFormControlsCollection, extending HTMLCollection with a namedItem getter that returns RadioNodeList or Element for radio button grouping.

nodes.name: HTMLFormElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTML <form> element, providing form submission controls, element collections, validation API, and the SelectionMode enum for text selection behavior.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the obsolete HTML <frame> element, a subwindow container with longDesc attribute, extending HTMLElement.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the obsolete HTML <frameset> element, a frame container that includes WindowEventHandlers mixin for window-level event handling.

nodes.name: HTMLHeadElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTML <head> element, the document metadata container with no additional attributes beyond HTMLElement.

nodes.name: HTMLHeadingElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTML heading elements (h1-h6), extending HTMLElement with a partial interface for the obsolete align attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLHRElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTML <hr> element, a thematic break with a partial interface providing obsolete presentation attributes like align, color, noShade, size, and width.

nodes.name: HTMLHtmlElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTML <html> root element, extending HTMLElement with a partial interface for the obsolete version attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLHyperlinkElementUtils.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL mixin definition for HTMLHyperlinkElementUtils, providing URL decomposition attributes (href, origin, protocol, host, pathname, etc.) for anchor and area elements.
nodes.languageNotes: Defined as a WebIDL mixin rather than an interface, allowing it to be included by multiple element interfaces via the includes statement.

nodes.name: HTMLIFrameElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTML <iframe> element, an inline frame with source, sandbox, allowFullscreen, referrerPolicy, and loading attributes plus contentDocument access, extending HTMLElement.

nodes.name: HTMLButtonElement
nodes.summary: Represents the HTML <button> element with form submission attributes (formAction, formEnctype, formMethod, formNoValidate, formTarget), validation API (checkValidity, reportValidity, setCustomValidity), and disabled state.

nodes.name: HTMLCanvasElement
nodes.summary: Represents the HTML <canvas> element with configurable width/height, rendering context retrieval (2D, WebGL, WebGL2, GPU), image export (toDataURL, toBlob), and OffscreenCanvas transfer support.

nodes.name: RenderingContext
nodes.summary: WebIDL typedef union type representing any valid canvas rendering context: CanvasRenderingContext2D, ImageBitmapRenderingContext, WebGLRenderingContext, WebGL2RenderingContext, or GPUCanvasContext.

nodes.name: HTMLCollection
nodes.summary: Represents a live, ordered collection of DOM Elements accessible by index via item() or by name via namedItem(), with legacy-unenumerable-named-properties behavior.

nodes.name: HTMLDataElement
nodes.summary: Represents the HTML <data> element, linking machine-readable data to human-readable content via the value attribute, with CEReactions support for custom element integration.

nodes.name: HTMLDataListElement
nodes.summary: Represents the HTML <datalist> element, providing a readonly HTMLCollection of option elements for use as input suggestions in form controls.

nodes.name: HTMLDetailsElement
nodes.summary: Represents the HTML <details> disclosure widget element with name and open attributes, enabling collapsible content sections with CEReactions support.

nodes.name: HTMLDialogElement
nodes.summary: Represents the HTML <dialog> element with open/returnValue state attributes and methods for showing (show, showModal) and closing (close) modal and non-modal dialogs.

nodes.name: HTMLDirectoryElement
nodes.summary: Represents the obsolete HTML <dir> directory list element. All members are commented out; serves as a minimal stub interface extending HTMLElement for backward compatibility.

nodes.name: HTMLDivElement
nodes.summary: Represents the HTML <div> generic flow container element, with a partial interface providing the obsolete align attribute for horizontal text alignment.

nodes.name: HTMLDListElement
nodes.summary: Represents the HTML <dl> description list element, with a partial interface for the obsolete compact attribute (currently commented out).

nodes.name: HTMLDocument
nodes.summary: Represents an HTML document with LegacyOverrideBuiltIns behavior, extending Document to provide named element access via a getter for DOM tree traversal by name.

nodes.name: HTMLElement
nodes.summary: The base interface for all HTML elements, extending Element with metadata attributes (title, lang, dir), user interaction (hidden, click, accessKey), innerText/outerText, microdata, CSSOM scroll/layout properties, and attachInternals for custom elements.

nodes.name: HTMLEmbedElement
nodes.summary: Represents the HTML <embed> element for embedded external content, with a partial interface providing obsolete align and name attributes (currently commented out).

nodes.name: HTMLFieldSetElement
nodes.summary: Represents the HTML <fieldset> form control grouping element with disabled state, form association, elements collection, and full constraint validation API (checkValidity, reportValidity, setCustomValidity).

nodes.name: HTMLFontElement
nodes.summary: Represents the obsolete HTML <font> element for text styling, with color (LegacyNullToEmptyString), face, and size attributes, all marked with CEReactions.

nodes.name: HTMLFormControlsCollection
nodes.summary: Represents a live collection of form control elements, extending HTMLCollection with a namedItem getter that shadows the inherited one and returns RadioNodeList or Element for radio button grouping.

nodes.name: HTMLFormElement
nodes.summary: Represents the HTML <form> element with form submission attributes (action, method, enctype, target), element collections, length/indexed access, submit/reset methods, requestSubmit with optional submitter, and validation API.

nodes.name: SelectionMode
nodes.summary: WebIDL enum defining text selection behavior modes for form elements: preserve (default), select, start, and end.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameElement
nodes.summary: Represents the obsolete HTML <frame> subwindow element with the longDesc USVString attribute providing a long description URI for the frame content.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement
nodes.summary: Represents the obsolete HTML <frameset> element, a frame layout container that includes WindowEventHandlers for window-level event attributes (cols and rows attributes commented out).

nodes.name: HTMLHeadElement
nodes.summary: Represents the HTML <head> document metadata container element, with no additional attributes or methods beyond those inherited from HTMLElement.

nodes.name: HTMLHeadingElement
nodes.summary: Represents the HTML heading elements (h1 through h6), with a partial interface for the obsolete align attribute (currently commented out).

nodes.name: HTMLHRElement
nodes.summary: Represents the HTML <hr> thematic break element, with a partial interface providing obsolete presentation attributes: align, color, noShade, size, and width, all marked with CEReactions.

nodes.name: HTMLHtmlElement
nodes.summary: Represents the HTML <html> root element of an HTML document, with a partial interface for the obsolete version attribute (currently commented out).

nodes.name: HTMLHyperlinkElementUtils
nodes.summary: WebIDL mixin providing URL decomposition attributes (href as stringifier, origin, protocol, username, password, host, hostname, port, pathname, search, hash) for hyperlink elements like HTMLAnchorElement and HTMLAreaElement.

nodes.name: HTMLIFrameElement
nodes.summary: Represents the HTML <iframe> inline frame element with src, srcdoc, name, sandbox, allowFullscreen, referrerPolicy, loading, width/height attributes, contentDocument/contentWindow access, and partial interface for frameBorder and longDesc.

nodes.name: BlobCallback
nodes.summary: WebIDL callback function type for HTMLCanvasElement.toBlob(), receiving an optional Blob parameter and returning undefined.

nodes.name: HTMLImageElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLImageElement interface, representing the HTML element, with attributes for image source, sizing, and decoding, plus a LegacyFactoryFunction for creating images via the Image() constructor.

nodes.name: HTMLImageElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the HTML element, inheriting from HTMLElement, with attributes for alt, src, srcset, sizes, crossOrigin, width, height, natural dimensions, and a decode() promise-based method for decoding image data.

nodes.name: Image
nodes.summary: LegacyFactoryFunction for creating HTMLImageElement instances programmatically, accepting optional width and height parameters. Exposed on the Window scope.

nodes.name: HTMLInputElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLInputElement interface, representing the <input> HTML element, with extensive attributes for form controls, validation API methods, text selection handling, and type-specific properties.

nodes.name: HTMLInputElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the HTML <input> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, with attributes covering all input types (accept, checked, disabled, files, maxLength, pattern, placeholder, required, src, type, value, etc.), validation API (checkValidity, reportValidity, setCustomValidity), text selection methods (select, setSelectionRange, setRangeText), and a testing-only selectFiles method.

nodes.name: HTMLLabelElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLLabelElement interface, representing the <label> HTML element, linking a label to a form control via its form association and htmlFor attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLLabelElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the HTML <label> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, providing read-only access to the associated form and control element, and the htmlFor attribute reflecting the for content attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLLegendElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLLegendElement interface, representing the <legend> HTML element, providing a caption for a fieldset with form association.

nodes.name: HTMLLegendElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the HTML <legend> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, providing read-only access to the associated HTMLFormElement via the form attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLLIElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLLIElement interface, representing the <li> HTML list item element, with a value attribute for ordered list numbering.

nodes.name: HTMLLIElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the HTML <li> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, with a CEReactions-triggering long value attribute for controlling the ordinal value in ordered lists.

nodes.name: HTMLLinkElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLLinkElement interface, representing the <link> HTML element, specifying external resource relationships including stylesheets, with attributes for href, rel, media, integrity, and includes the LinkStyle mixin.

nodes.name: HTMLLinkElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the HTML <link> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, with attributes for linking external resources (href, rel, relList, media, integrity, crossOrigin, type, hreflang, referrerPolicy, blocking, disabled) and including the LinkStyle mixin via the 'includes' statement for stylesheet support.

nodes.name: HTMLMapElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLMapElement interface, representing the <map> HTML element, providing client-side image map functionality with a name attribute and areas collection.

nodes.name: HTMLMapElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the HTML <map> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, with a name attribute and a read-only HTMLCollection of area elements.

nodes.name: HTMLMarqueeElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLMarqueeElement interface, representing the deprecated <marquee> HTML element with scrolling text behavior, attributes for direction, speed, and layout.

nodes.name: HTMLMarqueeElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL stub interface for the deprecated HTML <marquee> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, with all scrolling-related attributes and methods commented out, serving only as a minimal DOM presence.

nodes.name: HTMLMediaElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLMediaElement abstract interface, the base for <audio> and <video> elements, with network state constants, playback control, media tracks, and the CanPlayTypeResult enum and MediaProvider typedef.

nodes.name: CanPlayTypeResult
nodes.summary: WebIDL enum representing the result of canPlayType(): empty string (cannot play), 'maybe', or 'probably'. Used by HTMLMediaElement to report codec support levels.

nodes.name: HTMLMediaElement
nodes.summary: Abstract WebIDL interface serving as the base class for HTML audio and video elements, inheriting from HTMLElement. Defines network state constants (NETWORK_EMPTY through NETWORK_NO_SOURCE), ready state constants (HAVE_NOTHING through HAVE_ENOUGH_DATA), media error handling, network and playback state management (src, currentSrc, currentTime, duration, play, pause), volume and mute controls, and media track access (audioTracks, videoTracks, textTracks, addTextTrack).

nodes.name: HTMLMenuElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLMenuElement interface, representing the <menu> HTML element for toolbar and context menus, with an obsolete partial interface adding the compact attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLMenuElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the HTML <menu> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, serving as a minimal stub with only the HTMLConstructor and no active attributes in the main interface definition.

nodes.name: HTMLMetaElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLMetaElement interface, representing the <meta> HTML element, providing document-level metadata via name, httpEquiv, and content attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLMetaElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the HTML <meta> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, with CEReactions-triggering attributes for name, httpEquiv, and content, plus an obsolete partial interface adding the scheme attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLMeterElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLMeterElement interface, representing the <meter> HTML element for scalar measurement display, with attributes for value, min, max, low, high, optimum, and associated labels.

nodes.name: HTMLMeterElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the HTML <meter> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, with double-typed CEReactions attributes for value, min, max, low, high, and optimum gauge thresholds, plus a read-only NodeList of associated labels.

nodes.name: HTMLModElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLModElement interface, representing the <ins> and <del> HTML elements for content modifications, with cite and dateTime attributes commented out as a minimal stub.

nodes.name: HTMLModElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL stub interface for the HTML <ins> and <del> elements, inheriting from HTMLElement, with the cite and dateTime attributes commented out, serving only as a DOM presence marker.

nodes.name: HTMLObjectElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLObjectElement interface, representing the <object> HTML element for embedded external resources, with form association, validation API methods, and a partial interface with the useMap attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLObjectElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the HTML <object> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, with form association (form attribute), constraint validation API (willValidate, validity, checkValidity, reportValidity, setCustomValidity), and a type attribute for specifying the MIME type of the embedded resource.

nodes.name: HTMLOListElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLOListElement interface, representing the <ol> ordered list HTML element, with reversed, start, and type attributes commented out as a stub.

nodes.name: HTMLOListElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL stub interface for the HTML <ol> ordered list element, inheriting from HTMLElement, with all active attributes (reversed, start, type) and obsolete partial interface members (compact) commented out.

nodes.name: HTMLOptGroupElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLOptGroupElement interface, representing the <optgroup> HTML element for grouping <option> elements within a <select>, with disabled and label attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLOptGroupElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the HTML <optgroup> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, with CEReactions attributes for disabled state and the user-visible label text.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLOptionElement interface, representing the <option> HTML element within a <select>, with attributes for disabled, selected, value, text, index, and a LegacyFactoryFunction Option() constructor.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the HTML <option> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, with attributes for disabled state, form association, label text, defaultSelected and selected boolean flags, value, display text, and read-only index position within the parent options list.

nodes.name: Option
nodes.summary: LegacyFactoryFunction for creating HTMLOptionElement instances programmatically, accepting optional text, value, defaultSelected, and selected parameters. Exposed on the Window scope.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionsCollection.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLOptionsCollection interface, representing the live collection of <option> elements within a <select>, inheriting from HTMLCollection with indexed setter, add, remove, and selectedIndex.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionsCollection
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the options collection of a <select> element, inheriting from HTMLCollection. Provides an indexed setter for replacing options, add() method accepting HTMLOptionElement or HTMLOptGroupElement, remove() by index, a length attribute that shadows the inherited one, and a selectedIndex attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLOrSVGElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the FocusOptions dictionary and the HTMLOrSVGElement interface mixin, providing focus management (focus, blur, autofocus, tabIndex) and nonce attribute shared by both HTML and SVG elements.

nodes.name: FocusOptions
nodes.summary: WebIDL dictionary for configuring element focus behavior, with a preventScroll boolean member (defaulting to false) that controls whether the browser scrolls the element into view when focused.

nodes.name: HTMLOrSVGElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface mixin providing shared focus management functionality for both HTML and SVG elements. Includes the nonce attribute (security), autofocus and tabIndex CEReactions attributes, and focus/blur methods accepting optional FocusOptions.

nodes.name: HTMLOutputElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLOutputElement interface, representing the <output> HTML element for form calculation results, with form association, validation API, default and current value management, and labels.

nodes.name: HTMLOutputElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the HTML <output> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, with form association (form attribute), name attribute, Pure read-only type returning 'output', separate defaultValue and value with CEReactions, full constraint validation API (checkValidity, reportValidity, setCustomValidity), and a read-only NodeList of labels.

nodes.name: HTMLParagraphElement.webidl
nodes.summary:
WebIDL definition for the HTMLParagraphElement interface, representing the

paragraph HTML element, with a CEReactions align attribute added via the obsolete partial interface.

nodes.name: HTMLParagraphElement
nodes.summary:
WebIDL interface for the HTML

paragraph element, inheriting from HTMLElement, minimally defined with only the HTMLConstructor in the main interface, plus an obsolete partial adding the align attribute via CEReactions.

nodes.name: HTMLParamElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLParamElement interface, representing the <param> HTML element for defining parameters on an <object>, with name, value, type, and valueType attributes commented out as a stub.

nodes.name: HTMLParamElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL stub interface for the HTML <param> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, with all active attributes (name, value) and obsolete partial interface members (type, valueType) commented out.

nodes.name: HTMLPictureElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLPictureElement interface, representing the <picture> HTML element for responsive images, with only the HTMLConstructor as a minimal stub.

nodes.name: HTMLPictureElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL minimal interface for the HTML <picture> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, containing only the HTMLConstructor with no additional attributes or methods.

nodes.name: HTMLPreElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLPreElement interface, representing the <pre> preformatted text HTML element, with an obsolete partial interface adding the width attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLPreElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the HTML <pre> preformatted text element, inheriting from HTMLElement, minimally defined with only the HTMLConstructor in the main interface, plus an obsolete partial interface adding the long width attribute via CEReactions.

nodes.name: HTMLProgressElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLProgressElement interface, representing the <progress> HTML element for task completion display, with value, max, position attributes, and associated labels.

nodes.name: HTMLProgressElement
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for the HTML <progress> element, inheriting from HTMLElement, with double-typed CEReactions attributes for value and max, a read-only position attribute for computed progress, and a read-only NodeList of associated labels.

nodes.name: HTMLQuoteElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLQuoteElement DOM interface, representing <blockquote> and <q> elements, extending HTMLElement with a cite attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLScriptElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLScriptElement DOM interface, representing <script> elements with attributes for src, type, async, defer, integrity, and a static supports() method.

nodes.name: HTMLSelectElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLSelectElement DOM interface, representing <select> elements with selection, validation, options collection, and form integration methods.

nodes.name: HTMLSlotElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLSlotElement DOM interface and Slottable mixin, representing <slot> elements for shadow DOM slot assignment, with AssignedNodesOptions dictionary.

nodes.name: HTMLSourceElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLSourceElement DOM interface, representing <source> elements with attributes for src, srcset, sizes, media, type, width, and height.

nodes.name: HTMLSpanElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLSpanElement DOM interface, a minimal interface extending HTMLElement with no additional members, representing <span> elements.

nodes.name: HTMLStyleElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLStyleElement DOM interface, representing <style> elements with disabled, media, type, and blocking attributes, including the LinkStyle mixin.

nodes.name: HTMLTableCaptionElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLTableCaptionElement DOM interface, representing <caption> elements within tables.

nodes.name: HTMLTableCellElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLTableCellElement DOM interface, representing <td> and <th> elements with colSpan, rowSpan, and legacy presentational attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLTableColElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLTableColElement DOM interface, representing <col> and <colgroup> elements with span and legacy width attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLTableElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLTableElement DOM interface, representing <table> elements with methods for caption, tHead, tFoot, tBody, row management, and legacy presentational attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLTableRowElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLTableRowElement DOM interface, representing <tr> elements with rowIndex, cells collection, insertCell/deleteCell methods, and legacy bgColor attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLTableSectionElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLTableSectionElement DOM interface, representing <thead>, <tbody>, and <tfoot> elements with rows collection and insertRow/deleteRow methods.

nodes.name: HTMLTemplateElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLTemplateElement DOM interface, representing <template> elements with content fragment and declarative shadow DOM attributes (shadowRootMode, shadowRootDelegatesFocus, shadowRootClonable, shadowRootSerializable).

nodes.name: HTMLTextAreaElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLTextAreaElement DOM interface, representing <textarea> elements with extensive form control attributes, validation API, text selection methods, and constraint validation.

nodes.name: HTMLTimeElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLTimeElement DOM interface, representing <time> elements with a dateTime attribute for machine-readable date/time values.

nodes.name: HTMLTitleElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLTitleElement DOM interface, representing <title> elements with a text attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLTrackElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLTrackElement DOM interface, representing <track> elements with kind, src, srclang, label attributes, readyState constants, and a TextTrack reference.

nodes.name: HTMLUListElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLUListElement DOM interface, representing <ul> elements with deprecated compact and type attributes via a partial interface.

nodes.name: HTMLUnknownElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLUnknownElement DOM interface, representing unrecognized HTML elements as fallback, extending HTMLElement with no additional members.

nodes.name: HTMLVideoElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the HTMLVideoElement DOM interface, representing <video> elements, extending HTMLMediaElement with width, height, poster attributes, and video-specific dimensions.

nodes.name: IDBCursor.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the IDBCursor DOM interface and IDBCursorDirection enum, representing IndexedDB cursor objects for iterating over database records.

nodes.name: IDBCursorWithValue.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the IDBCursorWithValue DOM interface, extending IDBCursor with a value attribute for accessing the current record's value directly.

nodes.name: IDBDatabase.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the IDBDatabase DOM interface and supporting dictionaries/enums, representing an IndexedDB database connection with transaction creation, object store management, and event handlers.

nodes.name: IDBFactory.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the IDBFactory DOM interface and WindowOrWorkerGlobalScope mixin extension, providing IndexedDB database open, delete, and comparison operations.

nodes.name: HTMLQuoteElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <blockquote> and <q> elements. Extends HTMLElement with a USVString cite attribute for source URL, annotated with CEReactions for custom element integration.

nodes.name: HTMLScriptElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <script> elements. Extends HTMLElement with attributes for src, type, async, defer, integrity, crossOrigin, text content, and a static supports() method. Includes blocking via DOMTokenList.

nodes.name: HTMLSelectElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <select> elements. Provides selection management (selectedIndex, value), options collection, length manipulation, item/namedItem lookup, add/remove operations, and constraint validation API (checkValidity, setCustomValidity).

nodes.name: HTMLSlotElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <slot> elements in shadow DOM. Provides assignedNodes() and assignedElements() for retrieving slotted content, and assign() for imperative slot assignment.

nodes.name: Slottable
nodes.summary: Interface mixin applied to Element and Text nodes via includes, providing the assignedSlot readonly attribute for shadow DOM slot assignment introspection.

nodes.name: HTMLSourceElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <source> elements within <picture>, <audio>, and <video>. Provides attributes for src, srcset, sizes, media, type, width, and height for responsive media selection.

nodes.name: HTMLSpanElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <span> elements. A minimal interface extending HTMLElement with no additional members; serves as a generic inline container.

nodes.name: HTMLStyleElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <style> elements. Provides disabled, media, type, and blocking attributes. Includes the LinkStyle mixin for CSS stylesheet access.

nodes.name: HTMLTableCaptionElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <caption> elements within HTML tables. Extends HTMLElement with no additional standard members beyond deprecated align.

nodes.name: HTMLTableCellElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <td> and <th> table cell elements. Provides colSpan and rowSpan for cell spanning, cellIndex for position, and legacy presentational attributes (bgColor, height, width).

nodes.name: HTMLTableColElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <col> and <colgroup> table column elements. Provides a span attribute for column grouping and legacy width attribute via partial interface.

nodes.name: HTMLTableElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <table> elements. Manages caption, tHead, tFoot via getters/setters and create/delete methods, tBodies and rows collections, and insertRow/deleteRow operations for dynamic table manipulation.

nodes.name: HTMLTableRowElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <tr> table row elements. Provides rowIndex and sectionRowIndex for positioning, cells collection, and insertCell/deleteCell for dynamic cell management.

nodes.name: HTMLTableSectionElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <thead>, <tbody>, and <tfoot> table section elements. Provides a rows collection and insertRow/deleteRow methods for row management within table sections.

nodes.name: HTMLTemplateElement
