nodes.summary: DOM interface for <template> elements. Provides content DocumentFragment for template cloning and declarative shadow DOM attributes (shadowRootMode, shadowRootDelegatesFocus, shadowRootSlotAssignment, shadowRootClonable, shadowRootSerializable).

nodes.name: HTMLTextAreaElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <textarea> elements. Comprehensive form control with cols/rows dimensions, maxLength/minLength validation, defaultValue/value text management, constraint validation API, text selection methods (select, setSelectionRange, setRangeText), and labels collection.

nodes.name: HTMLTimeElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <time> elements. Provides a dateTime attribute for machine-readable date/time representations of human-readable content.

nodes.name: HTMLTitleElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <title> elements in document head. Provides a text attribute for getting and setting the document title with Pure annotation for DOM optimization.

nodes.name: HTMLTrackElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <track> elements for media text tracks. Provides kind, src, srclang, label, and default attributes, readyState constants (NONE, LOADING, LOADED, ERROR), and a TextTrack reference.

nodes.name: HTMLUListElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <ul> unordered list elements. Extends HTMLElement with deprecated compact and type attributes via a partial interface for legacy compatibility.

nodes.name: HTMLUnknownElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for unrecognized HTML elements. Acts as a fallback interface extending HTMLElement with no additional members, used when the browser encounters unknown element names.

nodes.name: HTMLVideoElement
nodes.summary: DOM interface for <video> elements. Extends HTMLMediaElement with width, height, poster attributes, videoWidth/videoHeight intrinsic dimensions, and an onpostershown event handler for testing.

nodes.name: IDBCursor
nodes.summary: DOM interface for IndexedDB cursor objects. Provides source (object store or index), direction, key, primaryKey, and request attributes for iterating over database query results.

nodes.name: IDBCursorWithValue
nodes.summary: DOM interface for IndexedDB cursors that include record values. Extends IDBCursor with a readonly value attribute, used when iterating object stores with full record data.

nodes.name: IDBDatabase
nodes.summary: DOM interface for IndexedDB database connections. Extends EventTarget with name/version attributes, transaction() for creating transactions, createObjectStore/deleteObjectStore for schema management, close(), and event handlers (onabort, onclose, onerror, onversionchange).

nodes.name: WindowOrWorkerGlobalScope
nodes.summary: Partial interface mixin for WindowOrWorkerGlobalScope that adds the indexedDB readonly attribute, providing access to the IndexedDB factory from both window and worker contexts.

nodes.name: IDBFactory
nodes.summary: DOM interface for the IndexedDB factory. Provides open() and deleteDatabase() for database lifecycle, databases() for listing available databases, and cmp() for key comparison.

nodes.name: AssignedNodesOptions
nodes.summary: Dictionary for slot assignedNodes/assignedElements options with a flatten boolean defaulting to false, controlling whether deeply nested slotted nodes are included.

nodes.name: IDBCursorDirection
nodes.summary: Enum defining IndexedDB cursor iteration directions: next, nextunique, prev, and prevunique, controlling record traversal order and uniqueness behavior.

nodes.name: IDBTransactionDurability
nodes.summary: Enum defining IndexedDB transaction durability hints: default, strict (flush to disk), and relaxed (performance-prioritized), controlling data persistence guarantees.

nodes.name: IDBTransactionOptions
nodes.summary: Dictionary for IndexedDB transaction options with a durability member defaulting to 'default', controlling transaction data persistence behavior.

nodes.name: IDBObjectStoreParameters
nodes.summary: Dictionary for IndexedDB object store creation parameters with optional keyPath (string or sequence) and autoIncrement boolean defaulting to false.

nodes.name: IDBDatabaseInfo
nodes.summary: Dictionary for IndexedDB database information returned by databases(), containing the database name and version number.

nodes.name: IDBIndex.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the IndexedDB IDBIndex interface, providing access to an object store index with key path, multiEntry, and unique properties. Gated behind the dom.indexeddb.enabled preference.

nodes.name: IDBIndex
nodes.summary: Represents an IndexedDB object store index, exposing readonly attributes for the associated object store, key path, multiEntry flag, and unique constraint.

nodes.name: IDBKeyRange.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the IndexedDB IDBKeyRange interface with static factory methods (only, lowerBound, upperBound, bound) and a private _includes helper for key range queries.

nodes.name: IDBKeyRange
nodes.summary: Defines a continuous key range for IndexedDB queries with lower/upper bounds and open/closed flags, plus static factory methods for constructing ranges.

nodes.name: IDBObjectStore.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the IndexedDB IDBObjectStore interface and IDBIndexParameters dictionary. The object store supports CRUD operations (put, add, get, delete, clear), cursor iteration, and index management.

nodes.name: IDBObjectStore
nodes.summary: Represents an IndexedDB object store with CRUD operations, cursor-based iteration, and index creation/deletion methods. Associated with an IDBTransaction.

nodes.name: IDBOpenDBRequest.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the IndexedDB IDBOpenDBRequest interface, extending IDBRequest with onblocked and onupgradeneeded event handlers for database open/upgrade operations.

nodes.name: IDBOpenDBRequest
nodes.summary: Extends IDBRequest to handle IndexedDB database open requests with event handlers for blocked and upgradeneeded lifecycle events.

nodes.name: IDBRequest.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the IndexedDB IDBRequest interface (extending EventTarget) and the IDBRequestReadyState enum. Represents an asynchronous request with result, error, source, and transaction tracking.

nodes.name: IDBRequest
nodes.summary: Base interface for IndexedDB asynchronous requests, exposing result/error attributes, the originating source object store/index, the associated transaction, and success/error event handlers.

nodes.name: IDBTransaction.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the IndexedDB IDBTransaction interface (extending EventTarget) and the IDBTransactionMode enum (readonly, readwrite, versionchange). Supports object store access, commit, and abort operations.

nodes.name: IDBTransaction
nodes.summary: Represents an IndexedDB transaction with access to object stores, commit/abort lifecycle control, and event handlers for abort, complete, and error notifications.

nodes.name: IDBVersionChangeEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the IndexedDB IDBVersionChangeEvent interface (extending Event) and its initializer dictionary IDBVersionChangeEventInit. Fired during database version upgrade transactions.

nodes.name: IDBVersionChangeEvent
nodes.summary: Event interface fired during IndexedDB version upgrade transactions, carrying oldVersion and newVersion attributes to track database schema version changes.

nodes.name: IIRFilterNode.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the Web Audio API IIRFilterNode interface (extending AudioNode) and IIRFilterOptions dictionary. Provides an infinite impulse response filter with feedforward and feedback coefficients.

nodes.name: IIRFilterNode
nodes.summary: Web Audio API node implementing an infinite impulse response (IIR) filter with a getFrequencyResponse method for computing magnitude and phase responses at specified frequencies.

nodes.name: ImageBitmap.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the ImageBitmap interface plus related enums (ImageOrientation, PremultiplyAlpha, ColorSpaceConversion, ResizeQuality), the ImageBitmapSource typedef, and ImageBitmapOptions dictionary. Represents a bitmap image that can be drawn to a canvas without undue latency.

nodes.name: ImageBitmap
nodes.summary: Represents a bitmap image suitable for efficient rendering to a canvas. Exposes width/height dimensions and a close method to release resources. Serializable and transferable across threads.

nodes.name: ImageBitmapRenderingContext.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the ImageBitmapRenderingContext interface and its settings dictionary. Provides a rendering context that transfers ImageBitmap data to an associated canvas.

nodes.name: ImageBitmapRenderingContext
nodes.summary: A canvas rendering context that accepts ImageBitmap objects via transferFromImageBitmap, allowing efficient pixel transfer to the associated canvas element.

nodes.name: InputEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the UI Events InputEvent interface (extending UIEvent) and InputEventInit dictionary. Represents user input events carrying data, inputType, isComposing, and DataTransfer information.

nodes.name: InputEvent
nodes.summary: Represents a DOM input event with access to inserted data, composing state, input type classification, associated DataTransfer, and a method to retrieve impacted StaticRange targets.

nodes.name: IntersectionObserver.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the IntersectionObserver callback type, IntersectionObserverInit dictionary, and IntersectionObserver interface. Provides a way to asynchronously observe changes in the intersection of a target element with an ancestor or the viewport.

nodes.name: IntersectionObserver

nodes.name: PermissionStatus
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface extending EventTarget to represent the status of a permission, with a readonly state attribute and an onchange event handler.

nodes.name: PermissionDescriptor
nodes.summary: WebIDL base dictionary for describing a permission query, requiring a PermissionName field.

nodes.name: PermissionState
nodes.summary: WebIDL enum with values granted, denied, and prompt representing the possible states of a permission.

nodes.name: PermissionName
nodes.summary: WebIDL enum listing all supported permission names: geolocation, notifications, push, midi, camera, microphone, speaker, device-info, background-sync, bluetooth, persistent-storage, screen-wake-lock, and gamepad.

nodes.name: Plugin.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the legacy Plugin interface, representing a browser plugin with name, description, filename, and MIME type accessors.

nodes.name: Plugin
nodes.summary: WebIDL legacy interface for enumerating browser plugins, providing indexed and named getters for MimeType objects along with name, description, filename, and length attributes.

nodes.name: PluginArray.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the legacy PluginArray interface, providing a collection of Plugin objects with refresh and indexed/named getter access.

nodes.name: PluginArray
nodes.summary: WebIDL legacy interface representing an array-like collection of Plugin objects, with refresh() to reload the plugin list and indexed/named getters.

nodes.name: PointerEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the PointerEvent interface and PointerEventInit dictionary, extending MouseEvent with pointer-specific attributes like pressure, tilt, twist, and altitude/azimuth angles.

nodes.name: PointerEvent
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for pointer input events, extending MouseEvent with attributes for pointerId, geometry (width/height), pressure, tilt, twist, altitude/azimuth angles, pointer type, and methods for coalesced/predicted events.

nodes.name: PointerEventInit
nodes.summary: WebIDL dictionary extending MouseEventInit for initializing PointerEvent instances, with defaults for pointerId, dimensions, pressure, tilt, twist, angles, and coalesced/predicted event sequences.

nodes.name: PopStateEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the PopStateEvent interface and PopStateEventInit dictionary, representing history navigation events with a state attribute.

nodes.name: PopStateEvent
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface extending Event for popstate events, with a readonly state attribute containing the history entry's state data.

nodes.name: PopStateEventInit
nodes.summary: WebIDL dictionary extending EventInit for initializing PopStateEvent with an optional state value defaulting to null.

nodes.name: ProcessingInstruction.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the ProcessingInstruction interface, extending CharacterData to represent XML processing instructions with a readonly target attribute.

nodes.name: ProcessingInstruction
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for XML/SGML processing instruction nodes, extending CharacterData with a constant readonly target attribute.

nodes.name: ProgressEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the ProgressEvent interface and ProgressEventInit dictionary, representing progress notifications with loaded and total size attributes.

nodes.name: ProgressEvent
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface extending Event for operation progress updates, with lengthComputable, loaded, and total attributes for tracking download/upload progress.

nodes.name: ProgressEventInit
nodes.summary: WebIDL dictionary extending EventInit for initializing ProgressEvent with lengthComputable, loaded, and total fields defaulting to false/0.

nodes.name: Promise.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL file defining internal Servo callback types (PromiseJobCallback, AnyCallback) and a LegacyNoInterfaceObject _Promise interface for internal JS promise handling.

nodes.name: _Promise
nodes.summary: Internal WebIDL interface (LegacyNoInterfaceObject) serving as a binding placeholder for JS Promise objects; not exposed to web content.

nodes.name: PromiseJobCallback
nodes.summary: WebIDL callback representing a promise job (microtask) with no arguments or return value.

nodes.name: AnyCallback
nodes.summary: WebIDL callback accepting any value and returning any value, with TreatNonCallableAsNull; used as a generic callback type for internal promise handling.

nodes.name: PromiseNativeHandler.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL file defining an internal PromiseNativeHandler interface (LegacyNoInterfaceObject) used to allow JS-owned native promise handler tracing and cycle collection.

nodes.name: PromiseNativeHandler
nodes.summary: Internal WebIDL interface (LegacyNoInterfaceObject) enabling JS to own and properly trace/cycle-collect native promise handlers; not exposed to web content.

nodes.name: PromiseRejectionEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the PromiseRejectionEvent interface and PromiseRejectionEventInit dictionary, representing unhandled promise rejection events.

nodes.name: PromiseRejectionEvent
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface extending Event for unhandled promise rejection events, exposing the rejected promise object and its rejection reason.

nodes.name: PromiseRejectionEventInit
nodes.summary: WebIDL dictionary extending EventInit for initializing PromiseRejectionEvent, requiring a promise object and optional reason.

nodes.name: QueuingStrategy.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for stream queuing strategies: the QueuingStrategy dictionary, QueuingStrategySize callback, and the ByteLengthQueuingStrategy and CountQueuingStrategy interfaces.

nodes.name: QueuingStrategy
nodes.summary: WebIDL dictionary defining a stream queuing strategy with a highWaterMark and an optional QueuingStrategySize sizing function.

nodes.name: QueuingStrategySize
nodes.summary: WebIDL callback that computes the size of a stream chunk as an unrestricted double, used by queuing strategies.

nodes.name: QueuingStrategyInit
nodes.summary: WebIDL dictionary for initializing a queuing strategy with a required highWaterMark value.

nodes.name: ByteLengthQueuingStrategy
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for a byte-length-based stream queuing strategy, with highWaterMark and size attributes using byte chunk sizing.

nodes.name: CountQueuingStrategy
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for a count-based stream queuing strategy, with highWaterMark and size attributes using per-chunk counting.

nodes.name: QuotaExceededError.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the QuotaExceededError interface (extending DOMException) and QuotaExceededErrorOptions dictionary, providing quota and requested attributes for storage quota errors.

nodes.name: QuotaExceededError
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface extending DOMException for storage quota errors, with nullable quota and requested attributes indicating the exceeded and attempted values.

nodes.name: QuotaExceededErrorOptions
nodes.summary: WebIDL dictionary for configuring QuotaExceededError with quota and requested double values.

nodes.name: RadioNodeList.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the RadioNodeList interface, extending NodeList with a mutable value attribute for radio button group value management.

nodes.name: RadioNodeList
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface extending NodeList for radio button groups, with a writable value attribute representing the selected radio button's value.

nodes.name: Range.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the Range interface extending AbstractRange, providing methods to manipulate document ranges including boundary setting, content deletion/extraction/cloning, and comparison. Includes partial extensions for createContextualFragment, getClientRects, and getBoundingClientRect.

nodes.name: Range
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for DOM Range objects, providing comprehensive methods for setting boundaries (setStart, setEnd, selectNode), manipulating content (deleteContents, extractContents, cloneContents, insertNode, surroundContents), comparison (compareBoundaryPoints, comparePoint), and position queries (isPointInRange, intersectsNode). Includes 4 comparison constants and a stringifier.

nodes.name: ReadableByteStreamController.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the ReadableByteStreamController interface, providing control over a readable byte stream with byobRequest, close, enqueue, and error operations.

nodes.name: ReadableByteStreamController
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for controlling a readable byte stream, with a nullable byobRequest attribute, desiredSize, and methods close(), enqueue(ArrayBufferView), and error().

nodes.name: ReadableStream.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the _ReadableStream (Transferable) interface and supporting types including ReadableStreamType enum, ReadableStreamReaderMode enum, and pipe-related dictionaries (ReadableWritablePair, StreamPipeOptions).

nodes.name: _ReadableStream
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for readable streams with Transferable support, providing locked status check, cancel, getReader, pipeThrough, pipeTo, and tee methods for stream consumption and piping.

nodes.name: ReadableStreamType
nodes.summary: WebIDL enum with value 'bytes' defining the type of a readable stream.

nodes.name: ReadableStreamReaderMode
nodes.summary: WebIDL enum with value 'byob' specifying the reader mode for readable streams.

nodes.name: ReadableStreamGetReaderOptions
nodes.summary: WebIDL dictionary for configuring how a readable stream reader is obtained, with an optional mode field.

nodes.name: ReadableWritablePair
nodes.summary: WebIDL dictionary pairing a readable stream with a writable stream, used by the pipeThrough method.

nodes.name: StreamPipeOptions
nodes.summary: WebIDL dictionary with preventClose, preventAbort, preventCancel flags and an optional AbortSignal for configuring stream pipe operations.

nodes.name: ReadableStreamBYOBReader.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the ReadableStreamBYOBReader interface (Bring-Your-Own-Buffer reader) and internal Servo-only ByteTee helper interfaces for stream teeing.

nodes.name: ReadableStreamBYOBReader
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for BYOB (Bring-Your-Own-Buffer) stream reading, providing read() with a caller-supplied ArrayBufferView and releaseLock(); includes ReadableStreamGenericReader mixin.

nodes.name: ReadableStreamBYOBReaderReadOptions
nodes.summary: WebIDL dictionary for BYOB reader read options, with an EnforceRange min bytes parameter defaulting to 1.

nodes.name: ReadableStreamBYOBRequest.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the ReadableStreamBYOBRequest interface, representing a request to write into a caller-supplied buffer with respond and respondWithNewView methods.

nodes.name: ReadableStreamBYOBRequest
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for BYOB read requests, with a nullable ArrayBufferView view attribute and respond/respondWithNewView methods to fulfill the request.

nodes.name: ReadableStreamDefaultController.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the ReadableStreamDefaultController interface, providing close, enqueue, and error methods for controlling a default readable stream.

nodes.name: ReadableStreamDefaultController
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface for controlling a default readable stream, with a desiredSize attribute and close, enqueue(chunk), and error methods for stream lifecycle management.

nodes.name: ReadableStreamDefaultReader.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the Streams API ReadableStreamDefaultReader, including the generic reader mixin and internal tee request/source interfaces.

nodes.name: ReadableStreamGenericReader
nodes.summary: Mixin interface providing the closed promise and cancel method shared by all readable stream readers.

nodes.name: ReadableStreamDefaultReader
nodes.summary: Default reader for a ReadableStream that provides read() and releaseLock() methods to consume stream chunks.

nodes.name: ReadableStreamReadResult
nodes.summary: Dictionary representing the result of a read operation containing the chunk value and done flag.

nodes.name: _DefaultTeeReadRequest
nodes.summary: Internal Servo-only interface for tee read requests, not exposed to web pages.

nodes.name: _DefaultTeeUnderlyingSource
nodes.summary: Internal Servo-only interface for tee underlying sources, not exposed to web pages.

nodes.name: ReportingObserver.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the Reporting API, including the ReportingObserver interface and supporting Report/ReportBody dictionaries.

nodes.name: ReportBody
nodes.summary: Base dictionary for report bodies; extended by specific report types like CSP violation reports.

nodes.name: Report
nodes.summary: Dictionary representing a generic report with type, url, destination, timestamp, attempts, and body fields.

nodes.name: ReportingObserver
nodes.summary: Interface for observing and collecting reports (e.g., CSP violations, deprecations) with observe(), disconnect(), and takeRecords() methods.

nodes.name: ReportingObserverOptions
nodes.summary: Configuration options for ReportingObserver specifying report types to observe and buffering behavior.

nodes.name: Request.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the Fetch API Request interface and associated enums for destinations, modes, credentials, cache, redirect, and referrer policy.

nodes.name: Request
nodes.summary: Represents an HTTP request in the Fetch API, with attributes for method, url, headers, and various request policies, plus a clone() method.

nodes.name: RequestInit
nodes.summary: Initialization dictionary for constructing a Request with optional method, headers, body, referrer, and policy settings.

nodes.name: RequestDestination
nodes.summary: Enumeration of request destination types (document, script, style, worker, etc.) as defined by the Fetch spec.

nodes.name: RequestMode
nodes.summary: Enumeration of request modes: navigate, same-origin, no-cors, and cors.

nodes.name: RequestCredentials
nodes.summary: Enumeration of credentials modes: omit, same-origin, and include.

nodes.name: RequestCache
nodes.summary: Enumeration of cache modes: default, no-store, reload, no-cache, force-cache, and only-if-cached.

nodes.name: RequestRedirect
nodes.summary: Enumeration of redirect handling modes: follow, error, and manual.

nodes.name: ReferrerPolicy
nodes.summary: Enumeration of referrer policy values including no-referrer, origin, strict-origin, and unsafe-url.

nodes.name: ResizeObserver.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the Resize Observer API, providing the ResizeObserver interface to observe element size changes.

nodes.name: ResizeObserver
nodes.summary: Observes element size changes, delivering ResizeObserverEntry notifications via callback when observed elements resize.

nodes.name: ResizeObserverBoxOptions
nodes.summary: Enumeration of box sizing options for observation: border-box, content-box, and device-pixel-content-box.

nodes.name: ResizeObserverOptions
nodes.summary: Configuration options for ResizeObserver observation specifying which box model to observe.

nodes.name: ResizeObserverEntry.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for ResizeObserverEntry, representing a single resize observation with target element and size information.

nodes.name: ResizeObserverEntry
nodes.summary: Represents a single resize observation entry with references to the target element and its content/border/device-pixel size rectangles.

nodes.name: ResizeObserverSize.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for ResizeObserverSize, a simple interface providing inline and block size dimensions for resize observations.

nodes.name: ResizeObserverSize
nodes.summary: Provides inlineSize and blockSize dimensions used in ResizeObserverEntry to report element dimensions.

nodes.name: Response.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the Fetch API Response interface, including static factory methods (error, redirect, json) and the ResponseType enum.

nodes.name: Response
nodes.summary: Represents an HTTP response with attributes for type, url, status, headers, and a clone() method, plus static factories error(), redirect(), and json().

nodes.name: ResponseInit
nodes.summary: Initialization dictionary for constructing a Response with optional status code, status text, and headers.

nodes.name: ResponseType
nodes.summary: Enumeration of response types: basic, cors, default, error, opaque, and opaqueredirect.

nodes.name: RTCDataChannel.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the WebRTC RTCDataChannel interface, supporting peer-to-peer data transfer with configurable ordering and retransmission.

nodes.name: RTCDataChannel
nodes.summary: WebRTC data channel extending EventTarget for bidirectional peer-to-peer data transfer with send() methods for strings, blobs, and array buffers.

nodes.name: RTCDataChannelInit
nodes.summary: Initialization dictionary for RTCDataChannel with ordered delivery, retransmission, protocol, and negotiation settings.

nodes.name: RTCDataChannelState
nodes.summary: Enumeration of RTCDataChannel states: connecting, open, closing, and closed.

nodes.name: RTCDataChannelEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the RTCDataChannelEvent interface, fired when a new RTCDataChannel is created by the remote peer.

nodes.name: RTCDataChannelEvent
nodes.summary: Event interface extending Event that carries a reference to the newly created RTCDataChannel from the remote peer.

nodes.name: RTCDataChannelEventInit
nodes.summary: Event initialization dictionary for RTCDataChannelEvent containing the required channel reference.

nodes.name: RTCError.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the WebRTC RTCError interface, extending DOMException with detailed error information for WebRTC operations.

nodes.name: RTCError
nodes.summary: Error type extending DOMException with WebRTC-specific details: errorDetail, SDP line numbers, HTTP status codes, SCTP cause codes, and alert codes.

nodes.name: RTCErrorInit
nodes.summary: Initialization dictionary for RTCError containing WebRTC-specific error detail fields.

nodes.name: RTCErrorDetailType
nodes.summary: Enumeration of WebRTC error detail types: data-channel-failure, dtls-failure, fingerprint-failure, sctp-failure, sdp-syntax-error, and hardware-encoder errors.

nodes.name: RTCErrorEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the RTCErrorEvent interface, an event carrying an RTCError object for WebRTC error reporting.

nodes.name: RTCErrorEvent
nodes.summary: Event interface extending Event that carries an RTCError object describing a WebRTC operation failure.

nodes.name: RTCErrorEventInit
nodes.summary: Event initialization dictionary for RTCErrorEvent containing the required RTCError.

nodes.name: RTCIceCandidate.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the WebRTC RTCIceCandidate interface, representing an ICE candidate for NAT traversal in peer connections.

nodes.name: RTCIceCandidate
nodes.summary: Represents an ICE (Interactive Connectivity Establishment) candidate with candidate string, SDP mid/index, username fragment, and toJSON() serialization.

nodes.name: RTCIceCandidateInit
nodes.summary: Initialization dictionary for RTCIceCandidate with candidate string, SDP mid/index, and username fragment fields.

nodes.name: RTCPeerConnection.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the core WebRTC RTCPeerConnection interface with SDP offer/answer negotiation, ICE candidate handling, data channels, and transceiver management.

nodes.name: RTCPeerConnection
nodes.summary: Core WebRTC interface extending EventTarget for peer-to-peer connections; handles SDP offer/answer, ICE candidates, signaling state, data channels, and transceivers.

nodes.name: RTCConfiguration
nodes.summary: Configuration for RTCPeerConnection with ICE servers, transport policy, bundle policy, RTCP mux policy, and ICE candidate pool size.

nodes.name: RTCIceTransportPolicy
nodes.summary: Enumeration of ICE transport policies: relay and all.

nodes.name: RTCBundlePolicy
nodes.summary: Enumeration of media bundle policies: balanced, max-compat, and max-bundle.

nodes.name: RTCRtcpMuxPolicy
nodes.summary: Enumeration of RTCP multiplexing policies: negotiate and require.

nodes.name: RTCIceServer
nodes.summary: Dictionary describing a STUN/TURN server with required URLs, optional username, credential, and credential type.

nodes.name: RTCIceCredentialType
nodes.summary: Enumeration of ICE credential types: password and oauth.

nodes.name: RTCOfferAnswerOptions
nodes.summary: Base dictionary for SDP offer/answer options with voice activity detection flag.

nodes.name: RTCOfferOptions
nodes.summary: Options for creating SDP offers extending RTCOfferAnswerOptions with ICE restart flag.

nodes.name: RTCAnswerOptions
nodes.summary: Options for creating SDP answers extending RTCOfferAnswerOptions (currently empty).

nodes.name: RTCIceGatheringState
nodes.summary: Enumeration of ICE gathering states: new, gathering, and complete.

nodes.name: RTCIceConnectionState
nodes.summary: Enumeration of ICE connection states: new, checking, connected, completed, disconnected, failed, and closed.

nodes.name: RTCSignalingState
nodes.summary: Enumeration of signaling states: stable, have-local-offer, have-remote-offer, have-local-pranswer, have-remote-pranswer, and closed.

nodes.name: RTCRtpCodingParameters
nodes.summary: Base dictionary for RTP coding parameters with an optional RTP stream ID (rid).

nodes.name: RTCRtpEncodingParameters
nodes.summary: RTP encoding parameters extending RTCRtpCodingParameters with active flag, max bitrate, and scale resolution down factor.

nodes.name: RTCRtpTransceiverInit
nodes.summary: Initialization dictionary for RTCRtpTransceiver with direction, streams, and send encodings.

nodes.name: RTCPeerConnectionIceEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the RTCPeerConnectionIceEvent interface, fired when an ICE candidate is discovered during peer connection negotiation.

nodes.name: RTCPeerConnectionIceEvent
nodes.summary: Event interface extending Event carrying the discovered RTCIceCandidate and its associated URL.

nodes.name: RTCPeerConnectionIceEventInit
nodes.summary: Event initialization dictionary for RTCPeerConnectionIceEvent with optional candidate and URL fields.

nodes.name: RTCRtpSender.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the WebRTC RTCRtpSender interface and supporting RTP parameter dictionaries for controlling media encoding and transmission.

nodes.name: RTCRtpHeaderExtensionParameters
nodes.summary: Dictionary for RTP header extension parameters with required URI, ID, and encryption flag.

nodes.name: RTCRtcpParameters
nodes.summary: Dictionary for RTCP parameters including CNAME and reduced size flag.

nodes.name: RTCRtpCodecParameters
nodes.summary: Dictionary for RTP codec parameters with required payload type, MIME type, clock rate, and optional channels and SDP format line.

nodes.name: RTCRtpParameters
nodes.summary: Dictionary for RTP parameters aggregating header extensions, RTCP parameters, and codec parameters.

nodes.name: RTCRtpSendParameters
nodes.summary: Dictionary for RTP send parameters extending RTCRtpParameters with transaction ID and encoding parameters.

nodes.name: RTCRtpSender
nodes.summary: Controls the encoding and transmission of media track data with setParameters() and getParameters() methods for RTP configuration.

nodes.name: RTCRtpTransceiver.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the WebRTC RTCRtpTransceiver interface, representing a combined sender and receiver with configurable direction.

nodes.name: RTCRtpTransceiver
nodes.summary: Represents a paired RTCRtpSender and receiver with a configurable direction (sendrecv, sendonly, recvonly, inactive, stopped).

nodes.name: RTCRtpTransceiverDirection
nodes.summary: Enumeration of transceiver directions: sendrecv, sendonly, recvonly, inactive, and stopped.

nodes.name: RTCSessionDescription.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the WebRTC RTCSessionDescription interface, representing an SDP session description for offer/answer negotiation.

nodes.name: RTCSessionDescription
nodes.summary: Represents an SDP session description with type (offer, pranswer, answer, rollback) and SDP string, plus toJSON() serialization.

nodes.name: RTCSessionDescriptionInit
nodes.summary: Initialization dictionary for RTCSessionDescription with required SDP type and optional SDP string.

nodes.name: RTCSdpType
nodes.summary: Enumeration of SDP types used in session descriptions: offer, pranswer, answer, and rollback.

nodes.name: RTCTrackEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the RTCTrackEvent interface, fired when a remote media track is added to an RTCPeerConnection.

nodes.name: RTCTrackEvent
nodes.summary: Event interface extending Event carrying a MediaStreamTrack received from a remote peer in a WebRTC connection.

nodes.name: RTCTrackEventInit
nodes.summary: Event initialization dictionary for RTCTrackEvent with a required MediaStreamTrack reference.

nodes.name: Sanitizer.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the HTML Sanitizer API, providing safe HTML sanitization with configurable allow/block lists for elements, attributes, and processing instructions.

nodes.name: SanitizerPresets
nodes.summary: Enumeration of sanitizer presets (currently only "default") for predefined sanitization configurations.

nodes.name: SetHTMLOptions
nodes.summary: Options for the setHTML() method accepting a sanitizer instance, config, or preset (defaults to "default").

nodes.name: SetHTMLUnsafeOptions
nodes.summary: Options for the setHTMLUnsafe() method accepting a sanitizer instance, config, or preset (defaults to empty).

nodes.name: Sanitizer
nodes.summary: HTML sanitizer interface for configuring and performing safe HTML sanitization with element allow/block lists, attribute filtering, and unsafe content removal.

nodes.name: SanitizerElementNamespace
nodes.summary: Dictionary for sanitizer element names with optional namespace (defaults to XHTML namespace).

nodes.name: SanitizerElementNamespaceWithAttributes
nodes.summary: Extended sanitizer element specifier with allowed and removed attribute lists for fine-grained element control.

nodes.name: SanitizerProcessingInstruction
nodes.summary: Dictionary for specifying processing instruction targets in sanitizer configuration.

nodes.name: SanitizerAttributeNamespace
nodes.summary: Dictionary for sanitizer attribute names with optional namespace (defaults to null).

nodes.name: SanitizerConfig
nodes.summary: Full sanitizer configuration with sequences for allowed/blocked elements, attributes, processing instructions, and comment/data-attribute flags.

nodes.name: Screen.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the CSSOM View Screen interface, providing information about the user's screen dimensions and color depth.

nodes.name: Screen
nodes.summary: Represents the user's screen providing read-only attributes for available width/height, total width/height, color depth, and pixel depth.

nodes.name: SecurityPolicyViolationEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the Content Security Policy SecurityPolicyViolationEvent interface, reporting CSP violation details.

nodes.name: SecurityPolicyViolationEventDisposition
nodes.summary: Enumeration of CSP violation dispositions: enforce and report.

nodes.name: SecurityPolicyViolationEvent
nodes.summary: Event interface extending Event that reports CSP violation details including document URI, blocked URI, violated directive, source file, line/column numbers, and status code.

nodes.name: SecurityPolicyViolationEventInit
nodes.summary: Event initialization dictionary for SecurityPolicyViolationEvent with all CSP violation detail fields defaulted.

nodes.name: Selection.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the Selection API interface, representing the user's text selection with methods for range manipulation and collapsing.

nodes.name: Selection
nodes.summary: Represents the user's text selection range with anchor/focus nodes and offsets, range management methods (getRangeAt, addRange, removeAllRanges), and collapse/extend operations.

nodes.name: ServiceWorker.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the Service Worker API ServiceWorker interface, representing a registered service worker with state tracking and messaging.

nodes.name: ServiceWorker
nodes.summary: Represents a registered service worker extending EventTarget with script URL, state tracking, postMessage() for communication, and onstatechange event.

nodes.name: ServiceWorkerState
nodes.summary: Enumeration of service worker lifecycle states: installing, installed, activating, activated, and redundant.

nodes.name: ServiceWorkerContainer.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the ServiceWorkerContainer interface, the entry point for service worker registration and retrieval.

nodes.name: ServiceWorkerContainer
nodes.summary: Entry point for service worker management extending EventTarget; provides controller reference, register(), and getRegistration() methods.

nodes.name: RegistrationOptions
nodes.summary: Options for service worker registration specifying scope, worker type (classic/module), and update-via-cache behavior.

nodes.name: ServiceWorkerGlobalScope.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the ServiceWorkerGlobalScope interface, the global execution context for service worker scripts.

nodes.name: ServiceWorkerGlobalScope
nodes.summary: Global scope for service worker execution extending WorkerGlobalScope; provides onmessage and onmessageerror event handlers for client communication.

nodes.name: ServiceWorkerRegistration.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the ServiceWorkerRegistration interface (extending EventTarget) for service worker lifecycle management, exposing installing/waiting/active workers, scope, updateViaCache, and the unregister() method. Includes the ServiceWorkerUpdateViaCache enum.

nodes.name: ServoInternals.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the Servo-internal ServoInternals interface with methods for memory reporting, garbage collection, preference listing/getting/setting, and a Navigator partial interface exposing the 'servo' attribute. Restricted to internal pages via Func check.

nodes.name: ServoParser.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines an empty marker interface ServoParser with LegacyNoInterfaceObject, used internally by Servo's parser infrastructure without exposing a constructor to web content.

nodes.name: ShadowRoot.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the ShadowRoot interface (extending DocumentFragment) per the DOM spec, with mode, delegatesFocus, slotAssignment, clonable, serializable, and host attributes. Includes partial interfaces for HTML serialization and the Sanitizer API, plus ShadowRootMode and SlotAssignmentMode enums.

nodes.name: SharedWorker.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the SharedWorker interface (extending EventTarget) per the HTML spec, with a scriptURL constructor and MessagePort port attribute. Includes the SharedWorkerOptions dictionary with extendedLifetime flag. Gated behind dom_sharedworker_enabled pref.

nodes.name: SharedWorkerGlobalScope.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the SharedWorkerGlobalScope interface (extending WorkerGlobalScope) with a replaceable name attribute, close() method, and onconnect event handler. Gated behind dom_sharedworker_enabled pref.

nodes.name: StaticRange.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the StaticRange interface (extending AbstractRange) per the DOM spec, with a constructor taking a StaticRangeInit dictionary specifying startContainer, startOffset, endContainer, and endOffset.

nodes.name: StereoPannerNode.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the StereoPannerNode interface (extending AudioScheduledSourceNode) for the Web Audio API, with a stereo pan AudioParam. Includes the StereoPannerOptions dictionary with default pan value.

nodes.name: Storage.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the Storage interface for the Web Storage API with length, key(), getItem(), setItem(), removeItem(), and clear() methods for client-side key-value storage.

nodes.name: StorageEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the StorageEvent interface (extending Event) for cross-window storage change notifications, with key, oldValue, newValue, url, and storageArea attributes. Includes the StorageEventInit dictionary and initStorageEvent() method.

nodes.name: StorageManager.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the StorageManager interface for the Storage API with persisted(), persist(), and estimate() methods, plus the NavigatorStorage mixin that adds the storage attribute to Navigator and WorkerNavigator. Includes the StorageEstimate dictionary.

nodes.name: StylePropertyMapReadOnly.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the StylePropertyMapReadOnly interface for the CSS Typed OM (Houdini) spec, with get(), has(), and getProperties() methods. Gated behind dom_worklet_enabled pref.

nodes.name: StyleSheet.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the StyleSheet interface per the CSSOM spec with type, href, ownerNode, title, media, and disabled attributes. Also defines the LinkStyle mixin for elements that reference stylesheets.

nodes.name: StyleSheetList.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the StyleSheetList interface per the CSSOM spec, providing an indexed collection of StyleSheet objects with item() getter and length attribute.

nodes.name: SubmitEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the SubmitEvent interface (extending Event) per the HTML spec, with a submitter attribute indicating which element triggered form submission. Includes the SubmitEventInit dictionary.

nodes.name: SubtleCrypto.webidl
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Web Crypto API definition. Defines the SubtleCrypto interface with encrypt, decrypt, sign, verify, digest, generateKey, deriveKey, deriveBits, importKey, exportKey, wrapKey, and unwrapKey methods. Includes a partial interface for modern algorithms (encapsulateKey, decapsulateKey, encapsulateBits, decapsulateBits, getPublicKey, supports). Defines ~30 algorithm parameter dictionaries (RSA, EC, AES, HMAC, HKDF, PBKDF2, Argon2, etc.) and the JsonWebKey dictionary.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive use of WebIDL dictionary inheritance chains (e.g., RsaHashedKeyGenParams : RsaKeyGenParams : Algorithm). Demonstrates partial interface pattern for spec layering. Defines ~30 algorithm-specific parameter dictionaries.

nodes.name: SVGElement.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the SVGElement interface (extending Element) as the base interface for all SVG DOM elements. Includes multiple mixins: GlobalEventHandlers, ElementCSSInlineStyle, and HTMLOrSVGElement.

nodes.name: SVGGraphicsElement.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the abstract SVGGraphicsElement interface (extending SVGElement) for SVG elements that can be rendered as graphics. Most attributes and methods are commented out as not yet implemented.

nodes.name: SVGImageElement.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the SVGImageElement interface (extending SVGGraphicsElement) for SVG <image> elements. Most geometry and attribute members are commented out as not yet implemented.

nodes.name: SVGSVGElement.webidl
nodes.summary: Defines the SVGSVGElement interface (extending SVGGraphicsElement) for the root SVG <svg> element. Most geometry, transform, intersection, and deprecated methods are commented out as not yet implemented.

nodes.name: TestBinding.webidl
nodes.summary: Comprehensive test interface for Servo's WebIDL binding code generator. Exercises every WebIDL type and feature: all numeric and string types, nullable/optional/variadic parameters, method overloading, union types, sequences, records, dictionaries (including inheritance and defaults), enums, typedefs, callbacks, promises, static members, preference-gated and Func-gated members, maplike stubs, and partial interfaces. Includes the TestNS namespace, TestDictionary family, and callback type definitions.
nodes.languageNotes: Exhaustive WebIDL feature coverage for testing the bindings code generator. Tests PutForwards, BinaryName attribute renaming, kebab-to-camel auto-renaming, [EnforceRange], [SameObject], [Func], [Pref], and [Exposed] extended attributes. Demonstrates record<DOMString, T> patterns, promise integration, and partial interface with differing [Exposed] scopes.

nodes.name: TestBindingIterable.webidl

nodes.name: TestBindingMaplikeWithPrimitive.webidl
