nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the VoidFunction callback type, a parameterless callback returning undefined.

nodes.name: VoidFunction
nodes.summary: WebIDL callback type representing a parameterless function that returns undefined, used as a generic void callback throughout the WebIDL ecosystem.

nodes.name: VTTCue.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the VTTCue interface (WebVTT cue), extending TextTrackCue with position, alignment, and rendering attributes for timed text tracks.

nodes.name: VTTRegion.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the VTTRegion interface (WebVTT region), defining a sub-area of the video viewport for rendering text track cues with anchor and scroll settings.

nodes.name: WakeLock.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the Screen Wake Lock API, including the WakeLock and WakeLockSentinel interfaces and a partial Navigator extension for preventing screen dimming.

nodes.name: WebGL2RenderingContext.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGL 2.0 rendering context, defining OpenGL ES 3.0 constants, methods for buffer management, texture operations, transform feedback, uniform buffer objects, sync objects, and instanced rendering via three mixins.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses WebIDL mixin composition pattern: WebGL2RenderingContext includes WebGLRenderingContextBase, WebGL2RenderingContextBase, and WebGL2RenderingContextOverloads. Defines ~280+ GLenum constants and ~70 methods.

nodes.name: WebGLActiveInfo.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGLActiveInfo interface, providing metadata (size, type, name) about active WebGL uniforms and attributes returned by introspection queries.

nodes.name: WebGLBuffer.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGLBuffer interface, representing a WebGL buffer object backed by the WebGLObject base class for vertex and index data storage.

nodes.name: WEBGLColorBufferFloat.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WEBGL_color_buffer_float WebGL extension, exposing GLenum constants for floating-point color buffer support (RGBA32F, FRAMEBUFFER_ATTACHMENT_COMPONENT_TYPE).

nodes.name: WEBGLCompressedTextureETC1.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WEBGL_compressed_texture_etc1 WebGL extension, exposing the COMPRESSED_RGB_ETC1_WEBGL constant for ETC1 compressed texture format support.

nodes.name: WEBGLCompressedTextureS3TC.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WEBGL_compressed_texture_s3tc WebGL extension, exposing S3TC (DXT1/DXT3/DXT5) compressed texture format constants for RGB and RGBA variants.

nodes.name: WebGLContextEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGLContextEvent interface (extends Event) and its WebGLContextEventInit dictionary, used to signal WebGL context loss and restoration events.

nodes.name: WebGLFramebuffer.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGLFramebuffer interface, representing an off-screen rendering target backed by the WebGLObject base class.

nodes.name: WebGLObject.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the abstract WebGLObject base interface, providing a label attribute common to all WebGL resource objects (buffers, textures, shaders, etc.).

nodes.name: WebGLProgram.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGLProgram interface, representing a linked shader program backed by the WebGLObject base class.

nodes.name: WebGLQuery.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGLQuery interface (WebGL 2.0), representing an asynchronous query object for occlusion and performance queries, backed by WebGLObject.

nodes.name: WebGLRenderbuffer.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGLRenderbuffer interface, representing a 2D image renderbuffer for off-screen rendering, backed by WebGLObject.

nodes.name: WebGLRenderingContext.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGL 1.0 rendering context, providing OpenGL ES 2.0 bindings including constants for all GL enums, buffer/texture/shader management, framebuffer operations, and drawing commands via two mixins.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses WebIDL mixin composition pattern: WebGLRenderingContext includes WebGLRenderingContextBase and WebGLRenderingContextOverloads. Defines all core WebGL 1.0 GLenum constants (~230+) and ~80 methods covering the full OpenGL ES 2.0 pipeline.

nodes.name: WebGLSampler.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGLSampler interface (WebGL 2.0), representing a texture sampler object for controlling texture filtering and wrapping, backed by WebGLObject.

nodes.name: WebGLShader.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGLShader interface, representing a compiled vertex or fragment shader backed by the WebGLObject base class.

nodes.name: WebGLShaderPrecisionFormat.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGLShaderPrecisionFormat interface, providing readonly attributes (rangeMin, rangeMax, precision) describing supported shader numeric precision formats.

nodes.name: WebGLSync.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGLSync interface (WebGL 2.0), representing a GL fence sync object for GPU-CPU synchronization, backed by WebGLObject.

nodes.name: WebGLTexture.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGLTexture interface, representing a GPU texture object for image sampling, backed by the WebGLObject base class.

nodes.name: WebGLTransformFeedback.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGLTransformFeedback interface (WebGL 2.0), representing a transform feedback object for capturing vertex shader output into buffers.

nodes.name: WebGLUniformLocation.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGLUniformLocation interface, representing the location of a uniform variable within a linked shader program for setting uniform values.

nodes.name: WebGLVertexArrayObject.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebGLVertexArrayObject interface (WebGL 2.0), representing a VAO that stores vertex attribute state configurations, backed by WebGLObject.

nodes.name: WebGLVertexArrayObjectOES.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the OES_vertex_array_object WebGL extension interface, providing VAO support for WebGL 1.0 contexts, backed by WebGLObject.

nodes.name: VTTCue
nodes.summary: WebVTT text track cue interface extending TextTrackCue with configurable display attributes: region, vertical direction, line position, alignment, size, and text content, plus getCueAsHTML() for rendering.

nodes.name: VTTRegion
nodes.summary: WebVTT region interface defining a sub-area of the video viewport for rendering cues, with configurable width, lines, anchor coordinates (region and viewport), and scroll behavior.

nodes.name: WakeLock
nodes.summary: Screen Wake Lock interface for requesting a wake lock sentinel that prevents the device screen from turning off, with an optional type parameter defaulting to 'screen'.

nodes.name: WakeLockSentinel
nodes.summary: Wake lock sentinel interface extending EventTarget, providing a released flag and wake lock type descriptor to monitor the state of an active screen wake lock.

nodes.name: WebGLActiveInfo
nodes.summary: WebGL active info interface providing readonly metadata (GLint size, GLenum type, DOMString name) about active uniforms and attributes queried from a compiled shader program.

nodes.name: WebGLBuffer
nodes.summary: WebGL buffer interface extending WebGLObject, representing a GPU buffer for storing vertex data, index data, or pixel data used in rendering operations.

nodes.name: WEBGLColorBufferFloat
nodes.summary: WebGL extension interface (LegacyNoInterfaceObject) exposing constants for floating-point color buffer rendering: RGBA32F, FRAMEBUFFER_ATTACHMENT_COMPONENT_TYPE, and UNSIGNED_NORMALIZED.

nodes.name: WEBGLCompressedTextureETC1
nodes.summary: WebGL extension interface (LegacyNoInterfaceObject) exposing the COMPRESSED_RGB_ETC1_WEBGL constant for Ericsson Texture Compression format support.

nodes.name: WEBGLCompressedTextureS3TC
nodes.summary: WebGL extension interface (LegacyNoInterfaceObject) exposing S3TC compressed texture format constants: DXT1 (RGB and RGBA), DXT3, and DXT5 variants with their GLenum values.

nodes.name: WebGLContextEvent
nodes.summary: WebGL context event interface extending Event, fired on context loss/restoration with a statusMessage attribute and constructor accepting WebGLContextEventInit dictionary.

nodes.name: WebGLContextEventInit
nodes.summary: Dictionary extending EventInit with a statusMessage DOMString field, used to initialize WebGLContextEvent with context loss/restoration status information.

nodes.name: WebGLFramebuffer
nodes.summary: WebGL framebuffer interface extending WebGLObject, representing an off-screen rendering target to which color, depth, and stencil attachments can be bound.

nodes.name: WebGLObject
nodes.summary: Abstract base interface for all WebGL resource objects, providing a USVString label attribute for developer-assigned debug labels on GPU objects.

nodes.name: WebGLProgram
nodes.summary: WebGL program interface extending WebGLObject, representing a linked GPU shader program combining vertex and fragment shaders into an executable rendering pipeline.

nodes.name: WebGLQuery
nodes.summary: WebGL 2.0 query interface extending WebGLObject, representing an asynchronous GPU query for occlusion testing and performance counters, gated behind the dom_webgl2_enabled pref.

nodes.name: WebGLRenderbuffer
nodes.summary: WebGL renderbuffer interface extending WebGLObject, representing a 2D image storage buffer that can be attached to framebuffers for depth, stencil, or color rendering.

nodes.name: WebGLContextAttributes
nodes.summary: Dictionary defining WebGL context creation attributes with defaults: alpha, depth, stencil, antialias, premultipliedAlpha, preserveDrawingBuffer, power preference, and fail-if-performance-caveat flags.

nodes.name: WebGLRenderingContextBase
nodes.summary: Core WebGL 1.0 rendering context mixin defining all OpenGL ES 2.0 constants (~230+ GLenums) and ~80 methods covering the complete graphics pipeline: buffers, shaders, textures, framebuffers, uniforms, blending, depth/stencil, and drawing commands.

nodes.name: WebGLRenderingContextOverloads
nodes.summary: WebGL 1.0 overloads mixin providing typed array overloads for bufferData, bufferSubData, texImage2D, texSubImage2D, readPixels, compressedTexImage2D, and uniform setter methods supporting Float32Array and Int32Array variants.

nodes.name: WebGLRenderingContext
nodes.summary: WebGL 1.0 rendering context interface composed via includes of WebGLRenderingContextBase and WebGLRenderingContextOverloads, exposed to both Window and Worker contexts.

nodes.name: WebGL2RenderingContextBase
nodes.summary: Core WebGL 2.0 rendering context mixin extending WebGL 1.0 with OpenGL ES 3.0 features: ~280+ new GLenum constants, buffer copy/subdata, framebuffer blit, 3D textures, instanced drawing, transform feedback, uniform buffer objects, sync objects, samplers, and multiple render targets.

nodes.name: WebGL2RenderingContextOverloads
nodes.summary: WebGL 2.0 overloads mixin providing typed array overloads with optional srcOffset/length for bufferData, texImage2D, texSubImage2D, readPixels, compressedTexImage2D, and uniform setter methods with Float32List and Int32List support.

nodes.name: WebGL2RenderingContext
nodes.summary: WebGL 2.0 rendering context interface composed via includes of WebGLRenderingContextBase, WebGL2RenderingContextBase, and WebGL2RenderingContextOverloads, gated behind the WebGL2RenderingContext::is_webgl2_enabled function check.

nodes.name: WebGLSampler
nodes.summary: WebGL 2.0 sampler interface extending WebGLObject, representing a texture sampler object for controlling texture filtering and wrapping modes independently from texture objects.

nodes.name: WebGLShader
nodes.summary: WebGL shader interface extending WebGLObject, representing a compiled vertex or fragment shader handle that can be attached to a WebGLProgram for linking.

nodes.name: WebGLShaderPrecisionFormat
nodes.summary: WebGL shader precision format interface providing readonly GLint attributes (rangeMin, rangeMax, precision) describing the numeric precision capabilities of vertex and fragment shaders.

nodes.name: WebGLSync
nodes.summary: WebGL 2.0 sync interface extending WebGLObject, representing a GL fence sync object used to synchronize GPU and CPU operations, gated behind dom_webgl2_enabled pref.

nodes.name: WebGLTexture
nodes.summary: WebGL texture interface extending WebGLObject, representing a GPU texture object for storing 2D image data that can be sampled by shaders during rendering.

nodes.name: WebGLTransformFeedback
nodes.summary: WebGL 2.0 transform feedback interface extending WebGLObject, capturing vertex shader output attributions into GPU buffer objects, gated behind dom_webgl2_enabled pref.

nodes.name: WebGLUniformLocation
nodes.summary: WebGL uniform location interface representing the opaque handle to a uniform variable's location within a shader program, used as a target for uniform setter methods.

nodes.name: WebGLVertexArrayObject
nodes.summary: WebGL 2.0 vertex array object interface extending WebGLObject, storing vertex attribute setup state for efficient switching between vertex buffer configurations, gated behind dom_webgl2_enabled pref.

nodes.name: WebGLVertexArrayObjectOES
nodes.summary: WebGL 1.0 OES_vertex_array_object extension interface extending WebGLObject, bringing VAO support to WebGL 1.0 contexts as a LegacyNoInterfaceObject extension.

nodes.name: WebGPU.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the WebGPU API, including interfaces for GPU device, buffers, textures, pipelines, command encoding, rendering, compute shaders, and error handling. Covers the complete GPU abstraction layer for Servo's WebGPU implementation.
nodes.languageNotes: Exposes over 40 interfaces, 25+ enums, 30+ dictionaries, 7 mixins, 5 namespaces, and 15+ typedefs covering the entire WebGPU specification including buffer management, texture operations, pipeline creation, command encoding, and render/compute pass execution.

nodes.name: WebSocket.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WebSocket API, providing full-duplex communication channels over TCP with events for open, message, error, and close states.

nodes.name: WheelEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WheelEvent interface, representing mouse wheel or similar input device events with delta values for X, Y, and Z axes.

nodes.name: Window.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the Window interface, the primary global scope for browser windows. Defines browsing context navigation, viewport properties, CSSOM View extensions, WebDriver support, localStorage/sessionStorage, fetch, animation frames, postMessage, and selection APIs.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses multiple partial interface declarations and mixin includes to assemble the complete Window API from separate specification modules (CSSOM, CSSOM View, HTML, WebDriver, Selection, Fetch).

nodes.name: WindowClient.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WindowClient interface from the Service Workers specification, representing a service worker client that is a window browsing context.

nodes.name: WindowOrWorkerGlobalScope.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WindowOrWorkerGlobalScope mixin, providing APIs common to both Window and Worker global scopes including timers, base64 encoding, microtask queuing, ImageBitmap creation, structured cloning, fetch, performance, trusted types, and secure context detection.

nodes.name: WindowProxy.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WindowProxy exotic object, representing a proxy for a Window object used in cross-origin access scenarios.

nodes.name: Worker.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the Worker interface, providing background thread execution with postMessage communication. Includes worker types (classic/module) and credential options.

nodes.name: WorkerGlobalScope.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WorkerGlobalScope interface, the global execution context for Web Workers providing self-reference, location, navigator, script imports, and lifecycle event handlers.

nodes.name: WorkerLocation.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WorkerLocation interface, providing URL information (href, origin, protocol, host, port, pathname, search, hash) for worker contexts.

nodes.name: WorkerNavigator.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WorkerNavigator interface, providing navigator capabilities (ID, language, online status, hardware concurrency, permissions) in worker contexts.

nodes.name: Worklet.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the Worklet interface from CSS Houdini, allowing script modules to be added to rendering pipeline worklets.

nodes.name: WorkletGlobalScope.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WorkletGlobalScope interface, the execution context for Houdini worklets.

nodes.name: WritableStream.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WritableStream interface from the Streams specification, providing a writable stream with abort, close, and writer acquisition methods.

nodes.name: WritableStreamDefaultController.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WritableStreamDefaultController interface, providing the abort signal and error signaling for writable stream controllers.

nodes.name: WritableStreamDefaultWriter.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the WritableStreamDefaultWriter interface, providing methods to write chunks, abort, close, and release the lock on a writable stream.

nodes.name: XMLDocument.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XMLDocument interface, a specialized Document type for XML content.

nodes.name: XMLHttpRequest.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XMLHttpRequest interface, providing HTTP request capabilities with support for synchronous and asynchronous operations, response types (arraybuffer, blob, document, json, text), and upload tracking.

nodes.name: XMLHttpRequestEventTarget.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XMLHttpRequestEventTarget abstract interface, providing XHR lifecycle event handlers (loadstart, progress, abort, error, load, timeout, loadend).

nodes.name: XMLHttpRequestUpload.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XMLHttpRequestUpload interface, representing the upload process of an XMLHttpRequest via inheritance from XMLHttpRequestEventTarget.

nodes.name: XMLSerializer.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XMLSerializer interface, providing DOM node serialization to XML/HTML strings.

nodes.name: XPathEvaluator.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XPathEvaluator interface and XPathEvaluatorBase mixin, providing XPath expression creation, Node resolver creation, and XPath evaluation against DOM nodes.

nodes.name: XPathExpression.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XPathExpression interface, representing a compiled XPath expression that can be evaluated against a DOM node.

nodes.name: XPathNSResolver.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XPathNSResolver callback interface, providing namespace prefix-to-URI resolution for XPath evaluation.

nodes.name: XPathResult.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XPathResult interface, representing the result of an XPath evaluation with typed result access (number, string, boolean, node, iterator, snapshot).

nodes.name: GPU
nodes.summary: Entry point interface for WebGPU, providing adapter request, preferred canvas format retrieval, and WGSLLanguageFeatures access.

nodes.name: GPUDevice
nodes.summary: Core WebGPU device interface that owns GPU resources. Creates buffers, textures, samplers, bind groups, pipelines, shader modules, command encoders, render bundle encoders, and query sets. Extends EventTarget and includes GPUObjectBase.

nodes.name: GPUAdapter
nodes.summary: Represents a physical GPU adapter with features, limits, and adapter info. Provides device creation with requested features and limits.

nodes.name: GPUBuffer
nodes.summary: Represents a GPU memory buffer with mapAsync for CPU access, getMappedRange for reading mapped data, unmap, and destroy lifecycle management.

nodes.name: GPUTexture
nodes.summary: Represents a GPU texture resource with view creation, destruction, and read-only properties for dimensions, mip levels, sample count, format, and usage flags.

nodes.name: GPUCommandEncoder
nodes.summary: Encodes GPU commands into command buffers. Provides render pass and compute pass creation, buffer-to-buffer/texture copy operations, query set resolution, and command buffer finalization. Includes GPUCommandsMixin and GPUDebugCommandsMixin.

nodes.name: GPUQueue
nodes.summary: GPU command queue that submits command buffers for execution, provides work-done tracking, and supports direct buffer writes, texture writes, and external image copying.

nodes.name: GPUShaderModule
nodes.summary: Represents a compiled WGSL shader module with compilation info retrieval for error/warning diagnostics.

nodes.name: GPUComputePassEncoder
nodes.summary: Encodes commands within a compute pass, including pipeline binding, workgroup dispatch (direct and indirect), debug markers, and bind group management. Includes multiple command mixins.

nodes.name: GPURenderPassEncoder
nodes.summary: Encodes commands within a render pass, including viewport/scissor configuration, blend constants, stencil reference, render bundle execution, debug markers, bind groups, and draw commands. Includes multiple command and render mixins.

nodes.name: GPUSupportedLimits
nodes.summary: Exposes GPU hardware limits as read-only attributes including maximum texture dimensions, bind group counts, buffer sizes, vertex attributes, color attachments, and compute workgroup parameters.

nodes.name: GPUQuerySet
nodes.summary: Represents a GPU query set for occlusion and timestamp queries with type and count properties and destroy lifecycle.

nodes.name: Window
nodes.summary: Primary browser window global scope interface. Provides browsing context management (navigation, focus, frames), user prompts (alert, confirm, prompt), animation frame scheduling, cross-origin postMessage, document access, navigator, location, history, and WebDriver extensions.

nodes.name: WebSocket
nodes.summary: WebSocket client interface for full-duplex communication. Provides connection state constants, open/close lifecycle, send methods for text and binary data, and event handlers for open, message, error, and close events.

nodes.name: WheelEvent
nodes.summary: Mouse wheel event interface extending MouseEvent with delta values for X/Y/Z axes, delta mode constants (pixel, line, page), and a legacy initWheelEvent method.

nodes.name: Worker
nodes.summary: Web Worker interface for background thread execution. Provides constructor with script URL and options, termination, structured postMessage, and message/error event handlers.

nodes.name: WorkerGlobalScope
nodes.summary: Abstract global execution context for Web Workers. Provides self-reference, location, navigator, importScripts for dynamic script loading, and lifecycle event handlers.

nodes.name: XMLHttpRequest
nodes.summary: HTTP request interface extending XMLHttpRequestEventTarget. Supports all HTTP methods, request header manipulation, timeout/credentials configuration, response type selection (arraybuffer, blob, document, json, text), upload tracking, and state change events.

nodes.name: XMLHttpRequestEventTarget
nodes.summary: Abstract event target base for XHR, providing lifecycle event handlers: loadstart, progress, abort, error, load, timeout, and loadend. Extended by both XMLHttpRequest and XMLHttpRequestUpload.

nodes.name: WritableStream
nodes.summary: Transferable writable stream interface from the Streams API. Provides abort and close operations, writer acquisition via getWriter, and a locked state property.

nodes.name: WritableStreamDefaultWriter
nodes.summary: Default writer for writable streams. Provides write, abort, close, and releaseLock methods, plus closed/ready promises and desiredSize for backpressure management.

nodes.name: XPathEvaluator
nodes.summary: XPath evaluation interface. Includes XPathEvaluatorBase mixin which provides createExpression, createNSResolver, and evaluate methods for XPath query execution against DOM nodes.

nodes.name: XPathEvaluatorBase
nodes.summary: Mixin providing core XPath evaluation capabilities: expression compilation, namespace resolver creation, and expression evaluation against context nodes with optional result type.

nodes.name: XPathExpression
nodes.summary: Compiled XPath expression interface that can be evaluated against a DOM context node with optional result type and result object reuse.

nodes.name: XPathResult
nodes.summary: XPath evaluation result with typed result access. Provides result type constants (ANY_TYPE through FIRST_ORDERED_NODE_TYPE), and typed getters for number, string, boolean, single node, and snapshot iteration.

nodes.name: Worklet
nodes.summary: CSS Houdini Worklet interface for loading rendering pipeline modules via addModule with optional credential configuration.

nodes.name: XRBoundedReferenceSpace.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRBoundedReferenceSpace interface, extending XRReferenceSpace to provide bounds geometry for bounded-floor reference spaces in WebXR.

nodes.name: XRCompositionLayer.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRCompositionLayer interface, a base layer type extending XRLayer with commented-out attributes for layout, blend, foveation, and destroy support (TODO: issue #27493).

nodes.name: XRCubeLayer.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRCubeLayer interface, extending XRCompositionLayer to define a cube-map layer type with space and orientation attributes (TODO: issue #27493, all members commented out).

nodes.name: XRCylinderLayer.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRCylinderLayer interface, extending XRCompositionLayer to define a cylindrical projection layer with radius, angle, and aspect-ratio attributes (TODO: issue #27493, all members commented out).

nodes.name: XREquirectLayer.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XREquirectLayer interface, extending XRCompositionLayer to define an equirectangular projection layer with radius and angular extent attributes (TODO: issue #27493, all members commented out).

nodes.name: XRFrame.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRFrame interface, the core per-frame state object providing viewer pose retrieval, joint pose queries, hit-test results, and pose-filling utilities for WebXR sessions.

nodes.name: XRHand.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for the XRHandJoint enum (25 joint constants for wrist, thumb, index, middle, ring, and pinky fingers) and the XRHand iterable interface for WebXR hand input tracking.

nodes.name: XRHitTestResult.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRHitTestResult interface, providing a getPose method to obtain the pose of a hit-test result relative to a given XRSpace in WebXR Hit Test API.

nodes.name: XRHitTestSource.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for XRHitTestTrackableType enum, XRHitTestOptionsInit dictionary, and XRHitTestSource interface providing hit-test subscription with cancel capability in WebXR Hit Test API.

nodes.name: XRInputSource.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for XRHandedness and XRTargetRayMode enums and the XRInputSource interface representing a WebXR input device with handedness, target ray, grip space, profiles, gamepad, and hand tracking support.

nodes.name: XRInputSourceArray.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRInputSourceArray interface, an iterable collection of XRInputSource objects with indexed getter and length attribute for WebXR input management.

nodes.name: XRInputSourceEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for XRInputSourceEvent (extending Event) and XRInputSourceEventInit dictionary, providing the event type fired when a WebXR input source state changes.

nodes.name: XRInputSourcesChangeEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for XRInputSourcesChangeEvent (extending Event) and its init dictionary, fired when WebXR input sources are added or removed from a session.

nodes.name: XRJointPose.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRJointPose interface, extending XRPose with a radius attribute representing the distance from the joint center for WebXR hand input.

nodes.name: XRJointSpace.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRJointSpace interface, extending XRSpace with a jointName attribute identifying which XRHandJoint this space tracks in WebXR hand input.

nodes.name: XRLayer.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRLayer base interface, extending EventTarget as the root type for all WebXR layer types in the layers specification.

nodes.name: XRLayerEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for XRLayerEvent (extending Event) and XRLayerEventInit dictionary, providing the event type for WebXR layer-related events with a reference to the associated XRLayer.

nodes.name: XRMediaBinding.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for XRMediaBinding interface and XRMediaLayerInit dictionary, enabling creation of quad, cylinder, and equirect layers from HTMLVideoElement sources in WebXR layers.

nodes.name: XRPose.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRPose interface, representing a spatial pose with a rigid transform, optional linear and angular velocity, and an emulated-position flag in WebXR.

nodes.name: XRProjectionLayer.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRProjectionLayer interface, extending XRCompositionLayer for rendering projection layers in WebXR (TODO: issue #27493, members commented out).

nodes.name: XRQuadLayer.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRQuadLayer interface, extending XRCompositionLayer to define a flat quadrilateral layer with width, height, space, and transform attributes (TODO: issue #27493, members commented out).

nodes.name: XRRay.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for XRRayDirectionInit dictionary and XRRay interface with two constructors, representing a ray with origin, direction, and matrix attributes for WebXR hit-testing.

nodes.name: XRReferenceSpace.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for XRReferenceSpaceType enum and XRReferenceSpace interface (extending XRSpace), providing getOffsetReferenceSpace and onreset event handler for WebXR spatial tracking.

nodes.name: XRReferenceSpaceEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for XRReferenceSpaceEvent (extending Event) and its init dictionary, fired when a WebXR reference space is reset with an optional transform.

nodes.name: XRRenderState.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definitions for XRRenderStateInit dictionary and XRRenderState interface with depth-range, field-of-view, baseLayer, and layers attributes configuring WebXR rendering parameters.

nodes.name: XRBoundedReferenceSpace
nodes.summary: WebXR interface extending XRReferenceSpace to expose boundsGeometry for bounded-floor reference spaces, conditionally compiled behind the WEBXR feature flag.

nodes.name: XRCompositionLayer
nodes.summary: Abstract base interface for all WebXR composition layer types, extending XRLayer with stubbed attributes for layout, blend, chromatic aberration, foveation, and destroy.

nodes.name: XRCubeLayer
nodes.summary: WebXR layer interface extending XRCompositionLayer for cube-map rendering surfaces with space and orientation attributes (stub, implementation pending).

nodes.name: XRCylinderLayer
nodes.summary: WebXR layer interface extending XRCompositionLayer for cylindrical projection surfaces with radius, central angle, and aspect ratio (stub, implementation pending).

nodes.name: XREquirectLayer
nodes.summary: WebXR layer interface extending XRCompositionLayer for equirectangular projection surfaces with radius and angular extent parameters (stub, implementation pending).

nodes.name: XRFrame
nodes.summary: Core WebXR per-frame state interface providing session reference, predicted display time, viewer/joint pose retrieval, fill methods for joint radii and poses, and hit-test result queries.

nodes.name: XRHand
nodes.summary: WebXR Hand Input iterable interface mapping XRHandJoint keys to XRJointSpace values, with a size attribute and get method for hand joint tracking.

nodes.name: XRHitTestResult
nodes.summary: WebXR Hit Test result interface providing a getPose method to obtain the spatial relationship between a hit-test result and a given base space.

nodes.name: XRHitTestSource
nodes.summary: WebXR Hit Test source interface representing an active hit-test subscription that can be cancelled to stop receiving hit-test results.

nodes.name: XRInputSource
nodes.summary: WebXR input source interface representing a tracked input device with handedness, target ray mode, grip/target-ray spaces, profiles, gamepad support, and optional hand tracking.

nodes.name: XRInputSourceArray
nodes.summary: WebXR iterable collection interface for XRInputSource objects, providing indexed access via getter and a length attribute.

nodes.name: XRInputSourceEvent
nodes.summary: WebXR event interface extending Event, fired on input source state changes with references to the associated XRFrame and XRInputSource.

nodes.name: XRInputSourcesChangeEvent
nodes.summary: WebXR event interface extending Event, fired when input sources are added or removed from a session, carrying the session reference and arrays of added and removed sources.

nodes.name: XRJointPose
nodes.summary: WebXR Hand Input interface extending XRPose with a radius attribute indicating the distance from the joint center to the skin surface.

nodes.name: XRJointSpace
nodes.summary: WebXR Hand Input interface extending XRSpace, associated with a specific XRHandJoint via the jointName attribute for per-joint spatial tracking.

nodes.name: XRLayer
nodes.summary: Root base interface for all WebXR layer types, extending EventTarget with no additional members; serves as the foundation of the layer type hierarchy.

nodes.name: XRLayerEvent
nodes.summary: WebXR Layers event interface extending Event, carrying a reference to the associated XRLayer when layer-related events fire.

nodes.name: XRMediaBinding
nodes.summary: WebXR Layers interface for binding HTMLVideoElement sources to XR layers, with factory methods creating quad, cylinder, and equirect layers from video media.

nodes.name: XRPose
nodes.summary: WebXR pose interface representing a spatial relationship with a rigid transform, optional linear/angular velocity vectors, and an emulated-position boolean flag.

nodes.name: XRProjectionLayer
nodes.summary: WebXR layer interface extending XRCompositionLayer for projection-based rendering with a stubbed ignoreDepthValues attribute (TODO: issue #27493).

nodes.name: XRQuadLayer
nodes.summary: WebXR layer interface extending XRCompositionLayer for flat quadrilateral rendering surfaces with width, height, space, and transform attributes (stub, implementation pending).

nodes.name: XRRay
nodes.summary: WebXR ray interface with two constructor overloads, providing origin, direction, and matrix attributes for spatial ray-casting used in hit-testing.

nodes.name: XRReferenceSpace
nodes.summary: WebXR spatial interface extending XRSpace, providing getOffsetReferenceSpace for creating offset spaces and an onreset event handler for reference-space reset events.

nodes.name: XRReferenceSpaceEvent
nodes.summary: WebXR event interface extending Event, fired on reference space resets with references to the affected XRReferenceSpace and an optional transform.

nodes.name: XRRenderState
nodes.summary: WebXR render state interface holding depth-near/far, field-of-view, baseLayer, and layers configuration attributes that control the rendering pipeline for an XR session.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Rust package manifest for the servo-script crate, declaring the script library path, feature flags (bluetooth, webgpu, webxr, gamepad, etc.), and 140+ workspace dependencies including cryptographic libraries, rendering APIs, and internal Servo components.

nodes.name: build.rs
nodes.summary: Build script that copies generated WebIDL binding files (InterfaceTypes.rs, DomTypeHolder.rs, etc.) and ConcreteBindings folder from script_bindings' OUT_DIR to script's OUT_DIR, working around rust-analyzer path resolution limitations.

nodes.name: aes_cbc_operation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements WebCrypto AES-CBC operations: encrypt (PKCS7 padding, 16-byte IV), decrypt (with padding validation), key generation, import, export, and get-key-length, delegating to aes_common for shared logic.

nodes.name: aes_common.rs
nodes.summary: Shared AES cryptographic operations used by all AES algorithm variants (CBC, CTR, GCM, KW, OCB). Provides key generation (128/192/256-bit), key import in multiple formats (raw, JWK, pkcs8, spki), key export, and JWK field extraction in a single centralized implementation.

nodes.name: aes_ctr_operation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements WebCrypto AES-CTR operations: encrypt and decrypt using 128-bit counter block (big-endian), CTR mode key stream, and delegates key management to aes_common.

nodes.name: aes_gcm_operation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements WebCrypto AES-GCM operations: authenticated encrypt with configurable tag lengths (32-128 bits), decrypt with tag verification, plus key generation/import/export via aes_common.

nodes.name: aes_kw_operation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements WebCrypto AES-KW (Key Wrap) operations per RFC 3394: wrap_key and unwrap_key using AES key-wrapping, plus key generation/import/export via aes_common.

nodes.name: aes_ocb_operation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements AES-OCB (Offset Codebook Mode) per WebCrypto Modern Algorithms proposal: authenticated encrypt/decrypt with tag lengths 64/96/128, IV up to 15 bytes, plus key management via aes_common.

nodes.name: argon2_operation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements Argon2 password-based key derivation per WebCrypto Modern Algorithms proposal. Supports Argon2d, Argon2i, Argon2id variants with configurable parallelism, memory, and passes. Handles key import (raw-secret format only) and get-key-length.

nodes.name: chacha20_poly1305_operation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD operations per WebCrypto Modern Algorithms proposal: encrypt/decrypt with 12-byte nonce, 128-bit authentication tag, and additional authenticated data support. Includes full key generation, import (raw/JWK), export, and JWK support.

nodes.name: cshake_operation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements cSHAKE128 and cSHAKE256 digest operations per NIST SP 800-185. Supports customizable function name and customization strings, variable-length output with bit-level precision (masking excess bits).

nodes.name: ec_common.rs
nodes.summary: Shared elliptic curve cryptographic operations for ECDSA and ECDH. Provides key generation (P-256/P-384/P-521), key import in multiple formats (raw, spki, pkcs8, JWK), key export, public key extraction, and SEC1 point encoding/validation across all supported NIST curves.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses elliptic-curve crate with NistP256/NistP384/NistP521 type parameters and PKCS#8/SEC1 encoding for cross-format key interoperability.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Cargo build script entry point that copies generated WebIDL binding files and the ConcreteBindings directory from script_bindings' build output to script's own output directory, enabling include! macro resolution.

nodes.name: encrypt
nodes.summary: Performs AES-CBC encryption per WebCrypto spec: validates 16-byte IV, applies PKCS7 padding, and encrypts using AES-128/192/256 based on key handle variant.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Performs AES-CBC decryption per WebCrypto spec: validates 16-byte IV, checks ciphertext length is nonzero and multiple of 16, decrypts and removes PKCS7 padding with integrity validation.

nodes.name: generate_key
nodes.summary: Generates a new AES-CBC CryptoKey by delegating to aes_common::generate_key with AesAlgorithm::AesCbc.

nodes.name: import_key
nodes.summary: Imports raw key data as an AES-CBC CryptoKey by delegating to aes_common::import_key.

nodes.name: export_key
nodes.summary: Exports an AES-CBC CryptoKey by delegating to aes_common::export_key.

nodes.name: get_key_length
nodes.summary: Returns the key length for AES-CBC derived key algorithm by delegating to aes_common::get_key_length.

nodes.name: AesAlgorithm
nodes.summary: Enumeration of supported AES algorithm variants: AesCtr, AesCbc, AesGcm, AesKw, AesOcb. Used to route key management operations to the correct algorithm-specific behavior.

nodes.name: generate_key
nodes.summary: Centralized AES key generation for all variants: validates usage constraints (encrypt/decrypt/wrapKey/unwrapKey for AEAD modes, wrapKey/unwrapKey only for KW), generates 128/192/256-bit keys, and creates CryptoKey with appropriate key algorithm metadata.

nodes.name: import_key
nodes.summary: Centralized AES key import supporting raw, JWK, pkcs8, and spki formats. Validates algorithm-specific usage constraints, parses JWK fields (kty, alg, k, key_ops, ext), and constructs CryptoKey handles for 128/192/256-bit keys.

nodes.name: export_key
nodes.summary: Centralized AES key export supporting raw and JWK formats. Extracts key bytes from handles, encodes algorithm-specific JWK properties (alg field based on algorithm and key length), and validates exportability.

nodes.name: get_key_length
nodes.summary: Returns the key length from a SubtleAesDerivedKeyParams, validating that the length is one of 128, 192, or 256 bits.

nodes.name: encrypt
nodes.summary: Performs AES-CTR encryption per WebCrypto spec: validates 16-byte counter and length (1-128), applies CTR mode key stream using Ctr128BE cipher over AES-128/192/256.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Performs AES-CTR decryption per WebCrypto spec: identical to encrypt since CTR mode is symmetric, validates counter and length, applies key stream to recover plaintext.

nodes.name: generate_key
nodes.summary: Generates a new AES-CTR CryptoKey by delegating to aes_common::generate_key with AesAlgorithm::AesCtr.

nodes.name: import_key
nodes.summary: Imports raw key data as an AES-CTR CryptoKey by delegating to aes_common::import_key.

nodes.name: export_key
nodes.summary: Exports an AES-CTR CryptoKey by delegating to aes_common::export_key.

nodes.name: get_key_length
nodes.summary: Returns the key length for AES-CTR derived key algorithm by delegating to aes_common::get_key_length.

nodes.name: encrypt
nodes.summary: Performs AES-GCM authenticated encryption per WebCrypto spec: validates plaintext/IV/AAD length limits, supports configurable tag lengths (32-128 bits), and encrypts using AesGcm AEAD with additional authenticated data.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Performs AES-GCM authenticated decryption per WebCrypto spec: validates tag length, decrypts and verifies authentication tag, returns error on tag mismatch.

nodes.name: generate_key
nodes.summary: Generates a new AES-GCM CryptoKey by delegating to aes_common::generate_key with AesAlgorithm::AesGcm.

nodes.name: import_key
nodes.summary: Imports raw key data as an AES-GCM CryptoKey by delegating to aes_common::import_key.

nodes.name: export_key
nodes.summary: Exports an AES-GCM CryptoKey by delegating to aes_common::export_key.

nodes.name: get_key_length
nodes.summary: Returns the key length for AES-GCM derived key algorithm by delegating to aes_common::get_key_length.

nodes.name: wrap_key
nodes.summary: Performs AES Key Wrap per RFC 3394: validates plaintext is multiple of 64 bits, wraps using KwAes128/192/256 with default Initial Value, returns ciphertext.

nodes.name: unwrap_key
nodes.summary: Performs AES Key Unwrap per RFC 3394: unwraps ciphertext using KwAes128/192/256, validates default Initial Value, returns plaintext in a Zeroizing buffer for secure cleanup.

nodes.name: generate_key
nodes.summary: Generates a new AES-KW CryptoKey by delegating to aes_common::generate_key with AesAlgorithm::AesKw.

nodes.name: import_key
nodes.summary: Imports raw key data as an AES-KW CryptoKey by delegating to aes_common::import_key.

nodes.name: export_key
nodes.summary: Exports an AES-KW CryptoKey by delegating to aes_common::export_key.

nodes.name: get_key_length
nodes.summary: Returns the key length for AES-KW derived key algorithm by delegating to aes_common::get_key_length.

nodes.name: encrypt
nodes.summary: Performs AES-OCB authenticated encryption per WebCrypto Modern Algorithms proposal: validates IV length (max 15 bytes), supports tag lengths 64/96/128, encrypts with Ocb3 AEAD including optional additional authenticated data.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Performs AES-OCB authenticated decryption per WebCrypto Modern Algorithms proposal: validates tag length and AAD length constraints, decrypts and verifies authentication tag via Ocb3 AEAD.

nodes.name: generate_key
nodes.summary: Generates a new AES-OCB CryptoKey by delegating to aes_common::generate_key with AesAlgorithm::AesOcb.

nodes.name: import_key
nodes.summary: Imports raw key data as an AES-OCB CryptoKey by delegating to aes_common::import_key.

nodes.name: export_key
nodes.summary: Exports an AES-OCB CryptoKey by delegating to aes_common::export_key.

nodes.name: get_key_length
nodes.summary: Returns the key length for AES-OCB derived key algorithm by delegating to aes_common::get_key_length.

nodes.name: derive_bits
nodes.summary: Performs Argon2 key derivation per WebCrypto Modern Algorithms proposal: validates parameters (length, version, parallelism, memory, passes), maps algorithm name to Argon2 variant (d/i/id), builds Argon2 context with optional secret and associated data, and hashes the password into output bits.

nodes.name: import_key
nodes.summary: Imports Argon2 password key: accepts only raw-secret format, validates usages are deriveKey/deriveBits only, requires extractable=false, and creates a secret CryptoKey with Argon2Password handle.

nodes.name: get_key_length
nodes.summary: Returns null (None) for Argon2 get-key-length since Argon2 keys have variable length.

nodes.name: encrypt
nodes.summary: Performs ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD encryption per WebCrypto Modern Algorithms proposal: validates 12-byte nonce and optional 128-bit tag length, encrypts with AAD support using ChaCha20Poly1305 cipher.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Performs ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD decryption per WebCrypto Modern Algorithms proposal: validates nonce and tag length, decrypts with authentication tag verification.

nodes.name: generate_key
nodes.summary: Generates a new 256-bit ChaCha20-Poly1305 CryptoKey, validates usage constraints, and sets up key algorithm metadata.

nodes.name: import_key
nodes.summary: Imports ChaCha20-Poly1305 key: supports raw and JWK formats, validates JWK fields (kty, alg, key_ops), and constructs CryptoKey with appropriate key algorithm.

nodes.name: export_key
nodes.summary: Exports ChaCha20-Poly1305 key: supports raw and JWK formats, encodes JWK properties with algorithm identifier.

nodes.name: get_key_length
nodes.summary: Returns the key length (256 bits) for ChaCha20-Poly1305 derived key algorithm.

nodes.name: digest
nodes.summary: Performs cSHAKE128 or cSHAKE256 digest per NIST SP 800-185: extracts output length, function name, and customization from algorithm params, hashes message using extendable-output function (XOF), and masks excess bits for non-byte-aligned output lengths.

nodes.name: EcAlgorithm
nodes.summary: Enumeration of supported elliptic curve algorithms: Ecdsa (sign/verify) and Ecdh (key agreement/deriveBits). Routes key operations to correct usage validation and algorithm behavior.

nodes.name: generate_key
nodes.summary: Generates elliptic curve key pairs for ECDSA or ECDH: validates usages (sign/verify for ECDSA, deriveKey/deriveBits for ECDH), generates P-256/P-384/P-521 secret keys, derives public keys, and creates CryptoKeyPair with appropriate key algorithm metadata.

nodes.name: import_key
nodes.summary: Imports elliptic curve keys in raw, spki, pkcs8, and JWK formats for ECDSA/ECDH. Validates named curve, parses JWK fields (kty, crv, x, y, d, key_ops), decodes PKCS#8/SEC1/SPKI encodings, and validates public key points on the curve.

nodes.name: export_key
nodes.summary: Exports elliptic curve keys to raw, spki, pkcs8, or JWK format: extracts public key point coordinates as SEC1 bytes, encodes private keys as PKCS#8, constructs JWK with crv/x/y/d fields, and validates exportability.

nodes.name: get_public_key
nodes.summary: Extracts the public key from an EC private CryptoKey: derives public key from private key, constructs a new CryptoKey with public key handle and sign/verify or deriveBits usages based on algorithm type.

nodes.name: x_y_to_sec1_bytes
nodes.summary: Concatenates X and Y coordinates into uncompressed SEC1 point encoding (0x04 || x || y).

nodes.name: validate_public_key
nodes.summary: Validates that a SEC1-encoded public key point matches the given private key's public key, returning an OperationError on mismatch.

nodes.name: XRRigidTransform.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRRigidTransform interface of the WebXR Device API. Defines a transform with position, orientation, matrix (as Float32Array), and inverse attributes, gated behind the 'dom_webxr_enabled' preference and CARGO_FEATURE_WEBXR.

nodes.name: XRRigidTransform
nodes.summary: WebXR interface representing an immutable rigid transform with position (DOMPointReadOnly), orientation (DOMPointReadOnly), matrix (Float32Array), and computed inverse transform. Constructed from optional DOMPointInit position and orientation parameters.

nodes.name: XRSession.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRSession interface (extends EventTarget) of the WebXR Device API. Defines session state attributes (visibilityState, frameRate, renderState, inputSources), methods for frame scheduling (requestAnimationFrame, cancelAnimationFrame), reference space requests, hit testing, AR module properties, and event handlers for select/squeeze/visibility/framerate changes. Includes enums for environment blend mode, visibility state, and interaction mode.

nodes.name: XRSessionEvent.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRSessionEvent interface (extends Event) of the WebXR Device API. Defines the session event type carrying a reference to the associated XRSession, plus the XRSessionEventInit dictionary for construction.

nodes.name: XRSpace.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRSpace interface (extends EventTarget) of the WebXR Device API. Represents a virtual coordinate space in the XR world with a currently empty interface (getTransformTo is commented out as a future addition).

nodes.name: XRSubImage.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRSubImage interface of the WebXR Layers API. Represents a viewport region within a layer texture, gated behind 'dom_webxr_layers_enabled' preference.

nodes.name: XRSystem.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRSystem interface (extends EventTarget) of the WebXR Device API. Provides session support checking and request methods. Includes a partial Navigator interface extension adding the 'xr' attribute, a partial XRSystem adding the WebXR Test API 'test' attribute, the XRSessionMode enum (inline/immersive-vr/immersive-ar), and the XRSessionInit dictionary.

nodes.name: XRTest.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRTest interface of the WebXR Test API. Provides methods for simulating device connections, user activation, and disconnecting all fake devices for automated testing. Includes the FakeXRDeviceInit dictionary with view configurations, feature flags, tracking, and world initialization parameters.

nodes.name: XRView.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRView interface of the WebXR Device API. Represents a single view into the XR scene with eye designation (left/right/none), projection matrix, transform, viewport scale control, and AR first-person observer flag. Includes the XREye enum.

nodes.name: XRViewerPose.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRViewerPose interface (extends XRPose) of the WebXR Device API. Represents the viewer's pose with access to the array of XRView objects. Uses 'any' type for views as a workaround for missing FrozenArray support (see servo issue #10427).

nodes.name: XRViewport.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRViewport interface of the WebXR Device API. Represents a rectangular viewport with x, y, width, and height attributes for rendering into a layer.

nodes.name: XRWebGLBinding.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRWebGLBinding interface of the WebXR Layers API. Provides methods for creating WebGL-backed XR layers (projection, quad, cylinder, equirect, cube), plus sub-image retrieval. Includes six dictionaries (XRProjectionLayerInit, XRQuadLayerInit, XRCylinderLayerInit, XREquirectLayerInit, XRCubeLayerInit, XRLayerInit) and two enums (XRTextureType, XRLayerLayout). Gated behind 'dom_webxr_layers_enabled'.

nodes.name: XRWebGLLayer.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRWebGLLayer interface (extends XRLayer) of the WebXR Device API. Provides a WebGL framebuffer for XR rendering with attributes (antialias, depth, stencil, alpha, framebufferScaleFactor), viewport retrieval, framebuffer dimensions, and the static getNativeFramebufferScaleFactor method. Includes the XRWebGLRenderingContext typedef, XRWebGLLayerInit dictionary, and a partial WebGLRenderingContextBase mixin adding makeXRCompatible().

nodes.name: XRWebGLSubImage.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL definition for the XRWebGLSubImage interface (extends XRSubImage) of the WebXR Layers API. Represents a WebGL texture sub-image with color and optional depth-stencil texture references, image index, and texture dimensions. Gated behind 'dom_webxr_layers_enabled'.

nodes.name: XRSession
nodes.summary: WebXR interface extending EventTarget. Manages an active XR session with attributes (visibilityState, frameRate, renderState, inputSources, environmentBlendMode, interactionMode), methods (updateRenderState, requestReferenceSpace, requestAnimationFrame, requestHitTestSource, end), and event handlers (onend, onselect, onsqueeze, oninputsourceschange, onvisibilitychange, onframeratechange, etc.).

nodes.name: XRSessionEvent
nodes.summary: WebXR event interface extending Event. Carries a reference to the associated XRSession via a [SameObject] readonly attribute. Constructed with a DOMString type and XRSessionEventInit dictionary.

nodes.name: XRSystem
nodes.summary: WebXR entry-point interface extending EventTarget. Provides isSessionSupported() for capability detection and requestSession() for initiating XR sessions with specified mode and optional features. Accessible via Navigator.xr through a partial interface extension.

nodes.name: XRTest
nodes.summary: WebXR Test API interface for automated testing. Provides simulateDeviceConnection() to instantiate fake XR devices from FakeXRDeviceInit configs, simulateUserActivation() to trigger user gestures, and disconnectAllDevices() to clean up all simulated devices.

nodes.name: XRView
nodes.summary: WebXR interface representing a single view into the XR scene. Provides eye designation (XREye enum: left/right/none), projection matrix (Float32Array), view transform (XRRigidTransform), optional viewport scale, requestViewportScale() method, and AR first-person observer flag.

nodes.name: XRViewerPose
nodes.summary: WebXR interface extending XRPose. Represents the viewer's pose with access to an array of XRView objects. Uses untyped 'any' for views attribute as a workaround for missing WebIDL FrozenArray support in Servo.

nodes.name: XRViewport
nodes.summary: WebXR interface representing a rectangular viewport region within an XR layer. Exposes x, y, width, and height as readonly long attributes for specifying the rendering area.

nodes.name: XRWebGLBinding
nodes.summary: WebXR Layers API interface for creating WebGL-backed composition layers. Constructed from an XRSession and XRWebGLRenderingContext. Provides factory methods for projection, quad, cylinder, equirect, and cube layers, plus getSubImage/getViewSubImage for texture sub-image retrieval.

nodes.name: XRWebGLLayer
nodes.summary: WebXR interface extending XRLayer. Provides a WebGL framebuffer for XR rendering with configurable attributes (antialias, depth, stencil, alpha, framebufferScaleFactor, ignoreDepthValues). Exposes framebuffer, framebufferWidth/Height, getViewport() method, fixedFoveation control, and a static getNativeFramebufferScaleFactor() method.

nodes.name: XRWebGLSubImage
nodes.summary: WebXR Layers API interface extending XRSubImage. Represents a WebGL texture sub-image with color texture (WebGLTexture), optional depth-stencil texture, image index, and texture dimensions (width/height).

nodes.name: ecdh_operation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Web Crypto SubtleCrypto ECDH (Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman) key agreement operation, supporting P-256 curve for shared secret derivation.

nodes.name: ecdsa_operation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Web Crypto SubtleCrypto ECDSA sign and verify operations for P-256, P-384, and P-521 curves with full key lifecycle management.

nodes.name: ed25519_operation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Web Crypto SubtleCrypto Ed25519 digital signature operations with key generation, import, export, and public key extraction for the Edwards curve.

nodes.name: ed448_operation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Web Crypto SubtleCrypto Ed448 digital signature operations supporting both Ed448 and Ed448ph modes with full key lifecycle management.

nodes.name: hkdf_operation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Web Crypto SubtleCrypto HKDF (HMAC-based Key Derivation Function) operation for deriving cryptographic keys from base key material.

nodes.name: hmac_operation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Web Crypto SubtleCrypto HMAC sign, verify, and key lifecycle operations with support for SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 hash functions.

nodes.name: kangarootwelve_operation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Web Crypto SubtleCrypto KangarooTwelve hash digest operation, a fast extendable-output function (XOF) based on Keccak.

nodes.name: ml_dsa_operation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Web Crypto SubtleCrypto ML-DSA (Module-Lattice Digital Signature Algorithm) post-quantum signing operations with comprehensive key lifecycle management.

nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for `servo-base`, the foundational utility crate for servo. Provides cross-process channels, geometry, IDs, and platform-specific dependencies (mach2 on macOS, libc on Linux, windows-sys on Windows).

nodes.summary: Code-generation script that reads Unicode Blocks.txt and emits a Rust enum `UnicodeBlock` with a trait implementation mapping every `char` to its Unicode block via a match expression. Generated output is used by servo-base for character classification.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for `servo-bluetooth-traits`, the Bluetooth API traits crate providing shared types for Bluetooth functionality in Servo. Depends on servo-base.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for `servo-canvas-traits`, providing shared types and traits for the canvas rendering subsystem including WebGL pipeline definitions. Features include optional bluetooth and webgpu support.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for `servo-constellation-traits`, defining the shared IPC message types and traits for Servo's constellation subsystem that manages pipelines and browsing contexts.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for `servo-devtools-traits`, the devtools traits crate. Provides shared types for the Firefox DevTools Protocol integration, including message types for DOM inspection, CSS, networking, and debugging.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Comprehensive devtools traits module defining all shared data types for Servo's Firefox DevTools Protocol implementation. Contains 47 structs and enums covering page info, console messages, network events (HTTP request/response), DOM mutation tracking, CSS rule inspection, script debugging (breakpoints, frames, environments), timeline markers, and stylesheet management. All types are serde-serializable for IPC transport.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of serde derive macros for IPC serialization. The DevtoolScriptControlMsg enum alone contains 35 variants, making it one of the largest message enums in Servo.

nodes.name: build.rs
nodes.summary: Build script for the embedder traits crate that inspects the Cargo profile via OUT_DIR to set conditional compilation flags (`servo_production` / `servo_do_not_use_in_production`) enabling profile-aware behavior at compile time.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for `servo-embedder-traits`, the embedder API traits crate. Defines shared types for the embedder layer including user content management, input events, WebDriver scripting, theme handling, and content security policy.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for `servo-fonts-traits`, providing shared types and traits for the font rendering subsystem with platform-specific dependencies for Windows (font-loader).

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for `servo-layout-traits`, defining shared types and traits for Servo's layout engine, bridging the layout subsystem with script, constellation, and net components.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for `servo-net-traits`, the networking traits crate. Defines shared types for HTTP request/response handling, cookie management, content security policy, resource threading, and TLS security. Includes a test-util feature flag.

nodes.name: headers.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Fetch Standard's header parsing algorithms including header value extraction, MIME type parsing (as DataUrlMime and standard Mime), forbidden method detection, and nosniff determination. Follows WHATWG Fetch specification for HTTP header list operations and value splitting.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for `paint-api`, the paint API crate. Provides shared types for the cross-process paint subsystem including pinch zoom and snapshot target parameters.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for `servo-profile-traits`, providing shared types and traits for the profiling and memory reporting subsystem. Includes features for time profiling and memory profiling channels.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for `servo-script-traits`, the script subsystem traits crate. Defines all shared message types for the script thread: pipeline spawning, navigation, input events, DOM messages, WebDriver commands, paint worklet errors, and more. Optional feature gates for bluetooth and webgpu.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Central script traits module defining all shared types for Servo's script subsystem. Contains `ScriptThreadMessage` (a 50-variant enum driving all script thread behavior), `NewPipelineInfo` for pipeline creation, `InitialScriptState` for script thread initialization, `ProgressiveWebMetricType` for web performance metrics, and the `Painter` trait for cross-process paint worklet integration.
nodes.languageNotes: The ScriptThreadMessage enum is the backbone of script-thread communication with 50 message variants, making it the single largest message enum in Servo's IPC layer.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for `servo-storage-traits`, providing shared types and traits for the storage subsystem including webstorage thread types and storage task management.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for `webgpu-traits`, providing shared message types for the WebGPU subsystem. Enables GPU compute and rendering message passing between script and the WebGPU server.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for the WebXR API crate, defining shared types and traits for WebXR (virtual/augmented reality) support including session management, frame rendering, and input handling.

nodes.name: ScriptHangAnnotation
nodes.summary: Enum mapping all script event categories to hang annotations, used to tag hang reports with the specific activity that was in progress (e.g., SpawnPipeline, InputEvent, NetworkEvent). Mirrors ScriptEventCategory from the script runtime.

nodes.name: HangMonitorAlert
nodes.summary: Enum for alerts sent from the background hang monitor to the constellation, carrying either a Hang detection or a sampled Profile backtrace.

nodes.name: HangAlert
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing between transient and permanent component hangs. Permanent hangs include an optional HangProfile backtrace for diagnostic purposes.

nodes.name: HangProfile
nodes.summary: Struct holding a backtrace of HangProfileSymbol entries captured when a component hang is detected, used for diagnostic profiling of hung components.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorRegister
nodes.summary: Trait for registering components with the background hang monitor. Provides `register_component` to start monitoring a thread for hangs with configurable timeout thresholds.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorClone
nodes.summary: Trait providing `clone_box` for object-safe cloning of BackgroundHangMonitorRegister trait objects.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitor
nodes.summary: Trait defining proxy methods for communicating with the background hang monitor: `notify_activity` to signal event handling start, `notify_wait` to signal idle waiting, and `unregister` to deregister a component.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorExitSignal
nodes.summary: Trait providing `signal_to_exit`, allowing the background hang monitor to urgently terminate a monitored component that has become unresponsive.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorControlMsg
nodes.summary: Enum for control messages sent to the sampling profiler: `ToggleSampler` with configurable rate and duration, and `Exit` to propagate shutdown signals to monitored components.

nodes.name: DevtoolsControlMsg
nodes.summary: Top-level enum for devtools control messages with three variants: FromChrome (browser UI commands), FromScript (script-side notifications), and ClientExited (devtools client disconnected).

nodes.name: ChromeToDevtoolsControlMsg
nodes.summary: Enum for messages sent from the browser chrome to the devtools server: AddClient, ServerExitMsg, NetworkEvent forwarding, and CollectMemoryReport.

nodes.name: ScriptToDevtoolsControlMsg
nodes.summary: Large enum (16 variants) carrying script-side devtools notifications: NewGlobal, Navigate, ConsoleAPI, framerate ticks, CSS error reporting, page errors, DOM mutations, debugger pause events, and actor creation for sources, frames, and objects.

nodes.name: DebuggerValue
nodes.summary: Enum representing JavaScript debugger values with variants for Void, Null, Boolean, Number, String, and Object (with optional ObjectPreview). Used for evaluate-JS replies and object inspection.

nodes.name: NodeInfo
nodes.summary: Struct containing comprehensive DOM node information for devtools inspection: unique ID, parent, node type/name/value, child count, attributes, shadow DOM mode, display properties, doctype info, and event listener presence.

nodes.name: ComputedNodeLayout
nodes.summary: Struct carrying computed layout information for a DOM node: display, position, z-index, box-sizing, and the full box model (margin, border, padding for all sides plus width/height).

nodes.name: DevtoolScriptControlMsg
nodes.summary: Massive enum (35 variants) representing all commands sent from the devtools server to the script thread: DOM queries (GetRootNode, GetChildren, GetLayout), style inspection (GetComputedStyle, GetStyleSheets), attribute/rule modification, navigation control, breakpoint management, JS evaluation, frame/environment inspection, and timeline markers.

nodes.name: HttpRequest
nodes.summary: Struct capturing HTTP request data for the devtools network panel: URL, method, headers, body, pipeline ID, timestamps, connect/send times, destination, XHR flag, and browsing context ID.

nodes.name: HttpResponse
nodes.summary: Struct capturing HTTP response data for the devtools network panel: headers, status code, body (optional), cache status, pipeline ID, and browsing context ID.

nodes.name: NetworkEvent
nodes.summary: Enum for network-related events reported to devtools: HttpRequest (new request), HttpRequestUpdate (partial update), HttpResponse (completed response), and SecurityInfo (TLS certificate info).

nodes.name: WorkerId
nodes.summary: Newtype struct wrapping a u32 used as a worker identifier in devtools, with Display and FromStr implementations.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Build script entry point that inspects the Cargo OUT_DIR to determine the active build profile. Sets `servo_production` cfg for production builds and `servo_do_not_use_in_production` for all other profiles, enabling compile-time feature gating.

nodes.name: get_value_from_header_list
nodes.summary: Implements the Fetch Standard's header list get algorithm: returns all values for a given header name joined by ', ' (0x2C 0x20), or None if the header is not present.

nodes.name: get_decode_and_split_header_value
nodes.summary: Parses a raw header value byte vector into a vector of decoded strings. Handles quoted strings with backslash escaping, trims HTTP tab/space characters, and splits on comma separators per the Fetch Standard.

nodes.name: extract_mime_type_as_dataurl_mime
nodes.summary: Extracts and constructs a DataUrlMime from the Content-Type header. Parses the MIME essence, charset parameter, and optional boundary parameter, reconstructing a parameter list suitable for data URL MIME representation.

nodes.name: NewPipelineInfo
nodes.summary: Struct carrying all initial data required to create a new Pipeline attached to an existing ScriptThread: parent info, pipeline/browsing context IDs, opener, load data, viewport details, theme, user content manager, and snapshot parameters.

nodes.name: ProgressiveWebMetricType
nodes.summary: Enum representing progressive web performance metrics: FirstPaint, FirstContentfulPaint, LargestContentfulPaint, and TimeToInteractive. Includes an `area` method returning the metric's numerical identifier for IPC serialization.

nodes.name: ScriptThreadMessage
nodes.summary: Massive enum (50 variants) representing all messages that can be sent to a script thread, including pipeline lifecycle (SpawnPipeline, ExitPipeline), input events, navigation, DOM focus, WebDriver commands, animation ticks, CSS error reporting, JS evaluation, storage events, font loading notifications, screenshot readiness, and garbage collection triggers.

nodes.name: ConstellationInputEvent
nodes.summary: Struct wrapping an input event with its hit-test result, pressed mouse buttons, and active keyboard modifiers for delivery from the constellation to the script thread.

nodes.name: InitialScriptState
nodes.summary: Struct holding all channel endpoints and configuration required to initialize a new script thread: namespace request sender, constellation channels (bidirectional), font service, resource threads, storage threads, bluetooth sender, profiler senders, devtools sender, WebGL channel, WebXR registry, paint API, and privileged URL configuration.

nodes.name: Painter

nodes.name: DrawAPaintImageResult
nodes.summary: Struct containing the result of a paint worklet rendering operation: width, height, pixel format, the generated image key, and a list of missing image URLs that could not be rendered.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml

nodes.name: create.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the IndexedDB SQLite schema creation function, adapted from Firefox's DBSchema.cpp. Creates six tables: database, object_store, object_data, object_store_index, index_data, and unique_index_data.
nodes.languageNotes: Port of Mozilla Firefox C++ IndexedDB schema, using raw SQL CREATE TABLE statements executed via rusqlite.

nodes.name: database_model.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the database table model for the IndexedDB SQLite backend. Provides a sea_query Iden-derived Column enum and a Model struct mapping to the database table rows.

nodes.name: encoding.rs
nodes.summary: Implements serialization and deserialization of IndexedDB keys to/from sortable byte sequences. Ported from Firefox Key.cpp, handles Number, Date, String, Binary, and Array key types with IEEE 754 floating-point encoding for sort-preserving byte order.
nodes.languageNotes: Port of Firefox C++ key encoding. Uses wrapping arithmetic for sign-bit manipulation and UTF-16 encoding for string keys, preserving lexicographic sort order in the serialized form.

nodes.name: object_data_model.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the object_data table model for the IndexedDB SQLite backend. Maps object store data rows with object_store_id, key, and data columns, providing TryFrom<&Row> conversion.

nodes.name: object_store_index_model.rs

nodes.name: object_store_model.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the object_store table model for the IndexedDB SQLite backend. Maps object store rows with id, name, optional key_path, and auto_increment columns.

nodes.name: 30-metric-aliases.conf

nodes.name: 40-nonlatin.conf
